pa-license-plates.description: Front plates are not mandatory in Panama so look for the rear ones, which are short, white plates with a turquoise band across the top.

pa-googlecar.title: Visible car
pa-googlecar.description: Panama's Street View car is a large white pickup truck. It is either fully visible or totally hidden, leaving a large blur.

pr-language.title: Spanish signs
pr-language.description: Signage throughout Puerto Rico is predominantly in Spanish despite being part of the USA.

pr-walmart.title: American influence
pr-walmart.description: US retail chains like Walmart are common in Puerto Rico. A useful differentiator from other Latin American territories where such stores are absent.

pr-speed-signs.title: Max speed
pr-speed-signs.description: Puerto Rican speed limit signs have the same design as in the US but are written entirely in Spanish.

ca-mailbox.title: Communal mailboxes
ca-mailbox.description: Shared mailbox units are a regular sight in Canada.

us-imperial.title: Imperial units
us-imperial.description: The US uses the imperial system, meaning speed and distances will be displayed in miles.

us-triangular-signs.title: Triangular signs
us-triangular-signs.description: Triangular yellow signs reading 'No Passing Zone' are found only in the US.

us-road-lines.title: Road lines
us-road-lines.description: US roads have yellow center lines (usually double) and white outer lines.

vi-lhd.title: Left hand drive
vi-lhd.description: The Virgin Islands is the only US territory that drives on the left side of the road.

vi-googlecar.title: Visible car
vi-googlecar.description: A white or red truck street view car will be visible while exploring the US Virgin Islands.

vi-license-plates.title: Blue plates
vi-license-plates.description: The Virgin Islands uses two types of blue plates. Dark blue and turquoise.

al-bollards.title: Albanian bollard
al-bollards.description: Bollards in Albania are white with a black, slanted top. The top features a red reflector on the front and a gray on the back.

al-license-plates.title: Albanian plates
al-license-plates.description: License plates in Albania come in two forms. One with a red strip to the left, and one featuring blue strips on each end.

al-rruga.title: Street name
al-rruga.description: The Albanian word for street is rruga.

ad-license-plates.title: Andorran plates
ad-license-plates.description: License plates in Andorra lacks the blue eu-strip. Instead an orange dot can be found on the left side.

ad-mountains.title: Mountains all around
ad-mountains.description: Andorra is located in a mountain range between France and Spain, this leads to mountains being visible at all times.

at-einbahn.title: One way street
at-einbahn.description: Signs for one way streets in Austria say 'EINBAHN'.

at-bollards.title: Black top bollards
at-bollards.description: Austrian roadside bollards are white with a black cap, often with a small rounded knob at the very top.

be-bollards.title: Belgian bollard
be-bollards.description: The standard Belgian bollard is white and has a yellow rectangular reflector on the front and a white one on the back.

be-license-plates.title: Red text
be-license-plates.description: Belgian number plates stand out for their red-colored characters, a tint that remains visible even through blurring.

be-crossing-signs.title: Crossing signs
be-crossing-signs.description: Belgian crossing signs show a figure with a square-shaped head walking over two horizontal dotted lines.

bg-language.title: Cyrillic
bg-language.description: Bulgaria writes primarily in Cyrillic, though Latin transliterations appear on many signs.

bg-bins.title: Metal waste bins
bg-bins.description: It is common to spot these metal waste bins in Bulgaria.

hr-domain.title: Web domain
hr-domain.description: The top domain in Croatia is .HR, originating from the local name for the country, Hrvatska.

hr-bollards.title: Croatian bollard
hr-bollards.description: Croatian bollards feature either red or white reflectors that sit on top of a black section.

hr-license-plates.title: Croatian plates
hr-license-plates.description: Older license plates in Croatia are fully white. Newer ones feature a blue strip on the left.

cz-bollards.title: Double orange
cz-bollards.description: The Czech bollards feature two orange reflectors stacked on top of each other on traffic side

cz-doublepole.title: Double poles
cz-doublepole.description: Round concrete utility poles are common in Czechia. They are frequently installed in joined pairs.

cz-number-signs.title: Street numbers
cz-number-signs.description: Building numbers in Czechia are displayed on small blue or red signs lined with a thin white border.

mk-license-plates.title: Red block
mk-license-plates.description: North Macedonian plates are white and can have the blue EU strip. A noticeable red block sits near the left side.

no-fjord.title: Beautiful views
no-fjord.description: Fjords are a common sight along the Norwegian coast.

no-yellow-signs.title: Directional signs
no-yellow-signs.description: In Norway directional signs are yellow with a thin black outline.

no-white-signs.title: White signs
no-white-signs.description: Regulatory traffic signs in Norway feature a red border on a white background.

dk-road-lines.title: White lines
dk-road-lines.description: All road markings in Denmark are white. Double center lines appear frequently on Danish roads.

dk-bollards.title: Danish bollard
dk-bollards.description: The standard Danish bollard is white with a yellow reflector and a prominent dark orange band, a combination exclusive to Denmark.

dk-streetname.title: Street names
dk-streetname.description: The suffix 'vej', Danish for 'road', appears at the end of most street names.

dk-framed-signs.title: Framed direction signs
dk-framed-signs.description: Danish wayfinding signs are mounted low to the ground inside a distinctive tubular metal frame. They appear in red or blue.

dk-flat-nature.title: Flat landscape
dk-flat-nature.description: The terrain across Denmark is predominantly flat.

ee-license-plates.title: EU plates
ee-license-plates.description: Estonia uses standard EU-plates. White plates with a blue strip on the left.

ee-small-signs.title: Kilometer markers
ee-small-signs.description: Small blue signs with numbers on them can be found in Estonia. They are placed perpendicular to the road.

ee-crossing-signs.title: Crossing signs
ee-crossing-signs.description: Estonian pedestrian crossing signs feature three black stripes.

ee-bollards.title: Estonian bollard
ee-bollards.description: Estonian bollards have a rounded profile. The front carries a rectangular reflector while the back has two circular ones, in either white or orange.

fo-notree.title: No trees
fo-notree.description: The Faroe Islands are virtually devoid of natural tree growth, the vegetation consists almost entirely of grass and low shrubs.

fo-rugged-nature.title: Rugged landscape
fo-rugged-nature.description: The terrain on Faroe Islands is defined by sweeping fjords bordered by steep, green mountains.

fo-bollards.title: Small bollards
fo-bollards.description: The bollards on Faroe Islands are yellow and quite small.

fi-outer-road.title: White outer lines
fi-outer-road.description: Outer road lines on Finnish roads are always continuous solid white lines, never dashed.

fi-snowpole.title: Snow poles
fi-snowpole.description: Finland has orange snow poles with a single narrow white band positioned close to the top.

fi-street-names.title: Street names
fi-street-names.description: Finnish road names typically end in 'tie' (road) or 'katu' (street).

fi-crossing-signs.title: Crossing signs
fi-crossing-signs.description: Finnish pedestrian crossing signs feature five black stripes.

fr-streetname.title: Street names
fr-streetname.description: 'Rue' is the standard French word for street and appears on countless signs throughout the country.

fr-ladderpole.title: Ladder poles
fr-ladderpole.description: France have concrete utility poles with a series of step-like indentations. This design is referred to as a 'ladder pole'.

de-bollards.title: German bollard
de-bollards.description: German bollards are black-and-white posts fitted with white or pale grey reflectors, switching to orange at intersections.

de-mailbox.title: Yellow mailboxes
de-mailbox.description: German mailboxes are yellow and carry the black 'Deutsche Post' horn logo.

de-one-way-signs.title: One-way streets
de-one-way-signs.description: One-way street signs carrying the full word 'Einbahnstraße' are exclusive to Germany.

de-windturbine.title: Wind turbines
de-windturbine.description: Wind turbines are encountered across Germany with considerably greater frequency than in any other European nation.

gi-bigrock.title: The rock of Gibraltar
gi-bigrock.description: A massive limestone mountain towers Gibraltar and is visible from virtually everywhere.

gi-vehicles.title: Right hand traffic
gi-vehicles.description: Despite being a British territory, Gibraltar drives on the right, the opposite of the UK mainland.

gr-license-plates.title: Greek plates
gr-license-plates.description: Greek license plates are either fully white or follow the standard EU layout with a blue strip on the left side.

gr-woodpole.title: Wooden poles
gr-woodpole.description: Most Greek utility poles are made of timber, often seen in a dark brown tone.

gr-bollards.title: Greek bollard
gr-bollards.description: Bollards in Greece are white and have a red, square reflector on the front, and a white on the back.

gr-directional-signs.title: Directional signs
gr-directional-signs.description: Arrow-shaped blue signs carry place names in two scripts: Greek lettering in yellow and a Latin transliteration in white underneath.

hu-holy-pole.title: Holey poles
hu-holy-pole.description: Hungary has concrete utility poles with narrow rectangular holes that continue all the way to the ground.

hu-language.title: Hungarian language
hu-language.description: Hungarian is characterized by heavy use of acute accents and notably long words. Keep an eye out for the unique letters Ű and Ő.

hu-bollards.title: Hungarian bollard
hu-bollards.description: Bollards in Hungary are black and white. They have a wedge-like profile and a red reflector on the front, and a white on the back.

is-license-plates.title: Icelandic plates
is-license-plates.description: Icelandic license plates do not feature the blue EU strip on the left. A yellow dot can sometimes be seen in the middle.

is-bollards.title: Yellow bollards
is-bollards.description: Icelandic bollards are yellow and have a single white reflector. They appear on virtually every stretch of rural road across the country.

is-barren-nature.title: Barren landscape
is-barren-nature.description: Much of the Icelandic countryside is devoid of trees, covered instead by dark grey soil composed largely of volcanic rock.

is-language.title: Icelandic language
is-language.description: Written Icelandic can be recognized by a frequent use of accents and unique letters such as ð and þ.

ie-license-plates.title: Irish plates
ie-license-plates.description: Irish license plates are white and have the standard EU blue strip on the left.

ie-yield-signs.title: Give way signs
ie-yield-signs.description: In Ireland the triangular give way signs say 'YIELD'.

ie-language.title: Bilingual signs
ie-language.description: Irish road signs usually carry text in both English and Irish.

it-bollards.title: Italian bollard
it-bollards.description: Bollards in Italy are white with a black top. They have a red reflector on the front and a white on the back.

it-street-name.title: Street names
it-street-name.description: The Italian word for street is 'Via'.

it-road-lines.title: Outer lines
it-road-lines.description: Solid white outer lines without any center lines is a common sight in Italy.

lv-license-plates.title: Latvian plates
lv-license-plates.description: Latvia have standard white EU plates with a blue strip on the left.

lv-small-signs.title: Kilometer markers
lv-small-signs.description: Small blue signs with numbers on them can be found in Latvia. They are placed parallel to the road.

lv-bollards.title: Latvian bollard
lv-bollards.description: Latvian bollards are white and feature a vertical reflector on the front and two round ones on the back. The reflectors can be white or orange.

li-valley.title: Rhine valley
li-valley.description: As Liechtenstein is located in a valley, mountains are always visible, especially to the east.

li-bollards.title: Liechtenstein bollard
li-bollards.description: Bollards in Liechtenstein are rounded with a round top. They are black and white and feature a vertical reflector on the front.

li-license-plates.title: White plates
li-license-plates.description: Liechtenstein license plates are black with white text with an emblem slightly to the left. It will appear as black or red.

li-lowcam.title: Low cam
li-lowcam.description: All Liechtenstein imagery is captured with a low-mounted camera.

lt-license-plates.title: Lithuanian plates
lt-license-plates.description: Lithuania has standard white EU plates with a blue strip on the left.

lt-small-signs.title: Kilometer markers
lt-small-signs.description: Small blue signs with numbers on them can be found in Lithuania. They are placed in pairs, with a 45 degree angle to the road.

lt-bollards.title: Lithuanian bollard
lt-bollards.description: Lithuanian bollards are whites and have a rectangular orange reflector on the front and a white on the back.

lu-architecture.title: Black roofs
lu-architecture.description: Luxembourg houses typically have dark slate roofs and plain, undecorated walls painted white, grey, or in pastel tones.

lu-directional-signs.title: Directional signs
lu-directional-signs.description: Luxembourg's directional signs are yellow with a thin black outline. They are arrow shaped and often feature a number in a red box .

lu-white-signpost.title: White signposts
lu-white-signpost.description: In Luxembourg, nearly all road signs are mounted on white signposts.

xx-general.title: General
xx-general.description: English is one of Malta's official languages and is widely used on signage and storefronts.

mt-small.title: Small island
mt-small.description: Roads on Malta tend to be only one or two lanes wide due to the island's small size and low population.

mc-rich.title: Rich microstate
mc-rich.description: Monaco is a tiny, but rich country. Buildings look fancy and streets are clean.

mc-urban.title: City only
mc-urban.description: There are no rural areas in Monaco, everything is urban.

mc-boats.title: Boat parking
mc-boats.description: Monaco has multiple marinas filled with fancy boats. There is even street view out on the water.

me-nature.title: Mountainous landscape
me-nature.description: The landscape in Montenegro is very mountainous. The mountains tend to be lush and covered in green vegetation.

me-license-plates.title: Red dot
me-license-plates.description: Montenegrin license plates are white and feature a blue strip on the left. They also have red coat of arms close to the center.

me-bollards.title: Montenegrin bollard
me-bollards.description: Montenegrin bollards are white with a red reflector on the front, a white reflector on the back, and a black top.

me-rifts.title: Cosmic encounters
me-rifts.description: Image artifacts in the sky are common to see in Montenegro. These are referred to as 'Rifts' by the community.

pt-license-plates.title: Blue and yellow
pt-license-plates.description: Portugal have white plates with a blue EU strip on the left and, on most vehicles, a yellow strip on the right, which is unique to Portugal.

pt-streetname.title: Street names
pt-streetname.description: The Portuguese word for street is "Rua", visible on nearly every street sign.

pt-hunt.title: Hunting signs
pt-hunt.description: Portuguese hunting signs are diamond or rectangular in a red-and-white color scheme.

ro-trees.title: Painted trees
ro-trees.description: In Romania, trees and utility poles frequently have their lower sections painted white.

ro-waystone.title: Waystones
ro-waystone.description: Romanian road waystones are very common. They are white and can have red or blue accents. They have the road number on the side.

sm-crosswalk.title: Blue crosswalks
sm-crosswalk.description: San Marino has crosswalks with big areas painted in blue.

sm-towers.title: Three towers
sm-towers.description: San Marino is situated around a mountain with three peaks each with a medieval tower. They are visible from many locations in the country.

sm-license-plates.title: Small plates
sm-license-plates.description: San Marino license plates are compact and white with blue lettering, noticeably shorter than the standard European format.

sm-italian.title: Italian influence
sm-italian.description: San Marino uses the Italian language and much of its infrastructure is identical to Italy.

rs-bollards.title: Off center
rs-bollards.description: Serbian bollards come in several designs, but most share an off-centered reflector.

rs-web.title: Web domain
rs-web.description: The top domain in Serbia is .RS, originating from its full name Republic of Serbia.

sk-bollards.title: Double orange
sk-bollards.description: Slovak bollards have two orange reflectors on the front and a white reflector on the back.

sk-arrow-signs.title: Small arrows
sk-arrow-signs.description: Slovak direction signs have a blue background and small white arrows.

sk-streetsigns.title: Street signs
sk-streetsigns.description: In Slovakia, street name signs are commonly white with blue lettering and a thin red border.

si-nature.title: Hilly landscape
si-nature.description: Slovenia's terrain is generally very hilly and heavily forested, with occasional patches of agriculture.

si-bollards.title: Slovenian bollard
si-bollards.description: Slovenian bollards are white with a black top. The front reflector is bright red and the back reflector is white.

si-house-signs.title: House numbers
si-house-signs.description: Slovenian house number plates are typically red with white text.

si-architecture.title: Alpine architecture
si-architecture.description: Slovenian buildings are alpine-inspired with light-colored walls and dark wooden details.

es-hunting.title: Hunting signs
es-hunting.description: In Catalonia you can find black and white signs indicating hunting grounds.

es-crossing-signs.title: Many stripes
es-crossing-signs.description: On the Spanish crossing signs there are eight stripes, the most in all of Europe.

se-overwalkplace.title: Pedestrian crossing
se-overwalkplace.description: Swedish pedestrian signs feature four stripes on the crossing. A variant with a female silhouette also exists.

se-bollards.title: Swedish bollard
se-bollards.description: Swedish bollards are black-and-white, usually fitted with a grey reflector. Near intersections, the reflectors are often orange.

se-snowpole.title: Snow poles
se-snowpole.description: Swedish snow poles are typically orange with a tall white reflector positioned slightly above the midpoint.

tr-bollards.title: Turkish bollard
tr-bollards.description: Turkish bollards are flat, white, and rectangular with a red reflector on the front. A way to remember is to think of their flag which is also red and white.

tr-minaret.title: Tall towers
tr-minaret.description: It is common in Turkey to see minarets.

tr-speciali.title: A special letter
tr-speciali.description: The written Turkish language has a special 'i', which will have a dot even when capitalized.

ua-license-plates.title: Ukrainian plates
ua-license-plates.description: License plates in Ukraine have a strip on the left that is blue and yellow, a representation of their flag.

ua-paintedstuff.title: Blue and yellow
ua-paintedstuff.description: In Ukraine you may come across various pieces of infrastructure painted blue and yellow, matching the color of their flag.

uk-license-plates.title: White and yellow
uk-license-plates.description: In the UK, license plates are yellow in the rear and white on the front.

uk-crossing-signs.title: No sign
uk-crossing-signs.description: Pedestrian crossings in the UK do not feature signs, instead there are striped poles with a light at the top.

uk-terraced.title: Terraced houses
uk-terraced.description: Two-story, terraced buildings are extremely common in the UK.

qa-bubble-antenna.title: Bubble antenna
qa-bubble-antenna.description: In Qatar, the Google car usually features an antenna with a small bubble on top.

no-chevrons.title: Black and yellow
no-chevrons.description: In Norway, you can see black and yellow chevrons.

im-oldcam.title: Old camera
im-oldcam.description: The images on Isle of Man were captured by an older camera, identifiable by lower resolution and a big bottom blur.

im-license-plates.title: Red stripe
im-license-plates.description: License plates on Isle of Man are yellow on the rear and white in the front. They have a red strip to the left.

im-shrubs.title: Yellow flowers
im-shrubs.description: Gorse shrubs, bushes with vivid yellow flowers, are commonly found on Isle of Man.

je-oldcamera.title: Old camera
je-oldcamera.description: The images on Jersey were captured by an older camera, identifiable by lower resolution and a big bottom blur.

je-license-plates.title: White and yellow
je-license-plates.description: License plates on Jersey are yellow on the rear and white in the front, with a small red emblem to the left. This can be hard to see.

je-language.title: Worlds collide
je-language.description: Even though Jersey is part of the UK, French can be seen written on signs and many locations have French names.

je-booths.title: Yellow booth
je-booths.description: Phone booths on Jersey are painted yellow.

as-nature.title: Tropical
as-nature.description: The vegetation on American Samoa is tropical. All land not used by humans is covered in dense jungle.

as-vehicles.title: Black truck
as-vehicles.description: On the main American Samoa island, Tutuila, the rear of a rusted black pickup truck is visible.

gu-green-signs.title: Green signs
gu-green-signs.description: Street signs in Guam are green.

gu-reflector.title: Road reflectors
gu-reflector.description: Roads on Guam are often studded with an unusually high amount of road reflectors.

gu-pole.title: Heavy poles
gu-pole.description: Utility poles on Guam are almost always made of concrete and tend to be noticeably thick.

mp-pole.title: Wooden poles
mp-pole.description: The Northern Mariana Islands uses wooden utility poles.

mp-road-signs.title: Blue signs
mp-road-signs.description: On Northern Mariana Islands street signs are blue.

mp-nature.title: Fancy trees
mp-nature.description: Flame Trees appear on the Northern Mariana Islands. Its wide crown covered in bright red flowers is easy to spot.

pe-red-bricks.title: Red bricks
pe-red-bricks.description: Red brick buildings are common near Lake Titicaca in Peru and resemble architecture frequently seen in western Bolivia.

dk-general.title: General
dk-general.description: Red brick houses are very common in Denmark. Roofs often have orange, black or brown tiles.

id-west-sumatra.title: West Sumatra
id-west-sumatra.description: West Sumatra has these unique boat-shaped roofs.

ae-general.title: United Arab Emirates
ae-general.description: Houses in residential areas are usually made out of this light-colored stone.

fi-red-houses.title: Red Houses
fi-red-houses.description: Along Sweden and Norway, Finland has many of these distinct red houses with white trim.

se-red-houses.title: Red houses
se-red-houses.description: In the countryside Sweden, along with Norway and Finland, has many of these distinct red houses with white trim.

tr-snow-poles.title: Black-Orange-White Snow Poles
tr-snow-poles.description: Turkish snow marker poles are alternating black, orange, and white and fitted with red reflectors.

pl-zabka.title: Thousands of stores
pl-zabka.description: The convenience store Żabka can be found pretty much everywhere in Poland.

br-phone-numbers.title: Phone numbers
br-phone-numbers.description: Phone numbers in Brazil often include an area code as a separate two-digit prefix.

id-white-sections.title: White sections
id-white-sections.description: Most Indonesian license plates are black with white letters, often appearing as three white segments through blur.

us-speed-signs.title: Speed signs
us-speed-signs.description: Speed signs in the US say ‘Speed Limit’.

pl-bollards.title: Red bollards
pl-bollards.description: Polish bollards have a red band around them, with a red reflector on the front and a white one on the back.

ar-double-poles.title: Double poles
ar-double-poles.description: Double poles with horizontal bars are commonly found in Argentina.

fr-road-numbers.title: Road numbers
fr-road-numbers.description: Yellow road signs beginning with “D” are specific to France and are often placed above direction signs or on town entry signs.

us-yield-signs.title: Yield signs
us-yield-signs.description: US yield signs are triangles with a red border and the word “YIELD” on a white background.

jp-pole-marking.title: Pole markings
jp-pole-marking.description: Japanese poles often have thin, vertical yellow lines on a black section towards the bottom.

jp-bollards.title: Japanese bollard
jp-bollards.description: Japanese bollards are white and have a circular reflector on the top.

ru-crosswalk.title: Crosswalk
ru-crosswalk.description: Crosswalks in Russia use alternating white and yellow stripes instead of the solid white stripes seen in most other countries.

py-chevron-signs.title: Yellow on black
py-chevron-signs.description: Chevrons in Paraguay are yellow with black arrows.

py-googlecar.title: Visible car
py-googlecar.description: Coverage in Paraguay has a visible Google car. It appears to be black or silver.

py-road-lines.title: Road lines
py-road-lines.description: Paraguay tends to have white solid outer lines and a single dashed yellow center line.

py-dark-signs.title: Dark signs
py-dark-signs.description: The backs of road signs in Paraguay are usually quite dark.

py-cross-signs.title: Crosses
py-cross-signs.description: In Paraguay some smaller road signs have a design that resembles a cross on their backside.

no-kiwi.title: Kiwi
no-kiwi.description: Kiwi is a store chain that only exists in Norway.

ch-bollards.title: Swiss bollards
ch-bollards.description: Bollards in Switzerland can either be cylindrical with a round top or have a rounded rectangular shape with a slanted top. Both are black and white with a rectangular reflector on the front.

my-jalan.title: Street abbreviation
my-jalan.description: In Malaysia it is common to see the abbreviation JLN for Jalan, the local word for street.

id-jalan.title: Street abbreviation
id-jalan.description: In Indonesia, it is common to see the abbreviation JL for Jalan, the local word for street.

mx-bollards.title: Mexican bollards
mx-bollards.description: Mexico uses round, white bollards with a black base.

au-road-lines.title: Road lines
au-road-lines.description: Australia generally uses all white road lines.

lt-sign-borders.title: Thin outline
lt-sign-borders.description: Lithuanian signs have a red border with a thin white outline.

al-highway-shield.title: Highway shields
al-highway-shield.description: Alaskan highway shields feature the Big Dipper constellation in the lower-left corner.

al-tree-appearance.title: Slim trees
al-tree-appearance.description: Alaskan trees tend to be slimmer with narrower foliage.

al-snow-capped-mountain.title: Snow-capped mountains
al-snow-capped-mountain.description: Tall, snowy mountain peaks are visible in much of Alaska.

al-subarctic-tundra-interior.title: Subarctic interior
al-subarctic-tundra-interior.description: Interior and northern Alaska have sparse undergrowth and short trees.

al-alexander-archipelago.title: Alexander Archipelago
al-alexander-archipelago.description: Towns in the panhandle's island chain sit among steep, densely forested mountains with mostly wooden buildings.

al-anchorage-suburb.title: Anchorage suburbs
al-anchorage-suburb.description: Suburban areas around Anchorage feature wide roads, shopping districts, and visible mountain ranges.

al-aspen-tree.title: Aspen trees
al-aspen-tree.description: Quaking aspens with white bark and round leaves grow at lower elevations in interior and south-central Alaska.

al-agricultural-field.title: Agricultural fields
al-agricultural-field.description: Farming in Alaska occurs mainly in the Matanuska Valley and Kenai Peninsula.

al-trans-alaska-pipeline.title: Trans-Alaska Pipeline
al-trans-alaska-pipeline.description: The pipeline is often visible from main roads and is a strong identifier.

as-country-flag.title: Country Flag
as-country-flag.description: The national flag of American Samoa is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ad-autumn-foliage.title: Autumn colours
ad-autumn-foliage.description: Much of the Andorran coverage was captured in October, so autumn colours on deciduous trees are common.

ad-snow-pole.title: Snow poles
ad-snow-pole.description: Wooden snow poles in various colours line roads throughout Andorra.

ad-catalan-language.title: Catalan language
ad-catalan-language.description: Andorra's official language is Catalan, recognisable by 'i' meaning 'and' and words that often end in consonants.

ad-street-name-carrer.title: Carrer street signs
ad-street-name-carrer.description: Street signs in Andorra use the Catalan word 'carrer' for street.

ad-kilometre-marker-cg-cs.title: Kilometre markers
ad-kilometre-marker-cg-cs.description: Andorran roads have distance markers labelled with CG or CS route numbers.

ad-yellow-guardrail-reflector.title: Yellow guardrail reflectors
ad-yellow-guardrail-reflector.description: In Andorra, guardrails have yellow reflectors.

ad-bollard.title: Bollards
ad-bollard.description: Andorran bollards are white with square orange reflectors and appear along main highways.

ad-traffic-cone.title: Traffic cones
ad-traffic-cone.description: Traffic cones in Andorra are yellow and turquoise-green.

ad-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian crossing signs
ad-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Andorran pedestrian crossing signs show a crosswalk with 8 stripes.

ad-country-flag.title: Andorran flag
ad-country-flag.description: A vertical tricolour of blue, yellow, and red, sometimes with the coat of arms in the centre.

aq-snow-ice.title: Snow and ice
aq-snow-ice.description: The vast majority of Antarctica is blanketed in snow and ice.

aq-dark-soil.title: Dark soil
aq-dark-soil.description: Wherever bare ground is exposed in Antarctica, it is consistently dark in colour.

aq-penguin.title: Penguins
aq-penguin.description: Penguins appear in parts of the Antarctic coverage and confirm the southern hemisphere.

aq-ross-island-western-tip.title: Ross Island Western Tip
aq-ross-island-western-tip.description: The western tip features very dark, barren rocky ground with almost no snow cover.

aq-ross-island-cabin.title: Ross Island Cabin
aq-ross-island-cabin.description: A small wooden cabin with a grey metal roof south of the island's eastern tip.

aq-mcmurdo-interior-tripod.title: McMurdo Interior Tripods
aq-mcmurdo-interior-tripod.description: Tripod footage inside several of McMurdo Station's buildings.

aq-mcmurdo-wooden-hut.title: McMurdo Wooden Hut
aq-mcmurdo-wooden-hut.description: A small wooden hut on the station's eastern side with interior tripod footage.

aq-mcmurdo-ice-trekker.title: McMurdo Ice Trekker
aq-mcmurdo-ice-trekker.description: A trekker walks across a frozen surface surrounded by machinery southeast of the station.

aq-mainland-dry-valley.title: Mainland Dry Valleys
aq-mainland-dry-valley.description: A surreal, barren landscape of empty valleys on the mainland west of Ross Island.

aq-south-mcmurdo-black-island-area.title: South of McMurdo
aq-south-mcmurdo-black-island-area.description: A wide, snowy expanse with scattered low hills south of McMurdo Station.

aq-country-flag.title: Country Flag
aq-country-flag.description: The national flag of Antarctica is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ar-wooden-utility-pole.title: Wooden Utility Poles
ar-wooden-utility-pole.description: Timber poles appear frequently, including unique A-frame variants.

ar-road-line.title: Road Lines
ar-road-line.description: Roads have broken white centre lines, solid double yellow dividers, or both.

ar-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
ar-kilometre-marker.description: Distance markers have a white body with a dark band showing the route number.

ar-guardrail-reflector.title: Guardrail Reflectors
ar-guardrail-reflector.description: Guardrails have rectangular yellow and red reflectors.

ar-wide-open-landscape.title: Wide Open Landscape
ar-wide-open-landscape.description: Vast, open terrain with sparse vegetation and few people.

ar-city-taxi-map.title: City Taxi Map
ar-city-taxi-map.description: Distinctive taxi colour schemes help pinpoint locations in multiple cities.

ar-western-mountain.title: Western Mountains
ar-western-mountain.description: The far west is dominated by mountainous terrain along the Andes.

ar-chaco-formosa.title: Chaco and Formosa
ar-chaco-formosa.description: Sandy ground covered with dense low shrubs and trees.

ar-grassland-plantation.title: Grassland with Plantations
ar-grassland-plantation.description: Open grasslands dotted with scattered clusters of planted trees.

ar-buenos-aires-lake.title: Buenos Aires Lakes
ar-buenos-aires-lake.description: Roadside ponds and small bodies of water appear in Buenos Aires province.

ar-san-luis-red-pavement.title: San Luis Red Pavement
ar-san-luis-red-pavement.description: San Luis roads have a reddish surface bordered by tall Argentine needle-grass.

ar-central-south-barren-flat.title: Central South Barren Flats
ar-central-south-barren-flat.description: Central-south Argentina features empty, level plains with almost no vegetation.

ar-tierra-del-fuego-grass.title: Tierra del Fuego Grass
ar-tierra-del-fuego-grass.description: Low, windswept grass with few shrubs signals Tierra del Fuego or SE Santa Cruz.

ar-entre-rios-tree-plantation.title: Entre Ríos Tree Plantations
ar-entre-rios-tree-plantation.description: Argentina's densest commercial tree plantations are in Entre Ríos.

ar-tierra-del-fuego-beech-forest.title: Tierra del Fuego Beech Forests
ar-tierra-del-fuego-beech-forest.description: Dense beech forests are a hallmark of Tierra del Fuego.

ar-caranday-wax-palm.title: Caranday Wax Palm
ar-caranday-wax-palm.description: Caranday Wax Palm has short fan-shaped fronds and grows in sparse stands, mainly in Formosa.

ar-caranday-palm-trithrinax.title: Caranday Palm (Trithrinax)
ar-caranday-palm-trithrinax.description: Trithrinax campestris has compact fan leaves and a trunk with dried leaf matter, native to Córdoba highlands.

ar-macaw-palm.title: Macaw Palm
ar-macaw-palm.description: Macaw Palm has narrow, slender fronds with a pointed crown, wild in Formosa, Chaco, and Misiones.

ar-cardon-cactus.title: Cardón Cactus
ar-cardon-cactus.description: Cardón cactus grows at high altitudes in Catamarca, Tucumán, Salta, and Jujuy with branching candelabra shape.

ar-toothpick-cactus.title: Toothpick Cactus
ar-toothpick-cactus.description: Stetsonia coryne is a tall, branched cactus with long slender spines, found between Catamarca and Córdoba.

ar-wild-sunflower.title: Wild Sunflowers
ar-wild-sunflower.description: Wild sunflowers grow commonly along roadsides in Salta, Jujuy, and Tucumán.

ar-calden-tree.title: Caldén Tree
ar-calden-tree.description: Caldén is a medium-large deciduous tree with fine foliage and twisting branches, found mainly in La Pampa.

ar-pampas-grass.title: Pampas Grass
ar-pampas-grass.description: Pampas grass has tall clustered stems topped by soft white plumes, defining the Pampas region.

ar-sugarcane-field.title: Sugarcane Fields
ar-sugarcane-field.description: Sugarcane cultivation is concentrated in Tucumán, with smaller pockets in Salta and Jujuy.

ar-sorghum-field.title: Sorghum Fields
ar-sorghum-field.description: Sorghum crops have deep red seed heads, common in Santa Fe, Córdoba, and Buenos Aires.

ar-corn-field.title: Corn Fields
ar-corn-field.description: Maize cultivation is widespread in northern Argentina, especially Córdoba, Buenos Aires, and Santiago del Estero.

ar-sunflower-field.title: Sunflower Fields
ar-sunflower-field.description: Commercial sunflower fields are most common in southern Chaco, with some in Buenos Aires and southern Córdoba.

ar-hook-pole-la-rioja-mendoza.title: Hook Poles
ar-hook-pole-la-rioja-mendoza.description: Wooden utility poles with curved hook shapes appear only in La Rioja and Mendoza.

ar-mendoza-single-insulator-pole.title: Mendoza Single Insulator Poles
ar-mendoza-single-insulator-pole.description: Mendoza utility poles have one insulator mounted on the side.

ar-tucuman-pole-sticker.title: Tucumán Pole Stickers
ar-tucuman-pole-sticker.description: Tucumán utility poles often have tall white stickers with multi-digit numbers.

ar-cordoba-road-marker.title: Córdoba Road Markers
ar-cordoba-road-marker.description: Córdoba provincial roads have distinctive kilometre markers unique to the province.

ar-la-pampa-t-junction-sign.title: La Pampa T-Junction Signs
ar-la-pampa-t-junction-sign.description: La Pampa T-junctions have rectangular yellow signs with route numbers, arrows, and a chevron base.

ar-jujuy-red-brick.title: Jujuy Red Bricks
ar-jujuy-red-brick.description: Bolivia-style red brick construction appears in western Jujuy province.

ar-pink-trumpet-tree.title: Pink Trumpet Trees
ar-pink-trumpet-tree.description: Pink-flowering lapacho trees line streets in northern Salta towns like Orán and Tartagal.

ar-jujuy-salt-pan.title: Jujuy Salt Pans
ar-jujuy-salt-pan.description: Expansive salt flats are concentrated in Jujuy province.

ar-cordoba-western-mountain.title: Córdoba Western Mountains
ar-cordoba-western-mountain.description: Moderate-elevation mountains lie west of Córdoba city, lower than the Andes.

ar-horse-trekker-san-juan.title: Horse Trekker
ar-horse-trekker-san-juan.description: Horseback Trekker coverage exists in southwest San Juan province.

ar-mendoza-vineyard.title: Mendoza Vineyards
ar-mendoza-vineyard.description: Vineyards backed by mountains and plains indicate Mendoza wine region near the city.

ar-bahia-blanca-grass-hill.title: Bahía Blanca Grass Hills
ar-bahia-blanca-grass-hill.description: Rolling grassy hills near the coast northeast of Bahía Blanca in southern Buenos Aires.

ar-monkey-puzzle-tree.title: Monkey Puzzle Trees
ar-monkey-puzzle-tree.description: Monkey puzzle trees grow in western Neuquén, especially along provincial road 23.

ar-rp25-snow-coverage.title: RP25 Snow Coverage
ar-rp25-snow-coverage.description: The eastern section of the RP25 in Santa Cruz province has coverage captured under heavy snowfall.

ar-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ar-country-flag.description: The national flag of Argentina is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

au-gum-tree-eucalyptus.title: Gum Trees (Eucalyptus)
au-gum-tree-eucalyptus.description: Eucalyptus trees have pale bark and rounded clumps of foliage.

au-white-road-line.title: White Road Lines
au-white-road-line.description: Australian roads use white markings almost everywhere.

au-rumble-strip.title: Rumble Strips
au-rumble-strip.description: Edge lines sometimes have short white bars across them as rumble strips.

au-chevron.title: Chevrons
au-chevron.description: Curve warning chevrons appear as white arrows on black or black arrows on yellow.

au-green-directional-sign.title: Green Directional Signs
au-green-directional-sign.description: Green signs with white arrows indicate nearby towns and distances.

au-speed-limit-sign.title: Speed Limit Signs
au-speed-limit-sign.description: Speed limits show a black number in a red ring on a white rectangular plate.

au-state-licence-plate.title: State Licence Plates
au-state-licence-plate.description: Every Australian state has its own plate design, often visible even through blur.

au-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
au-phone-area-code.description: Australian phone numbers have an eight-digit number preceded by a two-digit state area code.

au-state-bus-stop.title: State Bus Stops
au-state-bus-stop.description: Bus stop designs differ by state and appear frequently in urban areas.

au-stobie-pole-south-australia.title: Stobie Poles
au-stobie-pole-south-australia.description: The distinctive steel-and-concrete Stobie pole with a trident or rotated-E top is a hallmark of South Australia.

au-rusty-metal-pole-northern-territory.title: Rusty Metal Poles
au-rusty-metal-pole-northern-territory.description: Northern Territory has rusted metal utility poles peppered with holes along their length.

au-concrete-pole-victoria.title: Concrete Poles
au-concrete-pole-victoria.description: Concrete utility poles are heavily concentrated in Victoria.

au-trident-pole-top-wa-vic.title: Trident Pole Tops
au-trident-pole-top-wa-vic.description: Pole tops shaped like a three-pronged fork appear in Western Australia and Victoria.

au-upward-angled-coil-pole-top-queenslan.title: Upward-Angled Coil Pole Tops
au-upward-angled-coil-pole-top-queenslan.description: Queensland electricity poles often have side-mounted coils that tilt upwards.

au-three-coil-pole-top-victoria.title: Three-Coil Pole Tops
au-three-coil-pole-top-victoria.description: Victoria pole tops typically carry three round coils: one vertical at the peak and one on each side.

au-l-shaped-metal-crossbar-tasmania.title: L-Shaped Metal Crossbars
au-l-shaped-metal-crossbar-tasmania.description: Tasmanian utility poles often feature a slim metal arm bent at a right angle forming an L-shape at the top.

au-blue-pole-sticker-queensland.title: Blue Pole Stickers
au-blue-pole-sticker-queensland.description: Round blue stickers appear on power poles throughout Queensland.

au-black-pole-marking.title: Black Pole Markings
au-black-pole-marking.description: Queensland power poles bear distinctive black printed marks, often with angled numbers.

au-olive-green-possum-guard.title: Olive-Green Possum Guards
au-olive-green-possum-guard.description: Tasmania's electricity poles have olive-green possum guards.

au-green-pole-base.title: Green Pole Bases
au-green-pole-base.description: Western Australian timber utility poles often have green-painted lower sections.

au-short-bollard-reflector.title: Short Bollard Reflectors
au-short-bollard-reflector.description: Bollards with reflectors shorter than standard are concentrated in Queensland and South Australia.

au-brown-bottom-bollard.title: Brown-Bottom Bollards
au-brown-bottom-bollard.description: Western Australian road bollards often have a brown-painted lower portion.

au-black-white-striped-bollard.title: Black-and-White Striped Bollards
au-black-white-striped-bollard.description: Bollards with alternating black and white horizontal stripes are found only in Western Australia.

au-black-yellow-bollard.title: Black-and-Yellow Bollards
au-black-yellow-bollard.description: Black and yellow bollards are a Queensland-only design.

au-flat-signpost.title: Flat Signposts
au-flat-signpost.description: South Australia and Western Australia occasionally use flat-profile sign poles instead of cylindrical ones.

au-yellow-signpost-sticker.title: Yellow Signpost Stickers
au-yellow-signpost-sticker.description: Northern Territory signposts sometimes have small yellow adhesive labels.

au-fluorescent-sign-border.title: Fluorescent Sign Borders
au-fluorescent-sign-border.description: Queensland road signs often have bright fluorescent borders.

au-red-no-stopping-sign.title: Red 'No Stopping' Signs
au-red-no-stopping-sign.description: New South Wales uses red 'No Stopping' signs; other states use white.

au-text-based-parking-sign.title: Text-Based Parking Signs
au-text-based-parking-sign.description: ACT 'No Stopping' and 'No Parking' signs include the restriction spelled out in words.

au-white-directional-sign.title: White Directional Signs
au-white-directional-sign.description: Tasmania is the only state with white-background directional road signs.

au-c-road.title: 'C' Roads
au-c-road.description: Route numbers prefixed with 'C' appear in Victoria and Tasmania.

au-25kmh-school-zone.title: 25 km/h School Zones
au-25kmh-school-zone.description: South Australia enforces a 25 km/h school zone speed limit.

au-130kmh-speed-limit.title: 130 km/h Speed Limit
au-130kmh-speed-limit.description: Northern Territory has a 130 km/h speed limit.

au-thin-keep-left-sign.title: Thin 'Keep Left' Signs
au-thin-keep-left-sign.description: A slimmer 'Keep Left' sign without an arrow appears in NSW, Queensland, and Northern Territory.

au-dark-green-property-marker.title: Dark Green Property Markers
au-dark-green-property-marker.description: Roadside property markers in dark green are a Western Australian feature.

au-white-property-marker.title: White Property Markers
au-white-property-marker.description: South Australia uses white property markers along its roads.

au-guardrail-ending.title: Guardrail Endings
au-guardrail-ending.description: Guardrails in NSW and the ACT end with a black stripe on a yellow field.

au-blue-circle-hydrant-pole.title: Blue Circle Hydrant Poles
au-blue-circle-hydrant-pole.description: Victoria has white hydrant indicator poles topped with a red segment and a blue circle.

au-red-top-fire-hydrant.title: Red-Top Fire Hydrants
au-red-top-fire-hydrant.description: Fire hydrants in Victoria have red-painted caps.

au-reddish-orange-soil.title: Reddish-Orange Soil
au-reddish-orange-soil.description: Western Australian ground, especially near Perth, has a reddish-orange colour.

au-brush-plant.title: Brush Plants
au-brush-plant.description: Brush-type shrubs with dense, bushy growth are common in Western Australia.

au-termite-mound.title: Termite Mounds
au-termite-mound.description: Tall brown rough, spiky structures rising from the earth are termite mounds, mainly in the Northern Territory.

au-dry-shrubland.title: Dry Shrubland
au-dry-shrubland.description: From Warramboo in SA to Madura in WA, arid scrub, broad-canopied gum trees, and sandy orange earth define the landscape.

au-green-golden-field.title: Green and Golden Fields
au-green-golden-field.description: A belt of verdant or golden farmland runs from southern Yorke Peninsula to Echuca with broad gum canopies.

au-tropical-north-queensland.title: Tropical North Queensland
au-tropical-north-queensland.description: Far north Queensland's coastal strip is lushly tropical with palms and dense dark green foliage.

au-sugarcane-field.title: Sugarcane Fields
au-sugarcane-field.description: Sugarcane fields dominate northern Queensland's tropical agricultural landscape.

au-inland-nsw-landscape.title: Inland NSW Landscape
au-inland-nsw-landscape.description: Interior NSW is flat with red soil and dry pale-green scrub, becoming more temperate and hilly near borders.

au-tasmania-landscape.title: Tasmania Landscape
au-tasmania-landscape.description: Tasmania has green rolling hills, roadside eucalyptus, and densely forested hilly interiors.

au-rare-google-car-snorkel.title: Rare Cars and Snorkels
au-rare-google-car-snorkel.description: Cars with snorkels, protecting engines during water crossings, are concentrated in NSW and the ACT.

au-mount-gambier-sa.title: Mount Gambier
au-mount-gambier-sa.description: Mount Gambier in SA features chalky white soil and large pine plantations.

au-kangaroo-island-sa.title: Kangaroo Island
au-kangaroo-island-sa.description: Kangaroo Island has scrubby low eucalyptus, bushy undergrowth, and orange-tinted soil.

au-brisbane-street-sign.title: Brisbane Street Signs
au-brisbane-street-sign.description: Brisbane City Council street signs have a distinctive design.

au-sydney-street-sign.title: Sydney Street Signs
au-sydney-street-sign.description: City of Sydney street signs have a unique design.

au-country-flag.title: Country Flag
au-country-flag.description: The national flag of Australia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ro-licence-plates.title: Licence Plates
ro-licence-plates.description: Romanian plates are long, white European style with a single blue strip on the left.

ro-romanian-language.title: Romanian Language
ro-romanian-language.description: A Romance language with unique diacritics Ă/ă, Ș/ș, and Ț/ț.

ro-round-concrete-poles.title: Round Concrete Poles
ro-round-concrete-poles.description: Round concrete utility poles are widespread in Romania.

ro-large-yellow-pole-stickers.title: Large Yellow Pole Stickers
ro-large-yellow-pole-stickers.description: Extremely large yellow stickers wrapped around poles, usually with the town or city name.

ro-inverted-triangle-pole-tops.title: Inverted-Triangle Pole Tops
ro-inverted-triangle-pole-tops.description: Some pole tops have two support bars forming an upside-down triangle shape.

ro-short-dash-edge-lines.title: Short-Dash Edge Lines
ro-short-dash-edge-lines.description: Outer road lines made of short dashes with narrow gaps are a clue for Romania.

ro-thick-centre-lines.title: Thick Centre Lines
ro-thick-centre-lines.description: Centre road lines are often noticeably thicker than average.

ro-directional-signs.title: Directional Signs
ro-directional-signs.description: Blue arrow-shaped signs with white borders, often showing road numbers in red or blue.

ro-town-entry-signs.title: Town Entry Signs
ro-town-entry-signs.description: Yellow speed limit signs with city skylines, often with a white sign below showing the town name.

ro-black-sign-backs.title: Black Sign Backs
ro-black-sign-backs.description: The back sides of road signs in Romania are often painted black.

ro-chevrons.title: Chevrons
ro-chevrons.description: Red-on-white chevron boards frequently have a yellow frame.

ro-bollards.title: Bollards
ro-bollards.description: Thin white bollards with a red vertical strip near the top.

ro-thick-border-yield-sign.title: Thick-Border Yield Sign
ro-thick-border-yield-sign.description: Romanian yield signs have an extremely thick red border and thin white outline.

ro-architecture.title: Architecture
ro-architecture.description: Single-family stone houses painted in pastels with orange tile or grey metal roofs; some have painted square tile walls.

ro-carpathian-mountains.title: Carpathian Mountains and Hills
ro-carpathian-mountains.description: Tall forested mountains and hills dominate the centre and north of Romania.

ro-agricultural-lowlands.title: Agricultural Lowlands
ro-agricultural-lowlands.description: Flat or rolling agricultural land dominates southern and eastern Romania.

ro-haystack.title: Haystacks
ro-haystack.description: Haystacks with a stick driven straight through them are common in rural areas.

ro-dacia-car.title: Dacia Cars
ro-dacia-car.description: Dacia is the dominant car brand in Romania with over a quarter of all vehicles.

ro-elevation-map.title: Elevation Map
ro-elevation-map.description: Tallest mountains run through the centre and north; south and west are flat.

ro-flat-agricultural-plain.title: Flat Agricultural Plains
ro-flat-agricultural-plain.description: Flat agricultural land in south and west, with hills or mountains visible to the north or south respectively.

ro-orange-tiled-roofs-western-half.title: Orange Tiled Roofs
ro-orange-tiled-roofs-western-half.description: Villages with nearly all houses having orange tiled roofs are likely in the western half.

ro-metal-fake-tile-roofs-eastern-half.title: Metal or Fake-Tile Roofs
ro-metal-fake-tile-roofs-eastern-half.description: Villages dominated by metal or plastic fake-tiled roofs tend to be in the eastern half.

ro-hungarian-style-village.title: Hungarian-Style Villages
ro-hungarian-style-village.description: Near the Hungarian border, villages have long straight streets with evenly spaced single-storey houses and orange tiled roofs.

ro-bilingual-hungarian-signs.title: Bilingual Hungarian Signs
ro-bilingual-hungarian-signs.description: Common in central counties Covasna, Harghita, and Mureș, and near the Hungarian border.

ro-decorated-wooden-gates-maramures.title: Decorated Wooden Gates
ro-decorated-wooden-gates-maramures.description: Elaborately carved wooden gates are characteristic of Maramureș in the north.

ro-sunflower-field.title: Sunflower Fields
ro-sunflower-field.description: Sunflower crops are primarily found in the far east and far west.

ro-danube-delta-boat-trekker.title: Danube Delta Boat Trekker
ro-danube-delta-boat-trekker.description: A trekker aboard a green boat navigates small overgrown canals in a flat landscape in the far east.

ro-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ro-country-flag.description: The national flag of Romania is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

us-one-way-sign.title: One-Way Signs
us-one-way-sign.description: US one-way signs are black rectangles with white arrows and 'ONE WAY' text.

us-parking-sign.title: Parking Signs
us-parking-sign.description: US parking signs are white metal with colored text specifying parking rules.

us-green-highway-exit-sign.title: Green Highway Exit Signs
us-green-highway-exit-sign.description: Large green signs with white text mark exits and distances on US highways.

us-blue-highway-service-sign.title: Blue Highway Service Signs
us-blue-highway-service-sign.description: Blue signs near exits list services like food, fuel, and lodging.

us-rectangular-junction-sign.title: Rectangular Junction Signs
us-rectangular-junction-sign.description: Rectangular signs with arrows mark junctions in the US.

us-fibre-optic-cable-marker.title: Fibre Optic Cable Markers
us-fibre-optic-cable-marker.description: White-and-orange fibre optic cable markers are nearly exclusive to the US.

us-orange-construction-barrel.title: Orange Construction Barrels
us-orange-construction-barrel.description: Orange plastic barrels with white stripes and black bases mark US construction zones.

us-rumble-strip.title: Rumble Strips
us-rumble-strip.description: Perpendicular pavement indentations, rumble strips, line edges and lane dividers on US highways.

us-manufactured-trailer-home.title: Manufactured (Trailer) Homes
us-manufactured-trailer-home.description: Small rectangular manufactured homes on blocks are common in rural America.

us-baptist-church.title: Baptist Churches
us-baptist-church.description: Baptist churches are widespread across the US, especially in the Southern Plains and Southeast.

us-us-only-gas-station-chain.title: US-Only Gas Station Chains
us-us-only-gas-station-chain.description: Fuel brands such as Exxon, Sunoco, Citgo, Speedway, Marathon, Phillips 66, 76, Conoco and Sinclair only operate in the US.

us-overhead-traffic-light-bar.title: Overhead Traffic Light Bars
us-overhead-traffic-light-bar.description: Long metal arms with traffic lights, street signs, and highway signs extend over intersections throughout the US and Canada.

us-thin-metal-sign-post.title: Thin Metal Sign Posts
us-thin-metal-sign-post.description: Thin metal sign posts, either perforated or U-shaped, are standard in North America.

us-wooden-utility-pole.title: Wooden Utility Poles
us-wooden-utility-pole.description: North America predominantly uses wooden utility poles.

us-raised-insulator-pole.title: Raised Insulators on Poles
us-raised-insulator-pole.description: Insulators raised slightly above the top of poles are characteristic of the US and Canada.

us-long-nose-semi-truck.title: Long-Nose Semi-Trucks
us-long-nose-semi-truck.description: North American semi-trucks have a long nose with the engine ahead of the cab.

us-water-tower.title: Water Towers
us-water-tower.description: Tall water towers are common in US and Canadian towns, often displaying town or state names.

us-missing-front-plate.title: Missing Front Plates
us-missing-front-plate.description: About 22 states require only a rear plate; vehicles without front plates likely come from these states.

us-alaska-licence-plate.title: Alaska Licence Plate
us-alaska-licence-plate.description: Gold plate with dark blue characters and a yellow-gold background, easy to identify even blurred.

us-alabama-licence-plate.title: Alabama Licence Plate
us-alabama-licence-plate.description: White plate with maroon-red characters and a large circular county emblem on the left side.

us-arkansas-licence-plate.title: Arkansas Licence Plate
us-arkansas-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters, red 'Arkansas' header, and a white diamond shape in the centre.

us-arizona-licence-plate.title: Arizona Licence Plate
us-arizona-licence-plate.description: Plate shows a desert sunset gradient with blue, red, and white bands behind the characters.

us-california-licence-plate.title: California Licence Plate
us-california-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters and a subtle red blob on top.

us-colorado-licence-plate.title: Colorado Licence Plate
us-colorado-licence-plate.description: White plate with green mountain scenery across the top and 'COLORADO' in green.

us-connecticut-licence-plate.title: Connecticut Licence Plate
us-connecticut-licence-plate.description: Connecticut plates appear with a blue upper area and a pale lower area.

us-district-columbia-licence-plate.title: District of Columbia Licence Plate
us-district-columbia-licence-plate.description: White plate with blue characters, red 'WASHINGTON DC' header, and a small red DC flag emblem.

us-delaware-licence-plate.title: Delaware Licence Plate
us-delaware-licence-plate.description: Dark blue plate with gold-yellow characters, distinctive even when blurred.

us-florida-licence-plate.title: Florida Licence Plate
us-florida-licence-plate.description: White plate with green characters and two orange blobs from the orange graphic in the centre.

us-georgia-licence-plate.title: Georgia Licence Plate
us-georgia-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and a peach emblem in the centre.

us-hawaii-licence-plate.title: Hawaii Licence Plate
us-hawaii-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and a rainbow arc across the upper portion.

us-iowa-licence-plate.title: Iowa Licence Plate
us-iowa-licence-plate.description: Blue-gradient plate with a county name across the top and dark characters on a lighter centre.

us-idaho-licence-plate.title: Idaho Licence Plate
us-idaho-licence-plate.description: White plate with a red 'IDAHO' header, dark characters, and a blue band along the bottom.

us-illinois-licence-plate.title: Illinois Licence Plate
us-illinois-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters on a reddish-maroon background with the Lincoln silhouette.

us-indiana-licence-plate.title: Indiana Licence Plate
us-indiana-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters and a simple, clean design.

us-kansas-licence-plate.title: Kansas Licence Plate
us-kansas-licence-plate.description: Light blue plate with dark blue characters and 'KANSAS' header text.

us-kentucky-licence-plate.title: Kentucky Licence Plate
us-kentucky-licence-plate.description: White plate with blue characters, a dark blue band along the bottom, and 'KENTUCKY' in blue at top.

us-louisiana-licence-plate.title: Louisiana Licence Plate
us-louisiana-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and a red 'LOUISIANA' header, often with a fleur-de-lis or pelican emblem.

us-massachusetts-licence-plate.title: Massachusetts Licence Plate
us-massachusetts-licence-plate.description: White plate with red characters and 'Massachusetts' in blue script at the top.

us-maryland-licence-plate.title: Maryland Licence Plate
us-maryland-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and the Maryland flag pattern along the bottom edge.

us-maine-licence-plate.title: Maine Licence Plate
us-maine-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters and a green 'Maine' header with a chickadee emblem.

us-michigan-licence-plate.title: Michigan Licence Plate
us-michigan-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters and a blue 'MICHIGAN' header stripe across the top.

us-minnesota-licence-plate.title: Minnesota Licence Plate
us-minnesota-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and a broad teal-blue band across the top edge.

us-missouri-licence-plate.title: Missouri Licence Plate
us-missouri-licence-plate.description: Blue-tinted plate with white characters and a red emblem in the centre.

us-mississippi-licence-plate.title: Mississippi Licence Plate
us-mississippi-licence-plate.description: White plate with muted blue-grey characters and a very plain design.

us-montana-licence-plate.title: Montana Licence Plate
us-montana-licence-plate.description: Deep blue plate with white characters and a scenic background showing mountains and sky.

us-north-carolina-licence-plate.title: North Carolina Licence Plate
us-north-carolina-licence-plate.description: White plate with blue characters, a red 'FIRST IN FLIGHT' header, and a small Wright Brothers airplane silhouette.

us-north-dakota-licence-plate.title: North Dakota Licence Plate
us-north-dakota-licence-plate.description: Light blue plate with dark characters and a brown-orange landscape band along the bottom.

us-nebraska-licence-plate.title: Nebraska Licence Plate
us-nebraska-licence-plate.description: White plate with blue characters and a simple, plain design.

us-new-hampshire-licence-plate.title: New Hampshire Licence Plate
us-new-hampshire-licence-plate.description: White plate with green characters and 'NEW HAMPSHIRE' in green.

us-new-jersey-licence-plate.title: New Jersey Licence Plate
us-new-jersey-licence-plate.description: Pale yellow-cream plate with dark blue characters and a yellow gradient band across the top.

us-new-mexico-licence-plate.title: New Mexico Licence Plate
us-new-mexico-licence-plate.description: Turquoise-teal plate with yellow characters and a red-orange Zia sun symbol in the centre.

us-nevada-licence-plate.title: Nevada Licence Plate
us-nevada-licence-plate.description: Light blue-grey plate with dark characters and a dark blue-silver mountain range at the top.

us-new-york-licence-plate.title: New York Licence Plate
us-new-york-licence-plate.description: Gold-yellow plate with dark blue characters and a bright yellow background.

us-ohio-licence-plate.title: Ohio Licence Plate
us-ohio-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and a colourful scenic background including blue sky and green fields.

us-oklahoma-licence-plate.title: Oklahoma Licence Plate
us-oklahoma-licence-plate.description: Yellow-gold plate with dark characters and a dark scenic or emblem graphic.

us-oregon-licence-plate.title: Oregon Licence Plate
us-oregon-licence-plate.description: Blue plate with yellow characters and a tree or scenic graphic in the centre.

us-pennsylvania-licence-plate.title: Pennsylvania Licence Plate
us-pennsylvania-licence-plate.description: Blue-and-white plate with a broad blue header band and a yellow footer.

us-rhode-island-licence-plate.title: Rhode Island Licence Plate
us-rhode-island-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters and a small red anchor or sticker.

us-south-carolina-licence-plate.title: South Carolina Licence Plate
us-south-carolina-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters, a blue header, and a dark palmetto tree emblem in the centre.

us-south-dakota-licence-plate.title: South Dakota Licence Plate
us-south-dakota-licence-plate.description: Blue plate with dark characters and a scenic Mt. Rushmore or landscape background.

us-tennessee-licence-plate.title: Tennessee Licence Plate
us-tennessee-licence-plate.description: Dark blue-purple plate with lighter characters and a deep blue-violet background.

us-texas-licence-plate.title: Texas Licence Plate
us-texas-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and 'TEXAS' in dark header text.

us-utah-licence-plate.title: Utah Licence Plate
us-utah-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters and a small American flag graphic on the left.

us-virginia-licence-plate.title: Virginia Licence Plate
us-virginia-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters and an orange county sticker in the upper-left corner.

us-vermont-licence-plate.title: Vermont Licence Plate
us-vermont-licence-plate.description: Green plate with white characters and a solid green background.

us-washington-licence-plate.title: Washington Licence Plate
us-washington-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters, a red 'WASHINGTON' header band, and a dark blue flag emblem in the upper-right.

us-wisconsin-licence-plate.title: Wisconsin Licence Plate
us-wisconsin-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark characters, a red 'WISCONSIN' header, and colourful small stickers at the top.

us-west-virginia-licence-plate.title: West Virginia Licence Plate
us-west-virginia-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters and a dark blue 'WEST VIRGINIA' header band.

us-wyoming-licence-plate.title: Wyoming Licence Plate
us-wyoming-licence-plate.description: Yellow plate with dark characters and a bucking bronco silhouette on the left.

us-interstate-us-highway-numbering.title: Interstate and US Highway Numbering
us-interstate-us-highway-numbering.description: Even-numbered Interstates and U.S. Highways generally run east–west, while odd-numbered routes run north–south. The two systems use opposite numbering directions geographically.

us-three-digit-area-codes.title: Three-Digit Area Codes
us-three-digit-area-codes.description: US phone numbers begin with a three-digit area code mapping to specific regions.

us-alabama-state-flag.title: Alabama State Flag
us-alabama-state-flag.description: A crimson St Andrew's cross (saltire) on a white field.

us-alaska-state-flag.title: Alaska State Flag
us-alaska-state-flag.description: Eight gold stars forming the Big Dipper and Polaris on a dark blue field.

us-arizona-state-flag.title: Arizona State Flag
us-arizona-state-flag.description: Alternating red and yellow rays radiating from a copper star on a blue lower half.

us-arkansas-state-flag.title: Arkansas State Flag
us-arkansas-state-flag.description: A white diamond with a blue border and four blue stars on a red field.

us-california-state-flag.title: California State Flag
us-california-state-flag.description: A grizzly bear walking on green grass above 'California Republic' on a white field with a red stripe.

us-colorado-state-flag.title: Colorado State Flag
us-colorado-state-flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white, and blue with a red 'C' encircling a gold disc.

us-connecticut-state-flag.title: Connecticut State Flag
us-connecticut-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state coat of arms featuring three grapevines and a ribbon.

us-delaware-state-flag.title: Delaware State Flag
us-delaware-state-flag.description: A colonial blue field with a buff diamond containing the state coat of arms and date 1787.

us-florida-state-flag.title: Florida State Flag
us-florida-state-flag.description: A red saltire on a white field with the state seal in the centre.

us-georgia-state-flag.title: Georgia State Flag
us-georgia-state-flag.description: Three red and white stripes with a blue canton containing 13 stars around the state coat of arms.

us-hawaii-state-flag.title: Hawaii State Flag
us-hawaii-state-flag.description: Eight horizontal stripes of white, red, and blue with the Union Jack in the canton.

us-idaho-state-flag.title: Idaho State Flag
us-idaho-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state seal and a red band reading 'State of Idaho'.

us-illinois-state-flag.title: Illinois State Flag
us-illinois-state-flag.description: A white field with the state seal showing an eagle holding a shield with stars and stripes.

us-indiana-state-flag.title: Indiana State Flag
us-indiana-state-flag.description: A blue field with a gold torch surrounded by 19 gold stars and the word 'Indiana'.

us-iowa-state-flag.title: Iowa State Flag
us-iowa-state-flag.description: Three vertical stripes of blue, white, and red with an eagle carrying a blue streamer.

us-kansas-state-flag.title: Kansas State Flag
us-kansas-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with the state seal above a sunflower and the word 'Kansas'.

us-kentucky-state-flag.title: Kentucky State Flag
us-kentucky-state-flag.description: A navy blue field with the state seal showing two men embracing and the words 'Commonwealth of Kentucky'.

us-louisiana-state-flag.title: Louisiana State Flag
us-louisiana-state-flag.description: A blue field with a pelican feeding her young above a ribbon reading 'Union, Justice, Confidence'.

us-maine-state-flag.title: Maine State Flag
us-maine-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state coat of arms showing a moose, pine tree, and a farmer and sailor.

us-maryland-state-flag.title: Maryland State Flag
us-maryland-state-flag.description: Quartered with the black and gold Calvert arms and the red and white Crossland arms.

us-massachusetts-state-flag.title: Massachusetts State Flag
us-massachusetts-state-flag.description: A white field with the state coat of arms showing a Native American beneath a blue shield and gold star.

us-michigan-state-flag.title: Michigan State Flag
us-michigan-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms featuring an elk, moose, and an eagle above a shield.

us-minnesota-state-flag.title: Minnesota State Flag
us-minnesota-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with the state seal featuring a farmer, a Native American riding into the sunset, and the motto.

us-mississippi-state-flag.title: Mississippi State Flag
us-mississippi-state-flag.description: A magnolia blossom on a blue field with red and gold stripes, featuring the words 'In God We Trust'.

us-missouri-state-flag.title: Missouri State Flag
us-missouri-state-flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white, and blue with the state coat of arms in the centre surrounded by 24 stars.

us-montana-state-flag.title: Montana State Flag
us-montana-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state seal showing mountains, Great Falls, and a plough and pick above a ribbon reading 'Oro y Plata'.

us-nebraska-state-flag.title: Nebraska State Flag
us-nebraska-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state seal in gold and silver showing a steamboat, train, and a blacksmith.

us-nevada-state-flag.title: Nevada State Flag
us-nevada-state-flag.description: A cobalt blue field with a silver star, sagebrush sprays, and a gold banner reading 'Battle Born'.

us-new-hampshire-state-flag.title: New Hampshire State Flag
us-new-hampshire-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state seal showing the frigate Raleigh surrounded by a laurel wreath.

us-new-jersey-state-flag.title: New Jersey State Flag
us-new-jersey-state-flag.description: A buff field with the state coat of arms showing two goddesses flanking a blue shield.

us-new-mexico-state-flag.title: New Mexico State Flag
us-new-mexico-state-flag.description: A red Zia sun symbol on a yellow field.

us-new-york-state-flag.title: New York State Flag
us-new-york-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms featuring Liberty and Justice flanking a shield with ships and a sun.

us-north-carolina-state-flag.title: North Carolina State Flag
us-north-carolina-state-flag.description: A blue union with a white star, 'N' and 'C', and two dates, flanked by horizontal red and white stripes.

us-north-dakota-state-flag.title: North Dakota State Flag
us-north-dakota-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with an eagle holding an olive branch and arrows, with a fan of stars above.

us-ohio-state-flag.title: Ohio State Flag
us-ohio-state-flag.description: A unique burgee shape with red and white stripes, a blue triangle containing a white 'O' with a red centre.

us-oklahoma-state-flag.title: Oklahoma State Flag
us-oklahoma-state-flag.description: A blue field with an Osage warrior's buffalo-hide shield decorated with eagle feathers and a calumet crossed with an olive branch.

us-oregon-state-flag.title: Oregon State Flag
us-oregon-state-flag.description: A navy blue field with gold text 'State of Oregon' and the state seal on the front; a beaver on the reverse.

us-pennsylvania-state-flag.title: Pennsylvania State Flag
us-pennsylvania-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state coat of arms showing two horses flanking a shield with a ship, plough, and wheat sheaves.

us-rhode-island-state-flag.title: Rhode Island State Flag
us-rhode-island-state-flag.description: A white field with a gold anchor surrounded by 13 gold stars and a blue ribbon reading 'Hope'.

us-south-carolina-state-flag.title: South Carolina State Flag
us-south-carolina-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with a white palmetto tree and crescent moon in the upper left.

us-south-dakota-state-flag.title: South Dakota State Flag
us-south-dakota-state-flag.description: A sky blue field with the state seal surrounded by a gold sun and the text 'South Dakota. The Mount Rushmore State'.

us-tennessee-state-flag.title: Tennessee State Flag
us-tennessee-state-flag.description: A red field with a blue circle containing three white stars, bordered by a white ring, and a blue bar at the fly edge.

us-texas-state-flag.title: Texas State Flag
us-texas-state-flag.description: A vertical blue stripe with a white star, and two horizontal stripes of white and red.

us-utah-state-flag.title: Utah State Flag
us-utah-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with the state seal showing a beehive, sego lilies, and an eagle above the date 1896.

us-vermont-state-flag.title: Vermont State Flag
us-vermont-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state coat of arms featuring a pine tree, sheaves, and a deer head, with mountains in the background.

us-virginia-state-flag.title: Virginia State Flag
us-virginia-state-flag.description: A blue field with the state seal showing Virtus standing over a defeated tyrant, with the motto 'Sic Semper Tyrannis'.

us-washington-state-flag.title: Washington State Flag
us-washington-state-flag.description: A dark green field with the state seal showing a portrait of George Washington.

us-west-virginia-state-flag.title: West Virginia State Flag
us-west-virginia-state-flag.description: A white field bordered in dark blue with the state coat of arms showing a farmer and miner flanking a rock with the date June 20, 1863.

us-wisconsin-state-flag.title: Wisconsin State Flag
us-wisconsin-state-flag.description: A dark blue field with the state coat of arms featuring a sailor and yeoman flanking a shield, a badger, and the text 'Wisconsin' and '1848'.

us-wyoming-state-flag.title: Wyoming State Flag
us-wyoming-state-flag.description: A blue field bordered in white and red, with a white bison silhouette bearing the state seal.

us-topographic-overview.title: Topographic Overview
us-topographic-overview.description: The western US has major mountain ranges and high plateaus; the east is lower with the Appalachians as the main highland.

us-forest-density-map.title: Forest Density Map
us-forest-density-map.description: Eastern and northern US regions have denser tree cover than western and southwestern areas.

us-corn-field.title: Corn Fields
us-corn-field.description: Corn farming is concentrated in the Midwest and surrounding states.

us-soybean-field.title: Soybean Fields
us-soybean-field.description: Short, dark green crops growing in long rows across the Great Plains, Midwest, and Lower Mississippi Valley.

us-canola-field-canadian-border.title: Canola Fields
us-canola-field-canadian-border.description: Bright yellow canola flower fields appear in North Dakota and occasionally Montana near the Canadian border.

us-cotton-field.title: Cotton Fields
us-cotton-field.description: Fluffy white cotton fields are found in the coastal Southeast, Lower Mississippi Valley, western Texas, and parts of California and Arizona.

us-rice-production-area.title: Rice Production Areas
us-rice-production-area.description: US rice is grown in north-central California and the Lower Mississippi Valley. Fields resemble flat, low prairies.

us-oil-pumpjack.title: Oil Pumpjacks
us-oil-pumpjack.description: Short industrial metal structures that pump crude oil, common in Texas, eastern New Mexico, and North Dakota.

us-great-plains.title: The Great Plains
us-great-plains.description: A vast flat, largely treeless region from the Canadian border to central Texas with cropland and dry grassland.

us-prairie-pothole.title: Prairie Potholes
us-prairie-pothole.description: Low-lying wetlands with marshy grasses and shallow ponds from the Montana–Saskatchewan border to the western Great Lakes.

us-appalachian-mountain.title: Appalachian Mountains
us-appalachian-mountain.description: A low mountain range in the eastern US, covered in forest with beech and oak trees.

us-southern-pine.title: Southern Pines
us-southern-pine.description: Tall loblolly and longleaf pines with fluffy needle clusters abundant in the southeastern US.

us-reddish-soil-deep-south.title: Reddish Soil in the Deep South
us-reddish-soil-deep-south.description: Soil ranging from yellow to deep red is common across the Deep South, from Oklahoma to South Carolina.

us-dormant-southern-grass.title: Dormant Southern Grass
us-dormant-southern-grass.description: Bermuda and St. Augustine grasses in the southern US turn beige or brown in winter.

us-lower-mississippi-river-valley.title: Lower Mississippi River Valley
us-lower-mississippi-river-valley.description: An extremely flat, open landscape with red soil spanning Tennessee, Arkansas, Mississippi, and northeast Louisiana.

us-rocky-mountain.title: Rocky Mountains
us-rocky-mountain.description: Jagged, rocky formations from the Canadian border to northern New Mexico, often with pine forests and snow on high peaks.

us-sagebrush.title: Sagebrush
us-sagebrush.description: Great Basin sagebrush is a short, shrubby blue-green bush common in arid interior western US.

us-saguaro-cactus.title: Saguaro Cacti
us-saguaro-cactus.description: Tall tube-shaped cacti with upward-curving arms, found almost exclusively in southern Arizona.

us-douglas-fir-cascadia.title: Douglas Firs in Cascadia
us-douglas-fir-cascadia.description: Extremely tall conifers with dark brown bark and dark green foliage, common in Washington and Oregon.

us-pacific-temperate-rainforest.title: Pacific Temperate Rainforests
us-pacific-temperate-rainforest.description: Coastal Washington, Oregon, and northern California have temperate rainforests with broadleaf trees, large conifers, and ferns.

us-southwest-mesa-red-rock.title: Southwest Mesas and Red Rock
us-southwest-mesa-red-rock.description: The Four Corners region features mesas, tablelands, and reddish rock formations with red soil.

us-palm-tree.title: Palm Trees
us-palm-tree.description: Common along the Southeast coast, Gulf Coast, and Desert Southwest; Mexican Fan Palm prevalent in California.

us-texas-hill-country.title: Texas Hill Country
us-texas-hill-country.description: Dry, rocky hills west of Austin and San Antonio with yucca, prickly pear, and Texas Live Oak trees.

us-rio-grande-valley.title: Rio Grande Valley
