us-rio-grande-valley.description: South Texas's Rio Grande Valley is flat with shrubby trees and agricultural fields bordering Mexico.

us-spanish-moss.title: Spanish Moss
us-spanish-moss.description: Greyish-white drapes of Spanish moss hanging from trees are a hallmark of the Deep South.

us-golden-agricultural-field-eastern-was.title: Golden Agricultural Fields
us-golden-agricultural-field-eastern-was.description: Expansive golden fields are common in eastern Washington.

us-central-valley-california.title: Central Valley, California
us-central-valley-california.description: California's Central Valley has vineyards, olive trees, and rolling hills at the edges.

us-nebraska-sandhill.title: Nebraska Sandhills
us-nebraska-sandhill.description: A region of rolling, grass-covered hills in north-central Nebraska.

us-appalachian-ridge-valley.title: Appalachian Ridges and Valleys
us-appalachian-ridge-valley.description: Forest-covered ridges running southwest-to-northeast with flat valleys between, from southern New York to southern Virginia.

us-ouachita-mountain.title: Ouachita Mountains
us-ouachita-mountain.description: Steeper, more visible mountains from eastern Oklahoma into west-central Arkansas.

us-alabama-highway-shield.title: Alabama Highway Shield
us-alabama-highway-shield.description: Highway shields in Alabama are shaped like the state of Alabama in white with the route number in black.

us-arkansas-highway-shield.title: Arkansas Highway Shield
us-arkansas-highway-shield.description: Arkansas shields are shaped like the outline of the state in white, with the route number in black.

us-california-highway-shield.title: California Highway Shield
us-california-highway-shield.description: White route number on a green spade-shaped shield.

us-colorado-highway-shield.title: Colorado Highway Shield
us-colorado-highway-shield.description: Colorado shields are white rectangles featuring the state flag at the top.

us-connecticut-highway-shield.title: Connecticut Highway Shield
us-connecticut-highway-shield.description: Connecticut shields are plain white squares with a black border, showing the route number in black.

us-florida-highway-shield.title: Florida Highway Shield
us-florida-highway-shield.description: Florida shields are simple white rectangles with the route number in black next to a black outline of the state.

us-georgia-highway-shield.title: Georgia Highway Shield
us-georgia-highway-shield.description: Georgia shields have a white silhouette of the state inside.

us-idaho-highway-shield.title: Idaho Highway Shield
us-idaho-highway-shield.description: Idaho shields have a white silhouette of the state inside, showing the state name in black to the right.

us-illinois-highway-shield.title: Illinois Highway Shield
us-illinois-highway-shield.description: Illinois shields are showing 'ILLINOIS' in black at the top.

us-indiana-highway-shield.title: Indiana Highway Shield
us-indiana-highway-shield.description: Indiana shields are white squares with a black border, showing 'INDIANA' at the top.

us-iowa-highway-shield.title: Iowa Highway Shield
us-iowa-highway-shield.description: Iowa highway shields are black squares with the route number in black inside a white circle.

us-louisiana-highway-shield.title: Louisiana Highway Shield
us-louisiana-highway-shield.description: Louisiana highway shields are shaped like the outline of the state in green, with 'LA' at the top and the route number below in white.

us-maine-highway-shield.title: Maine Highway Shield
us-maine-highway-shield.description: Highway shields in Maine are plain white squares with the route number in black.

us-nevada-highway-shield.title: Nevada Highway Shield
us-nevada-highway-shield.description: Some shields put the state name right on them, like Nevada's. A black square with a white banner inside showing the route number above 'NEVADA' in black.

us-new-mexico-highway-shield.title: New Mexico Highway Shield
us-new-mexico-highway-shield.description: New Mexico highway shields show the route number framed by a red ring with short red marks pointing out.

us-north-dakota-highway-shield.title: North Dakota Highway Shield
us-north-dakota-highway-shield.description: North Dakota highway shields are black squares featuring a white arrowhead silhouette with jagged edges, with the route number in black on the arrowhead and 'N' and 'D' in white at the top corners.

us-oregon-highway-shield.title: Oregon Highway Shield
us-oregon-highway-shield.description: Black route number on a white shield with an oval shape.

us-rhode-island-highway-shield.title: Rhode Island Highway Shield
us-rhode-island-highway-shield.description: Rhode Island shields are showing 'R.I.' at the top.

us-south-carolina-highway-shield.title: South Carolina Highway Shield
us-south-carolina-highway-shield.description: South Carolina shields are white rectangles with a blue border, a blue banner at the top reading 'SOUTH CAROLINA' around a small white state outline, and the route number in blue below.

us-tennessee-highway-shield.title: Tennessee Highway Shield
us-tennessee-highway-shield.description: Tennessee shields are white with a black border and a curved bottom, showing the route number above 'Tennessee'.

us-texas-highway-shield.title: Texas Highway Shield
us-texas-highway-shield.description: Texas shields are white squares with a thick black border, showing the route number in black above 'TEXAS'.

us-utah-highway-shield.title: Utah Highway Shield
us-utah-highway-shield.description: Utah's shield is one of the most recognisable in the US: a white beehive on a black square with the route number in black inside the beehive.

us-vermont-highway-shield.title: Vermont Highway Shield
us-vermont-highway-shield.description: Vermont shields are white with a green border, showing 'VERMONT' in a green banner at the top and the route number in green below.

us-virginia-highway-shield.title: Virginia Highway Shield
us-virginia-highway-shield.description: Highway shields in Virginia have a white shield in the middle containing the route number in black.

us-adopt-highway-sign.title: Adopt-a-Highway Signs
us-adopt-highway-sign.description: Most states have unique Adopt-a-Highway sign designs found along roadsides.

us-rectangular-raised-pavement-marker.title: Rectangular Raised Pavement Markers
us-rectangular-raised-pavement-marker.description: Small rectangular raised markers embedded in the road surface appear in the southern and western US, plus Massachusetts.

us-snowplowable-h-shaped-pavement-marker.title: Snowplowable H-Shaped Pavement Markers
us-snowplowable-h-shaped-pavement-marker.description: H-shaped pavement markers flush with the road surface are found only in a group of eastern states shown on the reference map.

us-kentucky-rumble-strip.title: Kentucky Rumble Strips
us-kentucky-rumble-strip.description: Some Kentucky roads use uniquely shaped rumble strips, thin, elongated recessed lines on the outer road edges.

us-brown-national-park-infrastructure.title: Brown National Park Infrastructure
us-brown-national-park-infrastructure.description: Guardrails, signs, and sign posts painted medium brown are characteristic of US national parks. Rock walls sometimes replace guardrails.

us-wisconsin-missouri-lettered-county-hi.title: Wisconsin and Missouri Lettered County Highways
us-wisconsin-missouri-lettered-county-hi.description: Wisconsin and Missouri use a letter system (A–ZZZ) for county highways. Wisconsin signs typically include 'County' above the letter; Missouri signs usually do not.

us-concrete-paved-highway-iowa.title: Concrete-Paved Highways in Iowa
us-concrete-paved-highway-iowa.description: Concrete paving on main highways is far more common in Iowa than in other states.

us-wide-gap-yellow-centre-line.title: Wide-Gap Yellow Centre Lines
us-wide-gap-yellow-centre-line.description: Double yellow centre lines with a noticeably wide gap between them are most common in Texas, Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Oregon.

us-thick-yellow-centre-line-wv-va-md.title: Thick Yellow Centre Lines, WV, VA, MD
us-thick-yellow-centre-line-wv-va-md.description: Some roads in West Virginia, Virginia, and Maryland have centre yellow lines that are noticeably thicker than standard.

us-oregon-speed-sign-speed-only.title: Oregon Speed Signs, 'Speed' Only
us-oregon-speed-sign-speed-only.description: Oregon speed signs often display just the word 'Speed' rather than the standard 'Speed Limit'.

us-california-black-stripe-centre-line.title: California Black Stripe Between Centre Lines
us-california-black-stripe-centre-line.description: A black stripe can sometimes be seen between the two yellow centre lines on California roads.

us-california-three-stripe-pole-marking.title: California Three-Stripe Pole Markings
us-california-three-stripe-pole-marking.description: Utility poles in California typically have three yellow stripes painted near the base.

us-california-road-without-centre-line.title: California Roads Without Centre Lines
us-california-road-without-centre-line.description: Some smaller California roads lack a yellow centre line entirely, featuring only solid white edge lines.

us-nevada-bollard.title: Nevada Bollards
us-nevada-bollard.description: Nevada uses bollards consisting of a thin stick topped with a vertical rectangular white reflector outlined in black.

us-south-dakota-montana-bollard.title: South Dakota and Montana Bollards
us-south-dakota-montana-bollard.description: A dark metal post with a white diamond reflector on each side at the top is the standard bollard in South Dakota and Montana.

us-wyoming-bollard.title: Wyoming Bollards
us-wyoming-bollard.description: Wyoming bollards are dark metal poles with a white circular reflector at the top. The top portion of the pole is sometimes painted white or grey.

us-washington-state-bollard.title: Washington State Bollards
us-washington-state-bollard.description: Washington uses white or brown posts with a white rectangle on the front and two smaller white or silver squares on the back.

us-utah-idaho-numbered-street-name.title: Utah and Idaho Numbered Streets
us-utah-idaho-numbered-street-name.description: Streets in Utah and Idaho often have a number and cardinal direction (e.g. '600 South').

us-texas-road-surface.title: Texas Road Surface
us-texas-road-surface.description: Texas roads often have a distinctive grainy, 'salt and pepper' pavement texture.

us-upper-midwest-grainy-road.title: Upper Midwest Grainy Roads
us-upper-midwest-grainy-road.description: Rural roads in the Upper Midwest, especially Illinois, use grainy pavement similar to Texas but in varying colours.

us-texas-signpost-reflector.title: Texas Signpost Reflectors
us-texas-signpost-reflector.description: Yellow or red reflective bands are commonly wrapped around signposts in Texas.

us-kansas-white-signpost-reflector.title: Kansas White Signpost Reflectors
us-kansas-white-signpost-reflector.description: White reflectors on signposts, especially on rural stop signs, are unique to Kansas.

us-minnesota-bridge-warning-sign.title: Minnesota Bridge Warning Signs
us-minnesota-bridge-warning-sign.description: Yellow signs with vertical black triangles appear before major bridge crossings and guardrail ends on large highways in Minnesota.

us-minnesota-stop-sign-marker.title: Minnesota Stop Sign Markers
us-minnesota-stop-sign-marker.description: Most rural stop signs in Minnesota have a horizontal black-and-white marker attached to the post.

us-wisconsin-atv-route-sign.title: Wisconsin ATV Route Signs
us-wisconsin-atv-route-sign.description: Green 'ATV Route' signs are unique to Wisconsin.

us-wisconsin-michigan-up-pole-plate.title: Wisconsin/Michigan UP Pole Plates
us-wisconsin-michigan-up-pole-plate.description: White rectangular metal plates with an orange rectangle and diamond are found on most utility poles in Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula.

us-wisconsin-white-bollard.title: Wisconsin White Bollards
us-wisconsin-white-bollard.description: Simple white bollards with black reflectors are unique to Wisconsin.

us-wisconsin-michigan-up-house-number-si.title: Wisconsin/Michigan UP House Number Signs
us-wisconsin-michigan-up-house-number-si.description: Horizontal blue, red, or green signs at driveway ends show house numbers plus town or road names in Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula.

us-michigan-double-signpost.title: Michigan Double Signposts
us-michigan-double-signpost.description: Signs mounted on two parallel posts are common in Michigan.

us-michigan-wire-hung-traffic-sign.title: Michigan Wire-Hung Traffic Signs
us-michigan-wire-hung-traffic-sign.description: Many Michigan intersections have stop lights and signs suspended from wires across the road, often in yellow boxes.

us-ohio-michigan-indiana-property-marker.title: Ohio/Michigan/Indiana Property Markers
us-ohio-michigan-indiana-property-marker.description: Vertical blue or green metal signs with white house numbers, often attached to mailboxes, are common in rural Ohio, lower Michigan, and Indiana.

us-west-virginia-fraction-circle-sign.title: West Virginia Fraction-in-Circle Signs
us-west-virginia-fraction-circle-sign.description: West Virginia street signs sometimes include a symbol resembling a fraction inside a circle.

us-north-carolina-street-sign-number-arr.title: North Carolina Numbered Street Signs
us-north-carolina-street-sign-number-arr.description: North Carolina commonly uses street signs displaying block numbers and directional arrows alongside the street name.

us-oklahoma-stop-sign-marker.title: Oklahoma Stop Sign Markers
us-oklahoma-stop-sign-marker.description: Green rectangular signs with three rows of numbers are commonly attached to the back of rural stop signs in Oklahoma.

us-pennsylvania-intersection-route-sign.title: Pennsylvania Intersection Route Signs
us-pennsylvania-intersection-route-sign.description: White rectangular signs showing converging state route numbers sometimes appear on signposts at Pennsylvania intersections.

us-67-wisconsin.description: Wisconsin marks its state highways with a black and white sign with a triangular notch cut into the top edges and bottom.

us-67-wyoming.title: Wyoming Highway Shield
us-67-wyoming.description: Wyoming highway shields are yellow square signs with “WYOMING” at the top and a black silhouette of a cowboy on a bucking horse.

xx-general-01-h-e-b-supermarket-chain.title: General 01 H E B Supermarket Chain
xx-general-01-h-e-b-supermarket-chain.description: H-E-B is a supermarket chain that operates exclusively in Texas.

us-128-california-usa.title: California Carl's Jr. Branding
us-128-california-usa.description: California fast food locations use the Carl's Jr. name and yellow smiling star logo.

us-128-nevada-usa.title: Nevada Carl's Jr. Branding
us-128-nevada-usa.description: Nevada features only Carl's Jr. branding with the yellow star mascot.

us-128-arizona-usa.title: Arizona Carl's Jr. Branding
us-128-arizona-usa.description: Arizona fast food outlets display only the Carl's Jr. name and yellow star logo.

us-128-new-mexico-usa.title: New Mexico Carl's Jr. Branding
us-128-new-mexico-usa.description: New Mexico restaurants are branded as Carl's Jr. with the yellow star and red lettering.

us-128-wyoming-usa.title: Wyoming Dual Branding
us-128-wyoming-usa.description: Wyoming has both Carl's Jr. and Hardee's locations, each with their own yellow star logos.

us-128-oklahoma-usa.title: Oklahoma Dual Branding
us-128-oklahoma-usa.description: Oklahoma contains both Carl's Jr. and Hardee's restaurants with their respective yellow star logos.

us-128-central-usa.title: Central US Hardee's Branding
us-128-central-usa.description: Central US fast food locations are branded as Hardee's with a yellow star logo.

us-128-eastern-usa.title: Eastern US Hardee's Branding
us-128-eastern-usa.description: Eastern US uses Hardee's brand exclusively, identified by the yellow star logo.

dk-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
dk-licence-plate.description: Danish plates: standard white with blue EU band, yellow for commercial vehicles, and unique 'Parrot' variant with yellow left section.

dk-square-block-edge-line.title: Square-Block Edge Lines
dk-square-block-edge-line.description: Danish road edges often marked by small white squares instead of dashes.

dk-danish-language.title: Danish Language
dk-danish-language.description: Danish is a North Germanic language with letters Æ, Ø, and Å.

dk-thatched-corrugated-roof.title: Thatched and Corrugated Roofs
dk-thatched-corrugated-roof.description: Thatched roofs are common in the countryside. Grey corrugated metal roofing also appears.

dk-timber-framed-building.title: Timber-Framed Buildings
dk-timber-framed-building.description: Half-timbered walls with exposed wooden frames are found on older and rural structures throughout Denmark.

dk-bent-pipe-signpost.title: Bent-Pipe Signposts
dk-bent-pipe-signpost.description: A signpost design where the tubular metal frame wraps tightly around the sign panel is unique to Denmark.

dk-b-type-guardrail.title: Guardrails
dk-b-type-guardrail.description: Danish road barriers use guardrails with no reflectors.

dk-five-stripe-pedestrian-sign.title: Five-Stripe Pedestrian Signs
dk-five-stripe-pedestrian-sign.description: The pedestrian crossing warning sign in Denmark shows five horizontal stripes, with the outermost stripes touching the edges of the triangular border.

dk-town-entry-exit-sign.title: Town Entry and Exit Signs
dk-town-entry-exit-sign.description: Settlements are announced by a distinctive rectangular sign displaying the town name. The exit version adds a diagonal red slash.

dk-bus-stop-sign.title: Bus Stop Signs
dk-bus-stop-sign.description: Danish bus stops use a compact black-and-yellow sign mounted at the top of a pole, with the timetable below.

dk-red-white-chevron.title: Red-and-White Chevrons
dk-red-white-chevron.description: Curve warning boards in Denmark are red and white and tend to be positioned close to the ground.

dk-rare-street-level-utility-pole.title: Rare Street-Level Utility Poles
dk-rare-street-level-utility-pole.description: Conventional roadside utility poles are uncommon in Denmark. Most visible power infrastructure consists of tall high-voltage transmission towers.

dk-roadside-bicycle-path.title: Roadside Bicycle Paths
dk-roadside-bicycle-path.description: Dedicated cycle lanes running alongside the carriageway are a frequent feature of Danish roads.

dk-postnord-postal-box.title: PostNord Postal Boxes
dk-postnord-postal-box.description: PostNord operates distinctive postal collection boxes that are easily recognisable on the street.

dk-gas-station-brand.title: Gas Station Brands
dk-gas-station-brand.description: Four fuel-station chains common in Denmark are Ingo, Ok, Uno-X, and Yx.

dk-stone-bicycle-path-bollard.title: Stone Bicycle-Path Bollards
dk-stone-bicycle-path-bollard.description: Low stone bollards occasionally line bicycle paths, sometimes with a red-painted cap.

dk-road-numbering-system.title: Road Numbering System
dk-road-numbering-system.description: Danish road numbers follow a clear east-to-west pattern with regional groupings. Starting with 200 and ending with 500.

dk-ring-road.title: Ring Roads
dk-ring-road.description: Major cities have numbered ring roads labelled O1 to O4, with higher numbers encircling further from the centre.

dk-24-capital-region-of.title: Movia Buses (Capital Region)
dk-24-capital-region-of.description: Buses in the Capital Region are typically solid yellow or yellow with white and grey accents, featuring the Movia logo.

dk-24-central-denmark-region.title: Midttrafik Buses (Central Denmark)
dk-24-central-denmark-region.description: Central Denmark Region buses are bright red with the white Midttrafik logo.

dk-24-north-denmark-region.title: NT Buses (North Denmark)
dk-24-north-denmark-region.description: Buses in North Denmark Region are bright blue, featuring the NT logo.

dk-24-region-zealand.title: Movia Buses (Region Zealand)
dk-24-region-zealand.description: Region Zealand buses use Movia branding, usually yellow with white and grey details.

dk-24-region-of-southern.title: FynBus and Sydtrafik Buses (Southern Denmark)
dk-24-region-of-southern.description: Southern Denmark buses are bright green (FynBus) or orange (Sydtrafik), each with their logos.

dk-24-bornholm.title: BAT Buses (Bornholm)
dk-24-bornholm.description: Bornholm's buses have a distinctive blue and green two-tone scheme with the BAT logo.

dk-25-capital-region-of.title: Capital Region Yellow Bus Stop Sign
dk-25-capital-region-of.description: Bus stop signs have a bright yellow background with a black or dark gray band at the top, often showing the Movia logo.

dk-25-central-denmark-region.title: Midtjylland Bus Stop Sign
dk-25-central-denmark-region.description: Central Denmark bus stop signs use yellow with a white or light gray section and the Midttrafik logo.

dk-25-north-denmark-region.title: Nordjylland Bus Stop Sign
dk-25-north-denmark-region.description: North Denmark bus stop signs are yellow with a black or dark gray section and the NT logo.

dk-25-region-zealand.title: Region Zealand Bus Stop Sign
dk-25-region-zealand.description: Region Zealand bus stop signs have a yellow background with a white or light gray section and the Movia logo.

dk-25-region-of-southern.title: Sydtrafik Bus Stop Sign (Southern Denmark)
dk-25-region-of-southern.description: Southern Denmark bus stop signs are yellow with a gray or white section and the Sydtrafik logo.

dk-25-bornholm.title: Bornholm Bus Stop Sign
dk-25-bornholm.description: Bornholm bus stop signs are yellow with a black or dark section and the BAT logo.

dk-country-flag.title: Country Flag
dk-country-flag.description: The national flag of Denmark is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-57-argentina-chevrons.title: General 01 57 Argentina Chevrons
xx-general-01-57-argentina-chevrons.description: Argentina is the only South American country that has white chevrons with red arrows.

au-bollards-01.title: Bollards 01
au-bollards-01.description: Australian bollards are white with a vertical red stripe towards the top.

au-road-01-driving-direction.title: Driving direction
au-road-01-driving-direction.description: In Australia they drive on the left side of the road.

au-road-signs-01-yellow-poles.title: Yellow poles
au-road-signs-01-yellow-poles.description: In the state of Western Australia you can find yellow sign posts.

au-39-western-australia.title: Western Australia White-Bordered Traffic Lights
au-39-western-australia.description: Western Australia traffic light housings have a prominent white border framing the entire signal.

au-39-queensland.title: Queensland White-Bordered Traffic Lights
au-39-queensland.description: Queensland's traffic lights have a bold white outline encasing the entire signal housing.

au-39-new-south-wales.title: New South Wales White-Bordered Traffic Lights
au-39-new-south-wales.description: New South Wales traffic light casings feature a thick white border around the housing.

au-39-australian-capital-territory.title: ACT White-Bordered Traffic Lights
au-39-australian-capital-territory.description: ACT traffic lights have white-bordered housings defining the signal edges.

au-39-tasmania.title: Tasmania White-Bordered Traffic Lights
au-39-tasmania.description: Tasmania's traffic signals have a wide white outline framing the housing.

au-39-victoria.title: Victoria Borderless Traffic Lights
au-39-victoria.description: Victoria traffic light housings lack any white border, appearing unframed.

au-39-south-australia.title: South Australia Borderless Traffic Lights
au-39-south-australia.description: South Australia traffic lights are installed without any white border.

au-39-northern-territory.title: Northern Territory Borderless Traffic Lights
au-39-northern-territory.description: Northern Territory traffic lights have housings with no white outline.

at-24-burgenland.title: Burgenland Südburg Bus Logo
at-24-burgenland.description: Buses display the 'Südburg' logo with bold red and white text and regional motifs.

at-24-lower-austria.title: Lower Austria NÖVOG Bus Logo
at-24-lower-austria.description: Buses show the 'NÖVOG' or 'VOR' logo, often in blue and yellow.

at-24-salzburg.title: Salzburg Postbus Logo
at-24-salzburg.description: Buses display the 'Salzburg Verkehr' or 'Postbus' logo in red and white.

at-24-styria.title: Styria Steiermark Bus Logo
at-24-styria.description: Styrian buses carry the 'Steiermark' or 'Verbund Linie' logo in green and white.

at-24-tyrol.title: Tyrol VVT Bus Logo
at-24-tyrol.description: Tyrolean buses show the 'VVT' logo in red and white, often with the Tyrolean eagle.

at-24-upper-austria.title: Upper Austria OÖVV Bus Logo
at-24-upper-austria.description: Buses display the 'OÖVV' logo, usually in red and white.

at-24-vienna.title: Vienna Wiener Linien Bus Logo
at-24-vienna.description: Viennese buses feature the 'Wiener Linien' logo in red and white with stylized letters.

at-24-vorarlberg.title: Vorarlberg Landbus Logo
at-24-vorarlberg.description: Vorarlberg buses show the 'Landbus' or 'VVV' logo in green and yellow.

xx-general-01-29-vienna-street-signs.title: General 01 29 Vienna Street Signs
xx-general-01-29-vienna-street-signs.description: In Vienna, street signs appear as dark blue plaques, with the first number indicating the district.

xx-general-01-30-red-and-white-tape.title: General 01 30 Red And White Tape
xx-general-01-30-red-and-white-tape.description: In Vienna and some smaller Austrian cities, signposts have red and white tape, resembling the Austrian flag.

bd-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
bd-licence-plate.description: Vehicles in Bangladesh have licence plates in white, black, or turquoise.

bd-striped-signpost.title: Striped Signposts
bd-striped-signpost.description: Sign poles often have alternating black and white stripes.

bd-white-painted-tree-trunk.title: White-Painted Tree Trunks
bd-white-painted-tree-trunk.description: Roads are often lined with trees whose lower trunks are painted white.

bd-red-white-bollard.title: Red and White Bollards
bd-red-white-bollard.description: Concrete bollards alternate red and white and appear in cylindrical and square forms.

bd-tin-roof.title: Tin Roofs
bd-tin-roof.description: Corrugated metal roofing is widespread on residential buildings.

bd-eastern-triangle-window-roof.title: Eastern Triangle Window Roofs
bd-eastern-triangle-window-roof.description: Metal roofs in the east often have a small triangular opening below the ridge.

bd-tiled-roof-khulna-border.title: Tiled Roofs
bd-tiled-roof-khulna-border.description: Tile roofing appears near the Indian border within Khulna.

bd-early-growth-rice.title: Early Growth Rice
bd-early-growth-rice.description: Short green rice shoots just above water appear in Khulna, Mymensingh, and south Dhaka.

bd-mid-growth-rice.title: Mid-Growth Rice
bd-mid-growth-rice.description: Medium-height green rice indicates mid-season growth in Rangpur, Barishal, and Chittagong.

bd-fully-grown-rice.title: Fully-Grown Rice
bd-fully-grown-rice.description: Mature rice is taller, yellow or orange, with fluffy tips signaling ripeness.

bd-harvested-rice.title: Harvested Rice
bd-harvested-rice.description: Fields show short beige or brown stubble after harvesting.

bd-off-season-field.title: Off-Season Fields
bd-off-season-field.description: Rice paddies lie empty and bare between planting cycles.

bd-vast-empty-rice-field.title: Vast Empty Rice Fields
bd-vast-empty-rice-field.description: Expansive rice paddies stretch to the horizon with little else in sight.

bd-eastern-chittagong-hill.title: Eastern Chittagong Hills
bd-eastern-chittagong-hill.description: Forested hills break the flat terrain in eastern Chittagong.

bd-sylhet-border-ridge.title: Sylhet Border Ridge
bd-sylhet-border-ridge.description: An east-west mountain ridge runs along the Indian border near Sylhet.

bd-corn-field.title: Corn Fields
bd-corn-field.description: Maize fields concentrate in western divisions like Rajshahi and Rangpur.

bd-jute-crop.title: Jute Crops
bd-jute-crop.description: Tall green jute crops grow mainly in Rangpur; dried jute is seen nationwide.

bd-canola-field.title: Canola Fields
bd-canola-field.description: Short bright yellow canola blossoms grow north of the Padma River.

bd-tea-plantation.title: Tea Plantations
bd-tea-plantation.description: Tea grows in elevated southern Sylhet and occasionally in Chittagong.

bd-fruit-tree-orchard.title: Fruit Trees and Orchards
bd-fruit-tree-orchard.description: Isolated fruit trees and orchards appear near the Indian border in Rajshahi and Rangpur.

bd-barishal-sunflower.title: Barishal Sunflowers
bd-barishal-sunflower.description: Sunflower fields appear in southern Barishal.

bd-barishal-watermelon.title: Barishal Watermelons
bd-barishal-watermelon.description: Watermelon patches are found in southern Barishal.

bd-northern-eucalyptus.title: Northern Eucalyptus
bd-northern-eucalyptus.description: Tall eucalyptus trees with pale trunks are common in northern divisions.

bd-blossoming-tree.title: Blossoming Trees
bd-blossoming-tree.description: Flowering trees appear in Khulna, Mymensingh, and southern Dhaka during spring.

bd-beach-sheoaks.title: Beach Sheoaks
bd-beach-sheoaks.description: Slender evergreen Beach Sheoak trees line the Teknaf Peninsula coast and Noakhali.

bd-saint-martins-island-guard-trekker.title: Saint Martin's Island Guard Trekker
bd-saint-martins-island-guard-trekker.description: On Saint Martin's Island, the trekker is accompanied by a security guard.

bd-country-flag.title: Country Flag
bd-country-flag.description: The national flag of Bangladesh is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

by-language.title: Language
by-language.description: Signage is in Belarusian or Russian, both using Cyrillic script.

by-country-flag.title: Country Flag
by-country-flag.description: The national flag of Belarus is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

be-concrete-pole.title: Concrete Poles
be-concrete-pole.description: Utility poles are mostly square concrete with rows of small holes and often metal bands; some have oval perforations.

be-direction-sign.title: Direction Signs
be-direction-sign.description: Wayfinding signs in Belgium are typically blue or white. They are green on highways.

be-blue-supplementary-sign.title: Blue Supplementary Signs
be-blue-supplementary-sign.description: Regulatory signs often have a small blue auxiliary plate beneath them.

be-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
be-kilometre-marker.description: Distance posts are usually green and may have red numerals.

be-chevron.title: Chevrons
be-chevron.description: Curve warning boards are white with a red arrow pointing toward the bend.

be-concrete-slab-road.title: Concrete Slab Roads
be-concrete-slab-road.description: Many country roads are surfaced with precast concrete slabs.

be-road-line-bike-lane.title: Road Lines and Bike Lanes
be-road-line-bike-lane.description: All road markings are white; dedicated cycle lanes often flank both sides of the carriageway.

be-red-brick-architecture.title: Red Brick Architecture
be-red-brick-architecture.description: Residential buildings made of distinctive red brick are widespread in northern and western Belgium.

be-southern-stone-architecture.title: Southern Stone Architecture
be-southern-stone-architecture.description: Buildings in southern Belgium tend to be grey stone with French architectural style.

xx-general-01-04-orange-signs.title: General 01 04 Orange Signs
xx-general-01-04-orange-signs.description: In Belgium, you will often find orange signposts and sign backs.

be-street-name-sign.title: Street Name Signs
be-street-name-sign.description: Street name plaques are usually white or dark blue, squarish, and often include the municipality name.

be-town-entry-sign.title: Town Entry Signs
be-town-entry-sign.description: Settlements are marked by white rectangular signs with a black border and bold black municipality name.

be-priority-sign.title: Priority Signs
be-priority-sign.description: The orange diamond priority road sign is smaller than in neighboring countries.

be-bus-stop.title: Bus Stops
be-bus-stop.description: Bus stops have yellow signposts and often yellow-roofed shelters.

be-traffic-light-pole.title: Traffic Light Poles
be-traffic-light-pole.description: Traffic lights are mounted on poles painted with alternating black and yellow bands.

be-hydrant-marker.title: Hydrant Markers
be-hydrant-marker.description: Underground hydrants are marked by small red plates with the letter H.

be-road-gutter.title: Road Gutters
be-road-gutter.description: Kerbed gutters run along both edges of almost every road.

be-bicycle-path-marking.title: Bicycle Path Markings
be-bicycle-path-marking.description: Cycle paths are edged with short dashed lines on both sides.

be-blurred-house.title: Blurred Houses
be-blurred-house.description: Belgium has one of the highest rates of building-level blurring in Europe.

be-terrain.title: Terrain
be-terrain.description: The northwest is flat, especially along the coast; terrain gets hillier toward the southeast.

be-three-official-languages.title: Three Official Languages
be-three-official-languages.description: Belgium has three languages: Dutch in Flanders, French in Wallonia, and German in Ostbelgien.

be-bilingual-brussels.title: Bilingual Brussels
be-bilingual-brussels.description: Brussels is officially bilingual with signage in French and Dutch.

be-regional-bus-stop-difference.title: Regional Bus Stop Differences
be-regional-bus-stop-difference.description: Bus stop signs in Flanders and Brussels have a white rectangle at the top; Walloon stops have yellow-topped signs.

be-warning-sign-border.title: Warning Sign Borders
be-warning-sign-border.description: Flanders and Brussels warning signs have thick red borders without white rims.

be-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
be-phone-area-code.description: Belgian landline numbers have one or two digits after the leading zero indicating the area.

be-municipality-name-street-sign.title: Municipality Names on Street Signs
be-municipality-name-street-sign.description: Street signs often include the municipality name below the street name.

be-ardennes.title: The Ardennes
be-ardennes.description: The Ardennes in southeastern Belgium feature rolling forested hills, deep valleys, and steep gradients.

be-coastal-polder.title: Coastal Polders
be-coastal-polder.description: Near the North Sea coast and western Dutch border, terrain has polders—fields at or below sea level with drainage channels and waterways.

be-north-sea-coast.title: North Sea Coast
be-north-sea-coast.description: Belgian coastline features continuous rows of high-rise apartments and nearby dunes with low scrub, tall grasses, and sandy ground.

be-country-flag.title: Country Flag
be-country-flag.description: The national flag of Belgium is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

bm-general-landscape.title: General Landscape
bm-general-landscape.description: Landscape has thick low greenery, small trees, dense bushes, and scattered detached houses.

bm-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
bm-licence-plate.description: Plates are elongated, entirely white, with black numbers centered.

bm-road-marking.title: Road Markings
bm-road-marking.description: Most roads have a single solid yellow centreline and no edge markings.

bm-zig-zag-line.title: Zig-Zag Lines
bm-zig-zag-line.description: White zig-zag road markings appear in some locations.

bm-pastel-stone-house.title: Pastel Stone Houses
bm-pastel-stone-house.description: Bermuda's signature architecture features stone homes painted in soft pastels with bright white stepped roofs.

bm-palm-tree.title: Palm Trees
bm-palm-tree.description: Palm trees are abundant throughout the islands.

bm-turquoise-water.title: Turquoise Water
bm-turquoise-water.description: The ocean around Bermuda has a strikingly pale turquoise colour.

bm-country-flag.title: Country Flag
bm-country-flag.description: The national flag of Bermuda is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

bt-dzongkha-script.title: Dzongkha Script
bt-dzongkha-script.description: Bhutan's national language uses a distinctive Tibetan-derived script seen only in Bhutan on Street View.

bt-mountainous-terrain.title: Mountainous Terrain
bt-mountainous-terrain.description: Bhutan is mostly rugged highland with steep mountain highways.

bt-thin-metal-utility-pole.title: Thin Metal Utility Poles
bt-thin-metal-utility-pole.description: Slender metal utility poles often have the lower section painted black.

bt-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
bt-kilometre-marker.description: Bhutanese road markers have a yellow upper half and white lower half with route numbers on national highways.

bt-city-direction-sign.title: City Direction Signs
bt-city-direction-sign.description: Urban areas have red or blue signboards usually showing the town name.

bt-yellow-taxi.title: Yellow Taxis
bt-yellow-taxi.description: Bhutanese taxis have yellow roofs and yellow licence plates.

bt-striped-signpost.title: Striped Signposts
bt-striped-signpost.description: Sign poles painted with alternating black-and-white bands are common.

bt-double-white-edge-line.title: Double White Edge Lines
bt-double-white-edge-line.description: Roads with two solid white edge lines on each side appear around Thimphu in western Bhutan.

bt-flat-southern-lowland.title: Flat Southern Lowlands
bt-flat-southern-lowland.description: Flat, open terrain occurs only in Bhutan's southern border zone.

bt-country-flag.title: Country Flag
bt-country-flag.description: The national flag of Bhutan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

bo-road-line-colour.title: Road Line Colours
bo-road-line-colour.description: Centre road markings vary between solid yellow, mixed yellow and white, or solid white; edge lines are always white.

bo-concrete-slab-road.title: Concrete Slab Roads
bo-concrete-slab-road.description: Many Bolivian roads are surfaced with precast concrete slabs besides asphalt.

bo-cobblestone-road.title: Cobblestone Roads
bo-cobblestone-road.description: Cobblestoned streets often have orderly stone strips separating less regular sections.

bo-signpost.title: Signposts
bo-signpost.description: Road sign poles are thick, white, and square in cross-section.

bo-guardrail-marking.title: Guardrail Markings
bo-guardrail-marking.description: Guardrail end-plates have yellow and black diagonal stripes, with yellow on the outer edge.

bo-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
bo-utility-pole.description: Main poles are cylindrical concrete with pinholes or timber, with varied crossarm designs.

bo-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
bo-kilometre-marker.description: Distance posts have a black 'Km' upper section and white lower section with the distance figure.

bo-mas-political-graffiti.title: MAS Political Graffiti
bo-mas-political-graffiti.description: Graffiti reading 'MAS' or 'Evo' and objects painted black, white, and blue mark the ruling party.

bo-wiphala-flag.title: Wiphala Flag
bo-wiphala-flag.description: The Wiphala is a square flag with seven colours in diagonal stripes, seen on public buildings and signage.

bo-tigo-telecom-branding.title: Tigo Telecom Branding
bo-tigo-telecom-branding.description: Tigo's blue logo appears frequently in Bolivian urban areas.

bo-reddish-soil.title: Reddish Soil
bo-reddish-soil.description: Exposed rock and earth often have a pronounced red-orange hue.

bo-altiplano.title: Altiplano
bo-altiplano.description: A highland plateau with grasslands ranging from green to brown, often with clumpy tufted grass.

bo-northern-altiplano-greener.title: Northern Altiplano
bo-northern-altiplano-greener.description: The plateau near La Paz and El Alto appears greener and more vegetated.

bo-southern-altiplano-drier.title: Southern Altiplano
bo-southern-altiplano-drier.description: Around Oruro and southwest roads, the plateau is more barren and dry.

bo-andean-mountain.title: Andean Mountains
bo-andean-mountain.description: Towering peaks run northwest to southeast between the Altiplano and tropical lowlands.

bo-tropical-eastern-lowland.title: Tropical Eastern Lowlands
bo-tropical-eastern-lowland.description: East of the Andes, terrain flattens into lush tropical farmland with distinctive pinkish soil.

bo-santa-cruz-unpaved-road.title: Santa Cruz Unpaved Roads
bo-santa-cruz-unpaved-road.description: Dirt roads near Santa Cruz have characteristic pink soil.

bo-santa-cruz-tropical-setting.title: Santa Cruz Tropical Setting
bo-santa-cruz-tropical-setting.description: Santa Cruz is Bolivia's only major city in a flat, tropical environment.

bo-morochata-peru-look-alike.title: Morochata
bo-morochata-peru-look-alike.description: A coverage pocket on Ruta 25 northwest of Cochabamba with green mountain slopes and drier terrain.

bo-ruta-5-sunset-coverage.title: Ruta 5 Sunset Coverage
bo-ruta-5-sunset-coverage.description: Ruta 5 near Chaco was captured at sunset, showing a warm golden tint on mostly concrete roads.

bo-ruta-6-white-concrete.title: Ruta 6 White Concrete
bo-ruta-6-white-concrete.description: Between Tarabuco and Zudáñez, the road is paved with almost white concrete.

bo-country-flag.title: Country Flag
bo-country-flag.description: The national flag of Bolivia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ba-bollard-variant-1.title: White Bollard with Angled Top (No Black Cap or Band)
ba-bollard-variant-1.description: Slim white rectangular bollard with the top corner cut off at a diagonal angle. There is NO black cap at the top and NO black band around the shaft. A small rectangular reflector sits on a small dark patch just below the angled top.

ba-bollard-variant-2.title: White Bollard with Solid Black Block on Top
ba-bollard-variant-2.description: Slim white rectangular bollard with a thick solid black block sitting flat on top, like a hat. The rectangular reflector is on the white shaft, BELOW the black cap.

ba-bollard-variant-3.title: White Bollard with Wide Black Band (White Tip Above)

ba-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ba-country-flag.description: The national flag of Bosnia and Herzegovina is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

bw-language.title: Language
bw-language.description: Road signage is in English; place names derive from Tswana and local languages.

bw-road-line-colour.title: Road Line Colours
bw-road-line-colour.description: Edge lines in Botswana are yellow and centre lines are white.

b-general-01-black-and-yellow-signposts.title: General 01 Black And Yellow Signposts
b-general-01-black-and-yellow-signposts.description: If you're in southern Africa and come across this, you know you're in Botswana.

bw-striped-curb-guardrail.title: Striped Curbs and Guardrails
bw-striped-curb-guardrail.description: Kerbs and guardrails are painted in black-and-yellow, red-and-white, or black-and-white stripes.

bw-legacy-blue-sign.title: Legacy Blue Signs
bw-legacy-blue-sign.description: Older road signs have blue backgrounds but are being replaced by white-background signs.

bw-architecture.title: Architecture
bw-architecture.description: Housing in Botswana ranges from tin-roof shacks to single-storey bungalows and occasional traditional circular huts.

bw-random-small-blur.title: Random Small Blurs
bw-random-small-blur.description: Google's blurring algorithm places small random patches of blur, mostly in towns.

bw-region-map.title: Region Map
bw-region-map.description: Botswana has distinct landscape zones marked by soil colour and vegetation.

bw-paved-vs-unpaved-road.title: Paved vs Unpaved Roads
bw-paved-vs-unpaved-road.description: Map shows which routes are surfaced and which are dirt or gravel.

bw-elevation.title: Elevation
bw-elevation.description: Most of Botswana is flat; hills appear mainly in two areas with some isolated outcrops.

bw-southeast-scrub-hill.title: Southeast Scrub Hills
bw-southeast-scrub-hill.description: Between Gaborone and Lobatse are low, scrubby hills in a semi-arid setting.

bw-eastern-red-soil-pocket.title: Eastern Red Soil Pocket
bw-eastern-red-soil-pocket.description: North of Francistown, soil is firm, rocky red with yellowed or leafless trees.

bw-white-sand-region.title: White Sand Region
bw-white-sand-region.description: Mid-western interior has bright white sandy soil and parched vegetation.

bw-gaborone.title: Gaborone
bw-gaborone.description: The capital is more developed and affluent, mostly flat with some southern hills.

bw-chobe-flood-plain.title: Chobe Flood Plains
bw-chobe-flood-plain.description: Northern area near Chobe River has dirt tracks, dense green bush, and visible wildlife.

bw-salt-pan.title: Salt Pans
bw-salt-pan.description: Central-east has vast salt flats around Nwetwe pan, accessed by dirt roads.

bw-country-flag.title: Country Flag
bw-country-flag.description: The national flag of Botswana is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

br-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
br-licence-plate.description: Pre-2018 plates were plain white; current plates have a blue strip on top; commercial plates are red.

br-language-01-portuguese.title: Language 01 Portuguese
br-language-01-portuguese.description: Brazil is the only South American country that uses the Portuguese language. It has the letter “Ç”, something Spanish does not.

br-nature-01-red-soil.title: Red soil
br-nature-01-red-soil.description: This iron rich, red soil is primarily found in Brazil.

xx-pole-01-ladder-poles.title: Pole 01 Ladder Poles
xx-pole-01-ladder-poles.description: The poles you often see in Brazil have a ladder-like design at the base. They have horizontal sections near the bottom.

br-blue-kilometre-marker.title: Blue Kilometre Markers
br-blue-kilometre-marker.description: Small blue roadside posts show the route number and current kilometre.

br-chevron.title: Chevrons
br-chevron.description: Brazilian curve signs use yellow arrows on black boards.

br-road-marking.title: Road Markings
br-road-marking.description: Centre lines are typically double solid yellow; edge lines are white.

br-white-painted-kerb.title: White-Painted Kerbs
br-white-painted-kerb.description: Kerbstones along Brazilian roads are frequently painted white.

br-orange-roof-tile.title: Orange Roof Tiles
br-orange-roof-tile.description: Terracotta-orange clay tiles are standard roofing material nationwide.

br-transparent-satellite-dish.title: Transparent Satellite Dishes
br-transparent-satellite-dish.description: Clear or translucent satellite dishes on rooftops are common and unique in Latin America.

br-fortlev-water-tank.title: Fortlev Water Tanks
br-fortlev-water-tank.description: Blue Fortlev-branded rooftop water tanks are common on Brazilian homes.

br-misc-01-phone-numbers.title: Misc 01 Phone Numbers
br-misc-01-phone-numbers.description: Phone numbers in Brazil often include an area code as a separate two-digit prefix.

br-general-01-states.title: States
br-general-01-states.description: Finding state abbreviations is common in Brazil. The abbreviations can be seen on the map on certain zoom levels.

br-postcode-cep.title: Postcodes (CEP)
br-postcode-cep.description: Postal codes on street signs start with two digits indicating region or state.

br-elevation-map.title: Elevation Map
br-elevation-map.description: Brazil's tallest peaks cluster near the southeast coast; interior states are flatter.

br-caatinga-northeast.title: Caatinga
br-caatinga-northeast.description: Northeast interior features dry soil, thorny scrub, and succulents of the Caatinga biome.

br-amazon-rainforest.title: Amazon Rainforest
br-amazon-rainforest.description: Amazon covers 40% of Brazil with few roads through dense forest or grassy hills.

br-acre-landscape.title: Acre Landscape
br-acre-landscape.description: Acre has low grassy mounds with thinly spaced trees and roads cresting hills.

br-roraima-plain.title: Roraima Plains
br-roraima-plain.description: Roraima features expansive grasslands with wispy grass in discrete clumps and distant mountains.

br-rio-grande-do-sul.title: Rio Grande do Sul
br-rio-grande-do-sul.description: Landscape alternates between rolling hills and flat green pastures.

br-southeastern-rolling-hill.title: Southeastern Rolling Hills
br-southeastern-rolling-hill.description: Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and Espírito Santo have gentle grass-covered rolling hills.

br-exposed-rock-mountain.title: Exposed Rock Mountains
br-exposed-rock-mountain.description: Tall mountains with bare rock faces are common in Espírito Santo and nearby regions.

br-parana-pine.title: Paraná Pines
br-parana-pine.description: Araucaria trees have long horizontal branches with foliage clustered at tips, found in Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul.

br-coconut-palm.title: Coconut Palms
br-coconut-palm.description: Tall slender palms with long fronds grow along the northeastern coast.

br-carnauba-palm.title: Carnaúba Palms
br-carnauba-palm.description: Palms with compact fan-shaped leaves and spiky lower trunks, concentrated in Ceará.

br-babassu-palm.title: Babassu Palms
br-babassu-palm.description: Large palms with heavy leaflet fronds found throughout the Amazon and eastern seaboard.

br-acai-palm.title: Açaí Palms
br-acai-palm.description: Thin-trunked palms with downward-hanging leaflets, abundant around Belém and the Amazon basin.

br-moriche-palm.title: Moriche Palms
br-moriche-palm.description: Palms with broad, rounded fan-shaped leaves, concentrated in Amazonas, Acre, and Roraima.

br-macaw-palm.title: Macaw Palms
br-macaw-palm.description: Narrow-leaved palms with pointed spear-shaped crowns, common around Mato Grosso do Sul.

br-long-stemmed-plant.title: Long-Stemmed Plants
br-long-stemmed-plant.description: Tall, erect stems topped by upward-growing leaf clusters, characteristic of Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, and Paraíba.

br-tall-roadside-grass.title: Tall Roadside Grass
br-tall-roadside-grass.description: Exceptionally tall grass flanking roads in Tocantins, Goiás, Bahia, and Minas Gerais.

br-eucalyptus-plantation.title: Eucalyptus Plantations
br-eucalyptus-plantation.description: Rows of extremely tall, straight Eucalyptus Grandis trees across southern Brazil and some in Amapá.

br-sugarcane.title: Sugarcane
br-sugarcane.description: Sugarcane fields concentrated in São Paulo and the northeastern coast, especially Alagoas and Pernambuco.

br-soybean-field.title: Soybean Fields
br-soybean-field.description: Low, bushy soybean crops in Mato Grosso, Paraná, and Goiás.

br-coffee-plantation.title: Coffee Plantations
br-coffee-plantation.description: Coffee cultivation dominated by Minas Gerais, with areas in Espírito Santo and northeastern São Paulo.

br-round-concrete-pole.title: Round Concrete Poles
br-round-concrete-pole.description: Cylindrical concrete poles common in southern states and São Paulo; large cities use round poles.

br-wooden-pole.title: Wooden Poles
br-wooden-pole.description: Timber utility poles prevalent in Rio Grande do Sul, Roraima, Amazonas, and Rio de Janeiro.

br-bahia-pernambuco-pole-id.title: Bahia and Pernambuco Pole IDs
br-bahia-pernambuco-pole-id.description: Poles marked with yellow paint and black alphanumeric codes starting with a letter.

br-goias-pole-id.title: Goiás Pole IDs
br-goias-pole-id.description: Yellow-on-black painted codes starting with a digit, sometimes on plates.

br-rn-pe-small-pole-plate.title: RN and PE Small Pole Plates
br-rn-pe-small-pole-plate.description: Small yellow or orange ID plates fastened to poles in Rio Grande do Norte and Pernambuco.

br-parana-pole-id.title: Paraná Pole IDs
br-parana-pole-id.description: Poles identified by a painted black rectangle with yellow or white text.

br-maranhao-embedded-pole-plate.title: Maranhão Embedded Pole Plates
br-maranhao-embedded-pole-plate.description: Small beige numbered plates moulded into concrete poles, mostly in Maranhão.

br-parana-street-name-pole.title: Paraná Street Name Poles
br-parana-street-name-pole.description: Street names sometimes painted directly on utility poles at intersections in Paraná.

br-sao-paulo-asymmetric-pole-top.title: São Paulo Asymmetric Pole Top
br-sao-paulo-asymmetric-pole-top.description: Off-centre crossarm with diagonal support common in São Paulo and some other states.

br-ceara-rondonia-unsupported-crossbar.title: Ceará and Rondônia Unsupported Crossbar
br-ceara-rondonia-unsupported-crossbar.description: Asymmetric crossarm with no bracing exclusive to Ceará and Rondônia.

br-ceara-roraima-zigzag-pole-top.title: Ceará and Roraima Zigzag Pole Top
br-ceara-roraima-zigzag-pole-top.description: Zigzag-shaped top bar on a tall pole seen only in Ceará and Roraima.

br-pencil-pole.title: Pencil Poles
br-pencil-pole.description: Poles capped with smooth conical tips typical of Rio de Janeiro.

br-alternating-horizontal-insulator.title: Alternating Horizontal Insulators
br-alternating-horizontal-insulator.description: One central insulator above with horizontally alternating ones below in Mato Grosso and southern Acre.

br-brown-mushroom-insulator.title: Brown Mushroom Insulators
br-brown-mushroom-insulator.description: Brown mushroom-shaped insulators exclusive to Pernambuco.

br-white-mushroom-insulator.title: White Mushroom Insulators
br-white-mushroom-insulator.description: White mushroom-shaped insulators in Bahia and around Brasília.

br-transparent-insulator.title: Transparent Insulators
br-transparent-insulator.description: Clear glass or plastic insulators in Alagoas and Santa Catarina.

br-spool-shaped-insulator.title: Spool-Shaped Insulators
br-spool-shaped-insulator.description: Thread spool-shaped insulators in Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo, and Ceará.

br-elongated-thin-insulator.title: Elongated Thin Insulators
br-elongated-thin-insulator.description: Long, slender insulators mainly in Ceará.

br-horizontal-insulator.title: Horizontal Insulators
br-horizontal-insulator.description: Sideways-mounted insulators common in Pará and Mato Grosso.

br-long-grey-insulator.title: Long Grey Insulators
br-long-grey-insulator.description: Tall grey insulators common in Pará, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, Bahia, and other states.

br-maranhao-trident-insulator.title: Maranhão Trident Insulators
br-maranhao-trident-insulator.description: Black double-disc insulators arranged in a trident pattern characteristic of Maranhão.

br-lollipop-insulator.title: Lollipop Insulators
br-lollipop-insulator.description: Round or conical insulators on vertical rods above crossbars common in Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, and Pernambuco.

br-dark-brown-insulator-grey-base.title: Dark Brown Insulators with Grey Bases
br-dark-brown-insulator-grey-base.description: Found almost exclusively in Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul.

br-concrete-waste-bin.title: Concrete Waste Bins
br-concrete-waste-bin.description: In Acre and Rondônia, Brazilian homes use concrete curbside waste baskets instead of metal.

br-two-part-lamp-fixture.title: Two-Part Lamp Fixtures
br-two-part-lamp-fixture.description: Dual-head street lights are common in Minas Gerais and Goiás, and also appear in several other states.

br-parana-armless-lamp.title: Paraná Armless Lamps
br-parana-armless-lamp.description: Northern Paraná street lights sometimes lack horizontal arms and are mounted directly on poles.

br-direct-mounted-lamp-arm.title: Direct-Mounted Lamp Arms
br-direct-mounted-lamp-arm.description: In several states, lamp arms are bent and run along the pole, attached directly to it rather than through a plate.

br-roraima-city-coloured-lamp.title: Roraima City-Coloured Lamps
br-roraima-city-coloured-lamp.description: Roraima's lamp fixtures share a shape but are painted different colours by city.

br-ceara-ornamental-lamp-arm.title: Ceará Ornamental Lamp Arms
br-ceara-ornamental-lamp-arm.description: Ceará street lights often have decorative, brightly painted arms, sometimes with town names.

br-sao-paulo-divided-highway.title: São Paulo Divided Highways
br-sao-paulo-divided-highway.description: São Paulo has significantly more multi-lane divided highways than other parts of Brazil.

br-sao-paulo-km-marker-phone.title: São Paulo Km Marker Phone Numbers
br-sao-paulo-km-marker-phone.description: Telephone numbers sometimes appear below kilometre marker posts in São Paulo.

br-cobblestone-street.title: Cobblestone Streets
br-cobblestone-street.description: Cobblestone roads are most frequent in the northeast and Rio Grande do Sul.

br-hexagonal-concrete-tile.title: Hexagonal Concrete Tiles
br-hexagonal-concrete-tile.description: Hexagonal concrete paving blocks are common in Santa Catarina and Minas Gerais.

br-acre-red-brick-road.title: Acre Red Brick Roads
br-acre-red-brick-road.description: Some roads in Acre are paved with red bricks.

br-irregular-cobblestone-road.title: Irregular Cobblestone Roads
br-irregular-cobblestone-road.description: Streets paved with uneven stones are common in southeastern Rio Grande do Sul and Minas Gerais.

br-rough-square-stone-road.title: Rough Square-Stone Roads
br-rough-square-stone-road.description: Bumpy roads of roughly square-cut stones appear in western Rio Grande do Sul and Santa Catarina.

br-brown-tile-pavement.title: Brown Tile Pavements
br-brown-tile-pavement.description: Brown tile footpaths, jagged or square, are typical of Rio Grande do Sul and sometimes Santa Catarina.

br-european-influenced-architecture.title: European-Influenced Architecture
br-european-influenced-architecture.description: Southern states, especially Santa Catarina, feature buildings with Germanic architectural style.

br-stilt-house.title: Stilt Houses
br-stilt-house.description: Timber houses on stilts are common in Acre and flood-prone areas of Amazonas and Pará.

br-piaui-red-gravel-shoulder.title: Piauí Red Gravel Shoulders
br-piaui-red-gravel-shoulder.description: Roads in Piauí have red gravel verges, often persisting alongside tarmac and kerbs.

br-joao-de-barro-nest.title: João-de-Barro Nests
br-joao-de-barro-nest.description: Rufous Hornero bird builds round clay nests atop utility poles across southern Brazil.

br-coastal-rio-grande-do-sul-wetland.title: Coastal Rio Grande do Sul Wetland
br-coastal-rio-grande-do-sul-wetland.description: Rio Grande do Sul's coast is an unusually flat wetland for Brazil.

br-sao-paulo-pole-id-paint.title: São Paulo Pole ID Paint
br-sao-paulo-pole-id-paint.description: Poles in São Paulo have a yellow rectangle with letters and digits indicating municipality and ID.

br-rio-de-janeiro-curved-lamp-arm.title: Rio de Janeiro Curved Lamp Arms
br-rio-de-janeiro-curved-lamp-arm.description: Street light arms in Rio de Janeiro are continuously curved along their entire length.

br-country-flag.title: Country Flag
br-country-flag.description: The national flag of Brazil is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

io-palm-lined-sand-beach.title: Palm-Lined Sand Beaches
io-palm-lined-sand-beach.description: Sandy shorelines fringed with palm trees.

io-coconut-palm-forest.title: Coconut Palm Forests
io-coconut-palm-forest.description: Dense coconut palm stands along the coast.

io-interior-grassy-clearing.title: Interior Grassy Clearings
io-interior-grassy-clearing.description: Open grassy fields ringed by low bushes and palms on larger islands.

io-offshore-trekker-footage.title: Offshore Trekker Footage
io-offshore-trekker-footage.description: Imagery taken from shallow water offshore.

io-country-flag.title: Country Flag
io-country-flag.description: The national flag of the British Indian Ocean Territory is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

bg-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
bg-licence-plate.description: Bulgarian plates have a blue EU band on the left side.

bg-street-ulitsa.title: Street Word 'улица'
bg-street-ulitsa.description: Streets are labelled улица (ulitsa), often shortened to ул.

bg-concrete-utility-pole.title: Concrete Utility Poles
bg-concrete-utility-pole.description: Dominant poles are round concrete cylinders.

bg-alternating-hook-insulator.title: Alternating Hook Insulators
bg-alternating-hook-insulator.description: Pole tops have small insulators arranged in alternating hooks along a crossarm.

bg-three-large-hook-insulator.title: Three Large Hook Insulators
bg-three-large-hook-insulator.description: Poles have three oversized hook-shaped insulators pointing upward, staggered side to side.

bg-chevron.title: Chevrons
bg-chevron.description: Curve warning boards show red arrows on a white background.

xx-general-01-62-bilingual-signs.title: General 01 62 Bilingual Signs
xx-general-01-62-bilingual-signs.description: Road direction signs in Bulgaria are blue, arrow-shaped, and printed in both Cyrillic and Latin script.

bg-town-entry-sign.title: Town Entry Signs
bg-town-entry-sign.description: Settlement names appear on plain white boards with Cyrillic and Latin text in two lines.

bg-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signs
bg-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Bulgarian pedestrian crossing signs show a pedestrian wearing a hat walking across four horizontal stripes.

bg-bollard.title: Bollards
bg-bollard.description: Roadside bollards have red reflectors facing traffic and white on the rear.

bg-thin-road-marking.title: Thin Road Markings
bg-thin-road-marking.description: Road line markings are noticeably narrow.

bg-road-surface-quality.title: Road Surface Quality
bg-road-surface-quality.description: Road surfaces often have fine cracks and occasional potholes.

bg-orange-roof-tile.title: Orange Roof Tiles
bg-orange-roof-tile.description: Houses have orange clay tile roofs with visible mortar patches and uneven tilework.

bg-suburban-area.title: Suburban Areas
bg-suburban-area.description: Suburbs have tightly packed small houses with a run-down appearance.

bg-topography-overview.title: Topography Overview
bg-topography-overview.description: The Balkan range bisects the country; broad plains lie north, Rhodope Mountains in the south, and small valleys in the west.

bg-area-code.title: Area Codes
bg-area-code.description: Telephone area codes start with a digit that narrows down the region.

bg-pirin-rila-peak.title: Pirin and Rila Peaks
bg-pirin-rila-peak.description: Sharp, pyramid-like summits of Pirin and Rila parks are visible in certain provinces.

bg-wind-turbine.title: Wind Turbines
bg-wind-turbine.description: Wind farms concentrate in Dobrich Province near the Black Sea coast.

bg-nessebar-sozopol-old-town.title: Nessebar and Sozopol Old Towns
bg-nessebar-sozopol-old-town.description: Historic cores feature buildings with raw stone, whitewashed walls, dark timber framing, and cobblestone lanes.

bg-sofia-street-sign.title: Sofia Street Signs
bg-sofia-street-sign.description: Street plaques are white with two red bands—one along the bottom edge and one across part of the top.

bg-stara-zagora-street-sign.title: Stara Zagora Street Signs
bg-stara-zagora-street-sign.description: Street plaques are brown with vivid yellow lettering.

bg-country-flag.title: Country Flag
bg-country-flag.description: The national flag of Bulgaria is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-pole-01-01-cambodian-poles.title: Pole 01 01 Cambodian Poles
xx-pole-01-01-cambodian-poles.description: In Cambodia, you will typically see either concrete ladder poles with rectangular sections or round poles with small holes.

kh-bollard.title: Bollards
kh-bollard.description: Common bollards are stone posts with red-and-white stripes or red tops with embedded reflectors.

kh-road-marker.title: Road Markers
kh-road-marker.description: Kilometre posts are stone with white bases and rounded red tops showing road numbers and town distances.

kh-chevron.title: Chevrons
kh-chevron.description: Cambodian curve boards are black with yellow arrows but appear infrequently.

kh-road-line.title: Road Lines
kh-road-line.description: Cambodian roads have yellow centre lines; white edge lines are uncommon but always solid.

kh-unpaved-road.title: Unpaved Roads
kh-unpaved-road.description: Many Cambodian roads are unpaved; asphalt is mostly on main roads and in urban areas.

kh-stilt-house.title: Stilt Houses
kh-stilt-house.description: Wooden stilt houses with vertical plank walls and layered roofs are widespread in Cambodia.

kh-house-colour-scheme.title: House Colour Schemes
kh-house-colour-scheme.description: Traditional Cambodian stilt houses have walls in dark red-brown, light blue, or ochre orange, with doors and windows often bright blue.

kh-roof-style.title: Roof Styles
kh-roof-style.description: Many Cambodian homes have tiled orange or red roofs, sometimes with ornamental ridge and corner details; corrugated metal roofing is also common.

kh-buddhist-temple.title: Buddhist Temples
kh-buddhist-temple.description: Ornately decorated temples with multi-tiered roofs and Buddhist flags are found throughout Cambodia.

kh-beer-advertisement.title: Beer Advertisements
kh-beer-advertisement.description: Billboards and signs advertising Angkor, Anchor, and Cambodia Beer are ubiquitous.

kh-cpp-party-sign.title: CPP Party Signs
kh-cpp-party-sign.description: Distinctive blue signs from the Cambodian People's Party (CPP) often feature portraits of three party leaders.

kh-central-agricultural-plain.title: Central Agricultural Plain
kh-central-agricultural-plain.description: A flat, low-lying central plain with cultivated fields and villages.

kh-northeast-landscape.title: Northeast Landscape
kh-northeast-landscape.description: Less cultivated northeast with wild vegetation and gently rolling hills.

kh-southwest-highland.title: Southwest Highlands
kh-southwest-highland.description: Highest elevations with hills, low mountains, dense forest inland, and more populated coastal areas.

kh-white-sandy-soil-southeast.title: White Sandy Soil
kh-white-sandy-soil-southeast.description: Bright white to beige sandy soil common southeast of Phnom Penh and around the capital.

kh-northern-thai-border-mountain.title: Northern Thai Border Mountains
kh-northern-thai-border-mountain.description: Mountainous ridgeline near the Thai border with characteristic red soil; roads lie in flat lowlands south of the ridgeline.

kh-rubber-tree-plantation.title: Rubber Tree Plantations
kh-rubber-tree-plantation.description: Neatly rowed thin-trunked rubber trees with dark green canopies, found northeast of Phnom Penh, around Ban Lung, and near Pech Sreada.

kh-road-48-black-white-bollard.title: Road 48 Black-and-White Bollards
kh-road-48-black-white-bollard.description: Black-and-white bollards appear only on Road 48 between Tatai and the Road 4 intersection.

kh-kiri-sakor-road-construction.title: Kiri Sakor Road Construction
kh-kiri-sakor-road-construction.description: Road from Road 48 to Kiri Sakor is under construction with one paved lane and exposed red soil on the other side.

kh-southwest-jungle-off-road.title: Southwest Jungle Off-Roads
kh-southwest-jungle-off-road.description: Unpaved tracks northeast of Road 48 with red soil, dense jungle, and hilly terrain.

kh-phnum-samkos-area.title: Phnum Samkos Area
kh-phnum-samkos-area.description: Overcast weather, large distant mountains, unpaved brown roads, and lush wild vegetation near Phnum Samkos.

kh-road-4-red-shoulder.title: Road 4 Red Shoulders
kh-road-4-red-shoulder.description: Road 4 between Angk Snuol and Preah Sihanouk has wide red-brown shoulders that darken closer to the coast.

kh-oil-palm-plantation.title: Oil Palm Plantations
kh-oil-palm-plantation.description: Oil palm plantations along Road 4 and its rural offshoots just north of Preah Nob.

kh-road-41.title: Road 41
kh-road-41.description: Wide gravelly grey road southwest of Phnom Penh running north-northeast through flat agricultural terrain with distant hills.

kh-unique-pole-road-5-6.title: Unique Poles
kh-unique-pole-road-5-6.description: Utility poles on Roads 5 and 6 have three horizontal beams with hanging insulators on one side and distinctive base indents.

kh-pech-sreada-rubber-plantation.title: Pech Sreada Rubber Plantations
kh-pech-sreada-rubber-plantation.description: Rubber trees near Pech Sreada with bright orange soil and a barren dry-season look.

kh-angkor-wat.title: Angkor Wat
kh-angkor-wat.description: Massive Khmer temple complex north of Siem Reap with dark weathered stone and tourist crowds.

kh-country-flag.title: Country Flag
kh-country-flag.description: The national flag of Cambodia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-road-signs-01-checkered-signs.title: Road Signs 01 Checkered Signs
xx-road-signs-01-checkered-signs.description: In Canada, T-intersection signs are diamond-shaped and have a distinctive checkered pattern.

ca-centre-line-marking.title: Centre Line Markings
ca-centre-line-marking.description: Canadian roads commonly use a single yellow centre line; double yellow lines also appear.

ca-missing-front-plate.title: Missing Front Plates
ca-missing-front-plate.description: Seven provinces issue only a rear plate; vehicles without front plates exclude BC, Manitoba, and Ontario.

ca-alberta-licence-plate.title: Alberta Licence Plate
ca-alberta-licence-plate.description: White plate with bold red characters, visible through the blur as a red tint

ca-british-columbia-licence-plate.title: British Columbia Licence Plate
ca-british-columbia-licence-plate.description: British Columbia plates appear pale white with a slight bluish tint.

ca-manitoba-licence-plate.title: Manitoba Licence Plate
ca-manitoba-licence-plate.description: Manitoba plates are white with dark blue character shapes, a faint pale-blue area near the top, and blurred green-turquoise landscape shapes along the lower edges.

ca-new-brunswick-licence-plate.title: New Brunswick Licence Plate
ca-new-brunswick-licence-plate.description: New Brunswick plates appear pale white with a reddish tint.

ca-newfoundland-labrador-licence-plate.title: Newfoundland & Labrador Licence Plate
ca-newfoundland-labrador-licence-plate.description: Newfoundland and Labrador plates are pale white with a red blob in the lower-left area.

ca-nova-scotia-licence-plate.title: Nova Scotia Licence Plate
ca-nova-scotia-licence-plate.description: White plate with dark blue characters, visible only as blue blurred shapes.

ca-ontario-licence-plate.title: Ontario Licence Plate
ca-ontario-licence-plate.description: Dark blue plate with white characters, white trillium logo, and "A PLACE TO GROW" slogan at the bottom.

ca-prince-edward-island-licence-plate.title: Prince Edward Island Licence Plate
ca-prince-edward-island-licence-plate.description: Prince Edward Island plates are pale white with a green tint and a faint red-orange blob in the centre.

ca-quebec-licence-plate.title: Quebec Licence Plate
ca-quebec-licence-plate.description: Québec plates appear white with a dark bluish tint.

ca-saskatchewan-licence-plate.title: Saskatchewan Licence Plate
ca-saskatchewan-licence-plate.description: Saskatchewan plates are white with green character shapes, a faint green text-like area, and a golden wheat-sheaf graphic between the character groups.

ca-10-alberta.title: Alberta Provincial Highway Shield
ca-10-alberta.description: Highway shields in Alberta have 'ALBERTA' written on the banner at the bottom.

ca-10-british-columbia.title: British Columbia Highway Shield
ca-10-british-columbia.description: Highway shields in British Columbia have the BC coat of arms at the top and 'B.C.' written below the route number.

ca-10-manitoba.title: Manitoba Provincial Highway Shield
ca-10-manitoba.description: Highway shields in Manitoba have 'MANITOBA' written on the banner at the bottom.

ca-10-new-brunswick.title: New Brunswick Highway Shield
ca-10-new-brunswick.description: New Brunswick highway shields show the white silhouette of the province with 'NB' inside.

ca-10-newfoundland-and-labrador.title: Newfoundland and Labrador Highway Shield
ca-10-newfoundland-and-labrador.description: Highway shields in Newfoundland have 'NEWFOUNDLAND' written on the banner at the bottom.

ca-10-nova-scotia.title: Nova Scotia Highway Shield
ca-10-nova-scotia.description: Highway shields in Nova Scotia show the provincial flag at the top.

ca-10-ontario.title: Ontario King's Highway Shield
ca-10-ontario.description: Highway shields in Ontario have a black crown on top and 'ONTARIO' written at the bottom.

ca-10-prince-edward-island.title: Prince Edward Island Highway Shield
ca-10-prince-edward-island.description: Highway shields in Prince Edward Island have 'PRINCE EDWARD ISLAND' written on the banner at the bottom.

ca-10-quebec.title: Quebec Autoroute Shield
ca-10-quebec.description: Route shields in Quebec are red on top and blue on the bottom, with a small fleur-de-lis below the route number.

ca-10-saskatchewan.title: Saskatchewan Highway Shield
ca-10-saskatchewan.description: Highway shields in Saskatchewan have 'SASKATCHEWAN' written on the banner at the bottom.

ca-11-alberta.title: Alberta Kilometre Marker
ca-11-alberta.description: Tall, narrow green rectangle with white numbers centered vertically, no additional symbols.

ca-11-british-columbia.title: British Columbia Kilometre Marker
ca-11-british-columbia.description: Green rectangular marker with white numbers, often with small white 'km' label below number.

ca-11-manitoba.title: Manitoba Kilometre Marker
ca-11-manitoba.description: Green rectangle with bold white numbers, sometimes with small provincial highway shield above or below number.

ca-11-new-brunswick.title: New Brunswick Kilometre Marker
ca-11-new-brunswick.description: Green rectangle with white numbers, sometimes including small white 'km' at bottom right corner.

ca-11-newfoundland-and-labrador.title: Newfoundland and Labrador Kilometre Marker
ca-11-newfoundland-and-labrador.description: Green rectangle with white numbers, typically without additional text or symbols, mounted on metal posts.

ca-11-nova-scotia.title: Nova Scotia Kilometre Marker
ca-11-nova-scotia.description: Green rectangle with white numbers, sometimes with small white 'km' at bottom.

ca-11-ontario.title: Ontario Kilometre Marker
ca-11-ontario.description: Ontario's kilometre marker is a tall green rectangle with white numbers above a white square at the post's bottom.

ca-11-prince-edward-island.title: Prince Edward Island Kilometre Marker
ca-11-prince-edward-island.description: Prince Edward Island uses green rectangular markers with white numbers, sometimes with a small 'km' label, often on wooden posts.

ca-11-quebec.title: Quebec Kilometre Marker
ca-11-quebec.description: Quebec's kilometre markers are green rectangles with white numbers, often with a small white 'km' below.

ca-11-saskatchewan.title: Saskatchewan Kilometre Marker
ca-11-saskatchewan.description: Saskatchewan's markers are green rectangles with white numbers, sometimes with a small 'km' label, usually on metal posts.

ca-provincial-speed-sign-variant.title: Provincial Speed Sign Variants
ca-provincial-speed-sign-variant.description: Ontario speed signs may include a black strip reading 'km/h' or 'begins'. British Columbia shows 'km/h' without the black section. Québec signs sometimes include French text.

ca-alberta-bollard.title: Alberta Bollards
ca-alberta-bollard.description: Cylindrical white bollards with two black bands wrapped all the way around are common at Alberta intersections.

ca-manitoba-bollard.title: Manitoba Bollards
ca-manitoba-bollard.description: Manitoba bollards are black over grey, usually with an orange stripe below the grey section; further north, rectangular wooden bollards appear.

ca-quebec-guardrail-bollard.title: Québec Guardrail Bollards
ca-quebec-guardrail-bollard.description: Slender white poles tipped with a red or green reflector, always mounted directly on guardrails, unique to Québec.

ca-quebec-fire-hydrant-marker.title: Québec Fire Hydrant Markers
ca-quebec-fire-hydrant-marker.description: Yellow markers on top of signposts indicate underground fire hydrants throughout Québec.

ca-quebec-rectangular-road-marker.title: Québec Rectangular Road Markers
ca-quebec-rectangular-road-marker.description: Small rectangular reflective markers line Québec roadsides; their colour varies.

ca-ontario-diamond-road-marker.title: Ontario Diamond Road Markers
ca-ontario-diamond-road-marker.description: Diamond-shaped reflective markers are placed along roadsides in Ontario; their colour varies.

ca-ontario-wire-guardrail.title: Ontario Wire Guardrails
ca-ontario-wire-guardrail.description: Ontario guardrails have round wooden posts linked by exactly three metal wires; some posts have a reflective white band.

ca-northwest-territories-bollard.title: Northwest Territories Bollards
ca-northwest-territories-bollard.description: Cylindrical black-and-white bollards with two notably thick black bands, broader than Alberta's.

ca-transformer-orientation-bc-nb.title: Transformer Orientation (BC & NB)
ca-transformer-orientation-bc-nb.description: Pole-mounted transformers in British Columbia and New Brunswick face the road; elsewhere they align with the wires.

ca-45-degree-transformer-pei-ns.title: 45° Transformers (PEI & NS)
ca-45-degree-transformer-pei-ns.description: Transformers on Prince Edward Island and Nova Scotia are mounted at a 45° angle to the road; PEI ones usually have red numbers on the side.

ca-ontario-pole-top.title: Ontario Pole Tops
ca-ontario-pole-top.description: Ontario poles often have two insulators on the sides and one on top, attached with a distinctive bracket; multiple units can stack vertically.

ca-quebec-pole-top.title: Québec Pole Tops
ca-quebec-pole-top.description: Some Québec utility poles carry insulator rods that tilt slightly upward, a recognisable silhouette.

ca-quebec-pole-label.title: Québec Pole Labels
ca-quebec-pole-label.description: Québec utility poles sometimes display a vertical sticker split black and yellow, with a small 'Q' in the black half.

ca-pei-pole-sticker.title: PEI Pole Stickers
ca-pei-pole-sticker.description: Prince Edward Island utility poles typically bear a small white sticker.

ca-saskatchewan-alternating-pole-top.title: Saskatchewan Alternating Pole Tops
ca-saskatchewan-alternating-pole-top.description: Insulators on consecutive Saskatchewan poles alternate sides: one pole has one insulator left and two right, the next reverses this.

ca-quebec-t-intersection-sign.title: Québec T-Intersection Signs
ca-quebec-t-intersection-sign.description: Québec's T-intersection signs omit the chequerboard pattern entirely.

ca-newfoundland-t-intersection-sign.title: Newfoundland T-Intersection Signs
ca-newfoundland-t-intersection-sign.description: Newfoundland's diamond-shaped T-intersection sign sits inside a rectangular yellow border, unique to the province.

ca-bc-green-sign-back.title: BC Green Sign Backs
ca-bc-green-sign-back.description: The reverse side of road signs in British Columbia is often painted green.

ca-bc-hanging-sign.title: BC Hanging Signs
ca-bc-hanging-sign.description: In British Columbia, road signs are sometimes suspended from distinctive overhead brackets instead of posts.
