ca-bc-concrete-barrier.title: BC Concrete Barriers
ca-bc-concrete-barrier.description: British Columbia favours solid concrete barriers over metal guardrails on highways.

ca-manitoba-signpost-sticker.title: Manitoba Signpost Stickers
ca-manitoba-signpost-sticker.description: Manitoba signposts sometimes carry a small green-and-white striped sticker.

ca-saskatchewan-signpost-triangle.title: Saskatchewan Signpost Triangles
ca-saskatchewan-signpost-triangle.description: White triangular markers are attached to Saskatchewan signposts; the number varies.

ca-saskatchewan-centre-line-dash.title: Saskatchewan Centre Line Dashes
ca-saskatchewan-centre-line-dash.description: White dashed lines sometimes appear between yellow centre lines on Saskatchewan roads.

ca-arret-stop-sign.title: 'Arrêt' Stop Signs
ca-arret-stop-sign.description: Stop signs displaying only the French word 'Arrêt' are found exclusively in Québec.

ca-bilingual-stop-arret-sign.title: Bilingual 'Stop/Arrêt' Signs
ca-bilingual-stop-arret-sign.description: Stop signs bearing both 'Stop' and 'Arrêt' are predominantly a New Brunswick feature.

ca-alberta-grid-road-system.title: Alberta Grid Road System
ca-alberta-grid-road-system.description: Alberta's rural roads follow a numbered grid with Township roads running east–west and Range roads running north–south.

ca-alberta-cable-guardrail.title: Alberta Cable Guardrails
ca-alberta-cable-guardrail.description: Some Alberta highways have guardrails made of short posts connected by steel cables.

ca-newfoundland-pyramid-post-top.title: Newfoundland Pyramid Post Tops
ca-newfoundland-pyramid-post-top.description: Wooden guardrail posts in Newfoundland and Labrador are capped with a distinctive pyramid shape.

ca-newfoundland-hydrant-marker.title: Newfoundland Hydrant Markers
ca-newfoundland-hydrant-marker.description: Fire hydrants in Newfoundland often have a diamond-shaped marker beside them.

ca-newfoundland-wooden-sign-base.title: Newfoundland Wooden Sign Bases
ca-newfoundland-wooden-sign-base.description: Signs in Newfoundland and Labrador are sometimes supported by wooden box bases.

ca-traffic-cone-colour.title: Traffic Cone Colours
ca-traffic-cone-colour.description: Ontario uses orange-and-black striped cones; Québec uses orange-and-white striped cones.

ca-quebec-red-white-chevron.title: Québec Red-and-White Chevrons
ca-quebec-red-white-chevron.description: Québec curve warning boards are red and white, unlike the yellow-and-black used elsewhere.

ca-rectangular-street-lamp-nb-ns.title: Rectangular Street Lamps
ca-rectangular-street-lamp-nb-ns.description: New Brunswick and Nova Scotia often use rectangular-shaped lamp heads on street lights.

ca-western-mountain.title: Western Mountains
ca-western-mountain.description: Major mountain ranges are concentrated in British Columbia, western Alberta, and parts of Yukon.

ca-yukon-boreal-landscape.title: Yukon Boreal Landscape
ca-yukon-boreal-landscape.description: Yukon features boreal terrain with hilly land, distant mountains, and coniferous trees lining roads.

ca-bc-interior-kamloops-kelowna.title: BC Interior
ca-bc-interior-kamloops-kelowna.description: Southern British Columbia's interior is drier and hillier with brown grasslands and pine forests.

ca-great-plain.title: Great Plains
ca-great-plain.description: A vast, flat agricultural area with few trees, growing drier toward the southwest near Montana.

ca-canola-field.title: Canola Fields
ca-canola-field.description: Bright yellow canola flower fields are found in the central southern prairies.

ca-southern-saskatchewan-hill.title: Southern Saskatchewan Hills
ca-southern-saskatchewan-hill.description: Southern Saskatchewan has hilly, barren terrain with numerous river valleys.

ca-manitoba-aspen-tree.title: Manitoba Aspen Trees
ca-manitoba-aspen-tree.description: Aspens with white trunks are common in Manitoba's forests, turning yellow in autumn.

ca-canadian-shield-exposed-rock.title: Canadian Shield Exposed Rock
ca-canadian-shield-exposed-rock.description: The Canadian Shield features bare rock outcrops visible along highways in eastern Canada.

ca-quebec-city-windsor-corridor.title: Québec City–Windsor Corridor
ca-quebec-city-windsor-corridor.description: Canada's most populated zone, a flat green belt mixing farmland and woodland between Québec City and Windsor.

ca-pei-red-soil.title: PEI Red Soil
ca-pei-red-soil.description: Prince Edward Island is known for its red-tinted earth and potato farming.

ca-newfoundland-balsam-fir.title: Newfoundland Balsam Fir
ca-newfoundland-balsam-fir.description: The balsam fir, a cone-shaped evergreen, is very common in Newfoundland.

ca-area-code.title: Area Codes
ca-area-code.description: Canadian phone numbers start with a three-digit area code in the format XXX XXX XXXX.

ca-provincial-flag.title: Quebec Provincial Flags
ca-provincial-flag.description: Provincial flag, Québec's Fleurdelisé, is commonly displayed on buildings and roads.

ca-newfoundland-wooden-bin.title: Newfoundland Wooden Bins
ca-newfoundland-wooden-bin.description: Octagonal wooden bins are common in Newfoundland driveways.

ca-acadia.title: Acadia
ca-acadia.description: Acadia is a French-speaking region in northern and eastern New Brunswick, flying a French tricolour with a yellow star.

ca-gaspe-peninsula.title: Gaspé Peninsula
ca-gaspe-peninsula.description: Inland roads wind through heavily forested mountainous terrain with frequent overcast weather.

ca-cape-breton-highland.title: Cape Breton Highlands
ca-cape-breton-highland.description: Northeastern Nova Scotia's Cape Breton Highlands have high elevation and dense mixed forests.

ca-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ca-country-flag.description: The Canadian flag is red and white with a red maple leaf in the middle.

cl-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
cl-licence-plate.description: Private vehicles have white plates; taxis and commercial vehicles have orange ones.

cl-slotted-signpost.title: Slotted Signposts
cl-slotted-signpost.description: Sign poles often have open slots cut into the upper section.

cl-orange-temporary-bollard.title: Orange Temporary Bollards
cl-orange-temporary-bollard.description: Bright orange temporary road markers with white stripes sometimes replace permanent bollards.

cl-red-bridge-post.title: Red Bridge Posts
cl-red-bridge-post.description: Bridge railings and fence posts are commonly painted red.

cl-climate-zone.title: Climate Zones
cl-climate-zone.description: Chile spans arid desert in the north, Mediterranean near Santiago, and cold oceanic in the south.

cl-regional-road-letter-system.title: Regional Road Letter System
cl-regional-road-letter-system.description: Regional road numbers use letters from A in the north to Y in the south, indicating latitude.

cl-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
cl-phone-area-code.description: Landline numbers show two-digit area codes following a geographic pattern.

cl-atacama-desert.title: Atacama Desert
cl-atacama-desert.description: The northern third is the Atacama Desert, one of the driest places on Earth, with barren sand and rock.

cl-arica-parinacota-landscape.title: Arica y Parinacota Landscape
cl-arica-parinacota-landscape.description: Rounded, sandy-looking mountains with carved valleys are typical of the northernmost province.

cl-atacama-coquimbo-mountains.title: Atacama and Coquimbo Mountains
cl-atacama-coquimbo-mountains.description: Jagged, uneven rock formations dominate Atacama and northern Coquimbo.

cl-brownish-red-soil.title: Brownish Red Soil
cl-brownish-red-soil.description: Reddish-brown earth patches indicate Atacama province.

cl-eucalyptus-plantation.title: Eucalyptus Plantations
cl-eucalyptus-plantation.description: Rows of eucalyptus trees in semi-arid settings point to southwestern Valparaíso.

cl-santiago-region-landscape.title: Santiago Region Landscape
cl-santiago-region-landscape.description: Semi-arid hillsides with sparse scrub surround the capital.

cl-maule-province.title: Maule Province
cl-maule-province.description: Greener than Santiago, with vineyards common across the province.

cl-concepcion-pine.title: Concepción Pines
cl-concepcion-pine.description: Pinus radiata with fluffy needle clusters grow mainly in Bío Bío.

cl-tree-lined-narrow-road.title: Tree-Lined Narrow Roads
cl-tree-lined-narrow-road.description: Narrow roads flanked by dense trees are common in Bío Bío and Araucanía.

cl-monkey-puzzle-tree.title: Monkey Puzzle Trees
cl-monkey-puzzle-tree.description: Araucaria araucana with stiff, scaly branches grow in eastern Araucanía highlands.

cl-chilean-rhubarb.title: Chilean Rhubarb
cl-chilean-rhubarb.description: Nalca with oversized cabbage-like leaves grows on Isla Grande de Chiloé and nearby mainland.

cl-southern-green-valley.title: Southern Green Valleys
cl-southern-green-valley.description: Deep green valleys with rocky peaks and overcast skies span southern Los Lagos to northern Aysén.

cl-autumn-coverage-southern-aysen.title: Autumn Coverage in Southern Aysén
cl-autumn-coverage-southern-aysen.description: Southern Aysén shows vivid orange and red autumn foliage.

cl-alto-bio-bio-national-reserve.title: Alto Bío Bío National Reserve
cl-alto-bio-bio-national-reserve.description: A treeless highland plateau with triple yellow centre lines and monkey puzzle trees near the east.

cl-orange-street-lamp.title: Orange Street Lamps
cl-orange-street-lamp.description: Warm orange street lights are common in Calama and Chañaral.

cl-santiago-photocell-lamp.title: Santiago Photocell Lamps
cl-santiago-photocell-lamp.description: Light-sensitive photocells on street lamps are common in Santiago.

cl-arica-pole-marking.title: Arica Pole Markings
cl-arica-pole-marking.description: Utility poles in Arica have white number markings; elsewhere in Atacama Desert they are yellow.

cl-country-flag.title: Country Flag
cl-country-flag.description: The national flag of Chile is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

cn-simplified-chinese-script.title: Simplified Chinese Script
cn-simplified-chinese-script.description: Mainland China uses simplified Chinese characters with fewer brush strokes.

cn-blue-licence-plate.title: Blue Licence Plates
cn-blue-licence-plate.description: Vehicles display blue-backed number plates with white characters.

cn-museum-interior.title: Museum Interiors
cn-museum-interior.description: Much coverage consists of indoor museum photography, concentrated around Beijing and Shanghai.

cn-country-flag.title: Country Flag
cn-country-flag.description: The national flag of China is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

cx-silver-pickup-truck.title: Silver Pickup Truck
cx-silver-pickup-truck.description: Coverage uses a silver pickup truck with an open flatbed behind the camera.

cx-tropical-forest-landscape.title: Tropical Forest Landscape
cx-tropical-forest-landscape.description: Thick tropical rainforest with unpaved tracks, white sandy soil, settlements, and palm groves.

cx-rural-trail-coverage.title: Rural Trail Coverage
cx-rural-trail-coverage.description: Beyond paved roads, narrow overgrown bush tracks lead deep into the forest.

cx-built-up-area.title: Built-Up Areas
cx-built-up-area.description: All settlements are in the northeastern corner; elsewhere is dense jungle.

cx-trail-trekker.title: Trail Trekkers
cx-trail-trekker.description: Short walking trails are scattered across the island, often opening to beaches or viewpoints.

cx-country-flag.title: Country Flag
cx-country-flag.description: The national flag of Christmas Island is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

cc-landscape.title: Landscape
cc-landscape.description: Flat, low-lying terrain of white sand with coconut palms and mowed grass, less forested than Christmas Island.

cc-coastal-trekkers.title: Coastal Trekkers
cc-coastal-trekkers.description: Walking routes along shorelines with white sand, ocean on one side and palm trees on the other.

cc-horsburgh-island.title: Horsburgh Island
cc-horsburgh-island.description: Pulau Luar's inland trekker passes through dry, yellow grassland with thin vegetation.

cc-country-flag.title: Country Flag
cc-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Cocos Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

co-vehicles-01-01-yellow-plates.title: Yellow plates
co-vehicles-01-01-yellow-plates.description: Colombia is the only country in South America that uses all yellow license plates for personal vehicles.

xx-general-01-25-colombian-cross.title: General 01 25 Colombian Cross
xx-general-01-25-colombian-cross.description: In Colombia, signposts have white backs that form a cross shape, known as the Colombian Cross.

co-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
co-kilometre-marker.description: Two designs exist: a tall green post labelled 'Pr' and a stone marker with black lettering, both exclusive to Colombia.

co-concrete-dark-pole.title: Concrete and Dark Poles
co-concrete-dark-pole.description: Most poles are concrete, with dark-coloured poles more common here than nearby countries.

co-northern-arid-landscape.title: Northern Arid Landscape
co-northern-arid-landscape.description: The far north features pale, sandy ground and a dry, barren environment.

co-llanos-lowland.title: Llanos Lowlands
co-llanos-lowland.description: A broad flat plain east of the Andes with tropical grassland, savanna, and isolated trees.

co-antioquia-pole-marking.title: Antioquia Pole Markings
co-antioquia-pole-marking.description: Poles with narrow black bands top and bottom and a broad yellow middle are characteristic of Antioquia.

co-afro-colombian-pacific-coast.title: Afro-Colombian Pacific Coast
co-afro-colombian-pacific-coast.description: The Pacific coastline has a predominantly Afro-Colombian population.

co-leticia-vehicle.title: Leticia Vehicle
co-leticia-vehicle.description: A distinctive non-standard vehicle is used around Leticia, Colombia's southernmost Amazon settlement.

co-la-guajira-desert.title: La Guajira Desert
co-la-guajira-desert.description: Arid scrubland with scattered cacti; a highway from Uribia to Puerto Bolívar runs parallel to a railway line.

co-country-flag.title: Country Flag
co-country-flag.description: The national flag of Colombia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

cr-spanish-language.title: Spanish Language
cr-spanish-language.description: Costa Rica's official language is Spanish.

cr-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
cr-licence-plate.description: Plates are compact white with blue characters, appearing faint light-blue due to blurring.

cr-round-concrete-pole.title: Round Concrete Poles
cr-round-concrete-pole.description: Utility poles have cylindrical concrete shafts.

cr-beach-trekker.title: Beach Trekkers
cr-beach-trekker.description: Shoreline trekker paths are mainly along the northern Pacific coast and Cocos Island.

cr-forest-trekker.title: Forest Trekkers
cr-forest-trekker.description: Trekker routes through woodland are mostly in the central highlands and Cocos Island.

cr-urban-coverage-location.title: Urban Coverage Locations
cr-urban-coverage-location.description: City-level trekker imagery focuses on San José and Cartago, with smaller amounts in Liberia and Filadelfia.

cr-country-flag.title: Country Flag
cr-country-flag.description: The national flag of Costa Rica is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

hr-croatian-language.title: Croatian Language
hr-croatian-language.description: South Slavic language in Latin script; frequent 'IJE' digraph.

hr-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
hr-chevron-sign.description: Curve warning boards with red arrow on yellow or white background.

hr-b-type-square-guardrail.title: B-Type Square Guardrails
hr-b-type-square-guardrail.description: Square-profile (B-type) highway guardrails, rare in Europe.

hr-gen-3-autumn-foliage.title: Autumn Foliage
hr-gen-3-autumn-foliage.description: Landscapes often show golden and orange leaf colors in autumn.

hr-vehicles-01-country-stickers.title: Vehicles 01 Country Stickers
hr-vehicles-01-country-stickers.description: Oval stickers bearing the letters 'HR' can be sometimes be spotted on Croatian vehicles.

hr-yellow-directional-sign.title: Yellow Directional Signs
hr-yellow-directional-sign.description: Road signs have a yellow background with a black border, often tapering to a point.

hr-utility-pole-alternating-hooks.title: Utility Poles with Alternating Hooks
hr-utility-pole-alternating-hooks.description: Cylindrical concrete or timber poles; wooden ones have alternating step-pegs up each side.

hr-exposed-red-brick-building.title: Exposed Red Brick Buildings
hr-exposed-red-brick-building.description: Bare red brick walls on houses and outbuildings are common, especially inland.

hr-blue-fire-hydrant.title: Blue Fire Hydrants
hr-blue-fire-hydrant.description: Hydrants are blue with two diagonally angled outlets on each side.

hr-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Sign
hr-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Sign shows a walking figure with a visible belt crossing a zebra with five stripes.

hr-local-brand.title: Local Brands
hr-local-brand.description: Ads for Karlovačko and Ožujsko beer; Konzum and Plodine supermarkets appear in cities.

hr-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
hr-phone-area-code.description: Croatian landline numbers start with zero plus regional area code.

hr-flat-slavonian-northeast.title: Flat Slavonian Northeast
hr-flat-slavonian-northeast.description: Northeast Croatia is a broad agricultural plain.

hr-hilly-zagorje-northwest.title: Hilly Zagorje Northwest
hr-hilly-zagorje-northwest.description: Countryside north and west of Zagreb is rolling, hilly farmland.

hr-rocky-adriatic-coast.title: Rocky Adriatic Coast
hr-rocky-adriatic-coast.description: Coast features bare limestone mountains, scrubby Mediterranean vegetation, and many islands.

hr-coastal-beige-stone-house.title: Coastal Beige Stone Houses
hr-coastal-beige-stone-house.description: Adriatic buildings are beige stone or brick, often with green shutters.

hr-istria-red-soil.title: Istria Red Soil
hr-istria-red-soil.description: Istria peninsula has earth with a reddish hue.

hr-istrian-bilingual-sign.title: Istrian Bilingual Signs
hr-istrian-bilingual-sign.description: Street name plates in western Istria show Croatian and Italian text.

hr-town-name-ending-ec.title: Town Names Ending in '-ec'
hr-town-name-ending-ec.description: Settlement names ending in '-ec' cluster in northern inland Croatia.

hr-zagreb.title: Zagreb
hr-zagreb.description: Capital city with metropolitan feel, apartment blocks, hilly north, and blue electric trams.

hr-tram-city.title: Tram Cities
hr-tram-city.description: Only Zagreb and Osijek have tram networks.

hr-plain-northeast-zadar.title: Plain Northeast of Zadar
hr-plain-northeast-zadar.description: Flat lowland northeast of Zadar with a mountain ridge on the northern horizon.

hr-southern-cypress-tree.title: Southern Cypress Trees
hr-southern-cypress-tree.description: Tall, narrow cypress trees near Dubrovnik.

hr-country-flag.title: Country Flag
hr-country-flag.description: The national flag of Croatia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

cz-wide-type-b-guardrail.title: Wide Guardrails
cz-wide-type-b-guardrail.description: Czechia and Slovakia use a broad variant of guardrail unique in Europe.

cz-short-metal-bar-pole-top.title: Short Metal Bar Pole Tops
cz-short-metal-bar-pole-top.description: Czech pole tops commonly have compact horizontal metal bars carrying line insulators.

cz-inverted-triangle-pole-support.title: Inverted Triangle Pole Supports
cz-inverted-triangle-pole-support.description: Angled braces supporting the crossarm create an inverted-triangle silhouette at the pole top.

cz-trident-pole-top.title: Trident Pole Tops
cz-trident-pole-top.description: A distinctive pole-top design with three prongs forming a trident-like profile.

cz-bolt-mounted-lamp-base.title: Bolt-Mounted Lamp Bases
cz-bolt-mounted-lamp-base.description: Street lamp posts often have chunky base plates secured by pairs of protruding bolts.

cz-red-white-striped-temporary-signpost.title: Red-and-White Striped Temporary Signposts
cz-red-white-striped-temporary-signpost.description: Square temporary sign poles wrapped in alternating red and white bands are common.

cz-chevron.title: Chevrons
cz-chevron.description: Curve warning boards are white with a red arrow; a less common variant uses red arrows on yellow.

cz-striped-gas-water-poles.title: Striped Gas and Water Marker Poles
cz-striped-gas-water-poles.description: Slender roadside poles painted in coloured stripes mark underground gas or water lines.

cz-hiking-trail-markers.title: Hiking Trail Markers
cz-hiking-trail-markers.description: Painted blazes with a coloured band between two white bands mark walking trails and directions.

cz-colourful-panel-apartments.title: Colourful Panel Apartment Blocks
cz-colourful-panel-apartments.description: Soviet-era prefabricated housing blocks are well maintained and decorated with bold colours and patterns.

cz-diamond-roof-tiles.title: Diamond-Shaped Roof Tiles
cz-diamond-roof-tiles.description: Roofing tiles cut into a diamond pattern are common on residential buildings.

cz-bridge-end-markers.title: Bridge End Markers
cz-bridge-end-markers.description: Dark plaques at bridge ends display the road number on the left side.

cz-czech-slovak-script.title: Czech vs Slovak Script
cz-czech-slovak-script.description: Czech uses Ř, Ě, and Ů; Slovak uses Ľ, Ô, Ä, Ŕ, and Ĺ to distinguish their similar scripts.

cz-rolling-landscape.title: Rolling Landscape
cz-rolling-landscape.description: The Czech terrain is gently undulating with hills but few tall mountains.

cz-solid-edge-lines-no-centre.title: Solid Edge Lines, No Centre Line
cz-solid-edge-lines-no-centre.description: Many Czech roads have continuous white edge lines but no painted centre line.

xx-general-01-53-arrow-signs.title: General 01 53 Arrow Signs
xx-general-01-53-arrow-signs.description: Directional signs in Czechia taper to a solid filled arrow tip.

cz-inset-sign-borders.title: Inset Sign Borders
cz-inset-sign-borders.description: Czech road signs have coloured borders separated from the edge by a narrow background strip.

cz-highway-sign-double-border.title: Highway Sign Double Border
cz-highway-sign-double-border.description: Motorway signs feature a white inner border framed by a second border in the sign's main colour.

cz-bright-red-street-signs.title: Bright Red Street Name Signs
cz-bright-red-street-signs.description: Street signs are vivid red plates, either wide on walls or narrow on posts; sometimes blue.

cz-black-signpost-caps.title: Black Signpost Caps
cz-black-signpost-caps.description: Czech sign poles have chunky black caps on top.

cz-five-stripe-pedestrian-signs.title: Five-Stripe Pedestrian Signs
cz-five-stripe-pedestrian-signs.description: Pedestrian crossing signs show a figure walking across five horizontal stripes.

cz-thin-road-sign-font.title: Thin Road Sign Font
cz-thin-road-sign-font.description: Text on Czech road signs uses a noticeably lightweight typeface.

cz-kilometre-markers.title: Kilometre Markers
cz-kilometre-markers.description: Czech distance markers are framed in black with a yellow outline and lack the horizontal dividing line of Slovak markers.

cz-yellow-bicycle-signs.title: Yellow Bicycle Signs
cz-yellow-bicycle-signs.description: Cycle route markers in Czechia are yellow, replacing white bands used in hiking markers.

cz-semi-detached-suburban-houses.title: Semi-Detached Suburban Houses
cz-semi-detached-suburban-houses.description: Czech suburban homes are often mirror-image pairs sharing a dividing wall.

cz-winter-gen-3-coverage.title: Winter Imagery
cz-winter-gen-3-coverage.description: Many Czech images show overcast, grey winter scenes sometimes dusted with snow.

cz-railway-crossing-signs.title: Railway Crossing Signs
cz-railway-crossing-signs.description: Czech level-crossing signs are bare cross shapes without backing panels.

cz-road-number-regions.title: Road Number Regions
cz-road-number-regions.description: Road numbers start with digits 1 to 6 indicating regions; 7, 8, and 9 radiate from Prague northwards.

cz-cycle-path-numbers.title: Cycle Path Numbers
cz-cycle-path-numbers.description: Four-digit cycle route numbers follow a clockwise sequence starting in Southern Bohemia.

cz-phone-area-codes.title: Phone Area Codes
cz-phone-area-codes.description: Czech phone numbers have 9 digits; the first 1-3 digits are geographic area codes.

cz-moravian-wine-region.title: Moravian Wine Region
cz-moravian-wine-region.description: About 95% of Czech wine production is in Moravia, marked by vineyards.

cz-northern-bohemia-hills.title: Northern Bohemia Solitary Hills
cz-northern-bohemia-hills.description: Northern Bohemia features rolling farmland interrupted by isolated cone-shaped hills, some with castles.

cz-timber-framed-houses.title: Timber-Framed Houses
cz-timber-framed-houses.description: Half-timbered houses are common along the northern border with Germany.

cz-timber-post-supported-floors.title: Timber Post-Supported Upper Floors
cz-timber-post-supported-floors.description: Northernmost houses have dark wooden columns supporting upper floors or balconies.

cz-dark-wooden-houses-white-stripes.title: Dark Wooden Houses with White Stripes
cz-dark-wooden-houses-white-stripes.description: Dark timber houses with white plaster or mortar lines are common in northern Czechia.

cz-moravian-town-houses.title: Moravian Town Houses
cz-moravian-town-houses.description: Moravian village houses face the road with long sides and have tall, wide front entrances.

cz-selske-baroko-folk-baroque.title: Selské Baroko (Folk Baroque)
cz-selske-baroko-folk-baroque.description: Selské Baroko features richly ornamented façades on modest village buildings near České Budějovice.

cz-single-pane-windows.title: Single-Pane Windows
cz-single-pane-windows.description: Simple single-pane windows are more frequent in northwestern Czechia.

cz-blue-street-signs-east.title: Blue Street Signs
cz-blue-street-signs-east.description: Blue-background street name plates are concentrated in eastern Czechia, especially Ostrava.

cz-slovak-style-white-street-signs.title: Slovak-Style White Street Signs
cz-slovak-style-white-street-signs.description: White street signs with blue text inside a red border indicate proximity to Slovakia.

cz-white-street-signs-red-text.title: White Street Signs with Red Text
cz-white-street-signs-red-text.description: White plates with red lettering appear mostly in eastern and southern Czechia.

cz-white-street-signs-blue-text.title: White Street Signs with Blue Text
cz-white-street-signs-blue-text.description: White plates with blue lettering are common in eastern and central-northern Czechia.

cz-white-street-signs-black-text.title: White Street Signs with Black Text
cz-white-street-signs-black-text.description: White plates with black text are frequent in the southeast and resemble blue-text signs.

cz-country-flag.title: Country Flag
cz-country-flag.description: The national flag of Czechia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

do-square-concrete-pole.title: Square Concrete Poles
do-square-concrete-pole.description: Electricity poles are predominantly square concrete with a reverse-L bracket at the top.

do-dark-smooth-asphalt.title: Dark Smooth Asphalt
do-dark-smooth-asphalt.description: Roads are notably dark, smooth asphalt, darker than typical Caribbean surfaces.

do-country-flag.title: Country Flag
do-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Dominican Republic is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ec-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
ec-licence-plate.description: Private plates in Ecuador are white in short and long formats. Taxis and buses use orange plates.

xx-general-01-08-ecuadorian-bollards.title: General 01 08 Ecuadorian Bollards
xx-general-01-08-ecuadorian-bollards.description: In Ecuador, bollards are typically either thin and round with two red stripes or flat with two red reflectors.

ec-double-guardrail.title: Double Guardrails
ec-double-guardrail.description: Paired guardrails running in parallel are common.

ec-chevron-overuse.title: Chevron Overuse
ec-chevron-overuse.description: Road bends have a high density of chevron signs.

ec-square-road-sign.title: Square Road Signs
ec-square-road-sign.description: White square information signs with a standard layout are used extensively.

ec-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
ec-kilometre-marker.description: Distance posts are green with the highway shield emblem.

ec-teal-blue-sign-back.title: Teal Blue Sign Backs
ec-teal-blue-sign-back.description: Some sign backs are painted teal blue; poles are thin metal.

ec-one-way-street-sign.title: One-Way Street Signs
ec-one-way-street-sign.description: Directional signs feature the text "UNA VIA" inside arrow shapes indicating traffic flow.

ec-grey-brick-architecture.title: Grey Brick Architecture
ec-grey-brick-architecture.description: Houses are mostly grey cinder blocks with corrugated metal roofs.

ec-hexagonal-tile-pavement.title: Hexagonal Tile Pavements
ec-hexagonal-tile-pavement.description: Ecuadorian roads sometimes have interlocking hexagonal tiles.

ec-elevation-terrain.title: Elevation and Terrain
ec-elevation-terrain.description: The Andes run through the center, with flat terrain on the Pacific coast and Amazon basin.

ec-banana-plantation.title: Banana Plantations
ec-banana-plantation.description: Large banana plantations are in the southwestern lowlands.

ec-dry-coastal-belt.title: Dry Coastal Belt
ec-dry-coastal-belt.description: An arid coastal strip lies between Guayaquil and Manta.

ec-flat-guayaquil-region.title: Flat Guayaquil Region
ec-flat-guayaquil-region.description: The Guayaquil area is the flattest, especially along E-25 and E-48 highways.

ec-amazon-region.title: Amazon Region
ec-amazon-region.description: Amazon lowlands are flat and densely vegetated with Cordia trichotoma trees and oil palms.

ec-esmeraldas-province.title: Esmeraldas Province
ec-esmeraldas-province.description: Esmeraldas has Amazon-like vegetation but is hillier.

ec-southern-mountain-road.title: Southern Mountain Roads
ec-southern-mountain-road.description: Southern mountain roads have twisting paths with exposed reddish-brown earth.

ec-chimborazo-province.title: Chimborazo Province
ec-chimborazo-province.description: Chimborazo is semi-arid with abundant pine trees.

ec-taxi-province-letter.title: Taxi Province Letters
ec-taxi-province-letter.description: Taxi plates start with the province's initial letter; same for private plates.

ec-northeastern-roadside-pipeline.title: Northeastern Roadside Pipeline
ec-northeastern-roadside-pipeline.description: A brown above-ground pipeline runs alongside some northeastern roads.

ec-galapagos-island.title: Galápagos Islands
ec-galapagos-island.description: Galápagos has volcanic landscapes with lava fields, scrubland, and craters; covered by trekker and boat imagery.

ec-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ec-country-flag.description: The national flag of Ecuador is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

eg-sandstone-architecture.title: Sandstone Architecture
eg-sandstone-architecture.description: Built environment features sandstone construction from ancient monuments to medieval fortifications.

eg-arabic-script.title: Arabic Script
eg-arabic-script.description: Egypt uses Arabic script. It appears on signs, identifiable by flowing connected letters and diacritical dots.

eg-country-flag.title: Country Flag
eg-country-flag.description: The national flag of Egypt is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ee-wooden-utility-pole.title: Wooden Utility Poles
ee-wooden-utility-pole.description: Round wooden poles with diagonal braces are common; Estonia has varied pole types.

ee-square-concrete-pole.title: Square Concrete Poles
ee-square-concrete-pole.description: Square concrete poles appear regularly, often with diagonal bracing.

ee-trident-pole-top.title: Trident Pole Tops
ee-trident-pole-top.description: Pole tops have a single insulator pointing upward and two extending sideways.

ee-metal-pole-cap.title: Metal Pole Caps
ee-metal-pole-cap.description: Most wooden poles have a small metal cap at the top.

ee-short-dash-edge-line.title: Short-Dash Edge Lines
ee-short-dash-edge-line.description: Road edge markings sometimes use unusually short dashes.

ee-chevron.title: Chevrons
ee-chevron.description: Curve warning boards have a red background with white directional arrows.

ee-warning-speed-sign-border.title: Warning and Speed Sign Borders
ee-warning-speed-sign-border.description: Warning and speed limit signs have a narrow red border running to the edge.

ee-bus-stop-sign.title: Bus Stop Signs
ee-bus-stop-sign.description: Estonian bus stop signs show a bus icon with four windows.

ee-blue-white-signpost-wrapping.title: Blue-and-White Signpost Wrappings
ee-blue-white-signpost-wrapping.description: Signposts are commonly wrapped with alternating blue and white bands.

ee-estonian-language.title: Estonian Language
ee-estonian-language.description: Estonian uses umlauted vowels (Ä, Ö, Ü) and the letter Õ (O with tilde).

ee-street-name-suffix.title: Street Name Suffixes
ee-street-name-suffix.description: The words 'tänav' (street) and 'tee' (road) are uniquely Estonian.

ee-oval-blue-house-number.title: Oval Blue House Numbers
ee-oval-blue-house-number.description: Buildings often display blue oval-shaped house number plates.

ee-architecture.title: Architecture
ee-architecture.description: Estonian buildings combine wooden cladding, white-rendered brick, and steep corrugated metal roofs.

ee-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
ee-directional-sign.description: Wayfinding signs are blue with white lettering and a white border; arrows sit inside the sign.

ee-elevation-hill.title: Elevation and Hills
ee-elevation-hill.description: The country is mostly flat with hills in the southeast and Lääne-Viru County.

ee-russian-minority-ida-viru.title: Russian Minority in Ida-Viru
ee-russian-minority-ida-viru.description: Ida-Viru County has a Russian-speaking majority with occasional bilingual Cyrillic-Estonian signs.

ee-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ee-country-flag.description: The national flag of Estonia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

fk-carcass-island.title: Carcass Island
fk-carcass-island.description: Wide-open grassy plains with the sea clearly visible in many directions. The terrain can become stony and rugged in places.

fk-west-point-island.title: West Point Island
fk-west-point-island.description: Broad treeless grassland with a yellowish tint to the vegetation. Unlike Carcass Island, the ocean is not readily visible from most vantage points.

fk-west-point-bay-boat-trekker.title: West Point Bay Boat Trekker
fk-west-point-bay-boat-trekker.description: A marine trekker captured from a boat in West Point Bay, showing golden-brown hillsides in the background and the MS National Geographic Explorer anchored in the bay.

fk-new-island-beach.title: New Island Beach
fk-new-island-beach.description: A stretch of sandy shoreline where figures wearing red and blue outdoor jackets can be spotted.

fk-new-island-inland.title: New Island Inland
fk-new-island-inland.description: The interior of New Island is characterised by exposed dark brown earth, sometimes criss-crossed by vehicle tracks.

fk-new-island-cliff.title: New Island Cliffs
fk-new-island-cliff.description: Dramatic, sheer coastal cliffs dropping straight into the ocean are a prominent feature of New Island's trekker route.

fk-country-flag.title: Country Flag
fk-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Falkland Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

fo-architecture.title: Architecture
fo-architecture.description: Timber houses with raised stone basements and corrugated metal or turf roofs.

fo-faroese-language.title: Faroese Language
fo-faroese-language.description: Faroese uses special letters including Ø, distinguishing it from Icelandic.

fo-yellow-guardrail-reflector.title: Yellow Guardrail Reflectors
fo-yellow-guardrail-reflector.description: Metal guardrails fitted with yellow reflectors, unique in northern Europe.

fo-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
fo-directional-sign.description: Wayfinding signs in the Faroe Islands have a yellow background with a black border.

fo-klakkur-trekker.title: Klakkur Trekker
fo-klakkur-trekker.description: Two pyramid-shaped snow-capped peaks visible to the south from Klakkur.

fo-gjogv-trekker.title: Gjógv Trekker
fo-gjogv-trekker.description: Southward view of village and snow-dusted mountain ridges from Gjógv.

fo-koltur-boat-trekker.title: Koltur Boat Trekker
fo-koltur-boat-trekker.description: Grey inflatable 'RIB62' with passengers in high-visibility clothing en route to Koltur.

fo-country-flag.title: Country Flag
fo-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Faroe Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

fi-middle-road-line.title: Middle Road Lines
fi-middle-road-line.description: Centre lines appear as white dashes, solid white, solid yellow, or double yellow lines.

fi-bollard.title: Bollards
fi-bollard.description: Tall black-and-white posts with a rectangular white reflector on front and two reflective dots on back.

fi-finnish-language.title: Finnish Language
fi-finnish-language.description: Finnish has long words, frequent double vowels, and special characters ä and ö.

fi-yellow-sign-background.title: Yellow Sign Backgrounds
fi-yellow-sign-background.description: Information and direction signs in Finland have yellow backgrounds.

fi-yellow-stroke-sign.title: Yellow Stroke on Signs
fi-yellow-stroke-sign.description: Red-bordered regulatory signs have a fine yellow line along the outer edge.

fi-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
fi-directional-sign.description: Wayfinding signs have white text and arrows on a solid blue field with a white border.

fi-chevron.title: Chevrons
fi-chevron.description: Curve warning boards are black panels with yellow arrow markings.

fi-wooden-utility-pole.title: Wooden Utility Poles
fi-wooden-utility-pole.description: Plain timber poles with various top fittings; street lights often mounted directly on them.

fi-lamp-mounting-style.title: Lamp Mounting Style
fi-lamp-mounting-style.description: Street lamps on wooden poles attach at the top with a double-bolt fixture; lamp arm extends horizontally.

fi-blue-white-signpost-marking.title: Blue-and-White Signpost Markings
fi-blue-white-signpost-marking.description: Traffic sign poles often have alternating blue and white bands wrapped around them.

fi-boreal-forest.title: Boreal Forests
fi-boreal-forest.description: Thick coniferous forests dominated by pine and spruce, with birch trees having bright white bark.

fi-gen-3-autumn-coverage.title: Autumn Foliage
fi-gen-3-autumn-coverage.description: Imagery often shows vivid orange and yellow foliage in autumn.

fi-lake.title: Lakes
fi-lake.description: Finland has many lakes appearing frequently across the landscape.

fi-architecture-01-red-houses.title: Architecture 01 Red Houses
fi-architecture-01-red-houses.description: Along Sweden and Norway, Finland has many of these distinct red houses with white trim.

fi-bus-stop-sign.title: Bus Stop Signs
fi-bus-stop-sign.description: Two standard designs: blue-and-white and yellow-and-black.

fi-k-market-s-market.title: K-Market and S-Market
fi-k-market-s-market.description: Two supermarket chains exclusive to Finland with recognisable branding.

fi-regional-road-number.title: Regional Road Numbers
fi-regional-road-number.description: Local roads have three- or four-digit numbers; leading digit indicates geographic zone from south (1) to north (9).

fi-lapland-snow-pole.title: Lapland Snow Poles
fi-lapland-snow-pole.description: Major roads in Lapland have snow poles with two elongated reflectors instead of one.

fi-farmland-distribution.title: Farmland Distribution
fi-farmland-distribution.description: Agricultural fields concentrate along western and southern coasts; interior is mostly forested.

fi-wind-turbine.title: Wind Turbines
fi-wind-turbine.description: Wind farms cluster mainly along the western coastline.

fi-stunted-northern-tree.title: Stunted Northern Trees
fi-stunted-northern-tree.description: Northern trees are undersized with thin, spindly trunks, showing high-latitude growth.

fi-gen-3-snow-coverage.title: Snow Coverage in Northwest Lapland
fi-gen-3-snow-coverage.description: Snow regularly appears only in the extreme northwest corner of Lapland.

fi-swedish-language-area.title: Swedish Language Areas
fi-swedish-language-area.description: Coastal south and west communities use Swedish extensively, with bilingual Finnish–Swedish signs.

fi-sami-language.title: Sámi Language
fi-sami-language.description: Far north road signs show Finnish and Sámi names; Sámi includes the letter 'c'.

fi-aland-swedish-only.title: Åland Swedish Only
fi-aland-swedish-only.description: Åland is exclusively Swedish-speaking with no Finnish on signs.

fi-aland-road-feature.title: Åland Road Features
fi-aland-road-feature.description: Åland roads have reddish asphalt and dashed outer lines like Sweden.

fi-aland-licence-plate.title: Åland Licence Plates
fi-aland-licence-plate.description: Åland plates are white with blue text, no EU band, and shorter than Finnish plates.

fi-aland-pedestrian-sign.title: Åland Pedestrian Signs
fi-aland-pedestrian-sign.description: Some Åland crossing signs show four zebra stripes, matching Swedish design.

fi-aland-bus-stop.title: Åland Bus Stops
fi-aland-bus-stop.description: Bus stops have a white plate with a four-digit number, sometimes topped with a semicircle.

fi-helsinki-bus.title: Helsinki Buses
fi-helsinki-bus.description: Helsinki city buses are blue and white with a vertical split and operator logos.

fi-country-flag.title: Country Flag
fi-country-flag.description: The national flag of Finland is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

fr-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
fr-licence-plate.description: Modern French plates are white rectangles with blue bands on left and right edges.

fr-french-language.title: French Language
fr-french-language.description: French uses diacritics like é, à, â, ë, œ, ç and the suffix '-ux'.

fr-pointed-top-bollard.title: Pointed-Top Bollard
fr-pointed-top-bollard.description: White cylindrical bollard tapering to a conical point with a reflector band.

fr-double-band-bollard.title: Double-Band Bollard
fr-double-band-bollard.description: White round bollard with two indented reflective rings, sometimes green or yellow.

fr-wedge-shaped-bollard.title: Wedge-Shaped Bollard
fr-wedge-shaped-bollard.description: Tapered wedge-profile post with broad rectangular white reflectors on both faces.

fr-wooden-octagonal-metal-pole.title: Wooden and Octagonal Metal Poles
fr-wooden-octagonal-metal-pole.description: Rural areas have timber poles alongside slender octagonal metal ones.

fr-french-pole-top.title: French Pole Tops
fr-french-pole-top.description: Diamond-shaped insulators supporting three wires, known as 'French pole tops', appear most commonly atop ladder poles.

fr-arrowhead-pole-top.title: Arrowhead Pole Tops
fr-arrowhead-pole-top.description: A variant with insulators on top creating an arrowhead silhouette, found only in France.

fr-road-signs-01-road-numbers.title: Road Signs 01 Road Numbers
fr-road-signs-01-road-numbers.description: Yellow road signs beginning with “D” are specific to France and are often placed above direction signs or on town entry signs.

fr-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
fr-directional-sign.description: Local direction signs are white with a thick black border at the arrow point; highways use blue or green backgrounds.

fr-town-entrance-sign.title: Town Entrance Signs
fr-town-entrance-sign.description: Settlements are announced by white signs framed with a red border and thin outer white rim.

fr-road-sign-border.title: Road Sign Borders
fr-road-sign-border.description: Regulatory signs have a red border with a narrow white outline; white sub-signs with black text often attached below.

fr-flat-signpost.title: Flat Signposts
fr-flat-signpost.description: Traffic signs often mounted on flat rectangular posts; posts and sign backs may be painted in unusual, regionally distinctive colours.

fr-short-signpost.title: Short Signposts
fr-short-signpost.description: Unusually short poles supporting traffic signs at low heights are common across France.

fr-chevron.title: Chevrons
fr-chevron.description: Curve warning boards use white arrows on a blue background, displaying one to five arrows.

fr-pedestrian-sign.title: Pedestrian Signs
fr-pedestrian-sign.description: Crossing signs show a figure with a detached circular head walking over five zebra stripes, enclosed by a white-outline border.

fr-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
fr-kilometre-marker.description: Distance posts combine a yellow or red semicircle atop a white rectangle; major motorways use square markers topped in red.

fr-dashed-outer-line.title: Dashed Outer Lines
fr-dashed-outer-line.description: Edge markings on standard French roads are widely spaced, elongated white dashes.

fr-offset-block-middle-line.title: Offset Block Middle Lines
fr-offset-block-middle-line.description: Centre-line dashes formed by two staggered blocks, found only in France.

fr-long-middle-dash.title: Long Middle Dashes
fr-long-middle-dash.description: Centre line dashes noticeably longer than the European norm can indicate France.

fr-end-passing-zone-arrow.title: End-of-Passing-Zone Arrows
fr-end-passing-zone-arrow.description: Painted arrows indicating the end of an overtaking zone, accompanied by tightly spaced centre dashes.

fr-red-white-red-flag-marker.title: Red-White-Red Flag Markers
fr-red-white-red-flag-marker.description: Tall narrow rectangles on sticks painted red-white-red stripes, reminiscent of the Austrian flag, appear on French roads.

fr-architecture.title: Architecture
fr-architecture.description: Typical French houses are stone, unpainted or pale pastel, with simple gable roofs of orange tiles or dark slate; urban terraced houses line roads.

fr-blue-house-number.title: Blue House Numbers
fr-blue-house-number.description: Address plaques are predominantly blue with serif typeface and ornate numerals.

fr-french-car-brand.title: French Car Brands
fr-french-car-brand.description: Peugeot, Renault, and Citroën make up roughly half of all vehicles on the road.

fr-administrative-division.title: Administrative Divisions
fr-administrative-division.description: Metropolitan France has 13 regions and 96 departments; department logos appear on public infrastructure.

fr-telephone-area-code.title: Telephone Area Codes
fr-telephone-area-code.description: Phone numbers are ten digits; first pairs indicate broad zones, with 06–09 for mobile and non-regional.

fr-postal-code.title: Postal Codes
fr-postal-code.description: Five-digit postal codes start with the department number, also shown on licence plates.

fr-department-logo.title: Department Logos
fr-department-logo.description: Nearly every department has a unique logo appearing on bus stops, distance markers, and signs.

fr-occitanie-region-logo.title: Occitanie Region Logo
fr-occitanie-region-logo.description: A red-and-yellow emblem combining an Occitan cross with vertical stripes identifies Occitanie.

fr-pyrenees-orientales-senyera-flag.title: Pyrénées-Orientales Senyera Flag
fr-pyrenees-orientales-senyera-flag.description: Pyrénées-Orientales uses red-and-yellow stripes (Senyera pattern) as its official flag and logo.

fr-red-tinted-road.title: Red-Tinted Roads
fr-red-tinted-road.description: Asphalt with red, purple, or burgundy hues is concentrated between Paris and Dijon, roughly Burgundy.

fr-dark-green-signpost.title: Dark Green Signposts
fr-dark-green-signpost.description: Sign poles and backs painted dark green appear mainly in Brittany, Paris area, and some southern regions.

fr-eure-et-loir-signback.title: Eure-et-Loir Signbacks
fr-eure-et-loir-signback.description: In Eure-et-Loir, sign backs may have a green sticker with the department's logo on a dark green backing.

fr-greyish-green-signback.title: Greyish-Green Signbacks
fr-greyish-green-signback.description: Muted greyish-green sign backs on darker green posts are found in parts of Brittany, Pyrénées-Atlantiques, and near the Alps.

fr-pas-de-calais-green-sign.title: Pas-de-Calais Green Signs
fr-pas-de-calais-green-sign.description: Road signs have dark green posts with lighter green backs from matcha to turquoise. The green-and-blue triangle logo may appear.

fr-brown-signback.title: Brown Signbacks
fr-brown-signback.description: Signs with brown poles and backs are characteristic of Seine-et-Marne.

fr-paris-metro-street-sign.title: Paris Metro Street Signs
fr-paris-metro-street-sign.description: Street plaques in Paris suburbs often include the municipality name in a modern design.

fr-corsican-stone-barrier.title: Corsican Stone Barriers
fr-corsican-stone-barrier.description: Blocky crash barriers made from rough stone and mortar are common on Corsica.

fr-topography.title: Topography
fr-topography.description: Highest peaks are in the southeast (Alps) and along the Spanish border (Pyrenees). North and Atlantic coast are flat to rolling; southern interior is hillier.

fr-hedge-lined-road-northwest.title: Hedge-Lined Roads
fr-hedge-lined-road-northwest.description: Narrow rural lanes hemmed by tall hedges are most common in the northwest, especially Normandy.

fr-stone-pine.title: Stone Pines
fr-stone-pine.description: Umbrella-shaped stone pines line many roads along the Mediterranean coast, sometimes as far north as Nantes.

fr-maritime-pine-forest-southwest.title: Maritime Pine Forests
fr-maritime-pine-forest-southwest.description: Dense maritime pine stands cover the flat Gironde and Landes departments in the southwest.

fr-wine-region.title: Wine Regions
fr-wine-region.description: Major vineyard regions include Bordeaux, Mediterranean coast, Champagne, Loire Valley, Alsace, and Corsica.

fr-wind-turbine.title: Wind Turbines
fr-wind-turbine.description: Wind farms are more common in the northern half of France.

fr-black-shingle-roof.title: Black Shingle Roofs
fr-black-shingle-roof.description: Slate or dark shingle roofs dominate northwest of the Loire, near the Belgian border, south-centre, and the Pyrenees.

fr-brittany-architecture.title: Brittany Architecture
fr-brittany-architecture.description: Dark slate roofs, dark or brown stone walls, and light-coloured rendered buildings are characteristic of Brittany.

fr-southern-rounded-roof-tiles.title: Southern Rounded Roof Tiles
fr-southern-rounded-roof-tiles.description: Roofs in the south have curved overlapping tiles in terracotta to faded orange shades.

fr-flemish-brick-house-north.title: Flemish Brick Houses
fr-flemish-brick-house-north.description: Rows of dark red brick terraced houses with white mortar joints cluster near the Belgian border.

fr-paris-surroundings-stone-wall.title: Paris Surroundings Stone Walls
fr-paris-surroundings-stone-wall.description: Walls of rough cream-to-orange stones with red brick accents characterize towns around Paris.

fr-french-riviera.title: French Riviera
fr-french-riviera.description: Palm-lined avenues and pale multi-storey buildings with balconies typify the Côte d'Azur and southern coast.

fr-basque-timber-framed-house.title: Basque Timber-Framed Houses
fr-basque-timber-framed-house.description: White walls with bold, colorful timber framing matching shutters and gates are hallmarks of the Basque region.

fr-alpine-architecture.title: Alpine Architecture
fr-alpine-architecture.description: Light masonry ground floors with large wooden upper storeys and balconies are typical in eastern mountain valleys.

fr-alsace-germanic-architecture.title: Alsace Germanic Architecture
fr-alsace-germanic-architecture.description: Half-timbered facades, half-hip roofs, and fish-scale roof tiles are concentrated in Alsace.

fr-minority-language-overview.title: Minority Languages Overview
fr-minority-language-overview.description: Six minority languages are regionally significant: Alsatian, Basque, Breton, Catalan, Corsican, and Occitan.

fr-breton-language.title: Breton Language
fr-breton-language.description: A Celtic tongue with letters d, k, w, and ñ; 'straed' means street; bilingual signs reach east to Rennes.

fr-plou-town-prefix.title: Plou- Town Name Prefix
fr-plou-town-prefix.description: Place names starting with 'Plou-' cluster in northwest Brittany.

fr-alsatian-language.title: Alsatian Language
fr-alsatian-language.description: An Alemannic German dialect in Alsace; bilingual signs use 'gasse' or 'strasse'.

fr-occitan-language.title: Occitan Language
fr-occitan-language.description: A Romance language in southern France; street is 'carrièra' in Toulouse, 'carriero' in Avignon.

fr-french-basque-language.title: French Basque Language
fr-french-basque-language.description: Basque appears on bilingual signs near the Spanish border; street is 'karrika'.

fr-corsican-language.title: Corsican Language
fr-corsican-language.description: A Romance language with Italian roots; words often end in vowels like -u, -iu, -ju.

fr-catalan-pyrenees-orientales.title: Catalan Language
fr-catalan-pyrenees-orientales.description: Catalan signage in Pyrénées-Orientales; frequent cedilla (Ç); street is 'carrer'.

fr-town-name-suffixes-toponymy.title: Town Name Suffixes
fr-town-name-suffixes-toponymy.description: Town name endings vary by region and help narrow down locations in France.

fr-river-based-town-name.title: River-Based Town Names
fr-river-based-town-name.description: Many towns include a river name in '-sur-[river]' format; coastal towns end in '-sur-mer' or '-plage'.

fr-lavender-field.title: Lavender Fields
fr-lavender-field.description: Southeastern France has lavender plantations appearing as rows of small grey-green bushes when not in bloom.

fr-thin-b-type-guardrail-north.title: Thin Guardrails
fr-thin-b-type-guardrail-north.description: Thin guardrails appear on motorways in northern France around Le Mans, Tours, Paris, Reims, and Metz.

fr-country-flag.title: Country Flag
fr-country-flag.description: The national flag of France is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

de-german-language.title: German Language
de-german-language.description: Signs are in German, identifiable by Ä, Ö, Ü, and ß characters.

de-white-sticker-wooden-poles.title: White Sticker on Wooden Poles
de-white-sticker-wooden-poles.description: Nearly every wooden utility pole has a small rectangular white sticker on its shaft.

de-diverse-pole-tops.title: Diverse Pole Tops
de-diverse-pole-tops.description: Common German pole tops include horizontal crossarms with staggered insulators, inverted-triangle supports, and T-shaped arrangements.

de-dark-sign-backs.title: Dark Sign Backs
de-dark-sign-backs.description: Road sign backs are often black or dark grey, with a small inverted red triangle sticker on most signs.

de-yellow-h-bus-stops.title: Yellow 'H' Bus Stops
de-yellow-h-bus-stops.description: Bus stops feature a yellow-and-green 'H' symbol.

de-high-bollard-density.title: High Bollard Density
de-high-bollard-density.description: Bollards appear roughly every 50 metres along nearly every road.

de-yellow-town-entry-signs.title: Yellow Town Entry Signs
de-yellow-town-entry-signs.description: Town boundaries are marked by yellow signs with black text framed in metal, showing town, municipality, and county.

de-blue-kilometre-markers.title: Blue Kilometre Markers
de-blue-kilometre-markers.description: Distance markers are blue rectangles with rounded corners and a thin white border.

de-five-stripe-pedestrian-signs.title: Five-Stripe Pedestrian Signs
de-five-stripe-pedestrian-signs.description: The German pedestrian crossing sign shows a figure walking across five stripes.

de-no-stopping-arrow-signs.title: No-Stopping Arrow Signs
de-no-stopping-arrow-signs.description: No Stopping and No Waiting signs often include white directional arrows on the sign face.

de-phone-area-codes.title: Phone Area Codes
de-phone-area-codes.description: A map of German telephone area codes, useful for narrowing down regions.

de-postal-code-map.title: Postal Code Map
de-postal-code-map.description: An overview of German postal code zones, helpful for region guessing when visible on signs or buildings.

de-baden-wuerttemberg-state-flag.title: Baden-Württemberg Flag
de-baden-wuerttemberg-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of black and gold (yellow).

de-bavaria-state-flag.title: Bavaria Flag
de-bavaria-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of white and blue.

de-berlin-state-flag.title: Berlin Flag
de-berlin-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of red, white, and red with the Berlin bear.

de-brandenburg-state-flag.title: Brandenburg Flag
de-brandenburg-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of red and white with the red eagle.

de-bremen-state-flag.title: Bremen Flag
de-bremen-state-flag.description: Eight horizontal red and white stripes with a chequered pattern.

de-hamburg-state-flag.title: Hamburg Flag
de-hamburg-state-flag.description: A red flag with a white castle

de-hesse-state-flag.title: Hesse Flag
de-hesse-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of red and white.

de-lower-saxony-state-flag.title: Lower Saxony Flag
de-lower-saxony-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of black, red, and gold with a white horse.

de-mecklenburg-vorpommern-state-flag.title: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern Flag
de-mecklenburg-vorpommern-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of blue, white, and red with a with a yellow line in the middle. A version includes the region's coat of arms (a bull's head and a red griffin).

de-north-rhine-westphalia-state-flag.title: North Rhine-Westphalia Flag
de-north-rhine-westphalia-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of green, white, and red.

de-rhineland-palatinate-state-flag.title: Rhineland-Palatinate Flag
de-rhineland-palatinate-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of black, red, and gold with the coat of arms.

de-saarland-state-flag.title: Saarland Flag
de-saarland-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of black, red, and gold with the Saarland coat of arms.

de-saxony-state-flag.title: Saxony Flag
de-saxony-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of white and green.

de-saxony-anhalt-state-flag.title: Saxony-Anhalt Flag
de-saxony-anhalt-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of yellow and black with the coat of arms.

de-schleswig-holstein-state-flag.title: Schleswig-Holstein Flag
de-schleswig-holstein-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of blue, white, and red.

de-thuringia-state-flag.title: Thuringia Flag
de-thuringia-state-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of white and red.

de-state-coats-arms.title: State Coats of Arms
de-state-coats-arms.description: Each federal state has its own heraldic coat of arms, seen on official buildings or signs.

de-town-name-suffixes.title: Town Name Suffixes
de-town-name-suffixes.description: Certain place-name endings are concentrated in specific parts of Germany, aiding region guessing.

de-22-bavaria.title: Bavarian Cycling Route Signs
de-22-bavaria.description: Bavarian cycle route signs have a white background with a bold red border and text, often with a red bicycle symbol and directional arrows.

de-22-north-rhine-westphalia.title: North Rhine-Westphalia Cycling Route Signs
de-22-north-rhine-westphalia.description: Cycle route signs have a white background with a red border and text, including a red bicycle symbol and directional arrows.

de-22-saxony.title: Saxony Cycling Route Signs
de-22-saxony.description: Saxony's cycling signs have a white background with a thin green border and green text, sometimes with a green bicycle symbol.

de-22-lower-saxony.title: Lower Saxony Cycling Route Signs
de-22-lower-saxony.description: Lower Saxony cycle route signs are white with a green border and text, featuring a green bicycle symbol and directional arrows.

de-22-schleswig-holstein.title: Schleswig-Holstein Cycling Route Signs
de-22-schleswig-holstein.description: Cycle route signs have a white background, green border, green text, and a green bicycle symbol.

de-22-brandenburg.title: Brandenburg Cycling Route Signs
de-22-brandenburg.description: Cycle route signs have a white background, red border, red text, and a red bicycle symbol.

de-23-bavaria.title: Bavaria Folded Street Sign Backs
de-23-bavaria.description: Street sign backs are folded with ribbed edges, giving a reinforced, corrugated look.

de-23-north-rhine-westphalia.title: North Rhine-Westphalia Flat Street Sign Backs
de-23-north-rhine-westphalia.description: Street sign backs are completely flat and smooth metal.

de-23-saxony.title: Saxony Folded Street Sign Backs
de-23-saxony.description: Street sign backs are folded or ribbed with bent or reinforced edges.

de-23-lower-saxony.title: Lower Saxony Flat Street Sign Backs
de-23-lower-saxony.description: Street sign backs are flat, smooth metal with no ribbing or folding.

de-23-schleswig-holstein.title: Schleswig-Holstein Flat Street Sign Backs
de-23-schleswig-holstein.description: Street sign backs are flat and smooth without ribbed or folded reinforcement.

de-23-brandenburg.title: Brandenburg Folded Street Sign Backs
de-23-brandenburg.description: Street sign backs are folded or ribbed with visibly bent or reinforced edges.

de-24-bavaria.title: Bavaria Single Bar Sign Connector
de-24-bavaria.description: Road signs attach to posts with a single, slim vertical metal bar down the center.

de-24-north-rhine-westphalia.title: North Rhine-Westphalia Double Bar Sign Connector
de-24-north-rhine-westphalia.description: Road signs attach with two parallel vertical metal bars for a wider, robust look.

de-24-saxony.title: Saxony T-Shaped Sign Connector
de-24-saxony.description: Road signs feature a T-shaped metal bracket with a horizontal bar atop a vertical bar.

de-24-lower-saxony.title: Lower Saxony Double Bar Sign Connector
de-24-lower-saxony.description: Road signs attach with two vertical metal bars, sometimes with narrower spacing.

de-24-schleswig-holstein.title: Schleswig-Holstein Single Bar Sign Connector
de-24-schleswig-holstein.description: Road signs mount with a single, central vertical metal bar.

de-24-brandenburg.title: Brandenburg T-Shaped Sign Connector
de-24-brandenburg.description: Road signs use a T-shaped metal bracket with horizontal and vertical bars for mounting.

de-german-alps.title: German Alps
de-german-alps.description: The most mountainous terrain lies along the southern border with Austria.

de-baltic-pines.title: Baltic Pines
de-baltic-pines.description: Scots pines with orange-toned bark concentrate in the northeastern states.

de-white-painted-tree-trunks.title: White-Painted Tree Trunks
de-white-painted-tree-trunks.description: Roadside trees have lower trunks painted white, mainly in the northeast.

de-vineyard-regions.title: Vineyard Regions
de-vineyard-regions.description: Most vineyards cluster in the southwest, with some pockets further east.

de-northwestern-brick-houses.title: Northwestern Brick Houses
de-northwestern-brick-houses.description: Exposed red or brown brick houses concentrate in the northwest.

de-thatched-roofs-rock-walls.title: Thatched Roofs and Rock Walls
de-thatched-roofs-rock-walls.description: Straw-thatched roofs and dry-stone walls are common in North Frisian Islands and Schleswig-Holstein.

de-black-slate-fish-scale-walls.title: Black Slate Fish-Scale Walls
de-black-slate-fish-scale-walls.description: Building façades clad in overlapping black slate tiles resembling fish scales are widespread in central Germany.

de-east-german-socialist-housing.title: East German Housing Blocks
de-east-german-socialist-housing.description: Large prefabricated apartment slabs from the socialist period mark former East German states.

de-dark-reflector-bollard.title: Dark Reflector Bollards
de-dark-reflector-bollard.description: Bollards with noticeably darker reflectors appear in certain regions.

de-nrw-green-cap-bollard.title: NRW Green-Cap Bollards
de-nrw-green-cap-bollard.description: Some bollards have coloured plastic caps, mostly green, in North Rhine-Westphalia.

de-lvr-branded-green-cap.title: LVR-Branded Green Caps
de-lvr-branded-green-cap.description: Green bollard caps stamped with 'LVR' and a coat of arms appear in southern North Rhine-Westphalia.

de-bavarian-wooden-bollard.title: Bavarian Wooden Bollards
de-bavarian-wooden-bollard.description: Cylindrical timber bollards with painted tips are a Bavarian speciality.

de-orange-road-post.title: Orange Road Posts
de-orange-road-post.description: Plain orange marker posts are common in Bavaria and some other states.

de-green-tree-marker.title: Green Tree Markers
de-green-tree-marker.description: Miniature green tags nailed to roadside trees are typical of Brandenburg and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

de-bavaria-three-section-road-marker.title: Bavaria Three-Section Road Markers
de-bavaria-three-section-road-marker.description: White rectangular plaques divided into three panels, with the left panel showing the current road, are specific to Bavaria.

de-lower-saxony-rectangular-marker.title: Lower Saxony Rectangular Markers
de-lower-saxony-rectangular-marker.description: Unadorned rectangular road markers with softly rounded corners appear in Lower Saxony.

de-metallic-border-road-marker.title: Metallic-Border Road Markers
de-metallic-border-road-marker.description: Road markers surrounded by a thin metal frame occur in Schleswig-Holstein and Lower Saxony.

de-45-rhineland-palatinate.title: Rhineland-Palatinate Rough Stone Triangular Posts
de-45-rhineland-palatinate.description: Triangular rough, unpainted stone posts topped with a white plate.

de-45-saxony.title: Saxony Rough Stone Triangular Posts
de-45-saxony.description: Triangular rough, unpainted stone posts with a white plate attached.

de-45-saarland.title: Saarland White-Painted Triangular Posts
de-45-saarland.description: Triangular marker posts fully painted white, sometimes with a white plate.

de-45-thuringia.title: Thuringia White-Painted Triangular Posts
de-45-thuringia.description: Triangular roadside posts painted entirely white, sometimes with a white plate.

de-45-baden-w-rttemberg.title: Baden-Württemberg Short White or Grey Triangular Posts
de-45-baden-w-rttemberg.description: Short triangular posts usually white, sometimes grey, sometimes with a white plate.

de-45-north-rhine-westphalia.title: North Rhine-Westphalia White Triangular Posts Without Plates
de-45-north-rhine-westphalia.description: Triangular roadside posts painted fully white without any plates.

de-white-bollard-plate.title: White Bollard Plates
de-white-bollard-plate.description: Simple white information plates mounted on bollards in certain states.

de-black-disk-bollard-base.title: Black Disk Bollard Bases
de-black-disk-bollard-base.description: Bollards atop round black base disks typical of former East German states.

de-rhineland-palatinate-orange-plate.title: Rhineland-Palatinate Orange Plates
de-rhineland-palatinate-orange-plate.description: Information plates on bollards are orange instead of white in Rhineland-Palatinate.

de-baden-wuerttemberg-grey-plate.title: Baden-Württemberg Grey Plates
de-baden-wuerttemberg-grey-plate.description: Bollard information plates may be grey instead of white in Baden-Württemberg.

de-red-capped-white-post.title: Red-Capped White Posts
de-red-capped-white-post.description: Slim white posts topped with a red cap, common in former East Germany, especially Saxony-Anhalt.

de-fully-yellow-post.title: Fully Yellow Posts
de-fully-yellow-post.description: Solid yellow marker posts specific to Brandenburg.

de-yellow-post-white-plate.title: Yellow Posts with White Plates
de-yellow-post-white-plate.description: Yellow posts with attached white information plates indicate Saxony-Anhalt.

de-east-german-round-concrete-pole.title: East German Round Concrete Poles
de-east-german-round-concrete-pole.description: Cylindrical concrete utility poles mainly found in former East Germany.

de-trident-pole-top.title: Trident Pole Tops
de-trident-pole-top.description: Three-pronged pole-top assemblies in Bavaria, Saxony-Anhalt, and Baden-Württemberg.

de-triangle-pole-top.title: Triangle Pole Tops
de-triangle-pole-top.description: Inverted-triangle pole-top braces concentrated in western Germany.

de-thick-centre-bar-pole-top.title: Thick Centre-Bar Pole Tops
de-thick-centre-bar-pole-top.description: Pole tops with a bulging horizontal crossarm midpoint in former East German states.

de-curved-bar-pole-top.title: Curved Bar Pole Tops
de-curved-bar-pole-top.description: Pole-top crossarms that arc gently, a Bavaria-specific feature.

de-aldi-nord-vs-aldi-sued.title: Aldi Nord vs Aldi Süd
de-aldi-nord-vs-aldi-sued.description: Germany is split between Aldi Süd in the south and Aldi Nord in the north, each with distinct branding.

de-sorbian-language-sign.title: Sorbian Language Signs
de-sorbian-language-sign.description: Bilingual signs featuring Sorbian appear near the Polish and Czech borders.

de-saxony-half-timbered-arch-house.title: Saxony Half-Timbered Arch Houses
de-saxony-half-timbered-arch-house.description: Half-timbered houses with arched ground-floor openings concentrated in Saxony.

de-country-flag.title: Country Flag
de-country-flag.description: The national flag of Germany is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-20-green-sticker.title: General 01 20 Green Sticker
xx-general-01-20-green-sticker.description: In Germany, most cars have a green circular sticker on the bottom right of the windshield.

gh-misc-01-ghana-tape.title: Ghana tape
gh-misc-01-ghana-tape.description: One of the most (in)famous hints in Geoguessr is the tape on the top-right bar that can be seen when looking down. It can only be found in Ghana.

gh-white-road-line.title: White Road Lines
gh-white-road-line.description: Where present, road markings are always white; many paved roads lack markings.

gh-wooden-pole.title: Wooden Poles
gh-wooden-pole.description: Utility poles are timber posts with metal crossbars carrying three porcelain insulators.

gh-national-flag-colour.title: National Flag Colours
gh-national-flag-colour.description: Kerbs, poles, and fences are often painted red, gold, and green, sometimes with the black star from the flag.

gh-striped-signpost.title: Striped Signposts
gh-striped-signpost.description: Traffic sign poles have alternating black-and-white bands in urban areas; plain metal posts in the countryside.

gh-paved-vs-unpaved-road.title: Paved vs Unpaved Roads
gh-paved-vs-unpaved-road.description: Map showing which roads are surfaced and which are dirt tracks across Ghana.

gh-northern-savannah.title: Northern Savannah
gh-northern-savannah.description: Northern Ghana features savannah with open grassland, sparser trees, and drier, paler soil.

gh-mountain-range-lake-volta.title: Mountain Ranges near Lake Volta
gh-mountain-range-lake-volta.description: Hill and mountain ranges are concentrated around Lake Volta.

gh-dense-forest.title: Dense Forests
gh-dense-forest.description: Thick tropical forest with abundant palms is found in southwest and eastern Ghana.

gh-coastal-palm-tree.title: Coastal Palm Trees
gh-coastal-palm-tree.description: Tall palms line much of the coastline, especially along the western shore.

gh-east-accra-coast.title: East of Accra Coast
gh-east-accra-coast.description: The coastal strip east of Accra along the N1 is flat, open, and sparsely vegetated, appearing almost arid.

gh-nature-reserve-car.title: Nature Reserve Car
gh-nature-reserve-car.description: Several nature reserves use a different Google vehicle, white with visible side mirrors, though the characteristic Ghana roof-rack tape remains in place.

gh-country-flag.title: Country Flag
gh-country-flag.description: The national flag of Ghana is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

gi-yellow-rear-licence-plate.title: Yellow Rear Licence Plates
gi-yellow-rear-licence-plate.description: Vehicles display yellow rear plates, matching the UK system.

gi-english-language.title: English Language
gi-english-language.description: English is the primary language on official signage in a Mediterranean coastal setting.

gi-mediterranean-architecture.title: Mediterranean Architecture
gi-mediterranean-architecture.description: Dense pastel-coloured buildings with louvred window shutters, usually painted green, blue, or brown.

gi-christmas-decoration.title: Christmas Decorations
gi-christmas-decoration.description: Street View coverage was captured in December, showing festive Christmas decorations throughout the town.

gi-barbary-macaque.title: Barbary Macaques
gi-barbary-macaque.description: Wild Barbary macaques roam the Rock, the only free-living monkey population in Europe.

gi-country-flag.title: Country Flag
gi-country-flag.description: The national flag of Gibraltar is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

gr-greek-alphabet.title: Greek Alphabet
gr-greek-alphabet.description: Greek is written in its distinctive script with rounder, softer lowercase forms.

gr-harp-shaped-pole-top.title: Harp-Shaped Pole Tops
gr-harp-shaped-pole-top.description: Many Greek utility poles have a metal frame resembling a harp atop them.

gr-five-vertical-insulator.title: Five Vertical Insulators
gr-five-vertical-insulator.description: Five insulators arranged vertically, bolted to the pole or harp-shaped frames.

gr-round-shade-pole-lamp.title: Round-Shade Pole Lamps
gr-round-shade-pole-lamp.description: Compact lamps fixed to poles, capped by a circular shade over the bulb.

xx-general-01-24-double-white-lines.title: General 01 24 Double White Lines
xx-general-01-24-double-white-lines.description: You will often see worn double white center lines in Greece.

gr-yellow-road-marking.title: Yellow Road Markings
gr-yellow-road-marking.description: Yellow road lines appear frequently in Greece.

gr-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
gr-chevron-sign.description: Curve warning boards display white arrows on a black field.

gr-warning-sign.title: Warning Signs
gr-warning-sign.description: Triangular hazard signs have a red border with a yellow interior.

gr-town-entry-sign.title: Town Entry Signs
gr-town-entry-sign.description: Settlement entrance boards are white with bold blue horizontal bands at top and bottom.

gr-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
gr-kilometre-marker.description: Small blue roadside posts show 'km' in Greek and Latin alphabets with the distance.

gr-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signs
gr-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Pedestrian figures walk across two horizontal dotted lines.

gr-miniature-roadside-shrine.title: Miniature Roadside Shrines
gr-miniature-roadside-shrine.description: Tiny church-like structures on pedestals appear frequently alongside roads.

gr-architecture.title: Mediterranean Architecture
gr-architecture.description: Stone buildings with white or pastel walls and orange tile roofs; islands feature white walls with blue doors and windows.

gr-mountainous-terrain.title: Mountainous Terrain
gr-mountainous-terrain.description: Greece is heavily mountainous with narrow, twisting highland roads.

gr-red-soil.title: Red Soil
gr-red-soil.description: Exposed red-tinted earth is widespread in the landscape.

gr-generation-3-winter-autumn-coverage.title: Winter and Autumn Coverage
gr-generation-3-winter-autumn-coverage.description: Imagery often shows dull, grey, overcast winter and autumn scenes.

gr-island-coverage-map.title: Island Coverage Map
gr-island-coverage-map.description: Numerous small islands with limited Street View; mainland and Crete have more coverage.

gr-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
gr-phone-area-code.description: Landline numbers start with 2, followed by region-indicating digits.

gr-flat-agricultural-valley.title: Flat Agricultural Valleys
gr-flat-agricultural-valley.description: Broad lowland plains around Thessaloniki and Larissa; smaller valleys scattered in north and central mainland.

gr-western-mountain.title: Western Mountains
gr-western-mountain.description: Highest peaks and most high-altitude roads are in the western mainland.

gr-cycladic-white-blue-house.title: Cycladic White-and-Blue Houses
gr-cycladic-white-blue-house.description: White-walled buildings with blue doors and shutters are found on central Cycladic islands.

gr-barren-central-island.title: Barren Central Islands
gr-barren-central-island.description: Smaller central islands have arid, treeless terrain with low scrub and bare rock.

gr-olive-grove.title: Olive Groves
gr-olive-grove.description: Olive cultivation is concentrated along the coast, especially Crete and southern Peloponnese.

gr-citrus-orchard.title: Citrus Orchards
gr-citrus-orchard.description: Citrus farming centers in coastal lowlands, mainly southern Peloponnese.

gr-thessaloniki-taxi.title: Thessaloniki Taxis
gr-thessaloniki-taxi.description: Thessaloniki taxis have blue bodies with white roofs.

gr-country-flag.title: Country Flag
gr-country-flag.description: The national flag of Greece is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

gl-coverage-overview.title: Coverage Overview
gl-coverage-overview.description: Street View in Greenland is fragmented into many isolated pockets along the southern western coastline, each with distinctive vehicles, weather, and terrain.

gl-unusual-street-view-vehicle.title: Unusual Street View Vehicles
gl-unusual-street-view-vehicle.description: Each location features its own quirky vehicle, from red tractors to snowmobiles with large boxes.

gl-white-cabin-red-roof-boat-west-coast.title: White-Cabin Red-Roof Boat
gl-white-cabin-red-roof-boat-west-coast.description: A boat with a white cabin topped by a red roof appears at numerous west-coast towns, mainly around Aasiaat.

gl-red-square-cabin-boat-west-coast.title: Red Square-Cabin Boat
gl-red-square-cabin-boat-west-coast.description: A vessel with a distinctive red square-shaped cabin visits several west-coast settlements, densest near Akunnaaq.

gl-black-box-boat-northern-east-coast.title: Black-Box Boat
gl-black-box-boat-northern-east-coast.description: A boat with a black box near the bow and a chequered pattern navigates the northern east coast.

gl-bright-red-boat-east-coast.title: Bright Red Boat
gl-bright-red-boat-east-coast.description: A vivid red boat operates near two east-coast settlements: off Tiilerilaaq and Kuummiit.

gl-country-flag.title: Country Flag
