gl-country-flag.description: The national flag of Greenland is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

gu-tropical-vegetation.title: Tropical Vegetation
gu-tropical-vegetation.description: Guam has thick, low-growing tropical vegetation.

gu-east-asian-russian-signage.title: East Asian and Russian Signage
gu-east-asian-russian-signage.description: Commercial signs often feature Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Russian text.

gu-hilly-south.title: Hilly South
gu-hilly-south.description: The southern part of Guam is hillier and more rugged.

gu-flat-north.title: Flat North
gu-flat-north.description: Northern Guam is mostly flat and low-lying.

gu-country-flag.title: Country Flag
gu-country-flag.description: The national flag of Guam is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

gt-tropical-rainforest.title: Tropical Rainforest Landscape
gt-tropical-rainforest.description: Much of the terrain is dense tropical rainforest.

gt-architecture.title: Architecture
gt-architecture.description: Stone buildings painted pastel with corrugated metal or white cinder-block walls.

gt-road-marking.title: Road Markings
gt-road-marking.description: Solid white edge lines with a single yellow centre line; markings are thinner than Mexico's.

gt-topography.title: Topography
gt-topography.description: A central mountainous belt with flat terrain to the south and north.

gt-flat-southern-farmland.title: Flat Southern Farmland
gt-flat-southern-farmland.description: Southern lowlands are flat agricultural land, more developed than northern flat areas.

gt-central-highlands.title: Central Highlands
gt-central-highlands.description: The middle band is dominated by mountainous terrain.

gt-gently-rolling-north.title: Gently Rolling North
gt-gently-rolling-north.description: Northern Guatemala has gentle hills and undulating ground.

gt-oil-palm-plantation.title: Oil Palm Plantations
gt-oil-palm-plantation.description: Oil palm cultivation is in the southwest coast and north of the central mountains.

gt-solid-green-utility-pole.title: Solid Green Utility Poles
gt-solid-green-utility-pole.description: Poles painted entirely green appear mainly in the southeast and scattered eastern areas.

gt-pole-plate-route-code.title: Pole Plate Route Codes
gt-pole-plate-route-code.description: Many green poles have a white plate with the first two characters indicating the road.

gt-forward-facing-roof-bar.title: Forward-Facing Roof Bar
gt-forward-facing-roof-bar.description: Most Guatemalan cars have an upper-right roof bar angled toward the front.

gt-backward-facing-roof-bar-southeast.title: Backward-Facing Roof Bar
gt-backward-facing-roof-bar-southeast.description: In southeastern Guatemala, the upper-right roof bar points toward the rear.

gt-blue-rope-lower-bar.title: Blue Rope on Lower Bar
gt-blue-rope-lower-bar.description: Backward-bar regions often have a blue rope wrapped around the lower-right roof bar.

gt-missing-black-bar-cap.title: Missing Black Bar Cap
gt-missing-black-bar-cap.description: Some southern and far northeast areas have backward-facing bars without a black cap.

gt-phone-code-6-guatemala-department.title: Phone Code 6
gt-phone-code-6-guatemala-department.description: Numbers starting with 6 belong to the Guatemala Department.

gt-country-flag.title: Country Flag
gt-country-flag.description: The national flag of Guatemala is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ha-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
ha-licence-plate.description: Hawaiian plates are white with an arched rainbow; front plates are mandatory.

ha-hawaiian-language.title: Hawaiian Language
ha-hawaiian-language.description: Hawaiian place names appear on signs, using eight consonants and vowel endings.

ha-lush-tropical-vegetation.title: Lush Tropical Vegetation
ha-lush-tropical-vegetation.description: Dense tropical greenery lines Hawaiian roadsides.

ha-volcanic-topography.title: Volcanic Topography
ha-volcanic-topography.description: Hawaiian terrain features volcano-shaped slopes, cliffs, valleys, and craters.

ha-architecture.title: Architecture
ha-architecture.description: Homes are light-coloured wooden structures with dark volcanic rock retaining walls.

ha-yellow-pole-band.title: Yellow Pole Bands
ha-yellow-pole-band.description: Some Hawaiian utility poles have wide yellow bands painted around them.

ha-guitar-pick-highway-shield.title: Guitar-Pick Highway Shields
ha-guitar-pick-highway-shield.description: State highway markers are guitar pick-shaped with yellow-painted posts.

ha-raised-pavement-marker-pattern.title: Raised Pavement Marker Pattern
ha-raised-pavement-marker-pattern.description: Hawaiian road reflectors follow a pattern: one, four close, then one again.

ha-kauai.title: Kauai
ha-kauai.description: Kauai has deep red earth, steep hills, and dense jungle-like growth.

ha-oahu.title: Oʻahu
ha-oahu.description: Oʻahu features steep green hills visible from suburban areas.

ha-molokai.title: Molokaʻi
ha-molokai.description: Molokaʻi has vivid red soil, dry vegetation, and a prominent eastern volcano.

ha-lanai-coastal.title: Lānaʻi, Coastal
ha-lanai-coastal.description: Lānaʻi's coast is hilly with dry grass and scrubby bushes, few buildings.

ha-maui-central-isthmus.title: Maui, Central Isthmus
ha-maui-central-isthmus.description: Maui's central valley is dry grassland between two mountain ranges.

ha-maui-coastal-area.title: Maui, Coastal Areas
ha-maui-coastal-area.description: Maui's coast is greener with banana plants, palms, and mountain backdrops.

ha-big-island-interior.title: Big Island, Interior
ha-big-island-interior.description: Big Island's interior has grassy plains with lava rock and volcanic summits.

ha-big-island-coastal.title: Big Island, Coastal
ha-big-island-coastal.description: Big Island's coast is lusher with trees and ferns; towns are mostly here.

hk-licence-plate.title: Yellow License Plates
hk-licence-plate.description: Front plates in Hong Kong are white and rear plates are yellow..

hk-dense-urban-skyline.title: Dense Urban Skyline
hk-dense-urban-skyline.description: A tightly packed metropolis with modern towers and bustling streets crowded with traffic and pedestrians.

hk-green-mountainous-hinterland.title: Green Mountainous Hinterland
hk-green-mountainous-hinterland.description: Hilly subtropical greenery beyond the urban core with roads extending into rural highlands.

hk-exterior-air-conditioner.title: Exterior Air Conditioners
hk-exterior-air-conditioner.description: Wall-mounted air-conditioning units are ubiquitous on apartment buildings.

hk-grey-lamp-post-wide-base.title: Grey Lamp Posts with Wide Base
hk-grey-lamp-post-wide-base.description: Cylindrical grey street lamps flaring at the base, often with a small white sticker.

hk-rural-wooden-utility-pole.title: Rural Wooden Utility Poles
hk-rural-wooden-utility-pole.description: Round timber utility poles appear only in rural areas, often carrying meters or transformers.

hk-no-striped-kerb.title: No Striped Kerbs
hk-no-striped-kerb.description: Painted kerb stripes are virtually absent; grey pedestrian guardrails are common instead.

hk-yellow-pedestrian-crossing.title: Yellow Pedestrian Crossings
hk-yellow-pedestrian-crossing.description: Crosswalks and some junctions feature yellow paint markings.

hk-road-marking.title: Road Markings
hk-road-marking.description: White centre lines; white or yellow edge lines; concrete road surfaces common.

hk-bilingual-road-sign.title: Bilingual Road Signs
hk-bilingual-road-sign.description: White rectangular directional signs with thick black border and English and Chinese text.

hk-give-way-sign.title: Give Way Signs
hk-give-way-sign.description: Inverted white triangle with heavy red border and bilingual give-way text.

hk-mountainside-retaining-wall.title: Mountainside Retaining Walls
hk-mountainside-retaining-wall.description: Exposed weathered rock faces along hillside roads, sometimes with wire netting and small plaques.

hk-fire-hydrant.title: Fire Hydrants
hk-fire-hydrant.description: Typically red with domed top and three outlets; shape is a reliable identifier.

hk-yellow-traffic-bollard.title: Yellow Traffic Bollards
hk-yellow-traffic-bollard.description: Yellow posts topped with blue circle and white directional arrow at crossings and lane dividers.

hk-bright-orange-litter-bin.title: Bright Orange Litter Bins
hk-bright-orange-litter-bin.description: Vivid orange waste bins stand on pavements throughout the territory.

hk-double-decker-bus.title: Double-Decker Buses
hk-double-decker-bus.description: Most public buses are double-deckers with various color schemes; minibuses have green or red roofs.

hk-boxy-village-house.title: Boxy Village Houses
hk-boxy-village-house.description: Low-rise, boxy multi-storey houses typical of small villages in the northern New Territories.

hk-mong-kok-surrounding-kowloon.title: Mong Kok and Surrounding Kowloon
hk-mong-kok-surrounding-kowloon.description: Dense grid-pattern streets with older apartment blocks above ground-floor shops.

hk-northwestern-rice-paddies.title: Northwestern Rice Paddies
hk-northwestern-rice-paddies.description: Flat lowlands near the China border with waterlogged rice fields and Shenzhen skyline visible.

hk-caribbean-coast-tung-chung.title: Caribbean Coast and Tung Chung
hk-caribbean-coast-tung-chung.description: Matching residential towers forming a wall-like facade with palm trees lining the streets.

hk-country-flag.title: Country Flag
hk-country-flag.description: The national flag of Hong Kong is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

hu-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
hu-licence-plate.description: Elongated white EU-format plates; taxis have yellow, electric vehicles green plates.

hu-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
hu-chevron-sign.description: Curve warning boards with white arrows on red; less common black on white variant.

h-general-01-street-signs.title: General 01 Street Signs
h-general-01-street-signs.description: Street names in Hungary usually end with the word "utca".

hu-green-kilometre-marker.title: Green Kilometre Markers
hu-green-kilometre-marker.description: In Hungary, small green kilometre markers are common along the roads.

hu-very-tall-sign-post.title: Very Tall Sign Posts
hu-very-tall-sign-post.description: Road sign poles are unusually tall, often taller than the Street View camera.

hu-four-bolt-sign-mounting.title: Four-Bolt Sign Mounting
hu-four-bolt-sign-mounting.description: Signs fastened with four bolts in a tall rectangular pattern.

hu-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Sign
hu-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Hungarian pedestrian crossing signs have a walking figure with a belt low on the body crossing five zebra stripes.

hu-road-number-shield.title: Road Number Shields
hu-road-number-shield.description: Hungarian routes use green signs; M motorways use blue, both with compact shield-shaped emblems.

hu-green-directional-sign.title: Green Directional Signs
hu-green-directional-sign.description: Destination boards are green with a thin white inner border; motorways use the same layout on blue.

hu-gen-3-winter-coverage.title: Winter Coverage
hu-gen-3-winter-coverage.description: Imagery was captured during colder months, showing grey, leafless scenes.

hu-architecture.title: Architecture
hu-architecture.description: Suburbs have pale stone or rendered single-storey houses with red clay tiles; central districts have older multi-storey buildings.

hu-yellow-bicycle-lane-line.title: Yellow Bicycle Lane Lines
hu-yellow-bicycle-lane-line.description: Road markings are white except bicycle lane lines, which are yellow.

hu-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
hu-phone-area-code.description: Landline area codes are two digits; Budapest's code is 1.

hu-road-number-system.title: Road Number System
hu-road-number-system.description: Route numbers radiate clockwise from Budapest, indicating direction from the capital.

hu-town-name-prefix.title: Town Name Prefixes
hu-town-name-prefix.description: Many settlement names have distinctive prefixes that narrow down the region.

hu-metal-framed-street-sign.title: Metal-Framed Street Signs
hu-metal-framed-street-sign.description: Street name plates with thick metal borders are typical in western Hungary.

hu-arrow-shaped-street-sign.title: Arrow-Shaped Street Signs
hu-arrow-shaped-street-sign.description: Blue or green arrow-shaped name plates on utility poles indicate Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg county in the northeast.

hu-flat-southeast-farmland.title: Flat Southeast Farmland
hu-flat-southeast-farmland.description: Southeastern Hungary is flat agricultural land with wide open fields.

hu-northern-western-hills.title: Northern and Western Hills
hu-northern-western-hills.description: Forested hills and low mountains cover northern and western Hungary, with tallest peaks along the northern border.

hu-puszta-grassland.title: Puszta Grasslands
hu-puszta-grassland.description: Flat, marshy natural grasslands around Hortobágy National Park, left wild and often waterlogged.

hu-tornanadaska-snowy-road.title: Tornanadaska Snowy Road
hu-tornanadaska-snowy-road.description: Road east of Tornanadaska with persistent snow, roadside bollards, and a parallel railway line.

hu-country-flag.title: Country Flag
hu-country-flag.description: The national flag of Hungary is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ic-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
ic-licence-plate.description: Plain white plates with blue lettering, no blue EU-style strip.

ic-yellow-bollard.title: Yellow Bollards
ic-yellow-bollard.description: Yellow delineator posts with a single white reflector on most rural roads.

ic-barren-treeless-landscape.title: Barren Treeless Landscape
ic-barren-treeless-landscape.description: Countryside lacks trees, covered by dark grey volcanic soil.

ic-volcanic-geology.title: Volcanic Geology
ic-volcanic-geology.description: Landscape shaped by tectonic and volcanic forces: rugged peaks, geothermal pools, lava fields, rift valleys, and rock pillars.

ic-yellow-directional-sign.title: Yellow Directional Signs
ic-yellow-directional-sign.description: Destination boards have yellow backgrounds with a white inset panel showing route numbers.

ic-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signs
ic-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Pedestrian figure crosses four zebra stripes; sign background often has a faint yellow tinge.

ic-icelandic-language.title: Icelandic Language
ic-icelandic-language.description: Features letters ð (Ð), þ, æ, and accented vowels á, é, í, ó, ö, ú, ý.

ic-street-name-sign.title: Street Name Signs
ic-street-name-sign.description: White plates with black text, often edged by a thin metal rim, mounted on lamp posts or traffic-light poles.

ic-all-white-road-marking.title: All-White Road Markings
ic-all-white-road-marking.description: All road markings—centre lines, edge lines, lane dividers—are white.

ic-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
ic-chevron-sign.description: Curve warning boards show yellow arrows on a black field.

ic-yellow-warning-sign.title: Yellow Warning Signs
ic-yellow-warning-sign.description: Hazard signs use a yellow background.

ic-road-numbering-system.title: Road Numbering System
ic-road-numbering-system.description: Route 1 is a ring road; other routes start with digits 2–9 assigned clockwise by region.

ic-westfjords.title: Westfjords
ic-westfjords.description: Narrow fjords surrounded by moderately high, flat-topped mountains.

ic-eastfjords.title: Eastfjords
ic-eastfjords.description: Eastern coast fjords with taller, more rugged mountains than the Westfjords.

ic-northern-valleys-west-akureyri.title: Northern Valleys West of Akureyri
ic-northern-valleys-west-akureyri.description: Valleys between tall, often snow-dusted peaks opening north to northeast.

ic-inland-volcanic-desert.title: Inland Volcanic Desert
ic-inland-volcanic-desert.description: Desolate dark volcanic gravel expanses with almost no plant life in eastern interior highlands.

ic-southwest-agricultural-lowland.title: Southwest Agricultural Lowland
ic-southwest-agricultural-lowland.description: A broad, level farming area with farmsteads, meadows, and pastures. Surrounding mountains appear unusually distant.

ic-reykjavik.title: Reykjavík
ic-reykjavik.description: The capital sits on the southern shore of a bay, on mostly flat ground with gentle hills and a large urban footprint.

ic-akureyri.title: Akureyri
ic-akureyri.description: Iceland's second city occupies a north–south valley along the western shore of a bay, flanked by mountain ranges.

ic-southern-coast-glacier.title: Southern Coast Glaciers
ic-southern-coast-glacier.description: Tongues of ice from the Vatnajökull ice cap spill down towards the sea along the southern coastline.

ic-divided-multi-lane-highway.title: Divided and Multi-Lane Highways
ic-divided-multi-lane-highway.description: Dual carriageways and roads wider than two lanes are rare, mostly around Reykjavík and near major intersections.

ic-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ic-country-flag.description: The national flag of Iceland is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

is-volcanic-geology.title: Volcanic Geology
is-volcanic-geology.description: A dramatic landscape of rugged peaks, geothermal pools, lava fields, rift valleys, and rock pillars shaped by tectonic and volcanic forces.

is-yellow-directional-sign.title: Yellow Directional Signs
is-yellow-directional-sign.description: Road destination boards have a yellow background with a white inset panel showing the route number.

xx-general-01-44-pedestrian-crossings.title: General 01 44 Pedestrian Crossings
xx-general-01-44-pedestrian-crossings.description: In Iceland, you will see pedestrian crossing signs with four stripes at the bottom and a subtle yellow hue.

is-street-name-sign.title: Street Name Signs
is-street-name-sign.description: White plates with black text, often edged by a thin metal rim, mounted on lamp posts or traffic-light poles.

is-all-white-road-marking.title: All-White Road Markings
is-all-white-road-marking.description: All road markings in Iceland are white.

is-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
is-chevron-sign.description: Curve warning boards show yellow arrows on a black field.

is-yellow-warning-sign.title: Yellow Warning Signs
is-yellow-warning-sign.description: Warning signs in Iceland use a yellow background.

is-road-numbering-system.title: Road Numbering System
is-road-numbering-system.description: Route 1 is the ring road; other routes start with digits 2–9 corresponding to regions clockwise from the south.

is-westfjords.title: Westfjords
is-westfjords.description: Narrow fjords hemmed by moderately high mountains with flat summits.

is-eastfjords.title: Eastfjords
is-eastfjords.description: Eastern fjords with taller, more rugged flanking mountains.

is-northern-valley-west-akureyri.title: Northern Valleys West of Akureyri
is-northern-valley-west-akureyri.description: Multiple valleys between tall, often snow-dusted peaks opening north to northeast.

is-inland-volcanic-desert.title: Inland Volcanic Desert
is-inland-volcanic-desert.description: Desolate dark volcanic gravel expanses with virtually no plant life.

is-southwest-agricultural-lowland.title: Southwest Agricultural Lowland
is-southwest-agricultural-lowland.description: Broad farming area with farmsteads, meadows, and distant surrounding mountains.

is-reykjavik.title: Reykjavík
is-reykjavik.description: Capital on the southern shore of a bay, mostly flat with gentle hills and a large urban footprint.

is-25-rang-r-ing-eystra.title: Red Pickup Trucks
is-25-rang-r-ing-eystra.description: Street View coverage uses bright red pickup trucks distinctive to southwestern Iceland.

is-25-rang-r-ing-ytra.title: Red Pickup Trucks
is-25-rang-r-ing-ytra.description: Street View coverage uses bright red pickup trucks distinctive to southwestern Iceland.

is-25-keflav-k.title: Red Pickup Trucks
is-25-keflav-k.description: Street View imagery collected using bright red pickup trucks specific to southwestern Iceland.

is-25-reykjanesb-r.title: Red Pickup Trucks
is-25-reykjanesb-r.description: Street View coverage uses bright red pickup trucks exclusive to southwestern Iceland.

is-25-northeastern-region.title: White Pickup Trucks
is-25-northeastern-region.description: Street View imagery uses white pickup trucks unique to northeastern Iceland.

is-southern-coast-glacier.title: Southern Coast Glaciers
is-southern-coast-glacier.description: Ice tongues from Vatnajökull ice cap spill down to the sea along the southern coast.

is-divided-multi-lane-highway.title: Divided and Multi-Lane Highways
is-divided-multi-lane-highway.description: Dual carriageways and roads wider than two lanes are rare, mostly around Reykjavík.

is-country-flag.title: Country Flag
is-country-flag.description: The national flag of Iceland is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

in-regional-scripts.title: Regional Scripts
in-regional-scripts.description: Distinct writing systems help narrow down the state or region in India.

in-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
in-licence-plate.description: Indian plates are usually white; yellow plates are commercial vehicles, green plates are electric vehicles.

in-black-white-striped-signposts.title: Black and White Striped Signposts
in-black-white-striped-signposts.description: Road signposts in India are painted in alternating black and white stripes.

in-utility-poles.title: Utility Poles
in-utility-poles.description: Indian utility poles are concrete square columns topped with a trident-shaped fixture.

in-marathi-script.title: Marathi Script
in-marathi-script.description: Marathi in Maharashtra uses Devanagari script, distinguished by the character ळ.

in-punjabi-gurmukhi-script.title: Punjabi (Gurmukhi Script)
in-punjabi-gurmukhi-script.description: Gurmukhi script in Punjab has rounder letters and a broken horizontal bar, with key letters like ਨ, ਲ, and ਅ.

in-gujarati-script.title: Gujarati Script
in-gujarati-script.description: Gujarati script lacks the horizontal line across the top of words found in Hindi.

in-bengali-script.title: Bengali Script
in-bengali-script.description: Bengali script features many left-pointing triangular forms within its characters.

in-assamese-script.title: Assamese Script
in-assamese-script.description: Assamese script, based on Bengali, includes unique characters like ৰ and ৱ.

in-kannada-script.title: Kannada Script
in-kannada-script.description: Kannada script has flowing curves, small circles, and wavy tails on many characters.

in-telugu-script.title: Telugu Script
in-telugu-script.description: Telugu script resembles Kannada but has checkmark-style diacritics above letters.

in-tamil-script.title: Tamil Script
in-tamil-script.description: Tamil script blends curves, straight strokes, right angles, and dot-shaped diacritics.

in-oriya-script.title: Oriya Script
in-oriya-script.description: Oriya script is rounded with broad semi-circular arcs and sweeping curve diacritics.

in-malayalam-script.title: Malayalam Script
in-malayalam-script.description: Malayalam features smoothly rounded characters with inverted U-shaped forms.

in-manipuri-meitei-script.title: Manipuri (Meitei Script)
in-manipuri-meitei-script.description: Meitei script has many vertical strokes and sharp right-angled forms.

in-mizo-language-latin-script.title: Mizo Language (Latin Script)
in-mizo-language-latin-script.description: Mizo is commonly written in Latin script in Mizoram.

in-english-only-meghalaya.title: English-Only in Meghalaya
in-english-only-meghalaya.description: Meghalaya signage is almost entirely in English with no local script.

in-yellow-black-tuk-tuks.title: Yellow and Black Tuk Tuks
in-yellow-black-tuk-tuks.description: Yellow tuk tuks with black rooftops indicate Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, or Tamil Nadu.

in-gujarat-concrete-holey-poles.title: Gujarat Concrete Holey Poles
in-gujarat-concrete-holey-poles.description: Concrete utility poles with holes appear only in Gujarat and nearby union territories.

in-two-section-poles.title: Two-Section Poles
in-two-section-poles.description: Utility poles split into two segments are common in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

in-sikkim-mesh-poles.title: Sikkim Mesh Poles
in-sikkim-mesh-poles.description: Metallic lattice mesh utility poles are typical of Sikkim.

in-kerala-metal-holey-poles.title: Kerala Metal Holey Poles
in-kerala-metal-holey-poles.description: Perforated metal utility poles are widespread in Kerala.

in-thin-grey-metal-poles.title: Thin Grey Metal Poles
in-thin-grey-metal-poles.description: Slender grey metal poles, often in pairs, are common in northeastern states and Himalayan zones.

in-punjab-mint-green-electricity-counter.title: Punjab Mint Green Electricity Counters
in-punjab-mint-green-electricity-counter.description: Mint green electricity meter boxes with small square windows signal Punjab.

in-window-shaped-pole-tops.title: Window-Shaped Pole Tops
in-window-shaped-pole-tops.description: Compact metal pole tops shaped like window frames are typical of Punjab and Haryana.

in-karnataka-trident-pole-tops.title: Karnataka Trident Pole Tops
in-karnataka-trident-pole-tops.description: Poles with a top central insulator and two lower ones are typical of Karnataka.

in-manipur-metal-trident-poles.title: Manipur Metal Trident Poles
in-manipur-metal-trident-poles.description: Metal poles topped with a trident arrangement are exclusive to Manipur.

in-inverted-triangle-pole-tops.title: Inverted Triangle Pole Tops
in-inverted-triangle-pole-tops.description: Upside-down triangular attachments beneath pole tops are common in Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh.

in-madhya-pradesh-inverted-a-poles.title: Madhya Pradesh Inverted-A Poles
in-madhya-pradesh-inverted-a-poles.description: Metal brackets shaped like upside-down A's below pole tops are specific to Madhya Pradesh.

in-trapezoid-pole-connector.title: Trapezoid Pole Connector
in-trapezoid-pole-connector.description: Inverted trapezoid connectors link crossbars to poles, mainly in Chhattisgarh.

in-west-bengal-rectangle-pole-tops.title: West Bengal Rectangle Pole Tops
in-west-bengal-rectangle-pole-tops.description: Pole tops with tall, narrow rectangular frames are characteristic of West Bengal.

in-west-bengal-double-crossbar-poles.title: West Bengal Double Crossbar Poles
in-west-bengal-double-crossbar-poles.description: Poles with two horizontal crossbars joined by vertical supports are seen in West Bengal.

in-northeast-even-uneven-pole-tops.title: Northeast Even/Uneven Pole Tops
in-northeast-even-uneven-pole-tops.description: A distinctive pole arrangement with one even and one uneven crossbar top on the same pole in northeastern states.

in-chevron-shaped-pole-attachment.title: Chevron-Shaped Pole Attachment
in-chevron-shaped-pole-attachment.description: Diagonal bars in a '<' shape on poles, common in Meghalaya and Arunachal Pradesh.

in-assam-meghalaya-double-crossbar-poles.title: Assam/Meghalaya Double Crossbar Poles
in-assam-meghalaya-double-crossbar-poles.description: Poles with two crossbars and two insulators each, found in Assam, Meghalaya, and Mizoram.

in-assam-bent-trident-poles.title: Assam Bent Trident Poles
in-assam-bent-trident-poles.description: Trident-style pole top with the centre prong bent at a right angle, exclusive to Assam.

in-goa-stacked-crossbar-poles.title: Goa Stacked Crossbar Poles
in-goa-stacked-crossbar-poles.description: A shorter crossbar above a longer one on the same pole, specific to Goa.

in-tamil-nadu-pole-tree-markings.title: Tamil Nadu Pole/Tree Markings
in-tamil-nadu-pole-tree-markings.description: A black stripe flanked by two white stripes painted on poles and tree trunks, indicating Tamil Nadu.

in-delhi-pole-stripes.title: Delhi Pole Stripes
in-delhi-pole-stripes.description: Poles marked with five or more narrow alternating black and yellow bands, typical of Delhi.

in-bihar-pole-stripes.title: Bihar Pole Stripes
in-bihar-pole-stripes.description: Poles with four broader black and yellow bands, distinctive to Bihar.

in-bihar-red-white-tree-paint.title: Bihar Red and White Tree Paint
in-bihar-red-white-tree-paint.description: Tree trunks painted with four alternating red and white stripes near the base, mainly in Bihar.

in-kerala-yellow-pole-markings.title: Kerala Yellow Pole Markings
in-kerala-yellow-pole-markings.description: Compact yellow markings on utility poles, common in Kerala.

in-central-india-rounded-roof-tiles.title: Central India Rounded Roof Tiles
in-central-india-rounded-roof-tiles.description: Semi-cylindrical clay tiles laid in irregular rows on rooftops can be found across central India.

in-southern-india-flat-orange-roof-tiles.title: Southern India Flat Orange Roof Tiles
in-southern-india-flat-orange-roof-tiles.description: Vivid orange flat tiles with a central ridge, prevalent in Tamil Nadu.

in-west-bengal-diamond-protrusion-roof-t.title: West Bengal Diamond-Protrusion Roof Tiles
in-west-bengal-diamond-protrusion-roof-t.description: Flat roofing tiles with a small diamond-shaped raised element at the centre, typical of West Bengal.

in-west-bengal-large-metal-hip-roofs.title: West Bengal Large Metal Hip Roofs
in-west-bengal-large-metal-hip-roofs.description: Broad hip-style roofs made from corrugated metal sheeting in West Bengal and nearby areas.

in-northeast-metal-roofs-triangle.title: Northeast Metal Roofs with Triangle
in-northeast-metal-roofs-triangle.description: Sheet metal roofs with a small triangular detail near the apex, widespread in Northeast India.

in-northeast-square-panel-houses.title: Northeast Square-Panel Houses
in-northeast-square-panel-houses.description: Houses built from square wall panels divided by slender beams, characteristic of Northeast India.

in-thatched-roof-huts.title: Thatched Roof Huts
in-thatched-roof-huts.description: Thatched huts along the eastern coast and northern plains, using hay or dried palm fan leaves.

in-sikh-gurdwaras-punjab.title: Sikh Gurdwaras in Punjab
in-sikh-gurdwaras-punjab.description: Temples with white domed roofs, decorated walls, and the Khanda emblem, concentrated in Punjab.

in-wealthy-homes-goa-kerala.title: Wealthy Homes in Goa and Kerala
in-wealthy-homes-goa-kerala.description: Modern, affluent residential architecture common in prosperous Goa and Kerala.

in-chir-pines.title: Chir Pines
in-chir-pines.description: Trees with smooth conical or spherical canopies of long needles, found in Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, and western Arunachal Pradesh.

in-khasi-pines.title: Khasi Pines
in-khasi-pines.description: Pines with long needles and irregular, rough crowns, growing in Meghalaya and Manipur.

in-euphorbia-cacti-fences.title: Euphorbia Cacti Fences
in-euphorbia-cacti-fences.description: Hedgerows of Euphorbia neriifolia cacti used as natural fencing in Gujarat, western Maharashtra, and southern Rajasthan.

in-palmyra-palms.title: Palmyra Palms
in-palmyra-palms.description: Tall palms with spherical fan-leaf canopies, common in southern and eastern India.

in-areca-palms.title: Areca Palms
in-areca-palms.description: Slender-trunk palms with compact crowns along the southwestern coast, northeastern states, and Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

in-date-palms.title: Date Palms
in-date-palms.description: Typical palms of the arid central interior where tropical palms are scarce.

in-oil-palm-plantations.title: Oil Palm Plantations
in-oil-palm-plantations.description: Primarily in Andhra Pradesh's narrow panhandle near the eastern Telangana border.

in-tea-plantations.title: Tea Plantations
in-tea-plantations.description: Located in northeastern states and the far southern hills.

in-sugarcane.title: Sugarcane
in-sugarcane.description: Grown mainly in northern Uttar Pradesh and parts of the southwest.

in-cotton.title: Cotton
in-cotton.description: Cultivated across western India, especially Gujarat and Maharashtra.

in-canola.title: Canola
in-canola.description: Grown chiefly in and around Rajasthan.

in-himalayan-mountains.title: Himalayan Mountains
in-himalayan-mountains.description: India's tallest mountain range, towering over all other terrain.

xx-general-01-11-dry-landscape.title: General 01 11 Dry Landscape
xx-general-01-11-dry-landscape.description: Some parts of the northern Himalayan region administered by India are known for dry, high altitude landscapes with very little vegetation.

in-northern-plains-ganges-valley.title: Northern Plains
in-northern-plains-ganges-valley.description: Vast flat farmland with highly fertile soil in the Ganges Valley.

in-maharashtra-dark-soil.title: Maharashtra Dark Soil
in-maharashtra-dark-soil.description: Dark-coloured earth concentrated in Maharashtra and nearby areas.

in-red-soil.title: Red Soil
in-red-soil.description: Red soil along the southern west coast and Chhattisgarh–western Odisha corridor.

in-western-rajasthan-desert.title: Western Rajasthan Desert
in-western-rajasthan-desert.description: Arid, sandy terrain dominating western Rajasthan.

in-western-ghats-ridgelines.title: Western Ghats Ridgelines
in-western-ghats-ridgelines.description: Flat, plateau-like ridges in western Maharashtra, drier in the north and greener in the south.

in-mizoram-green-valleys.title: Mizoram Green Valleys
in-mizoram-green-valleys.description: Deep green valleys with low vegetation, flanked by eroded hills and small peaks.

in-northeast-wooden-stick-fences.title: Northeast Wooden Stick Fences
in-northeast-wooden-stick-fences.description: Rustic fences of thin wooden sticks woven into a square grid, common in northeastern states.

in-buddhist-prayer-flags.title: Buddhist Prayer Flags
in-buddhist-prayer-flags.description: Colourful prayer flags visible in Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh.

in-andaman-nicobar-pole-stickers.title: Andaman and Nicobar Pole Stickers
in-andaman-nicobar-pole-stickers.description: Dark stickers with digits and a central arrow on utility poles, unique to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

in-elevated-railways.title: Elevated Railways
in-elevated-railways.description: Above-ground metro and rail lines in major cities like Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, and Mumbai.

in-grey-brick-roofs-telangana-karnataka-.title: Grey Brick Roofs
in-grey-brick-roofs-telangana-karnataka-.description: Rooftops of thin grey stone or brick slabs, with similar grey rock in walls and stockyards on the Telangana/Karnataka border.

in-white-clay-huts-bihar-up.title: White Clay Huts
in-white-clay-huts-bihar-up.description: Mud-walled huts coated in white paint in northwest Bihar and northeast Uttar Pradesh.

in-central-bihar-cross-pattern-huts.title: Central Bihar Cross-Pattern Huts
in-central-bihar-cross-pattern-huts.description: Timber-framed huts with criss-cross lattice walls in central Bihar.

in-japanese-cedar-trees.title: Japanese Cedar Trees
in-japanese-cedar-trees.description: Tall trees with slender, bushy canopies near the Sikkim-West Bengal boundary and Meghalaya.

in-barren-western-uttarakhand.title: Barren Western Uttarakhand
in-barren-western-uttarakhand.description: Hillsides northwest of Dehradun are stripped of vegetation due to deforestation and erosion.

in-gujarat-salt-flat.title: Gujarat Salt Flats
in-gujarat-salt-flat.description: Expansive salt pans and coastal marshlands with little plant life and shallow water.

in-southern-tamil-nadu-red-soil.title: Southern Tamil Nadu Red Soil
in-southern-tamil-nadu-red-soil.description: Flat, scrubby terrain with intensely red earth in southern Tamil Nadu.

in-country-flag.title: Country Flag
in-country-flag.description: The national flag of India is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

id-road-marking.title: Road Markings
id-road-marking.description: Centre lines can be white or yellow; edge lines are always white.

id-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
id-utility-pole.description: Cylindrical steel or concrete poles, some painted black with red-and-white bands. Crossbars may be symmetrical or asymmetrical.

id-bollard.title: Bollards
id-bollard.description: Common designs include black-and-white square or round-topped posts and yellow-and-black variants with red reflectors.

id-red-white-banner.title: Red-and-White Banners
id-red-white-banner.description: Strings of small red and white pennants, the national colours, hung along roads throughout the archipelago.

id-cigarette-advertisement.title: Cigarette Advertisements
id-cigarette-advertisement.description: Tobacco billboards with the word 'PERINGATAN' is a common sight in Indonesia.

id-front-licence-plate-motorcycle.title: Front Licence Plates on Motorcycles
id-front-licence-plate-motorcycle.description: Indonesian motorcycles carry a front licence plate, unlike other Southeast Asian countries.

id-general-01-kabupaten.title: General 01 Kabupaten
id-general-01-kabupaten.description: Indonesia is divided into hundreds of regencies know as Kabupaten (Kab. for short). This term is unique to Indonesia.

id-cardinal-direction-word.title: Cardinal Direction Words
id-cardinal-direction-word.description: Addresses and province names often include directional terms: Utara (North), Timur (East), Selatan (South), Barat (West), Tengah (Central).

id-triangle-pole-connector.title: Triangle Pole Connector
id-triangle-pole-connector.description: A triangular brace connects the vertical pole to its horizontal crossbar in some provinces, particularly in western Java.

id-trident-pole-top.title: Trident Pole Tops
id-trident-pole-top.description: A three-pronged 'trident' crossbar design mainly in Central Java and Yogyakarta.

id-bali-rectangular-pole-attachment.title: Bali Rectangular Pole Attachment
id-bali-rectangular-pole-attachment.description: Poles in Bali sometimes have a distinctive rectangular bracket at the top.

id-lesser-sunda-extra-long-pole-support.title: Lesser Sunda Extra-Long Pole Support
id-lesser-sunda-extra-long-pole-support.description: Pole tops feature an elongated diagonal brace; some have two supports on the Lesser Sunda Islands.

id-north-central-sulawesi-pole-bracket.title: North/Central Sulawesi Pole Bracket
id-north-central-sulawesi-pole-bracket.description: An additional bracket beneath the horizontal crossbar is typical in North and Central Sulawesi and Gorontalo.

id-central-sulawesi-secondary-pole.title: Central Sulawesi Secondary Poles
id-central-sulawesi-secondary-pole.description: Slender black secondary poles beside main utility poles with two strips of tape near the top.

id-satellite-dish-direction.title: Satellite Dish Direction
id-satellite-dish-direction.description: Satellite dishes aim towards the equator; dish direction indicates relative position to it.

id-central-sulawesi-tricolour-bollard.title: Central Sulawesi Tricolour Bollards
id-central-sulawesi-tricolour-bollard.description: Roadside posts painted black, white, and yellow horizontal bands are specific to Central Sulawesi.

id-painted-fence-sulawesi.title: Painted Fences on Sulawesi
id-painted-fence-sulawesi.description: Roadside fences painted white with blue or red highlights are common on Sulawesi.

id-green-bridge-railing-kalimantan.title: Green Bridge Railings in Kalimantan
id-green-bridge-railing-kalimantan.description: Bridge guardrails and side panels painted green are characteristic of South and Central Kalimantan.

id-oil-palm-plantation.title: Oil Palm Plantations
id-oil-palm-plantation.description: Vast palm oil estates are concentrated on Sumatra and Kalimantan, rare on Sulawesi.

id-rice-paddy.title: Rice Paddies
id-rice-paddy.description: Most rice cultivation is on Java, with secondary areas in South Sulawesi and South Sumatra.

id-dry-lesser-sunda-landscape.title: Dry Lesser Sunda Landscape
id-dry-lesser-sunda-landscape.description: Nusa Tenggara islands are arid, with brown sparse vegetation, driest on Sumba.

id-north-sumba-savannah.title: North Sumba Savannah
id-north-sumba-savannah.description: Open grassland like African savannah appears in northern Sumba.

id-red-soil-batam-bangka-belitung.title: Red Soil on Batam and Bangka Belitung
id-red-soil-batam-bangka-belitung.description: Reddish earth is common on Batam Island and Bangka Belitung off Sumatra's east coast.

id-clay-tile-roof-java.title: Clay Tile Roofs on Java
id-clay-tile-roof-java.description: Terracotta roof tiles are mainly a Javanese feature.

id-corrugated-metal-roof.title: Corrugated Metal Roofs
id-corrugated-metal-roof.description: Sheet-metal roofing predominates in northern and outer islands like Kalimantan, Sulawesi, and Sumatra.

id-bugis-roof-vent-south-sulawesi.title: Bugis Roof Vents in South Sulawesi
id-bugis-roof-vent-south-sulawesi.description: Horizontal louvred openings in triangular gable ends are nearly exclusive to South Sulawesi.

id-sumba-high-peaked-roof.title: Sumba High-Peaked Roofs
id-sumba-high-peaked-roof.description: Sumba houses have extremely steep, towering roof peaks unique in Indonesia.

id-north-sumatra-batak-roof.title: North Sumatra Batak Roofs
id-north-sumatra-batak-roof.description: Batak houses have curved boat-like roofs with gentler upward sweep and no spires.

id-kalimantan-wooden-shingle-roof.title: Kalimantan Wooden Shingle Roofs
id-kalimantan-wooden-shingle-roof.description: Roofs covered in small overlapping wooden shingles are distinctive in Kalimantan.

id-gable-horn-roof.title: Gable Horn Roofs
id-gable-horn-roof.description: Roofs topped with horn-like finials at the gable peak, common in South Sulawesi, Riau, and Central/South Kalimantan.

id-regional-licence-plate-code.title: Regional Licence Plate Codes
id-regional-licence-plate-code.description: Plate prefixes indicate region: single letters on western Java, two letters on eastern Java and other islands.

id-christian-minority-region.title: Christian Minority Regions
id-christian-minority-region.description: Churches and Christian iconography appear in minority areas like parts of Sulawesi, Papua, NTT, and North Sumatra.

id-country-flag.title: Country Flag
id-country-flag.description: The national flag of Indonesia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

iq-iraqi-national-museum.title: Iraqi National Museum Only
iq-iraqi-national-museum.description: Entire Street View coverage is a single trekker walk-through inside the Iraqi National Museum in Baghdad.

iq-courtyard-date-palm.title: Courtyard with Date Palms
iq-courtyard-date-palm.description: Small patio with date palms and a diagonal path, the only outdoor scene.

i-general-01-dashed-outer-lines.title: General 01 Dashed Outer Lines
i-general-01-dashed-outer-lines.description: Irish roads often have dashed yellow outlines.

ie-architecture.title: Architecture
ie-architecture.description: Rural houses are cream with dark slate roofs; urban streets have terraced row houses.

ie-diamond-shaped-warning-sign.title: Diamond-Shaped Warning Signs
ie-diamond-shaped-warning-sign.description: Irish hazard warnings use yellow diamond-shaped boards, unique in Europe.

ie-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
ie-chevron-sign.description: Curve warnings show yellow arrows on black background.

ie-pole-warning-sticker.title: Pole Warning Stickers
ie-pole-warning-sticker.description: Yellow hazard stickers on poles show a lightning bolt without electrocuted figure.

ie-green-white-bollard.title: Green-and-White Bollards
ie-green-white-bollard.description: Roadside posts in Ireland are painted green and white.

ie-rounded-corner-farm-gate.title: Rounded-Corner Farm Gates
ie-rounded-corner-farm-gate.description: Metal field gates almost always have rounded top corners.

ie-boreen-grass-centre-lane.title: Boreens (Grass-Centre Lanes)
ie-boreen-grass-centre-lane.description: Narrow rural tracks often have a grass strip down the centre.

ie-green-hedgerow-landscape.title: Green Hedgerow Landscape
ie-green-hedgerow-landscape.description: Lush farmland bordered by dense hedgerows dominates the country.

ie-wooden-utility-pole-step-rung.title: Wooden Utility Poles with Step Rungs
ie-wooden-utility-pole-step-rung.description: Timber poles have thin horizontal metal climbing pegs up one side.

ie-double-yellow-no-parking-line.title: Double Yellow No-Parking Lines
ie-double-yellow-no-parking-line.description: Double yellow lines along kerbs indicate no-parking zones.

ie-pedestrian-crossing-marker.title: Pedestrian Crossing Markers
ie-pedestrian-crossing-marker.description: Crossings are marked by black-and-white striped posts topped with a yellow globe, like in the UK.

ie-regional-road-number.title: Regional Road Numbers
ie-regional-road-number.description: Regional roads have three-digit numbers; the first digit indicates the area arranged anti-clockwise from Dublin.

ie-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
ie-phone-area-code.description: Landline numbers start with a two-digit area code whose first digit corresponds to a geographic region.

ie-rugged-west-coast.title: Rugged West Coast
ie-rugged-west-coast.description: The west coast has steep hills, low mountains, open moorland, brownish-yellow grass, and occasional bare rock.

ie-donegal-gen-4-rural-road.title: Donegal Rural Roads
ie-donegal-gen-4-rural-road.description: Very narrow, unmarked roads with grassy centers in hilly terrain are typical of County Donegal.

ie-wicklow-mountains.title: Wicklow Mountains
ie-wicklow-mountains.description: Upland area south of Dublin with minor roads having newer coverage and no sea views.

ie-22-eastern.title: Grey EV Camera Car
ie-22-eastern.description: A grey electric vehicle with a black semicircular shape at the rear edge of the camera view, common in eastern Ireland.

ie-22-county-donegal.title: Grey EV Camera Car
ie-22-county-donegal.description: A grey electric vehicle with a black semicircular marking at the rear of the camera view used in County Donegal.

ie-22-county-londonderry-northern.title: Grey EV Camera Car
ie-22-county-londonderry-northern.description: A grey electric vehicle with a black semicircular shape at the rear edge of the camera image in County Londonderry.

ie-22-county-tyrone-northern.title: Grey EV Camera Car
ie-22-county-tyrone-northern.description: A grey electric vehicle with a black semicircular marking at the rear of the camera view in County Tyrone.

ie-22-county-fermanagh-northern.title: Grey EV Camera Car
ie-22-county-fermanagh-northern.description: A grey electric vehicle with a black semicircular shape at the back edge of the camera view in County Fermanagh.

ie-22-county-antrim-northern.title: Grey EV Camera Car
ie-22-county-antrim-northern.description: A grey electric vehicle with a black semicircular shape at the rear of the camera view in County Antrim.

ie-22-county-down-northern.title: Grey EV Camera Car
ie-22-county-down-northern.description: A grey electric vehicle with a black semicircular shape at the back edge of the camera view in County Down.

ie-sligo-leitrim-tabletop-mountain.title: Sligo/Leitrim Tabletop Mountains
ie-sligo-leitrim-tabletop-mountain.description: Flat-topped mesa-like mountains rise above the landscape in northern counties Sligo and Leitrim.

ie-hilly-cork.title: Hilly Cork
ie-hilly-cork.description: Cork is notable among major Irish cities for its markedly hilly topography.

ie-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ie-country-flag.description: The national flag of Ireland is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

im-hilly-farmland-landscape.title: Hilly Farmland Landscape
im-hilly-farmland-landscape.description: Undulating green pastures crossed by narrow roads dominate the scenery.

im-whitewashed-house.title: Whitewashed Houses
im-whitewashed-house.description: White-rendered walls on houses and boundary walls are common, giving an Irish feel.

im-striped-kerb.title: Striped Kerbs
im-striped-kerb.description: Alternating black-and-white painted kerbstones appear intermittently along main roads.

im-blue-bollard.title: Blue Bollards
im-blue-bollard.description: Blue-painted roadside bollards are frequent in built-up areas.

im-generally-hilly-terrain.title: Generally Hilly Terrain
im-generally-hilly-terrain.description: The island's interior is mostly hilly, with some flat pockets.

im-flat-northern-plain.title: Flat Northern Plain
im-flat-northern-plain.description: The northern tip is flat compared to the rest, with mountains visible on the southern horizon.

im-blue-base-lamp-posts-parish-codes.title: Blue-Base Lamp Posts with Parish Codes
im-blue-base-lamp-posts-parish-codes.description: Lamp posts have blue-painted bases and a blue sticker with two-letter parish codes outside Douglas.

im-all-green-lamp-posts.title: All-Green Lamp Posts
im-all-green-lamp-posts.description: Entirely green street lights are found mainly in Ramsey and Castletown, with some in other parishes.

im-country-flag.title: Country Flag
im-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Isle of Man is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

it-license-plates-01-double-stripes.title: Double stripes
it-license-plates-01-double-stripes.description: The Italian license plates will have a blue strip on both sides. The front plates are also shorter than usual.

it-italian-language.title: Italian Language
it-italian-language.description: Recognisable by abundant double consonants, frequent 'i', accented vowels (ì, é, à), and words ending in vowels.

it-mediterranean-landscape.title: Mediterranean Landscape
it-mediterranean-landscape.description: Gently rolling farmland with forested mountain valleys.

it-architecture.title: Architecture
it-architecture.description: Pastel stone houses with terracotta roofs and outward-swinging bi-fold wooden shutters.

it-round-concrete-utility-pole.title: Round Concrete Utility Poles
it-round-concrete-utility-pole.description: Cylindrical concrete poles are widespread, unlike the wood or metal poles common in other Mediterranean countries.

it-white-pole-sticker.title: White Pole Sticker
it-white-pole-sticker.description: Timber utility poles often have a small white identification sticker.

it-concrete-trident-pole-top.title: Concrete Trident Pole Tops
it-concrete-trident-pole-top.description: A three-pronged concrete frame tops most poles, Italy's common insulator mount.

it-double-guardrail.title: Double Guardrails
it-double-guardrail.description: Two guardrail beams stacked on the same posts are common along Italian roads.

it-red-guardrail-reflector.title: Red Guardrail Reflectors
it-red-guardrail-reflector.description: Italian guardrails have red reflectors on their faces.

it-flared-guardrail-end.title: Flared Guardrail Ends
it-flared-guardrail-end.description: Guardrails typically end by flattening, widening, and curving away from the road.

it-black-sign-back.title: Black Sign Backs
it-black-sign-back.description: The reverse side of road signs is often painted black or dark grey.

it-road-signs-01-blue-signs.title: Road Signs 01 Blue Signs
it-road-signs-01-blue-signs.description: Directional signs in Italy tend to be bright blue with a white capitalised text.

it-highway-sign-colour.title: Highway Sign Colours
it-highway-sign-colour.description: National roads have blue signs with white-and-blue borders; motorways have green signs with white-and-green borders.

it-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
it-kilometre-marker.description: White square stones show a Roman numeral on top (hundreds of metres) and an Arabic numeral below (kilometres from origin).

it-road-number-prefix.title: Road Number Prefixes
it-road-number-prefix.description: Route numbers start with SS (state), SR (regional), or SP (provincial).

it-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
it-chevron-sign.description: In Italy, curve warning boards show white arrows on a black background.

it-street-name-sign.title: Street Name Signs
it-street-name-sign.description: White plates with a narrow blue border and black lettering.

it-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Sign
it-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: A walking figure crosses five zebra stripes and has no visible belt.

it-passo-carrabile-no-parking-sign.title: 'Passo Carrabile' No-Parking Signs
it-passo-carrabile-no-parking-sign.description: No-parking signs labelled 'passo carrabile' are common in built-up areas.

it-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
it-phone-area-code.description: Area code leading digits increase broadly from west to east, then southward.

it-regional-flag-abruzzo.title: Abruzzo Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-abruzzo.description: The regional flag of Abruzzo is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-basilicata.title: Basilicata Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-basilicata.description: The regional flag of Basilicata is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-calabria.title: Calabria Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-calabria.description: The regional flag of Calabria is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-campania.title: Campania Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-campania.description: The regional flag of Campania is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-emilia-romagna.title: Emilia-Romagna Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-emilia-romagna.description: The regional flag of Emilia-Romagna is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-friuli-venezia-giulia.title: Friuli-Venezia Giulia Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-friuli-venezia-giulia.description: The regional flag of Friuli-Venezia Giulia is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-lazio.title: Lazio Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-lazio.description: The regional flag of Lazio is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-liguria.title: Liguria Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-liguria.description: The regional flag of Liguria is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-lombardy.title: Lombardy Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-lombardy.description: The regional flag of Lombardy is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-marche.title: Marche Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-marche.description: The regional flag of Marche is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-molise.title: Molise Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-molise.description: The regional flag of Molise is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-piedmont.title: Piedmont Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-piedmont.description: The regional flag of Piedmont is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-puglia.title: Puglia Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-puglia.description: The regional flag of Puglia is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-sardinia.title: Sardinia Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-sardinia.description: The regional flag of Sardinia is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-sicily.title: Sicily Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-sicily.description: The regional flag of Sicily is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-tuscany.title: Tuscany Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-tuscany.description: The regional flag of Tuscany is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-trentino-alto-adige.title: Trentino-Alto Adige Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-trentino-alto-adige.description: The regional flag of Trentino-Alto Adige is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-umbria.title: Umbria Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-umbria.description: The regional flag of Umbria is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-aosta-valley.title: Aosta Valley Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-aosta-valley.description: The regional flag of Aosta Valley is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-regional-flag-veneto.title: Veneto Regional Flag
it-regional-flag-veneto.description: The regional flag of Veneto is occasionally seen on public buildings and signs.

it-south-tyrol-german-bilingual-sign.title: South Tyrol German Bilingual Signs
it-south-tyrol-german-bilingual-sign.description: Road and street signs appear in both Italian and German in South Tyrol.

it-aosta-valley-french-sign.title: Aosta Valley French Signs
it-aosta-valley-french-sign.description: French text appears alongside Italian, with street names pairing 'via' and 'rue'.

it-po-valley-padan-plain.title: Po Valley
it-po-valley-padan-plain.description: A vast, flat agricultural basin in the north, often shrouded in haze.

it-bari-peninsula-olive-grove.title: Bari Peninsula Olive Groves
it-bari-peninsula-olive-grove.description: The southeastern heel has olive plantations, pale rock walls, and reddish earth.

it-alpine-mountain.title: Alpine Mountains
it-alpine-mountain.description: Broad, towering mountain ranges separated by deep valleys in the far north.

it-sicilian-landscape.title: Sicilian Landscape
it-sicilian-landscape.description: Dry, undulating farmland with craggy rock formations defines much of Sicily's interior.

it-sardinia-grey-rock-outcrop.title: Sardinia Grey Rock Outcrops
it-sardinia-grey-rock-outcrop.description: Grey boulders protrude from the ground, especially in northeast Sardinia.

it-southern-cactus.title: Southern Cacti
it-southern-cactus.description: Prickly-pear and other cacti grow abundantly in the far south: Sicily, southern Sardinia, and Apulia.

it-citrus-orchard.title: Citrus Orchards
it-citrus-orchard.description: Citrus cultivation is concentrated in eastern Sicily and southern Calabria.

it-rice-paddy.title: Rice Paddies
it-rice-paddy.description: Rice fields cluster in the western and central Po Valley, with some on Sardinia.

it-tuscan-brown-grey-brick-building.title: Tuscan Brown-Grey Brick Buildings
it-tuscan-brown-grey-brick-building.description: Rough-hewn, unpainted brown-grey stone is typical in and around Tuscany.

it-alpine-architecture.title: Alpine Architecture
it-alpine-architecture.description: Sturdy white-walled buildings with exposed timber detailing are typical of the Alpine north.

it-aosta-valley-grey-stone-building.title: Aosta Valley Grey Stone Buildings
it-aosta-valley-grey-stone-building.description: Irregular grey stone masonry with an Alpine character marks Aosta Valley buildings.

it-veneto-solid-wooden-shutter.title: Veneto Wooden Shutters
it-veneto-solid-wooden-shutter.description: Heavy wooden shutters on black iron hinges are common in Veneto.

it-apulian-flat-roofed-house.title: Apulian Flat-Roofed Houses
it-apulian-flat-roofed-house.description: Pale, flat-roofed two- or three-storey buildings give parts of Apulia a Middle-Eastern feel.

it-slovene-bilingual-sign.title: Slovene Bilingual Signs
it-slovene-bilingual-sign.description: Near Slovenia, road signs show both Italian and Slovene text.

it-vulcano-white-stripe.title: Vulcano White Stripe
it-vulcano-white-stripe.description: A near-white band of exposed earth traces the upper slopes of Vulcano volcano, visible from afar.

it-country-flag.title: Country Flag
it-country-flag.description: The national flag of Italy is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ja-island-region-prefecture.title: Islands, Regions and Prefectures
ja-island-region-prefecture.description: Japan is divided into four major islands, regions grouping prefectures, and 47 prefectures.

ja-japanese-writing-system.title: Japanese Writing Systems
ja-japanese-writing-system.description: Japanese uses kanji, hiragana with rounded strokes, and angular katakana scripts.

ja-katakana-script.title: Katakana Script
ja-katakana-script.description: Katakana, angular and geometric, is used for foreign words in signage and ads.

ja-useful-kanji-place-name.title: Useful Kanji for Place Names
ja-useful-kanji-place-name.description: Eight kanji recur in place names; compass and suffix kanji aid navigation.

ja-architecture.title: Architecture
ja-architecture.description: Japan’s buildings range from traditional rural houses to ultramodern urban high-rises.

ja-round-concrete-pole.title: Round Concrete Poles
ja-round-concrete-pole.description: Utility poles are round concrete with screw-like protrusions, often with electrical plates and reflectors.

ja-pole-reflector.title: Pole Reflectors
ja-pole-reflector.description: Pole reflectors are compact, elevated, with vertical or diagonal yellow and white stripes.

ja-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
ja-licence-plate.description: Vehicle plates are white with green characters; kei cars have yellow plates with black lettering.

ja-road-line.title: Road Lines
ja-road-line.description: Road markings combine solid white edges with dashed or solid white/yellow center lines; no yellow edge lines.

ja-bollard.title: Bollards
ja-bollard.description: Default bollards are plain white posts with round reflectors; some show kanji or extra attachments.

ja-white-guardrail.title: White Guardrails
ja-white-guardrail.description: Plain white guardrails are the standard road barriers.

ja-hexagonal-prefecture-road-shield.title: Hexagonal Prefecture Road Shields
ja-hexagonal-prefecture-road-shield.description: Prefectural routes use hexagonal shields with route numbers and kanji prefecture names.

ja-common-infrastructure.title: Common Infrastructure
ja-common-infrastructure.description: Distinctive triangular stop signs, school-zone crossings, and convex traffic mirrors are common.

ja-retaining-wall.title: Retaining Walls
ja-retaining-wall.description: Retaining walls in remote countryside indicate Japan.

ja-area-code.title: Area Codes
ja-area-code.description: Telephone area codes on signs increase southward.

ja-utility-pole-plate.title: Utility Pole Plates
ja-utility-pole-plate.description: Utility poles have region-specific identification plates.

ja-regional-pole-reflector-pad.title: Regional Pole Reflector Pads
ja-regional-pole-reflector-pad.description: Reflector pads on utility poles vary by region.

ja-road-diamond-large-filled.title: Road Diamonds, Large Filled
ja-road-diamond-large-filled.description: A large white diamond with a small central hole; wide and bold, common across Japan.

ja-road-diamond-narrow-filled.title: Road Diamonds, Narrow Filled
ja-road-diamond-narrow-filled.description: A filled diamond with narrow, elongated proportions.

ja-road-diamond-tall-thin.title: Road Diamonds, Tall Thin
ja-road-diamond-tall-thin.description: A tall, thin diamond outline with a small center hole.

ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-medium.title: Road Diamonds, Crossed Outline (Medium)
ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-medium.description: A medium diamond with overlapping sides creating a crossed-line pattern.

ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-nara-wak.title: Road Diamonds, Crossed Outline (Nara / Wakayama)
ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-nara-wak.description: A crossed-line diamond like the medium variant but taller.

ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-standard.title: Road Diamonds, Crossed Outline (Standard)
ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-standard.description: A crossed-line diamond used in central and southern prefectures.

ja-road-diamond-small-crossed-outline.title: Road Diamonds, Small Crossed Outline
ja-road-diamond-small-crossed-outline.description: A smaller crossed-line diamond with compact proportions.

ja-road-diamond-very-small.title: Road Diamonds, Very Small
ja-road-diamond-very-small.description: The smallest diamond variant, distinguished by its size.

ja-road-diamond-kagawa.title: Road Diamonds, Kagawa
ja-road-diamond-kagawa.description: A clean, tall outline diamond with thin lines, specific to Kagawa Prefecture.

ja-road-diamond-aomori-new-pattern.title: Road Diamonds, Aomori
ja-road-diamond-aomori-new-pattern.description: A newer crossed-line diamond pattern appearing in Aomori alongside the traditional filled style.

ja-road-diamond-thick-outline.title: Road Diamonds, Thick Outline
ja-road-diamond-thick-outline.description: A thick-stroked outline diamond with a prominent centre hole and bold, heavy lines.

ja-road-diamond-ishikawa-kumamoto.title: Road Diamonds, Ishikawa / Kumamoto
ja-road-diamond-ishikawa-kumamoto.description: A clean outline diamond with moderate line weight, used in Ishikawa and Kumamoto.

ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-yamanash.title: Road Diamonds, Yamanashi / Nagano
ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-yamanash.description: A crossed-line diamond used in Yamanashi and as a newer pattern in Nagano.

ja-road-diamond-nara-new-pattern.title: Road Diamonds, Nara
ja-road-diamond-nara-new-pattern.description: A newer, smaller crossed-line diamond appearing in Nara alongside the traditional style.

ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-ibaraki-.title: Road Diamonds, Ibaraki / Niigata
ja-road-diamond-crossed-outline-ibaraki-.description: A newer crossed-line diamond appearing in Ibaraki and Niigata alongside their traditional style.

ja-road-diamond-saga-new-pattern.title: Road Diamonds, Saga
ja-road-diamond-saga-new-pattern.description: A newer, small thick-outlined diamond appearing in Saga alongside the traditional very-small style.

ja-road-diamond-shizuoka.title: Road Diamonds, Shizuoka
ja-road-diamond-shizuoka.description: A clean outline diamond with thin, delicate lines, specific to Shizuoka Prefecture.

ja-road-diamond-thin-outline.title: Road Diamonds, Thin Outline
ja-road-diamond-thin-outline.description: A wide outline diamond with thick strokes but an open, airy feel. Used in several prefectures as a newer alternate pattern.

ja-prefecture-signpost-sticker.title: Prefecture Signpost Stickers
ja-prefecture-signpost-sticker.description: Signposts across Japan often display small stickers specific to individual prefectures.

ja-chugoku-guy-wire.title: Chugoku Guy Wires: Orange Bulge
ja-chugoku-guy-wire.description: Guy wires in the Chugoku region have an orange cover with a large bulge near the bottom.

ja-hokuriku-guy-wire.title: Hokuriku Guy Wires: Black-Yellow Bottle Stripes
ja-hokuriku-guy-wire.description: Guy wires in the Hokuriku area have a bottle-shaped cover with black and yellow stripes.

ja-kansai-guy-wire.title: Kansai Guy Wires: Yellow with Flat Top
ja-kansai-guy-wire.description: Guy wires in the Kansai (Kinki) region have a yellow cover with a flat lid at the top.

ja-chiba-guy-wire.title: Chiba Guy Wires: Wide Black-Yellow Stripes
ja-chiba-guy-wire.description: Guy wires in Chiba Prefecture have wide alternating black and yellow stripes.

ja-chugoku-orange-arrow-pole.title: Chugoku Orange Arrow on Poles
ja-chugoku-orange-arrow-pole.description: In Chugoku, an orange arrow is visible above the highest plate on utility poles.

ja-shikoku-orange-black-pole-band.title: Shikoku Orange-Black Pole Bands
ja-shikoku-orange-black-pole-band.description: Utility poles in Shikoku often have alternating orange and black bands wrapped around them.

ja-kansai-120-pole-attachment.title: Kansai 120° Pole Attachments
ja-kansai-120-pole-attachment.description: In Kansai, pole hardware with roughly 120-degree angular spread is common.

ja-shikoku-90-pole-attachment.title: Shikoku 90° Pole Attachments
ja-shikoku-90-pole-attachment.description: Compact right-angle brackets attached to utility poles appear regularly in Shikoku.

ja-hokkaido-transformer.title: Hokkaido Transformers
ja-hokkaido-transformer.description: In Hokkaido, a cross-shaped bracket or lone transformer sits on horizontal bars; multiple transformers are on opposing sides of a square frame.

ja-tohoku-transformer.title: Tohoku Transformers
ja-tohoku-transformer.description: Tohoku transformers have square mounting brackets and the Tohoku Electric Power logo, often on circular plates with zigzag or straight bars.

ja-kanto-transformer.title: Kanto Transformers
ja-kanto-transformer.description: Kanto transformers with two or three insulators sit on wooden backing boards with dual bars or circular plates with T-shaped bars.

ja-hokuriku-transformer.title: Hokuriku Transformers
ja-hokuriku-transformer.description: Hokuriku transformers are secured by slender metal bars and have compact, lantern-shaped insulators without other horizontal supports.

ja-chubu-transformer.title: Chubu Transformers
ja-chubu-transformer.description: Chubu transformers have yellow numerals, black tap connectors, and are supported by large triangular bars or narrow metal brackets.

ja-kansai-transformer.title: Kansai Transformers
ja-kansai-transformer.description: Kansai transformers sit on square frames with straight or zigzag bars along the bottom edge, sometimes attached to vertical supports.

ja-chugoku-transformer.title: Chugoku Transformers
ja-chugoku-transformer.description: Chugoku uses a cross-shaped arm with a triangular brace and elongated or compact insulators; transformers have white labels with red numerals.

ja-shikoku-transformer.title: Shikoku Transformers
ja-shikoku-transformer.description: Shikoku uses a cross-shaped arm with a half-triangle brace and cap-shaped insulators; transformers often have white labels with black numerals.

ja-kyushu-transformer.title: Kyushu Transformers
ja-kyushu-transformer.description: In Kyushu, a horizontal bar ends with three insulators; transformers face opposite directions, 180 degrees apart.

ja-okinawa-transformer.title: Okinawa Transformers
ja-okinawa-transformer.description: Okinawa poles have a T-shaped arm with transformers on directly opposing faces.

ja-grey-insulator-block.title: Grey Insulator Blocks
ja-grey-insulator-block.description: Grey, insulator-like wire-routing blocks appear in Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, and Shikoku.

ja-chubu-pole-top.title: Chubu Pole Top
ja-chubu-pole-top.description: A pole cap of four heavy bars crowned by a circular element is characteristic of Chubu.

ja-hokuriku-pole-top.title: Hokuriku Pole Top
ja-hokuriku-pole-top.description: A tent-shaped pole cap with two filled sides is typical of Hokuriku.

ja-chugoku-pole-top.title: Chugoku Pole Top
ja-chugoku-pole-top.description: Four slender, narrow bars at the top of the pole are a hallmark of Chugoku.

ja-kanto-tuning-fork-pole-top.title: Kanto Tuning Fork Pole Top
ja-kanto-tuning-fork-pole-top.description: A fork-shaped pole cap with an upper bar protruding beyond each side and horizontal crossbars beneath, common in Kanto.

ja-chubu-tuning-fork-pole-top.title: Chubu Tuning Fork Pole Top
ja-chubu-tuning-fork-pole-top.description: A fork-shaped pole cap with a compact upper bar and single horizontal crossbar below, frequent in Chubu.

ja-kansai-tuning-fork-pole-top.title: Kansai Tuning Fork Pole Top
ja-kansai-tuning-fork-pole-top.description: A fork-shaped pole cap with a thin wire upper bar and horizontal crossbar underneath, prevalent in Kansai.

ja-snow-shoulder-arrow.title: Snow Shoulder Arrows
ja-snow-shoulder-arrow.description: Road-edge marker arrows guide drivers along snowy shoulders, appearing almost exclusively in Hokkaido.

ja-kyushu-flat-bollard.title: Kyushu Flat Bollards
ja-kyushu-flat-bollard.description: Flat white bollards with a row of orange reflectors on one face, plain white on the reverse, characteristic of Kyushu and Yamaguchi.

ja-shikoku-black-stripe-bollard.title: Shikoku Black-Stripe Bollards
ja-shikoku-black-stripe-bollard.description: Bollards on Shikoku with a dark horizontal band beneath the reflector, freestanding or mounted.

ja-tohoku-thick-bollard.title: Tohoku Thick Bollards
ja-tohoku-thick-bollard.description: Wide white posts with octagonal reflector and single yellow band below, common in Tohoku.

ja-akita-prefecture-bollard.title: Akita Prefecture Bollard
ja-akita-prefecture-bollard.description: Similar to Tohoku bollards but with two yellow bands beneath the octagonal reflector.

ja-toyama-prefecture-bollard.title: Toyama Prefecture Bollard
ja-toyama-prefecture-bollard.description: Extendable bollard with one reflector and red band below, specific to Toyama.

ja-okayama-prefecture-bollard.title: Okayama Prefecture Bollard
ja-okayama-prefecture-bollard.description: Bollard with eight-sided reflector, red band below, and tapered slope, found only in Okayama.

ja-aomori-prefecture-bollard.title: Aomori Prefecture Bollard
ja-aomori-prefecture-bollard.description: Extendable post with single round reflector flanked by two yellow bands, found in Aomori.

ja-tohoku-striped-bollard.title: Tohoku Striped Bollards
ja-tohoku-striped-bollard.description: Painted striped sleeves over bollards, tapering upward and lacking reflectors, common in Tohoku.

ja-chugoku-snow-pole.title: Chugoku Snow Poles
ja-chugoku-snow-pole.description: Simple snow marker poles with slim tips, concentrated in northern Chugoku.

ja-green-guardrail-band-kyushu.title: Green Guardrail Bands
ja-green-guardrail-band-kyushu.description: Guardrails with green banding throughout Kyushu, especially Oita and Miyazaki.

ja-yamaguchi-yellow-guardrail.title: Yamaguchi Yellow Guardrails
ja-yamaguchi-yellow-guardrail.description: Bright yellow guardrails exclusive to Yamaguchi Prefecture.

ja-hokkaido-chevron-guardrail-sticker.title: Hokkaido Chevron Guardrail Stickers
ja-hokkaido-chevron-guardrail-sticker.description: Arrow-patterned chevron stickers on guardrail tips and posts, common in Hokkaido.

ja-chugoku-red-yellow-guardrail-end.title: Chugoku Red-Yellow Guardrail Ends
ja-chugoku-red-yellow-guardrail-end.description: Red and yellow striped stickers on guardrail ends, widespread in Chugoku except Yamaguchi.

ja-vertical-traffic-light.title: Vertical Traffic Lights
ja-vertical-traffic-light.description: Traffic signals oriented vertically in Hokkaido and northwest coast; horizontal elsewhere.

ja-kagawa-black-sign.title: Kagawa Black Signs
ja-kagawa-black-sign.description: Dark boards with two yellow dots, exclusive to Kagawa, sometimes with arrows.

ja-kerosene-tank-claymore.title: Kerosene Tanks (Claymores)
ja-kerosene-tank-claymore.description: Fuel storage tanks nicknamed "Claymores," common northward and in Hokkaido.

ja-hot-water-propane-tank.title: Hot Water and Propane Tanks
ja-hot-water-propane-tank.description: Heating and cooking tanks common in northern and mountainous rural areas.

ja-snow-prevention-road-shosetsu.title: Snow Prevention Roads (Shosetsu)
ja-snow-prevention-road-shosetsu.description: Roads with small nozzles spraying heated groundwater to prevent snow, mainly on northwest coast.

ja-ehime-cycling-route.title: Ehime Cycling Routes
ja-ehime-cycling-route.description: Bicycle lanes marked by white outside and blue inside stripes, mainly along Ehime's coast.

ja-red-tiled-roof.title: Red-Tiled Roofs
ja-red-tiled-roof.description: Houses with red roof tiles, common in Chugoku, especially Hiroshima and Shimane.

ja-northern-flat-sloped-roof.title: Northern Flat/Sloped Roofs
ja-northern-flat-sloped-roof.description: Northern roofs are flat or low-sloped with exterior ladders for snow removal.

ja-okinawa-concrete-building.title: Okinawa Concrete Buildings
ja-okinawa-concrete-building.description: Flat-roofed white concrete buildings define Okinawa architecture.

ja-cabbage-hokkaido.title: Cabbage (Hokkaido)
ja-cabbage-hokkaido.description: Cabbage grows prolifically in Hokkaido and northern Honshu, often beside roads.

ja-green-tea-plant.title: Green Tea Plants
ja-green-tea-plant.description: Neatly trimmed tea bushes with pole fans, mainly from Shizuoka and Kagoshima.

ja-rice-paddy.title: Rice Paddies
ja-rice-paddy.description: Rice fields north of Tokyo with green shoots or golden husks in flooded paddies.

ja-japanese-white-birch.title: Japanese White Birch
ja-japanese-white-birch.description: Tree species concentrated in Chubu and Hokkaido, less so in Tohoku.

ja-bamboo.title: Bamboo
ja-bamboo.description: Bamboo is more common in southern areas and less so northward.

ja-chinese-silver-grass-kyushu.title: Chinese Silver Grass
ja-chinese-silver-grass-kyushu.description: Kyushu grass thrives across Kyushu island in large quantities.

ja-sugarcane.title: Sugarcane
ja-sugarcane.description: Sugarcane grows almost entirely on Kyushu and Okinawa islands.

ja-hokkaido-winter-coverage.title: Hokkaido Winter Coverage
ja-hokkaido-winter-coverage.description: Snowy winter Street View is scarce on Hokkaido, mostly in the south.

ja-nobi-kanto-plain.title: Nobi and Kanto Plains
ja-nobi-kanto-plain.description: Nobi and Kanto plains are flat expanses in mountainous Japan.

ja-okinawa-shisa-lion-house-plaque.title: Okinawa Shisa Lions
ja-okinawa-shisa-lion-house-plaque.description: Okinawa has Shisa guardian lions and house plaques with local lettering.

ja-trekker-tripod.title: Trekkers and Tripods
ja-trekker-tripod.description: Many trekker and tripod camera setups create non-standard coverage.

ja-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ja-country-flag.description: The national flag of Japan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

jp-island-region-prefecture.title: Islands, Regions and Prefectures
jp-island-region-prefecture.description: Japan is divided into four major islands, regions grouping prefectures, and 47 prefectures.

jp-road-01-driving-direction.title: Driving direction
jp-road-01-driving-direction.description: In Japan they drive on the left side of the road.

jp-japanese-writing-system.title: Japanese Writing Systems
jp-japanese-writing-system.description: Japanese uses kanji, hiragana with rounded strokes, and angular katakana scripts.

jp-architecture.title: Architecture
jp-architecture.description: Building styles range from traditional rural houses to ultramodern urban high-rises.

jp-round-concrete-pole.title: Round Concrete Poles
jp-round-concrete-pole.description: Utility poles are round concrete with threaded screw-like protrusions and often electrical plates.

jp-road-line.title: Road Lines
jp-road-line.description: Japanese road markings include solid white edges with dashed or solid white/yellow center lines.

jp-white-guardrail.title: White Guardrails
jp-white-guardrail.description: Plain white guardrails are the default road barrier throughout Japan.

jp-hexagonal-prefecture-road-shield.title: Hexagonal Prefecture Road Shields
jp-hexagonal-prefecture-road-shield.description: Prefectural routes use hexagonal shields with route numbers and often kanji prefecture names.

jp-common-infrastructure.title: Common Infrastructure
jp-common-infrastructure.description: Triangular stop signs, school-zone crossings, and convex traffic mirrors are widespread.

jp-retaining-wall.title: Retaining Walls
jp-retaining-wall.description: Retaining walls in remote countryside indicate you are in Japan.

jp-area-code.title: Area Codes
jp-area-code.description: Telephone area codes appear on signage and increase in value moving southward.

jp-regional-pole-reflector-pad.title: Regional Pole Reflector Pads
jp-regional-pole-reflector-pad.description: Reflector pads on utility poles vary in design by region.

jp-road-diamond-large-filled.title: Road Diamonds
jp-road-diamond-large-filled.description: A standard white hollow diamond with a continuous outline. This generic variant can be found throughout Japan.

jp-road-diamond-narrow-filled.title: Regional Road Diamonds
jp-road-diamond-narrow-filled.description: This diamond variant has gaps in the upper-right and bottom-left corners of the outline and can be found in Hyōgo, Kyoto, Okayama and Miyagi prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-tall-thin.title: Regional Road Diamonds
