jp-road-diamond-tall-thin.description: This diamond variant has two offset gaps along the upper-left and lower-right sides of the outline. It can be found in Mie and Kōchi prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-medium.title: Regional Road Diamonds
jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-medium.description: This diamond variant has four gaps around the outline, creating four separate sections, and can be found in Gunma, Chiba and Gifu prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-nara-wak.title: Road Diamonds (Nara / Wakayama)
jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-nara-wak.description: This diamond variant has four gaps in the outline, dividing it into four separate sections. It can be found in Nara and Wakayama prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-standard.title: Regional Road Diamonds
jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-standard.description: This diamond variant has four gaps around the corners of the outline, creating four separate sections. It can be found in Shiga, Ibaraki, Saitama, Tochigi, Niigata and Okinawa prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-small-crossed-outline.title: Regional Road Diamonds
jp-road-diamond-small-crossed-outline.description: This diamond variant has four gaps in the outline, with breaks along both the upper-right and lower-left sides. It can be found in Ōita and Toyama prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-very-small.title: Regional Road Diamonds
jp-road-diamond-very-small.description: This diamond variant has gaps at the middle of both the left and right sides of the outline. It can be found in Tottori, Shimane and Saga prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-thick-outline.title: Small Road Diamond
jp-road-diamond-thick-outline.description: A smaller version of the diamond with gaps at the upper-right and lower-left corners. It can be found in Hiroshima and Tokushima prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-ishikawa-kumamoto.title: Road Diamonds, Ishikawa / Kumamoto
jp-road-diamond-ishikawa-kumamoto.description: This diamond variant has gaps at the top and bottom, with the upper gap offset to the left and the lower gap offset to the right. It can be found in Kumamoto and Ishikawa prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-yamanash.title: Road Diamonds, Yamanashi / Nagano
jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-yamanash.description: This diamond variant has two gaps along the left side of the outline, creating three distinct sections. It can be found in Yamanashi and Nagano prefectures.

jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-ibaraki-.title: Road Diamonds, Ibaraki / Niigata
jp-road-diamond-crossed-outline-ibaraki-.description: A newer crossed-line diamond in Ibaraki and Niigata alongside the traditional style.

jp-road-diamond-thin-outline.title: Thin Road Diamond
jp-road-diamond-thin-outline.description: A thinner version of the standard continuous diamond. This variant can be found in Kagoshima, Aichi, Yamaguchi and Nagano prefectures.

jp-prefecture-signpost-sticker.title: Prefecture Signpost Stickers
jp-prefecture-signpost-sticker.description: Signposts across Japan display small stickers specific to individual prefectures.

jp-chugoku-orange-arrow-pole.title: Chugoku Orange Arrow on Poles
jp-chugoku-orange-arrow-pole.description: In Chugoku, an orange arrow appears above the highest plate on utility poles.

jp-shikoku-orange-black-pole-band.title: Shikoku Orange-Black Pole Bands
jp-shikoku-orange-black-pole-band.description: Utility poles in Shikoku often have alternating orange and black bands.

jp-kansai-120-pole-attachment.title: Kansai 120° Pole Attachments
jp-kansai-120-pole-attachment.description: In Kansai, pole hardware has a roughly 120-degree angular spread.

jp-shikoku-90-pole-attachment.title: Shikoku 90° Pole Attachments
jp-shikoku-90-pole-attachment.description: Compact right-angle brackets appear regularly on Shikoku utility poles.

jp-hokkaido-transformer.title: Hokkaido Transformers
jp-hokkaido-transformer.description: Hokkaido transformers mount on cross-shaped brackets or horizontal bars, often opposite sides of a square frame.

jp-tohoku-transformer.title: Tohoku Transformers
jp-tohoku-transformer.description: Tohoku transformers have square mounting brackets, the Tohoku Electric Power logo, and various support bar styles.

jp-kanto-transformer.title: Kanto Transformers
jp-kanto-transformer.description: Kanto transformers sit on wooden backing boards with dual bars or circular plates with T-shaped bars.

jp-hokuriku-transformer.title: Hokuriku Transformers
jp-hokuriku-transformer.description: Hokuriku transformers have slender metal bars and compact, lantern-shaped insulators without other horizontal supports.

jp-chubu-transformer.title: Chubu Transformers
jp-chubu-transformer.description: Chubu transformers feature yellow numerals, black tap connectors, and large triangular or narrow metal supports.

jp-kansai-transformer.title: Kansai Transformers
jp-kansai-transformer.description: Kansai transformers sit on square frames with straight or zigzag bars, sometimes attached to vertical supports.

jp-chugoku-transformer.title: Chugoku Transformers
jp-chugoku-transformer.description: Chugoku transformers use a cross-shaped arm with a triangular brace and carry white labels with red numerals.

jp-shikoku-transformer.title: Shikoku Transformers
jp-shikoku-transformer.description: Shikoku transformers have a cross-shaped arm with a half-triangle brace and cap-shaped insulators with white labels.

jp-kyushu-transformer.title: Kyushu Transformers
jp-kyushu-transformer.description: Kyushu transformers mount on a horizontal bar ending with three insulators, facing opposite directions.

jp-okinawa-transformer.title: Okinawa Transformers
jp-okinawa-transformer.description: Okinawa poles have a T-shaped arm with transformers on opposite faces.

jp-grey-insulator-block.title: Grey Insulator Blocks
jp-grey-insulator-block.description: Grey wire-routing blocks appear in Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, and Shikoku, rarely in Hokkaido.

jp-chubu-pole-top.title: Chubu Pole Top
jp-chubu-pole-top.description: A pole cap with four heavy bars crowned by a circular element is typical of Chubu.

jp-hokuriku-pole-top.title: Hokuriku Pole Top
jp-hokuriku-pole-top.description: A tent-shaped pole cap with two filled sides is typical of Hokuriku.

jp-chugoku-pole-top.title: Chugoku Pole Top
jp-chugoku-pole-top.description: Four slender, narrow bars atop the pole are a hallmark of Chugoku.

jp-kanto-tuning-fork-pole-top.title: Kanto Tuning Fork Pole Top
jp-kanto-tuning-fork-pole-top.description: A fork-shaped pole cap with a protruding upper bar and horizontal crossbars appears mainly in Kanto.

jp-chubu-tuning-fork-pole-top.title: Chubu Tuning Fork Pole Top
jp-chubu-tuning-fork-pole-top.description: A fork-shaped pole cap with a compact upper bar and single horizontal crossbar is common in Chubu.

jp-kansai-tuning-fork-pole-top.title: Kansai Tuning Fork Pole Top
jp-kansai-tuning-fork-pole-top.description: A fork-shaped pole cap with a thin wire upper bar and horizontal crossbar is prevalent in Kansai.

j-general-01-02-overhead-arrows.title: General 01 02 Overhead Arrows
j-general-01-02-overhead-arrows.description: This arrow above the road marks the road during heavy snow and is mainly seen in Hokkaido.

jp-kyushu-flat-bollard.title: Kyushu Flat Bollards
jp-kyushu-flat-bollard.description: Flat, white bollards with a row of orange reflectors on one face are characteristic of Kyushu and Yamaguchi.

jp-shikoku-black-stripe-bollard.title: Shikoku Black-Stripe Bollards
jp-shikoku-black-stripe-bollard.description: On Shikoku, bollards have a dark horizontal band beneath the reflector and appear freestanding or mounted.

jp-tohoku-thick-bollard.title: Tohoku Thick Bollards
jp-tohoku-thick-bollard.description: Tohoku's bollards are wide white posts with an octagonal reflector and a yellow band below it; black versions appear on highways.

jp-tohoku-striped-bollard.title: Tohoku Striped Bollards
jp-tohoku-striped-bollard.description: Striped sleeves tapering to a narrower top and lacking reflectors are common over bollards in Tohoku, especially Akita.

jp-chugoku-snow-pole.title: Chugoku Snow Poles
jp-chugoku-snow-pole.description: Simple snow marker poles with slim tips are concentrated in northern Chugoku and sporadically in Iwate.

jp-green-guardrail-band-kyushu.title: Green Guardrail Bands
jp-green-guardrail-band-kyushu.description: Guardrails with green bands appear throughout Kyushu, especially in Oita and Miyazaki.

xx-road-01-01-yellow-guardrails.title: Road 01 01 Yellow Guardrails
xx-road-01-01-yellow-guardrails.description: Yamaguchi Prefecture in Japan is recognized for its distinctive bright yellow roadside guardrails.

jp-hokkaido-chevron-guardrail-sticker.title: Hokkaido Chevron Guardrail Stickers
jp-hokkaido-chevron-guardrail-sticker.description: Arrow-patterned chevron stickers appear on guardrail tips and fence posts in Hokkaido.

jp-chugoku-red-yellow-guardrail-end.title: Chugoku Red-Yellow Guardrail Ends
jp-chugoku-red-yellow-guardrail-end.description: Red and yellow striped stickers on guardrail ends are widespread in Chugoku, excluding Yamaguchi.

jp-vertical-traffic-light.title: Vertical Traffic Lights
jp-vertical-traffic-light.description: Traffic signals are vertical in Hokkaido and the northwestern coast; elsewhere they are horizontal.

jp-kagawa-black-sign.title: Kagawa Black Signs
jp-kagawa-black-sign.description: Road side reflectors with dark boards and two yellow dots are exclusive to Kagawa.

jp-kerosene-tank-claymore.title: Kerosene Tanks
jp-kerosene-tank-claymore.description: Fuel storage tanks nicknamed "Claymores" are common northward, especially in Hokkaido and mountainous areas.

jp-hot-water-propane-tank.title: Hot Water and Propane Tanks
jp-hot-water-propane-tank.description: Tanks for heating and cooking appear more often in northern and mountainous prefectures, common in rural areas.

jp-snow-prevention-road-shosetsu.title: Snow Prevention Roads
jp-snow-prevention-road-shosetsu.description: Rows of small nozzles spray heated groundwater to prevent snow buildup, mainly along the northwestern coast.

jp-ehime-cycling-route.title: Ehime Cycling Routes
jp-ehime-cycling-route.description: Bicycle lanes in Ehime have a white outer stripe and blue inner stripe, mostly along coastal roads.

jp-red-tiled-roof.title: Red-Tiled Roofs
jp-red-tiled-roof.description: Houses with red roof tiles are common in Chugoku, especially Hiroshima and Shimane.

jp-northern-flat-sloped-roof.title: Northern Flat/Sloped Roofs
jp-northern-flat-sloped-roof.description: Northern roofs shift to flat or low-angle slopes with exterior ladders for snow removal.

jp-okinawa-concrete-building.title: Okinawa Concrete Buildings
jp-okinawa-concrete-building.description: Flat-roofed white concrete buildings define Okinawa architecture.

jp-cabbage-hokkaido.title: Cabbage
jp-cabbage-hokkaido.description: Cabbage grows prolifically in Hokkaido and parts of northern Honshu, often visible beside roads.

jp-green-tea-plant.title: Green Tea Plants
jp-green-tea-plant.description: Tea bushes grow in trimmed hedgerows with pole-mounted fans, mainly in Shizuoka and Kagoshima.

jp-rice-paddy.title: Rice Paddies
jp-rice-paddy.description: Rice fields north of Tokyo show green shoots in season and golden husks at harvest, often flooded.

jp-japanese-white-birch.title: Japanese White Birch
jp-japanese-white-birch.description: This tree species is concentrated in Chubu and Hokkaido, with some presence in Tohoku.

jp-bamboo.title: Bamboo
jp-bamboo.description: Bamboo is more common in southern Japan and less so heading north.

jp-chinese-silver-grass-kyushu.title: Chinese Silver Grass
jp-chinese-silver-grass-kyushu.description: Known as Kyushu grass, it thrives across Kyushu in large quantities.

jp-sugarcane.title: Sugarcane
jp-sugarcane.description: Sugarcane grows almost exclusively in southern Kyushu and Okinawa.

jp-hokkaido-winter-coverage.title: Hokkaido Winter Coverage
jp-hokkaido-winter-coverage.description: Snowy winter Google Street View is scarce in Hokkaido, mostly in the southern part.

jp-nobi-kanto-plain.title: Nobi and Kanto Plains
jp-nobi-kanto-plain.description: The Nobi and Kanto plains are conspicuously flat expanses in mountainous Japan.

jp-okinawa-shisa-lion-house-plaque.title: Okinawa Shisa Lions
jp-okinawa-shisa-lion-house-plaque.description: Okinawa features Shisa guardian lion statues and house plaques with local lettering.

jp-trekker-tripod.title: Trekkers and Tripods
jp-trekker-tripod.description: Trekker and tripod camera setups appear across many prefectures, creating non-standard coverage.

jp-country-flag.title: Country Flag
jp-country-flag.description: The national flag of Japan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

jp-misc-01-vending-machines.title: Vending machines
jp-misc-01-vending-machines.description: Japan has millions of vending machines, making them a common sight here.

je-architecture.title: Architecture
je-architecture.description: Buildings mix northern-French and British styles with pastel walls and slate roofs.

je-red-granite.title: Red Granite
je-red-granite.description: Local red granite is used widely, giving buildings a warm reddish tone.

je-cornish-palm.title: Cornish Palms
je-cornish-palm.description: Cordyline australis palms are common ornamental garden plants.

je-yellow-give-way-line.title: Yellow Give-Way Lines
je-yellow-give-way-line.description: Junctions use yellow give-way lines instead of white.

je-cycling-route-sign.title: Cycling Route Signs
je-cycling-route-sign.description: Cycle network marked with 'Green Lane' markers and blue route plates with maps.

je-asymmetric-sign-attachment.title: Asymmetric Sign Attachments
je-asymmetric-sign-attachment.description: Many road signs are off-centre on their posts.

je-parish-coat-arms-street-sign.title: Parish Coat of Arms on Street Signs
je-parish-coat-arms-street-sign.description: Street signs display the parish's heraldic emblem.

je-st-helier-capital.title: St Helier Capital
je-st-helier-capital.description: The capital has taller buildings, tighter streets, and a livelier urban feel.

je-country-flag.title: Country Flag
je-country-flag.description: The national flag of Jersey is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-03-black-google-car.title: General 01 03 Black Google Car
xx-general-01-03-black-google-car.description: In Jordan, the Street View coverage was captured by a black Google car.

jo-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
jo-licence-plate.description: Jordan has white plates in long and short formats; commercial vehicles have green left band.

jo-road-marking.title: Road Markings
jo-road-marking.description: Yellow edge lines paired with a white centre line.

jo-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
jo-utility-pole.description: Three common types: concrete with diagonal brace, concrete with Y-shaped crossarms, and two-legged metal towers with coils.

jo-arid-landscape.title: Arid Landscape
jo-arid-landscape.description: Dominated by barren desert with sparse Mediterranean greenery.

jo-sandstone-architecture.title: Sandstone Architecture
jo-sandstone-architecture.description: Flat-roofed buildings clad in pale sandstone blocks.

jo-poor-road-quality.title: Poor Road Quality
jo-poor-road-quality.description: Many roads have heat-buckled asphalt with warps and cracks.

jo-coverage-area.title: Coverage Area
jo-coverage-area.description: Street View covers only the far western strip on major towns and roads.

jo-amman.title: Amman
jo-amman.description: Jordan's capital, a hilly city of mid-rise apartments with an urban feel.

jo-dead-sea-highway-65-north.title: Dead Sea
jo-dead-sea-highway-65-north.description: The Dead Sea is visible directly to the west along the northern section of Highway 65.

jo-highway-65-south.title: Highway 65
jo-highway-65-south.description: A single-lane north–south highway with extended sandy stretches south of Feifa valley.

jo-madaba-red-soil-field.title: Madaba Red Soil Fields
jo-madaba-red-soil-field.description: Flat farmland around Madaba stands out for its deep red earth.

jo-aqaba-mountain.title: Aqaba Mountains
jo-aqaba-mountain.description: A chain of ragged, jagged peaks along the eastern and southern edges of Aqaba.

jo-petra-trekker-coverage.title: Petra Trekker Coverage
jo-petra-trekker-coverage.description: Trekker imagery covers Petra’s rock-hewn city, reddish gorges, cliffs, and tourist clusters.

jo-country-flag.title: Country Flag
jo-country-flag.description: The national flag of Jordan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

kz-kazakh-language-alphabet.title: Kazakh Language and Alphabet
kz-kazakh-language-alphabet.description: Kazakhstan uses Cyrillic and Latin scripts; Kazakh has unique Cyrillic letters.

kz-diverse-mostly-flat-landscape.title: Mostly Flat Landscape
kz-diverse-mostly-flat-landscape.description: Kazakhstan features varied terrain but mostly vast, open, flat rural scenery.

kz-russian-style-infrastructure.title: Russian-Style Infrastructure
kz-russian-style-infrastructure.description: Kazakhstan's built environment closely mirrors Russia's.

kz-blue-street-sign-building.title: Blue Street Signs on Buildings
kz-blue-street-sign-building.description: Kazakh street signs are blue with white patterns, mounted on building facades, often bilingual or trilingual.

kz-unique-90-degree-bollard.title: Unique 90-Degree Angle Bollards
kz-unique-90-degree-bollard.description: Distinctive bollards of two thin posts joined at a 90-degree angle.

xx-general-01-46-tree-trunks.title: General 01 46 Tree Trunks
xx-general-01-46-tree-trunks.description: The bottom of tree trunks in Kazakhstan are often painted white.

kz-yellow-black-chevron-sign.title: Yellow and Black Chevron Signs
kz-yellow-black-chevron-sign.description: Kazakh road chevrons are predominantly yellow and black; T-intersections use red and white.

kz-urban-gas-pipe.title: Urban Gas Pipes
kz-urban-gas-pipe.description: Above-ground gas pipes are common throughout Kazakh cities.

kz-koshkar-muiz-ornamental-pattern.title: Koshkar-Muiz Ornamental Pattern
kz-koshkar-muiz-ornamental-pattern.description: The ram's-horn motif koshkar-muiz appears as decoration across Kazakhstan.

kz-ornate-city-entrance-arch.title: Ornate City Entrance Arches
kz-ornate-city-entrance-arch.description: Many Kazakh cities feature decorative and ornate entrance arches.

kz-limited-street-view-coverage.title: Limited Street View Coverage
kz-limited-street-view-coverage.description: Coverage is sparse; major roads and cities are covered, rural roads often lack imagery.

kz-seasonal-coverage-region.title: Seasonal Coverage Regions
kz-seasonal-coverage-region.description: Imagery shows summer in west/central, autumn in northeast, and winter in southeast Kazakhstan.

kz-driving-direction-map.title: Driving Direction Map
kz-driving-direction-map.description: Knowing travel direction on rural roads helps narrow down locations.

kz-16-atyrau-region.title: Atyrau Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-atyrau-region.description: Atyrau Region area codes start with '7122', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-16-west-kazakhstan-region.title: West Kazakhstan Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-west-kazakhstan-region.description: West Kazakhstan Region area codes start with '7112', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-16-mangystau-region.title: Mangystau Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-mangystau-region.description: Mangystau Region area codes start with '7292', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-16-karaganda-region.title: Karaganda Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-karaganda-region.description: Karaganda Region area codes start with '7212', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-16-kostanay-region.title: Kostanay Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-kostanay-region.description: Kostanay Region area codes start with '7142', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-16-akmola-region.title: Akmola Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-akmola-region.description: Akmola Region area codes start with '7162', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-16-pavlodar-region.title: Pavlodar Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-pavlodar-region.description: Pavlodar Region area codes start with '7182', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-16-eastern.title: East Kazakhstan Telephone Area Codes
kz-16-eastern.description: East Kazakhstan Region area codes start with '7232', shown in bold near phone icons on signs.

kz-17-akmola-region.title: Akmola Licence Plate Code
kz-17-akmola-region.description: Licence plates start with '03' for Akmola Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-aktobe-region.title: Aktobe Licence Plate Code
kz-17-aktobe-region.description: Licence plates start with '04' for Aktobe Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-almaty-region.title: Almaty Licence Plate Code
kz-17-almaty-region.description: Licence plates start with '05' for Almaty Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-atyrau-region.title: Atyrau Licence Plate Code
kz-17-atyrau-region.description: Licence plates start with '06' for Atyrau Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-east-kazakhstan-region.title: East Kazakhstan Licence Plate Code
kz-17-east-kazakhstan-region.description: Licence plates start with '16' for East Kazakhstan Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-jambyl-region.title: Jambyl Licence Plate Code
kz-17-jambyl-region.description: Licence plates have '08' in Jambyl Region, which can be seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-west-kazakhstan-region.title: West Kazakhstan Licence Plate Code
kz-17-west-kazakhstan-region.description: Licence plates start with '07' for West Kazakhstan Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-karaganda-region.title: Karaganda Licence Plate Code
kz-17-karaganda-region.description: Licence plates start with '09' for Karaganda Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-kostanay-region.title: Kostanay Licence Plate Code
kz-17-kostanay-region.description: Licence plates start with '10' for Kostanay Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-kyzylorda-region.title: Kyzylorda Licence Plate Code
kz-17-kyzylorda-region.description: Licence plates start with '11' for Kyzylorda Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-mangystau-region.title: Mangystau Licence Plate Code
kz-17-mangystau-region.description: Licence plates start with '12' for Mangystau Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-pavlodar-region.title: Pavlodar Licence Plate Code
kz-17-pavlodar-region.description: Licence plates start with '14' for Pavlodar Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-north-kazakhstan-region.title: North Kazakhstan Licence Plate Code
kz-17-north-kazakhstan-region.description: Licence plates start with '15' for North Kazakhstan Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-17-turkistan-region.title: Turkistan Licence Plate Code
kz-17-turkistan-region.description: Licence plates start with '13' for Turkistan Region, seen on rear of trucks and buses.

kz-qr-code-region-text-street-sign.title: QR Code Region Text on Street Signs
kz-qr-code-region-text-street-sign.description: Some blue street signs have region text beneath the QR code.

kz-northern-birch-forest.title: Northern Birch Forests
kz-northern-birch-forest.description: Dense birch forests alongside green fields are typical of northern Kazakhstan.

kz-northwestern-green-steppe.title: Northwestern Green Steppe
kz-northwestern-green-steppe.description: Wide grassy plains are typical of northwestern Kazakhstan, especially Akmola and Kostanay.

kz-southwestern-sandy-desert.title: Southwestern Sandy Desert
kz-southwestern-sandy-desert.description: Sandy terrain with sparse shrubs is typical of southwestern Kazakhstan.

kz-southeastern-snow-capped-mountain.title: Southeastern Snow-Capped Mountains
kz-southeastern-snow-capped-mountain.description: Tall snow-capped mountains appear in southeastern Kazakhstan.

kz-snow-coverage-southeast-almaty.title: Snow Coverage Southeast of Almaty
kz-snow-coverage-southeast-almaty.description: Snowy roads appear southeast, especially east of Almaty.

kz-green-rolling-hill-north-bishkek.title: Green Rolling Hills North of Bishkek
kz-green-rolling-hill-north-bishkek.description: Lush green rolling hills occur just north of Bishkek in southern Kazakhstan.

kz-39-west-kazakhstan-region.title: West Kazakhstan Pole Paint
kz-39-west-kazakhstan-region.description: Utility poles have three bold horizontal bands: red top, white middle, black bottom, all equal width.

kz-39-atyrau-region.title: Atyrau Pole Paint
kz-39-atyrau-region.description: Poles feature three horizontal bands: blue top, white middle, black bottom, with vivid colors.

kz-39-akmola-region.title: Akmola Pole Paint
kz-39-akmola-region.description: Poles show a thin red stripe top, broad white middle, thin black bottom; white section is widest.

kz-39-kostanay-region.title: Kostanay Pole Paint
kz-39-kostanay-region.description: Poles have narrow alternating thin turquoise and yellow horizontal stripes.

kz-39-north-kazakhstan-region.title: Petropavl Pole Paint
kz-39-north-kazakhstan-region.description: Utility poles have thin horizontal bands of white and light grey.

kz-39-jambyl-region.title: Taraz Pole Paint
kz-39-jambyl-region.description: Poles have three bold horizontal bands: red top, yellow middle, black bottom, similar width.

kz-39-kyzylorda-region.title: Kyzylorda Pole and Lamp Post Paint
kz-39-kyzylorda-region.description: Poles show thin yellow and red stripes top, broad white below; lamp posts are white with turquoise base.

kz-baltic-pine-forest.title: Baltic Pine Forests
kz-baltic-pine-forest.description: Thick Baltic pine forests appear north of Shchuchinsk.

kz-country-flag.title: Country Flag
kz-country-flag.description: The national flag of Kazakhstan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ke-road-line.title: Road Lines
ke-road-line.description: Kenyan roads have solid white edge lines and yellow centre lines, solid or dashed.

ke-green-directional-sign.title: Green Directional Signs
ke-green-directional-sign.description: Kenyan directional signs have green backgrounds with white borders and lettering; route numbers are white or yellow.

ke-red-white-road-sign.title: Red-and-White Road Signs
ke-red-white-road-sign.description: Road signs in Kenya are mostly red and white.

ke-county-name-signage.title: County Names on Signage
ke-county-name-signage.description: Signs often display Kenyan county names, useful for regional identification.

ke-repurposed-van.title: Repurposed Vans
ke-repurposed-van.description: Colourfully wrapped repurposed vans are common throughout Kenya.

ke-eucalyptus-tree.title: Eucalyptus Trees
ke-eucalyptus-tree.description: Eucalyptus trees with long clustered leaves and smooth bark grow widely in Kenya.

ke-topography.title: Topography
ke-topography.description: Eastern and northern Kenya is very flat; elevation rises steadily toward the southwest.

ke-regional-climate.title: Regional Climates
ke-regional-climate.description: Kenya spans humid to very arid climate zones; use climate as a regional clue.

ke-white-tape-roof.title: White Tape on Roof
ke-white-tape-roof.description: White tape strips appear on car roofs north and south of Nairobi.

ke-mombasa-coast.title: Mombasa Coast
ke-mombasa-coast.description: Mombasa coast features white sandy soil, palm trees, and a coastal atmosphere.

ke-far-west-kisumu.title: Far West (Kisumu Area)
ke-far-west-kisumu.description: Northwest and southwest of Kisumu are agricultural with farms, grassy hills, and tall eucalyptus.

ke-kitui-semi-arid.title: Kitui (Semi-Arid)
ke-kitui-semi-arid.description: Kitui area is semi-arid, hilly or mountainous, with light orange sandy soil.

ke-b9-northeast.title: B9 Northeast
ke-b9-northeast.description: The B9 northeast is unpaved with bright reddish-orange dirt and dense tree cover.

ke-mount-kilimanjaro.title: Mount Kilimanjaro
ke-mount-kilimanjaro.description: Kilimanjaro's broad silhouette is visible south from much coverage north of the mountain.

ke-mara-triangle.title: Mara Triangle
ke-mara-triangle.description: Flat to gently hilly savannah with no major mountains, covered by a white car.

ke-aberdare-national-park.title: Aberdare National Park
ke-aberdare-national-park.description: Grey-and-brown car with snorkel and rubber bands on roof rack appears near Aberdare.

ke-mt-elgon-area.title: Mt Elgon Area
ke-mt-elgon-area.description: Between Kitale and Mt Elgon, same grey-and-brown car appears; redder soil and greener landscape.

ke-kerio-lodwar-area.title: Kerio–Lodwar Area
ke-kerio-lodwar-area.description: Between Kerio and Lodwar, same car appears in sandy, dry, sparsely vegetated landscape.

ke-b8-succulent.title: B8 Succulents
ke-b8-succulent.description: A stretch of the B8 north of Kibaoni is lined with many succulent plants.

ke-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ke-country-flag.description: The national flag of Kenya is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

kr-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
kr-licence-plate.description: South Korea's plates: pre-2006 short green; post-2006 white (private) or yellow (commercial), in long and short formats.

kr-autumn-winter-coverage.title: Autumn and Winter Coverage
kr-autumn-winter-coverage.description: Much South Korean imagery was captured in autumn or winter, showing bare trees and muted colours.

kr-spiked-pole-top.title: Spiked Pole Tops
kr-spiked-pole-top.description: Most South Korean utility poles taper to a pointed spike at the top.

kr-general-01-driving-direction.title: Driving direction
kr-general-01-driving-direction.description: In South Korea they drive on the right side of the road.

kr-road-line.title: Road Lines
kr-road-line.description: South Korean roads have yellow centre lines and white edge lines.

kr-red-block-marking.title: Red Block Markings
kr-red-block-marking.description: Red-painted block patterns occasionally appear on South Korean road surfaces.

kr-yellow-warning-sign.title: Yellow Warning Signs
kr-yellow-warning-sign.description: South Korean triangular warning signs have a yellow background.

kr-arrow-shaped-street-sign.title: Arrow-Shaped Street Signs
kr-arrow-shaped-street-sign.description: South Korean street name signs are blue and arrow-shaped, hung from utility poles.

kr-green-direction-sign.title: Green Direction Signs
kr-green-direction-sign.description: South Korean directional signs display white text on a green background.

kr-pedestrian-crossing.title: Pedestrian Crossings
kr-pedestrian-crossing.description: South Korean zebra crossings often use alternating yellow and white stripes.

kr-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pentagonal Pedestrian Crossing Signs
kr-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Crossing signs are pentagonal on a blue background, unique to South Korea.

kr-house-number.title: House Numbers
kr-house-number.description: South Korean buildings have blue house-shaped address plaques with Hangul and Latin script.

kr-wedge-shaped-bollard.title: Wedge-Shaped Bollards
kr-wedge-shaped-bollard.description: Black-and-white wedge-shaped bollards with round yellow and grey reflectors appear along some roads.

kr-mountainous-landscape.title: Mountainous Landscape
kr-mountainous-landscape.description: South Korea's terrain is mostly hilly or mountainous, with elevation visible on the horizon.

kr-red-brick-architecture.title: Red Brick Architecture
kr-red-brick-architecture.description: Red brick is a common building material throughout South Korea.

kr-traditional-tiled-roof.title: Traditional Tiled Roofs
kr-traditional-tiled-roof.description: Many South Korean buildings have traditional tiled roofs with upturned edges and decorative corners.

kr-area-code.title: Area Codes
kr-area-code.description: Phone area codes increase from north to south, 02 in Seoul up to 064 on Jeju Island.

kr-jeju-island-volcanic-soil.title: Jeju Island Volcanic Soil
kr-jeju-island-volcanic-soil.description: Jeju is a volcanic island with dark volcanic dirt and visible volcanic cones.

xx-general-01-19-rock-walls.title: General 01 19 Rock Walls
xx-general-01-19-rock-walls.description: Jeju Island in South Korea is known for its many rock walls made from dark volcanic stone.

kr-country-flag.title: Country Flag
kr-country-flag.description: The national flag of South Korea is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-license-plates-01-01-red-strip.title: License Plates 01 01 Red Strip
xx-license-plates-01-01-red-strip.description: Licence plates in Kyrgyzstan feature a red strip on the left side.

kg-kyrgyz-cyrillic-script.title: Kyrgyz Cyrillic Script
kg-kyrgyz-cyrillic-script.description: Kyrgyz uses Cyrillic with extra letters Ө, Ү, and Ң.

kg-white-painted-tree-pole.title: White-Painted Trees and Poles
kg-white-painted-tree-pole.description: Trees and concrete poles often have lower portions painted white.

kg-red-white-kilometre-marker.title: Red-and-White Kilometre Markers
kg-red-white-kilometre-marker.description: Kilometre markers have a red-and-white triangle pattern unique to Kyrgyzstan.

kg-driving-direction-map.title: Driving Direction Map
kg-driving-direction-map.description: Knowing which way the Google car drives on Kyrgyzstan's major roads helps narrow your position.

kg-southern-mirror-clue.title: Southern Mirror Clue
kg-southern-mirror-clue.description: The car's side mirror shows less road and a more diagonal reflection in southern Kyrgyzstan.

kg-black-dot-mirror.title: Black Dot on Mirror
kg-black-dot-mirror.description: A small black dot on the car mirror indicates a specific Kyrgyzstan region.

kg-divided-road.title: Divided Roads
kg-divided-road.description: Divided roads in Kyrgyzstan cluster around Bishkek, with a major highway east to Balykchy.

kg-snowy-northern-road.title: Snowy Northern Roads
kg-snowy-northern-road.description: Northern roads often have heavy snow coverage and bright skies.

kg-bishkek-capital-city.title: Bishkek, Capital City
kg-bishkek-capital-city.description: Bishkek features taller multi-storey buildings and upscale outskirts; mountains lie to the south.

kg-south-bishkek-tian-shan.title: South of Bishkek, Tian Shan Mountains
kg-south-bishkek-tian-shan.description: South of Bishkek is hilly with snow-capped Tian Shan mountains visible to the south.

kg-colourful-poles-bishkek.title: Colourful Poles near Bishkek
kg-colourful-poles-bishkek.description: Towns east and west of Bishkek have multi-coloured poles painted yellow, green, white, and sometimes red.

kg-osh-second-largest-city.title: Osh, Second-Largest City
kg-osh-second-largest-city.description: Osh uses the southern mirror and has partly cloudy weather.

kg-osh-trees-leaves.title: Osh, Trees with Leaves
kg-osh-trees-leaves.description: Most trees in Osh retain their leaves, unlike in Bishkek.

kg-jalal-abad-overcast.title: Jalal-Abad, Overcast Coverage
kg-jalal-abad-overcast.description: Jalal-Abad shows the southern mirror and has distinct overcast skies with no cloud gaps.

kg-talas-red-yellow-poles.title: Talas, Red and Yellow Striped Poles
kg-talas-red-yellow-poles.description: Poles in Talas are white at the base with red and yellow stripes.

kg-naryn-orange-ridge-snow-peaks.title: Naryn, Orange Ridge and Snow-Capped Peaks
kg-naryn-orange-ridge-snow-peaks.description: Naryn has a steep orange ridge to the north and snow-capped mountains to the south.

kg-em-04-tian-shan-visible.title: EM-04: Tian Shan Mountain Range Visible
kg-em-04-tian-shan-visible.description: The Tian Shan mountains are visible to the south; terrain is otherwise flat.

kg-em-04-southern-agricultural.title: EM-04: Southern Agricultural Section
kg-em-04-southern-agricultural.description: This southern section has extensive agriculture, lush roadside vegetation, and nearby hills.

kg-em-11-red-soil-snow-naryn.title: EM-11: Red Soil and Snow South of Naryn
kg-em-11-red-soil-snow-naryn.description: Mountains and hills south of Naryn show a striking mix of snow and red soil.

kg-em-09-overcast-east-cholpon-ata.title: EM-09: Overcast East of Cholpon Ata
kg-em-09-overcast-east-cholpon-ata.description: East of Cholpon Ata is overcast with mountains to the north, a lake to the south, and tall roadside trees.

kg-em-10-sandy-shore-lake-mountains.title: EM-10: Sandy Shore with Lake and Mountains
kg-em-10-sandy-shore-lake-mountains.description: Lake Issyk Kul and Tian Shan mountains are visible; soil is sandy and rocky.

kg-em-10-sandy-terrain-southern-mountain.title: EM-10: Sandy Terrain with Southern Mountains
kg-em-10-sandy-terrain-southern-mountain.description: Mountains dominate the south; sandy roadsides persist throughout.

kg-em-10-dry-west-issyk-kul.title: EM-10: Dry Western End of Issyk Kul
kg-em-10-dry-west-issyk-kul.description: The western end of Issyk Kul has drier terrain; lake and hills sit further from the road.

kg-country-flag.title: Country Flag
kg-country-flag.description: The national flag of Kyrgyzstan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

la-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
la-licence-plate.description: Laotian plates are short and yellow; commercial plates white; government plates blue.

la-striped-curb.title: Striped Curbs
la-striped-curb.description: Kerbstones painted in alternating red-white, yellow-white, or black-white stripes are common.

la-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
la-utility-pole.description: Laotian utility poles are square concrete columns with vertical rows of small pinholes.

la-black-white-bollard.title: Black-and-White Bollards
la-black-white-bollard.description: Laos uses square concrete bollards with black bands on a white body.

la-lamp-post-marking.title: Lamp Post Markings
la-lamp-post-marking.description: Some Laotian lamp posts have diagonal red-and-white stripes stopping short of the base.

la-red-white-concrete-bollard.title: Red-and-White Concrete Bollards
la-red-white-concrete-bollard.description: Cuboid concrete bollards painted red and white appear a few metres off the roadside.

la-communist-flag.title: Communist Flags
la-communist-flag.description: Laos occasionally displays red hammer-and-sickle flags.

la-palm-tree.title: Palm Trees
la-palm-tree.description: Palm trees are common in Luang Prabang's streetscape.

la-flat-terrain.title: Flat Terrain
la-flat-terrain.description: Savannakhet is exceptionally flat with slightly reddish soil.

la-red-soil-dry-hill.title: Red Soil and Dry Hills
la-red-soil-dry-hill.description: Pakse has vivid red soil and dry, arid vegetation with parched hills nearby.

la-country-flag.title: Country Flag
la-country-flag.description: The national flag of Laos is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

lv-hook-shaped-poletop-insulator.title: Hook-Shaped Poletop Insulators
lv-hook-shaped-poletop-insulator.description: Latvian utility poles have hook-shaped insulators in an alternating left–right–left pattern.

lv-chevron.title: Chevrons
lv-chevron.description: Latvian chevrons are white with red arrows.

lv-warning-speed-sign-border.title: Warning and Speed Sign Borders
lv-warning-speed-sign-border.description: Latvian warning and speed signs have a thick red border with a thin white outline.

lv-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signs
lv-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Latvian crossing signs have five stripes and a pedestrian figure with long legs.

lv-guardrail-white-red-reflector.title: Guardrails with White or Red Reflectors
lv-guardrail-white-red-reflector.description: Latvian guardrails are standard A-type with white or red reflectors.

lv-latvian-language.title: Latvian Language
lv-latvian-language.description: A Baltic language with unique letters: vowels with macrons (Ā Ē Ī) and consonants with cedilla hooks (Ģ Ķ Ļ Ņ).

lv-iela-street-label.title: 'Iela' Street Label
lv-iela-street-label.description: The Latvian word for street is iela.

lv-tall-rectangular-house-number.title: Tall Rectangular House Numbers
lv-tall-rectangular-house-number.description: Latvian house number plates are often tall rectangles in several colours.

lv-architecture.title: Architecture
lv-architecture.description: Latvian buildings mix wood and white brick under steep corrugated metal roofs; pastel-painted stone and wood-brick houses are common.

lv-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
lv-directional-sign.description: Latvian directional signs are blue with white text and stylised arrowheads.

lv-open-plains-south-jelgava.title: Open Plains South of Jelgava
lv-open-plains-south-jelgava.description: South of Jelgava features wide-open fields with less forest than elsewhere in Latvia.

lv-country-flag.title: Country Flag
lv-country-flag.description: The national flag of Latvia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

lb-mediterranean-landscape.title: Mediterranean Landscape
lb-mediterranean-landscape.description: Lebanon's terrain is Mediterranean, hilly, with rocky cliffs and green vegetation.

lb-metallic-mesh-pole.title: Metallic Mesh Poles
lb-metallic-mesh-pole.description: Lebanon uses metallic mesh (lattice) utility poles, sometimes bright yellow; wooden poles also appear.

lb-sandstone-brick-building.title: Sandstone Brick Buildings
lb-sandstone-brick-building.description: Many Lebanese buildings are made from pale sandstone blocks.

lb-zahle-agricultural-field.title: Zahle Agricultural Fields
lb-zahle-agricultural-field.description: Zahle area features flat farmland with mountains visible to the northwest.

lb-snow-capped-mountain.title: Snow-Capped Mountains
lb-snow-capped-mountain.description: Snow covers mountaintops or ground in northeastern mountains east of Tripoli.

lb-flat-northern-plain.title: Flat Northern Plains
lb-flat-northern-plain.description: Northern Lebanon is flat and agricultural, with mountains visible to the southeast.

lb-trekker-coverage-overview.title: Trekker Coverage Overview
lb-trekker-coverage-overview.description: Lebanese trekker imagery is sparse, mostly around tourist sites, campuses, and trails.

lb-beirut.title: Beirut
lb-beirut.description: The capital has many modern high-rises; urban structures or infrastructure are almost always visible.

lb-country-flag.title: Country Flag
lb-country-flag.description: The national flag of Lebanon is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ls-licence-plate.title: Licence Plate
ls-licence-plate.description: Lesotho plates are long and white with blue text and a Mokorotlo hat symbol on the left.

ls-road-line.title: Road Lines
ls-road-line.description: Lesotho's edge lines are yellow and centre lines are white.

ls-triple-centre-line.title: Triple Centre Lines
ls-triple-centre-line.description: Some Lesotho roads have a unique triple centre-line: two solid lines flanking a dashed line.

ls-agave-plant.title: Agave Plants
ls-agave-plant.description: Agave plants are widespread in Lesotho countryside.

ls-traditional-basotho-blanket.title: Traditional Basotho Blankets
ls-traditional-basotho-blanket.description: Many people, especially in rural areas, wear traditional Basotho woollen blankets.

ls-free-roaming-livestock.title: Free-Roaming Livestock
ls-free-roaming-livestock.description: Lesotho's roads are frequently shared with wandering cattle, horses, donkeys, and other farm animals.

ls-flat-western-region.title: Flat Western Region
ls-flat-western-region.description: The western lowlands are flat or gently hilly with visible tabletop mountains, dense coverage, settlements, and agriculture.

ls-mountainous-eastern-region.title: Mountainous Eastern Region
ls-mountainous-eastern-region.description: In the east, roads run along grassy mountainsides with limited coverage on six main roads.

ls-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ls-country-flag.description: The national flag of Lesotho is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

li-liemobil-bus-stop.title: LIEmobil Bus Stops
li-liemobil-bus-stop.description: Bus stop signs are green-and-white with a black frame and 'LIEMOBIL' across the top.

li-direction-sign.title: Direction Signs
li-direction-sign.description: Directional signs are white for minor roads and blue for major roads, each with a pointed arrowhead.

li-pedestrian-sign.title: Pedestrian Signs
li-pedestrian-sign.description: Pedestrian crossing signs have seven stripes and a tall rectangular shape.

li-yellow-black-road-separator.title: Yellow-and-Black Road Separators
li-yellow-black-road-separator.description: Striped road separators have a rounded top, small knob, and three bands of yellow and black.

li-metal-sign-border.title: Metal Sign Borders
li-metal-sign-border.description: Road signs commonly have a round grey metal border.

li-architecture.title: Architecture
li-architecture.description: Architecture ranges from traditional Alpine chalets to modern structures, more modern in larger settlements.

li-eastern-mountain-coverage.title: Eastern Mountain Coverage
li-eastern-mountain-coverage.description: Mountains are visible in every direction east of the central ridge.

li-blue-street-sign.title: Blue Street Signs
li-blue-street-sign.description: Blue street signs with a thin white border appear in the south and around Bendern.

li-flat-black-sign.title: Flat Black Signs
li-flat-black-sign.description: Plain flat black street signs indicate eastern Liechtenstein.

li-brown-fraktur-sign.title: Brown Fraktur-Style Signs
li-brown-fraktur-sign.description: Brown street signs with traditional German-style typeface and white border are found in Vaduz and northern towns.

li-country-flag.title: Country Flag
li-country-flag.description: The national flag of Liechtenstein is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-16-square-poles.title: General 01 16 Square Poles
xx-general-01-16-square-poles.description: In Lithuania, utility poles are usually square concrete posts with a diagonal support beam.

lt-poletop-style.title: Poletop Styles
lt-poletop-style.description: Lithuanian poletops often have short horizontal rods holding insulators, sometimes in a trident pattern.

lt-chevron.title: Chevrons
lt-chevron.description: Lithuanian chevrons are white with red arrows; small variants have a red outline.

lt-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
lt-kilometre-marker.description: Lithuanian blue L-shaped km markers are mounted at a 45° angle toward the road.

lt-warning-speed-sign-border.title: Warning and Speed Sign Borders
lt-warning-speed-sign-border.description: Lithuanian warning and speed signs have a thin red border with a thin white outline.

lt-guardrail-orange-reflector.title: Guardrails with Orange Reflectors
lt-guardrail-orange-reflector.description: Lithuanian guardrails are standard A-type with orange reflectors.

lt-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signs
lt-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Lithuanian crossing signs show three stripes and a low-detail pedestrian figure.

lt-bus-stop-sign.title: Bus Stop Signs
lt-bus-stop-sign.description: Lithuanian bus stop signs feature a bus icon with four windows.

lt-lithuanian-language.title: Lithuanian Language
lt-lithuanian-language.description: A Baltic language with hooked vowels (Ą Ę Į Ų), Ė with a dot, and the letter Y.

lt-gatve-street-label.title: 'Gatvė' Street Label
lt-gatve-street-label.description: The word for street is gatvė, often abbreviated as g. on signs.

lt-place-name-ending-ai.title: Place Name Ending '-ai'
lt-place-name-ending-ai.description: Many Lithuanian town and village names end in -ai.

lt-architecture.title: Architecture
lt-architecture.description: Buildings are light-coloured brick with steep corrugated metal roofs; wooden and pastel-painted stone houses also appear.

lt-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
lt-directional-sign.description: Directional signs are blue with white text and arrowheads with straight vertical back edges.

lt-open-agricultural-landscape.title: Open Agricultural Landscape
lt-open-agricultural-landscape.description: Lithuania has less forest cover, giving the countryside an open, agricultural feel.

lt-topography.title: Topography
lt-topography.description: Although Lithuania is largely flat, the southeast is the hilliest region.

lt-bilingual-polish-sign-southeast.title: Bilingual Polish Signs
lt-bilingual-polish-sign-southeast.description: In southeastern Lithuania, bilingual Lithuanian-Polish signs occasionally appear.

lt-country-flag.title: Country Flag
lt-country-flag.description: The national flag of Lithuania is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

lu-bollard.title: Bollards
lu-bollard.description: Black-and-white wedge-shaped bollards with grey reflectors; some have a lower indent.

lu-chevron.title: Chevrons
lu-chevron.description: Chevrons are black with yellow arrows; a blue-and-yellow variant also appears.

lu-upside-down-trident-poletop.title: Upside-Down Trident Poletops
lu-upside-down-trident-poletop.description: Common pole tops shaped like inverted tridents.

lu-multilingual-signage.title: Multilingual Signage
lu-multilingual-signage.description: French dominates public signage; German and Luxembourgish also appear.

lu-luxembourgish-language.title: Luxembourgish Language
lu-luxembourgish-language.description: Closely related to German with umlauts, double vowels, and accented é.

lu-town-entrance-sign.title: Town Entrance Signs
lu-town-entrance-sign.description: Yellow framed, often bilingual signs showing road number and speed limit.

lu-square-cornered-frame.title: Square-Cornered Frames
lu-square-cornered-frame.description: Metal frames around signs and road infrastructure are common.

lu-street-name-sign.title: Street Name Signs
lu-street-name-sign.description: Typically short, white-backed signs; a common variant has slanted blue corners.

lu-blue-white-signpost-reflector.title: Blue-and-White Signpost Reflectors

lu-rolling-hill-landscape.title: Rolling Hills Landscape
lu-rolling-hill-landscape.description: Landscape dominated by green rolling hills with farmland and forest patches.

lu-local-road-number.title: Local Road Numbers

lu-topography.title: Topography
lu-topography.description: Northern half is higher and hillier than the flatter south.

lu-vineyard.title: Vineyards

lu-country-flag.title: Country Flag

xx-license-plates-01-02-black-license-pl.title: License Plates 01 02 Black License Plates
xx-license-plates-01-02-black-license-pl.description: In Macau, cars have black licence plates.

mo-country-flag.description: The national flag of Macau is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

mk-winter-coverage-city.title: Winter Coverage Cities

mk-divided-road-overview.title: Divided Roads Overview

mk-obituary-posters.title: Obituary Posters Overview

mg-country-flag.title: Country Flag

my-yellow-street-name-signs-johor.description: Yellow arrow-shaped street name signs are specific to Johor.

mq-country-flag.title: Country Flag

mx-21-zacatecas.title: Zacatecas Licence Plate
mx-21-zacatecas.description: Zacatecas plates feature a white background with green and red accents, typically displaying a mining cart or the state coat of arms, and 'Zacatecas' in green.

mx-prickly-pear-cacti.title: Prickly Pear Cacti
mx-prickly-pear-cacti.description: Prickly pear cacti, identifiable by their flat, oval-shaped pads, appear far more frequently in the central highlands.

mx-pulque-agaves.title: Pulque Agaves
mx-pulque-agaves.description: Agave salmiana has broad, smooth, curling leaves forming a crown-like silhouette, thriving in the central valley and around San Luis Potosi.

mx-blue-agave-fields.title: Blue Agave Fields
mx-blue-agave-fields.description: Extensive blue agave plantations for tequila are concentrated in Jalisco and Nayarit.

mx-tree-yucca.title: Tree Yucca
mx-tree-yucca.description: Yucca filifera and Yucca decipiens grow as single-trunked trees with oblong rosettes of sharp green leaves, concentrated in San Luis Potosi, Zacatecas, and nearby states.

mx-mexican-giant-cardon-cactus.title: Mexican Giant Cardon Cactus
mx-mexican-giant-cardon-cactus.description: A prevalent Baja California cactus with large sprawling arms branching from a single trunk and ribbed surface.

mx-saguaro-cactus.title: Saguaro Cactus
mx-saguaro-cactus.description: Found in western Sonora, featuring a tall main trunk with short, upward-curving arms.

mx-organ-pipe-cactus.title: Organ Pipe Cactus
mx-organ-pipe-cactus.description: Cactus with long, slender stems emerging near ground level, mainly in Sonora and occasionally Baja California Sur.

mx-blue-myrtle-cactus.title: Blue Myrtle Cactus
mx-blue-myrtle-cactus.description: Cactus with short arms curving uniformly upward, abundant in San Luis Potosi, Queretaro, and Hidalgo.

mx-sugar-cane.title: Sugar Cane
mx-sugar-cane.description: Sugar cane is cultivated widely but most prevalent in Veracruz.

mx-coconut-palm.title: Coconut Palms
mx-coconut-palm.description: Coconut palms line coastal areas, especially dense in Guerrero and Colima.

mx-sabal-palm.title: Sabal Palms
mx-sabal-palm.description: Sabal palms have spiky, sun-shaped crowns giving a lollipop silhouette, growing along Mexico's east coast, Yucatan, and Nayarit.

mx-attalea-rostrata-palm.title: Attalea Rostrata Palm
mx-attalea-rostrata-palm.description: Large palm with erect, umbrella-like fronds, found mainly in Veracruz and Tabasco.

mx-oil-palm-plantations.title: Oil Palm Plantations
mx-oil-palm-plantations.description: Orderly rows of oil palms concentrated in Chiapas, with scattered plantations in Veracruz, Tabasco, and Campeche.

mx-boojum-trees.title: Boojum Trees
mx-boojum-trees.description: Trees with alien, tentacle-like trunks nearly exclusive to southern Baja California peninsula.

mx-brittlebush.title: Brittlebush
mx-brittlebush.description: Low shrub with bright silver-grey foliage, common in Sonora near Hermosillo.

mx-thin-white-barked-trees.title: Thin White-Barked Trees
mx-thin-white-barked-trees.description: Slender trees with pale white bark across the Yucatan peninsula, especially in Quintana Roo.

mx-golden-roadside-grass-tufts.title: Golden Roadside Grass Tufts
mx-golden-roadside-grass-tufts.description: Lines of golden grass tufts growing immediately beside roads in Coahuila.

mx-teardrop-grass-clumps.title: Teardrop-Shaped Grass Clumps
mx-teardrop-grass-clumps.description: Grass growing in rounded, teardrop-shaped clumps typical in and around Tlaxcala.

mx-red-agricultural-fields-zacatecas.title: Red Agricultural Fields
mx-red-agricultural-fields-zacatecas.description: Fields with distinctly red soil frequent in Zacatecas and southern Durango.

mx-northern-pine-forest.title: Northern Pine Forests
mx-northern-pine-forest.description: Rocky, mountainous terrain with pine forests in western Chihuahua and Durango; northern pines are shorter and stunted.

mx-dark-field-guanajuato.title: Dark Fields of Guanajuato
mx-dark-field-guanajuato.description: Extremely dark-coloured agricultural fields common in Guanajuato.

mx-reddish-brown-hills-northern-baja.title: Reddish-Brown Hills of Northern Baja
mx-reddish-brown-hills-northern-baja.description: Hills with reddish-brown tint and large boulders in northern Baja California peninsula.

mx-bright-white-soil-quintana-roo.title: Bright White Soil in Quintana Roo
mx-bright-white-soil-quintana-roo.description: Intensely white, almost blinding soil in the Yucatan peninsula, most common in Quintana Roo.

mx-red-fields-northern-campeche.title: Red Fields in Northern Campeche
mx-red-fields-northern-campeche.description: Red-earth farmland bordered by dense tropical forest in northern Campeche.

mx-red-brick-buildings.title: Red Brick Buildings
mx-red-brick-buildings.description: Exposed red brick construction concentrated west of Mexico City in Jalisco, Michoacan, Guanajuato, and Aguascalientes.

mx-white-concrete-block-buildings.title: White Concrete Block Buildings
mx-white-concrete-block-buildings.description: White concrete block structures cluster near Mexico City and become more common eastward.

mx-mud-brick-buildings.title: Mud Brick Buildings
mx-mud-brick-buildings.description: Adobe-style mud brick construction prevalent in Durango and scattered across northern arid states.

mx-northern-mexican-architecture.title: Northern Mexican Architecture
mx-northern-mexican-architecture.description: Homes with pastel facades, gated yards, and orange Spanish colonial roof tiles common in northern Mexico.

mx-thatched-roofs.title: Thatched Roofs
mx-thatched-roofs.description: Buildings with thatched roofing are prevalent in the Yucatan peninsula and eastern San Luis Potosi.

mx-light-coloured-rock-walls.title: Light-Coloured Rock Walls
mx-light-coloured-rock-walls.description: Low walls of pale limestone across the Yucatan peninsula, especially in Yucatan state.

mx-cross-sign-backs-chihuahua.title: Cross on Sign Backs in Chihuahua
mx-cross-sign-backs-chihuahua.description: Road signs in Chihuahua have a thick cross printed on their reverse side.

mx-red-banded-bollards-nayarit.title: Red-Banded Bollards
mx-red-banded-bollards-nayarit.description: Bollards with a red band near the top are unique to Nayarit.

mx-jalisco-bollards-crown-emblem.title: Jalisco Bollards with Crown
mx-jalisco-bollards-crown-emblem.description: Some Jalisco bollards bear a crown symbol and the word "Jalisco".

mx-acorn-shaped-white-insulators.title: Acorn-Shaped White Insulators
mx-acorn-shaped-white-insulators.description: Small white insulators resembling acorns sit atop power poles in coastal states, especially Michoacan, Colima, and Veracruz.

mx-asymmetric-crossbar-poles.title: Asymmetric Crossbar Poles
mx-asymmetric-crossbar-poles.description: Power poles with an off-centre crossbar and double-stacked insulators are exclusive to Mexico City, State of Mexico, Hidalgo, and Morelos.

mx-wooden-poles-lowered-crossbar.title: Wooden Poles with Lowered Crossbar
mx-wooden-poles-lowered-crossbar.description: Wooden utility poles with a noticeably lower crossbar are mainly found in Sinaloa and Sonora.

mx-hanging-insulators-concrete-poles-yuc.title: Hanging Insulators on Concrete Poles
mx-hanging-insulators-concrete-poles-yuc.description: Concrete power poles with insulators hanging below the crossbar are typical of the Yucatan peninsula.

mx-wooden-hanging-insulator-poles-baja.title: Wooden Hanging-Insulator Poles
mx-wooden-hanging-insulator-poles-baja.description: Wooden poles with hanging insulators are found on the Baja California peninsula.

mx-single-support-beam-poles-durango.title: Single Support Beam Poles
mx-single-support-beam-poles-durango.description: Utility poles with a lowered crossbar braced by a single diagonal support beam are specific to Durango.

mx-mesh-body-poles.title: Mesh-Body Poles
mx-mesh-body-poles.description: Utility poles with a lattice or mesh body are common in San Luis Potosi, Guanajuato, and Queretaro.

mx-white-centre-road-lines-tabasco.title: White Centre Road Lines
mx-white-centre-road-lines-tabasco.description: Roads in Tabasco commonly use white centre lines instead of yellow.

mx-red-barked-tree-fences-veracruz.title: Red-Barked Tree Fences
mx-red-barked-tree-fences-veracruz.description: Living fences made from trees with reddish bark are characteristic of Veracruz.

mx-black-tar-centre-lines.title: Black Tar Along Centre Lines
mx-black-tar-centre-lines.description: Black tar patches flanking yellow centre lines appear in Sinaloa, Durango, and Guerrero.

mx-grainy-blue-grey-pavement.title: Grainy Blue-Grey Pavement
mx-grainy-blue-grey-pavement.description: Coarse-textured road surfaces with a blue-grey tinge are typical of Tamaulipas and Nuevo Leon.

mx-irregular-cobblestone-pavement.title: Irregular Cobblestone Pavement
mx-irregular-cobblestone-pavement.description: Streets paved with randomly arranged, irregular cobblestones are widespread in central Mexico, especially Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, and Queretaro.

mx-hexagonal-tile-pavement.title: Hexagonal Tile Pavement
mx-hexagonal-tile-pavement.description: Streets surfaced with interlocking hexagonal tiles are distinctive of Puebla and Tlaxcala.

mx-three-line-cobblestone-pavement-oaxac.title: Three-Line Cobblestone Pavement
mx-three-line-cobblestone-pavement-oaxac.description: A cobblestone pattern with three parallel lines of stones is mainly associated with Oaxaca.

mx-mexicali-farmland-brown-wooden-poles.title: Mexicali Farmland and Brown Poles
mx-mexicali-farmland-brown-wooden-poles.description: Mexicali features flat farmland, a western ridge, Washingtonia palms, and brown wooden utility poles.

mx-sierra-del-abra-tanchipa-ridge.title: Sierra del Abra Tanchipa Ridge
mx-sierra-del-abra-tanchipa-ridge.description: A long, flat-topped ridge in the Sierra del Abra Tanchipa Biosphere Reserve is visible from roads in eastern San Luis Potosi.

mx-country-flag.title: Country Flag
mx-country-flag.description: The national flag of Mexico is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

mc-location.title: Location
mc-location.description: A European microstate on the French Riviera, west of the Italian border.

mc-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
mc-licence-plate.description: Monaco plates are short and lack the blue EU strip.

mc-hilly-terrain.title: Hilly Terrain
mc-hilly-terrain.description: Monaco's terrain is hilly with Mediterranean vegetation in open patches.

mc-palm-tree.title: Palm Trees
mc-palm-tree.description: Ornamental palm trees line Monaco's streets and boulevards.

mc-tunnel.title: Tunnels
mc-tunnel.description: Much of Monaco's coverage passes through tunnels.

mc-parked-moped.title: Parked Mopeds
mc-parked-moped.description: Rows of parked mopeds line many Monaco streets.

mc-country-flag.title: Country Flag
mc-country-flag.description: The national flag of Monaco is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

mn-licence-plate-red-soyombo.title: Licence Plates with Red Soyombo Symbol
mn-licence-plate-red-soyombo.description: Mongolian plates are mostly white with a red Soyombo emblem on the left side.

mn-cyrillic-unique-letters.title: Cyrillic Script with Unique Letters
mn-cyrillic-unique-letters.description: Mongolian Cyrillic includes extra letters Ɵ and Ү and often uses doubled vowels like aa, ƟƟ, or ЭЭ.

xx-general-01-42-tent-car.title: General 01 42 Tent Car
xx-general-01-42-tent-car.description: In Mongolia the google car is often visible. It takes many shapes but usually a tent can be seen packed on the car.

mn-general-01-vast-landscapes.title: General 01 Vast Landscapes
mn-general-01-vast-landscapes.description: The Mongolian landscape is often barren, featuring large open areas without much vegetation.

mn-bollards-01-strike.title: Strike!
mn-bollards-01-strike.description: The Mongolian bollard is reminiscent of a bowling pin.

mn-dirt-alleys-wooden-fences.title: Dirt Alleys and Wooden Fences
mn-dirt-alleys-wooden-fences.description: Residential areas divided by unpaved dirt alleys lined with wooden fencing.

mn-traditional-yurt.title: Traditional Yurts (Gers)
mn-traditional-yurt.description: Round white yurts, traditional homes of Mongolian nomads, are common throughout the country.

mn-livestock-herd.title: Livestock Herds
mn-livestock-herd.description: Large groups of roadside animals including horses, yaks, cattle, sheep, goats, and camels.

mn-street-view-coverage-map.title: Street View Coverage Map
mn-street-view-coverage-map.description: Sparse coverage concentrated along major highways and larger towns, densest around Ulaanbaatar.

mn-driving-direction-away-ulaanbaatar.title: Driving Direction Away from Ulaanbaatar
mn-driving-direction-away-ulaanbaatar.description: Street View car generally heads outward from the capital, so driving direction points away from Ulaanbaatar.

mn-topography-flat-east-mountainous-west.title: Topography: Flat East, Mountainous West
mn-topography-flat-east-mountainous-west.description: East and south are flat, north has rolling hills, west has large mountains and rocky terrain.

mn-northern-forest.title: Northern Forests
mn-northern-forest.description: Forested areas with Siberian Larch, pine, and birch appear throughout northern Mongolia.

mn-flat-grassy-plains-far-east.title: Flat Grassy Plains in the Far East
mn-flat-grassy-plains-far-east.description: Narrow dirt tracks cut through vast, treeless grasslands in Mongolia's far east.

mn-off-road-desert-coverage-south.title: Off-Road Desert Coverage in the South
mn-off-road-desert-coverage-south.description: Unpaved desert tracks appear south or east of Mandalgovi.

mn-paved-desert-road-south.title: Paved Desert Roads in the South
mn-paved-desert-road-south.description: A few paved highways cross the southern desert region.

mn-arid-steppe-rangeland-southwest.title: Arid Steppe Rangeland in the Southwest
mn-arid-steppe-rangeland-southwest.description: Dry steppe rangeland with coarse soil, sparse grass, and scattered low shrubs.

mn-dry-rugged-mountains-far-west.title: Dry Rugged Mountains in the Far West
mn-dry-rugged-mountains-far-west.description: Barren, rugged hills and mountains with no vegetation in the far west.

mn-lake-river-west.title: Lakes and Rivers in the West
mn-lake-river-west.description: Lakes and rivers appear more frequently in western Mongolia.

mn-snow-coverage-near-ulaanbaatar.title: Snow Coverage Near Ulaanbaatar
mn-snow-coverage-near-ulaanbaatar.description: Snowy Street View imagery is concentrated around Ulaanbaatar.

mn-fall-foliage-coverage.title: Fall Foliage Coverage
mn-fall-foliage-coverage.description: Autumn imagery shows vivid orange trees and grass mainly between Lun and Hatgal, and near Ulaanbaatar.

mn-rare-crop-field-selenge-tov.title: Rare Crop Fields
mn-rare-crop-field-selenge-tov.description: Agricultural fields appear occasionally in Selenge and Töv provinces near Ulaanbaatar.

mn-ulaanbaatar-cityscape.title: Ulaanbaatar Cityscape
mn-ulaanbaatar-cityscape.description: The capital has high-rises, chain stores, heavy traffic, buses, pedestrians, maintained roads, and sprawling yurt suburbs on hills.

mn-spare-tire-variation.title: Spare Tire Variations
mn-spare-tire-variation.description: The spare tire on the back right of the Street View truck divides Mongolia into four zones by tire type and presence.

mn-light-blue-tent-forward-snorkel.title: Light Blue Tent with Forward Snorkel
mn-light-blue-tent-forward-snorkel.description: In eastern grasslands, the Street View truck has a light blue tent and a forward-facing snorkel intake.

mn-orange-roof-rack-strap.title: Orange Roof Rack Strap Patterns
mn-orange-roof-rack-strap.description: Eastern Mongolia sub-areas can be identified by orange strap arrangements on roof racks, visible from above.

mn-bright-silver-tent.title: Bright Silver Tent
mn-bright-silver-tent.description: A bright silver tent on the Street View truck is typical in central and northwestern Mongolia.

mn-cage-roof-rack.title: Cage Roof Rack
mn-cage-roof-rack.description: Near Ulaanbaatar, some coverage shows a metal cage replacing the tent, often with a green camouflage sleeping bag on top.

mn-gen-4-silver-truck-ulaanbaatar.title: White and Blue Truck in Ulaanbaatar
mn-gen-4-silver-truck-ulaanbaatar.description: Some imagery in the capital uses a truck with an ornate blue-and-white roof decal.

mn-western-mongolia-snow-peaks-glaciers.title: Western Mongolia Snow-Capped Peaks
mn-western-mongolia-snow-peaks-glaciers.description: Western Mongolia features the tallest mountains with glaciers and snow, and a Street View car with a green or black bag on the roof.

mn-shrubland-east-uvs-lake.title: Shrubland East of Uvs Lake
mn-shrubland-east-uvs-lake.description: East of Uvs Lake has abundant small shrubs and patchy grass on flat terrain.

mn-nighttime-coverage.title: Nighttime Coverage Locations
mn-nighttime-coverage.description: After-dark imagery appears in four main areas, with the car heading toward the nearest town.

mn-country-flag.title: Country Flag
mn-country-flag.description: The national flag of Mongolia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

me-chevron.title: Chevrons
me-chevron.description: Montenegro uses black-on-white and red-on-yellow chevrons.

me-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
me-utility-pole.description: Montenegro uses simple round concrete or wooden utility poles.

me-northern-agricultural-valley.title: Northern Agricultural Valleys
me-northern-agricultural-valley.description: Green valleys with deforested hillsides cleared for farming are common in northern Montenegro.

me-dry-mountain-podgorica.title: Dry Mountains Around Podgorica
me-dry-mountain-podgorica.description: Barren, treeless mountains characterise the area around and south of Podgorica. Vineyards are also common.

me-pine-forest.title: Pine Forests
me-pine-forest.description: Pine forests appear mainly in the east, with smaller patches in the north and north of Nikšić.

me-podgorica.title: Podgorica
me-podgorica.description: The capital and largest city, identifiable by modern buildings, wide roads, and updated infrastructure.

me-cemi-river-valley-terrace.title: Cemi River Valley Terraces
me-cemi-river-valley-terrace.description: Distinctive staircase-like terraced mountainsides line the Cemi River Valley.

me-country-flag.title: Country Flag
me-country-flag.description: The national flag of Montenegro is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

n-general-01-road-lines.title: General 01 Road Lines
n-general-01-road-lines.description: Like many countries in Southern Africa, Namibia uses roads with single yellow outer lines and white center lines.

na-green-directional-signs-yellow-road-n.title: Green Directional Signs with Yellow Road Numbers
na-green-directional-signs-yellow-road-n.description: Directional signs are green with yellow route numbers using A, B, C, D, M, and sometimes F designations.

na-small-stone-bollards.title: Small Stone Bollards
na-small-stone-bollards.description: Short stone bollards are common along Namibian roadsides and intersections.

na-green-white-metal-bins.title: Green-and-White Metal Bins
na-green-white-metal-bins.description: Cylindrical metal rubbish bins painted green and white appear at rest stops and junctions.

na-limited-coverage-minor-roads.title: Limited Coverage on Minor Roads
na-limited-coverage-minor-roads.description: Street View in Namibia is concentrated along major highways with scattered minor road coverage.

na-pavement-type-driving-direction-map.title: Pavement Type and Driving Direction Map
na-pavement-type-driving-direction-map.description: Map showing road surface types and Google car travel direction on major routes.

na-telephone-area-codes-region.title: Telephone Area Codes by Region
na-telephone-area-codes-region.description: Namibian area codes help pinpoint regions or cities.

na-tall-lush-tree-north.title: Tall Lush Trees Indicate the North
na-tall-lush-tree-north.description: Tall, leafy trees on both sides of the road indicate northern Namibia.

na-agricultural-land-oshakati.title: Agricultural Land near Oshakati
na-agricultural-land-oshakati.description: Northern Namibia near Oshakati has cultivated fields with light sandy soil and fan palms.

na-botswana-like-landscape-east-windhoek.title: Botswana-Like Landscape East of Windhoek
na-botswana-like-landscape-east-windhoek.description: East of Windhoek features flat, dry terrain with reddish earth, short grass, shrubs, and acacia trees.

na-arid-mountain-west-south.title: Arid Mountains in the West and South
na-arid-mountain-west-south.description: Western and southern Namibia have barren, dry mountains and rocky hills.

na-greener-hill-northwest.title: Greener Hills in the Northwest
na-greener-hill-northwest.description: Northwest hills and mountains have more vegetation with shrubs and trees.

na-coastal-sandy-terrain-dune.title: Coastal Sandy Terrain with Dunes
na-coastal-sandy-terrain-dune.description: Flat sandy coastal areas with dunes occur around and north of Swakopmund and near Luderitz and Oranjemund.

na-southeast-ridge-rollercoaster-road.title: Southeast Ridges and Rollercoaster Roads
na-southeast-ridge-rollercoaster-road.description: Southeast has small parallel ridges with red sandy soil; roads crossing them feel bumpy.

na-60-kunene-region.title: Kunene C46 Poor Pavement & No Yellow Edges
na-60-kunene-region.description: Near Ruacana, C46 lacks yellow edge lines, has poor cracked pavement, and dry flat terrain.

na-60-omusati-region.title: Omusati C46 Low Sun & No Yellow Edges
na-60-omusati-region.description: In Omusati, C46 lacks yellow edges, has poor pavement, flat terrain with sparse trees, and low sun.

na-60-ohangwena-region.title: Ohangwena C41 (M123) Cloudy No-Yellow-Edge Road
na-60-ohangwena-region.description: C41 in Ohangwena lacks yellow edges, runs northwest, with cloudier skies and flat terrain.

na-60-kavango-west-region.title: Kavango West B10 Dense Vegetation & Moon
na-60-kavango-west-region.description: East of Nkurenkuru, B10 lacks yellow edges, has dense vegetation, and a visible moon to the east.

na-60-kavango-east-region.title: Kavango East B10 E-W Road with Heavy Vegetation
na-60-kavango-east-region.description: West of Eenhana, B10 runs east-west without yellow edges, bordered by heavy vegetation.

na-60-namibia.title: Namibia D3615 Faded Yellow Edge Lines
na-60-namibia.description: D3615 has extremely faded yellow edge lines, a white dashed centre line, and dry surroundings.

na-country-flag.title: Country Flag
na-country-flag.description: The national flag of Namibia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

np-devanagari-script.title: Devanagari Script
np-devanagari-script.description: Nepali text uses Devanagari, with a horizontal bar atop words and prominent vertical strokes.

np-utility-pole-trident-top.title: Utility Poles and Trident Tops
np-utility-pole-trident-top.description: Flat areas have square concrete poles; mountains use slender metal ones. Pole tops often have a trident shape.

np-flat-south-mountainous-north.title: Flat South vs. Mountainous North
np-flat-south-mountainous-north.description: Southern Nepal is flat farmland; northern half has high-altitude mountain roads with dramatic elevation changes.

np-building-style-triangle-decoration.title: Building Styles and Triangles
np-building-style-triangle-decoration.description: Buildings range from colourful blocky structures to smaller houses with triangular ornamental motifs.

np-black-white-striped-signpost.title: Black-and-White Signposts
np-black-white-striped-signpost.description: Sign poles feature alternating black and white stripes along their length.

np-white-buddhist-stupa.title: White Buddhist Stupas
np-white-buddhist-stupa.description: White-painted Buddhist stupas, sometimes with painted eyes, are unique to Nepal.

np-district-name-address.title: District Names on Addresses
np-district-name-address.description: District names often appear in postal addresses in English alongside Devanagari.

np-flat-southern-plain-mountainous-inter.title: Flat Southern Plains vs. Mountains
np-flat-southern-plain-mountainous-inter.description: The far southern strip is flat; central and northern regions have steep, rugged terrain.

np-dry-western-hill.title: Dry Western Hills
np-dry-western-hill.description: Western hills have an arid look with large stretches of bare, unvegetated hillside.

np-areca-palm-southeast.title: Areca Palms in Southeast
np-areca-palm-southeast.description: Areca palms with slender trunks and compact crowns grow mainly in southeastern lowlands.

np-canola-field-yellow-flower.title: Canola Fields
np-canola-field-yellow-flower.description: Canola with vivid yellow blossoms grows in southern pockets of western Nepal.

np-chir-pine-tree.title: Chir Pine Trees
np-chir-pine-tree.description: Chir pines have smooth conical crowns with long needles, prevalent in the west and near Kathmandu.

np-japanese-cedar-far-east.title: Japanese Cedar Trees
np-japanese-cedar-far-east.description: Japanese cedars in far eastern Nepal are tall with narrow, feathery crowns.

np-tea-plantation-far-east.title: Tea Plantations
np-tea-plantation-far-east.description: Tea cultivation occurs only in far eastern Nepal on mountain slopes and flatlands.

np-rounded-roof-tile.title: Rounded Roof Tiles
np-rounded-roof-tile.description: Fully rounded clay roof tiles are common south of Kathmandu and westward.

np-west-bengal-roof-tile-diamond.title: West Bengal Style Roof Tiles
np-west-bengal-roof-tile-diamond.description: Tiles with small diamond-shaped bumps are concentrated in far western plains.

np-irregular-rectangular-roof-tile.title: Irregular Rectangular Roof Tiles
np-irregular-rectangular-roof-tile.description: Rectangular stone tiles laid unevenly are typical of western mountain towns and central areas.

np-corrugated-metal-roof.title: Corrugated Metal Roofs
np-corrugated-metal-roof.description: Corrugated sheet metal roofs are common between Birgunj and Janakpur.

np-roof-railing-western-nepal.title: Roof Railings in Western Nepal
np-roof-railing-western-nepal.description: Dark concrete railings run along roof edges in parts of western Nepal, especially Tulsipur valley.

np-stick-fence-eastern-plain.title: Stick Fences
np-stick-fence-eastern-plain.description: Fences made from sticks, varying in quality, are common in the eastern flatlands.

np-sheet-metal-roof-triangular-window.title: Sheet Metal Roofs with Triangular Window
np-sheet-metal-roof-triangular-window.description: Roofs in the far east are sheet metal with a small triangular window below the ridge and an outward-angled section beneath it.

np-hip-roof-tiny-metal-ridge.title: Hip Roofs with Tiny Metal Ridge Protrusion
np-hip-roof-tiny-metal-ridge.description: Sheet metal hip roofs with a small metal protrusion at the ridge are found west of and around Biratnagar.

np-mosque-southern-nepal.title: Mosques in Southern Nepal
np-mosque-southern-nepal.description: Mosques cluster in Muslim-majority pockets along the southern belt near Janakpur, Birgunj, Nepalgunj, and Biratnagar.

np-cross-topped-utility-pole-east.title: Cross-Topped Utility Poles
np-cross-topped-utility-pole-east.description: Utility poles with a cross-shaped attachment near the top are common in eastern Nepal.

np-yellow-water-tank-east.title: Yellow Water Tanks
np-yellow-water-tank-east.description: Yellow rooftop water tanks are predominantly found in eastern Nepal.

np-country-flag.title: Country Flag
np-country-flag.description: The national flag of Nepal is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

nl-dutch-language.title: Dutch Language
nl-dutch-language.description: Dutch is a Germanic language with frequent double vowels and distinctive letter combinations like 'ij'.

nl-dutch-bollard.title: Dutch Bollards
nl-dutch-bollard.description: Dutch bollards are plain white posts with a red reflector.

nl-no-utility-pole.title: Absence of Utility Poles
nl-no-utility-pole.description: Street-level utility poles are essentially absent in the Netherlands; only large high-voltage towers appear.

nl-abundant-waterway.title: Abundant Waterways
