nl-abundant-waterway.description: Canals, ditches, dikes, dams, and bridges are constant, reflecting Dutch water management.

nl-tree-lined-rural-road.title: Tree-Lined Rural Roads
nl-tree-lined-rural-road.description: Dutch rural roads are often bordered by rows of trees on both sides, creating a tunnel effect.

nl-organised-urban-planning.title: Highly Organised Urban Planning
nl-organised-urban-planning.description: Dutch towns have neat, orderly layouts with well-maintained roads and uniform row houses.

nl-all-white-road-marking.title: All-White Road Markings
nl-all-white-road-marking.description: Dutch road lines are entirely white, with common dashed edge lines and occasional green centre lines.

nl-bicycle-path.title: Bicycle Paths
nl-bicycle-path.description: Dedicated cycling lanes run alongside many roads, often reddish-pink; cycling is a primary transport mode.

nl-sidewalk-tile.title: Distinctive Sidewalk Tiles
nl-sidewalk-tile.description: Sidewalks typically use uniform square grey tiles in an offset pattern; historic areas may have brick paving.

nl-striped-speed-bump.title: Speed Bumps with Alternating Stripes
nl-striped-speed-bump.description: Dutch speed bumps have alternating long and short white warning stripes on brick or asphalt.

nl-brick-rumble-strip.title: Brick Rumble Strips
nl-brick-rumble-strip.description: Rural roads often have brick-paved rumble strips along edges, unique to the Netherlands.

nl-blue-street-sign-white-text.title: Blue Street Signs with White Text
nl-blue-street-sign-white-text.description: Street name signs are nearly always blue with white lettering; common suffixes include -straat, -weg, -laan.

nl-direction-sign.title: Direction Signs
nl-direction-sign.description: Motorist direction signs are blue with white text; cyclist signs are white with a red border.

nl-blue-town-entry-sign.title: Blue Town Entry Signs
nl-blue-town-entry-sign.description: Town entry signs are blue, often with decorative frames and supplementary signs.

nl-green-road-marker.title: Green Road Markers (Hectometre Posts)
nl-green-road-marker.description: Roadside kilometre markers are green with road numbers in coloured boxes: red for highways, yellow for regional roads.

nl-road-sign-edge-behind.title: Road Sign Edges Visible from Behind
nl-road-sign-edge-behind.description: Dutch road signs have edges wrapping around to the back, creating a visible border.

nl-striped-signpost-marking.title: Striped Signpost Markings
nl-striped-signpost-marking.description: Signpost poles often have black-and-white or blue-and-white striped bands.

nl-bulky-yellow-signpost.title: Bulky Yellow Signposts on Traffic Islands
nl-bulky-yellow-signpost.description: Road signs on traffic islands are often mounted on thick, bright yellow posts.

nl-striped-road-barrier.title: Striped Road Barriers
nl-striped-road-barrier.description: Red-and-white striped barriers are common along Dutch roads, especially rural areas.

nl-brick-architecture.title: Brick Architecture
nl-brick-architecture.description: Buildings are mostly red-brown brick with roofs of orange or dark grey tiles.

nl-row-house.title: Row Houses
nl-row-house.description: Nearly half of Dutch homes are row houses (terraced houses).

nl-windmill-turbine.title: Windmills and Wind Turbines
nl-windmill-turbine.description: Traditional windmills and modern wind turbines are common sights.

nl-landline-area-code.title: Landline Area Codes
nl-landline-area-code.description: Dutch landline numbers start with three- or four-digit area codes that are geographically grouped.

nl-28-drenthe.title: Drenthe N-Road Hectometre Marker
nl-28-drenthe.description: Drenthe's N-road markers have a yellow box with the road number and often a 'DR' abbreviation or provincial logo.

nl-28-flevoland.title: Flevoland N-Road Hectometre Marker
nl-28-flevoland.description: Flevoland's N-road markers show a yellow road number box, sometimes with 'Flevoland' or the province's blue-green logo.

nl-28-friesland.title: Friesland N-Road Hectometre Marker
nl-28-friesland.description: Friesland's N-road markers have a yellow box with the road number and often 'FR' or Frisian flag motifs.

nl-28-gelderland.title: Gelderland N-Road Hectometre Marker
nl-28-gelderland.description: Gelderland's N-road markers feature a yellow box with the road number and sometimes 'GLD' or the provincial logo.

nl-28-groningen.title: Groningen N-Road Hectometre Marker
nl-28-groningen.description: Groningen's N-road markers show a yellow box with the road number and often 'GR' or the provincial flag pattern.

nl-28-limburg.title: Limburg N-Road Hectometre Marker
nl-28-limburg.description: Limburg's N-road markers have a yellow box with the road number and sometimes 'LB' or a Limburg lion emblem or flag colors.

nl-28-north-brabant.title: North Brabant N-Road Hectometre Marker
nl-28-north-brabant.description: North Brabant's N-road markers feature a yellow box with the road number and sometimes 'NB' or the province's checkerboard flag motif.

nl-28-north-holland.title: North Holland N-Road Marker
nl-28-north-holland.description: North Holland's N-road hectometre markers show a yellow road number box, sometimes with 'NH' or the province's blue and yellow flag colors or lion emblem.

nl-28-overijssel.title: Overijssel N-Road Marker
nl-28-overijssel.description: Overijssel's N-road hectometre markers use a yellow box for the road number, sometimes with 'OV' or the province's wavy red-yellow-blue flag motif.

nl-28-south-holland.title: South Holland N-Road Marker
nl-28-south-holland.description: South Holland's N-road hectometre markers feature a yellow road number box, sometimes with 'ZH' or the province's red lion emblem or flag colors.

nl-28-utrecht.title: Utrecht N-Road Marker
nl-28-utrecht.description: Utrecht's N-road hectometre markers display a yellow box with the road number, sometimes including 'UT' or the province's red-and-white flag motif.

nl-28-zeeland.title: Zeeland N-Road Marker
nl-28-zeeland.description: Zeeland's N-road hectometre markers feature a yellow road number box, sometimes with 'ZL' or the province's blue-and-white wavy flag motif or lion emblem.

nl-provincial-flag.title: Provincial Flags
nl-provincial-flag.description: Friesland and Noord-Brabant flags appear frequently. The unofficial flag of the Achterhoek region is also sometimes visible.

nl-frisian-bilingual-sign.title: Frisian Bilingual Signs
nl-frisian-bilingual-sign.description: In Friesland, many town entry signs show both Dutch and Frisian place names. Street names ending in -wei or -strjitte are uniquely Frisian.

nl-limburg-streetlight-sticker.title: Limburg Street Light Stickers
nl-limburg-streetlight-sticker.description: Street lights in Limburg have tall, vertical white stickers with three to four digits.

nl-north-brabant-streetlight-sticker.title: North Brabant Street Light Stickers
nl-north-brabant-streetlight-sticker.description: Street lights in North Brabant have horizontal white stickers showing one or two digits.

nl-polder-landscape-west-north.title: Polder Landscape
nl-polder-landscape-west-north.description: Western and northern regions are flat, marshy polders criss-crossed by many small waterways.

nl-farmland-landscape-south-east.title: Farmland Landscape
nl-farmland-landscape-south-east.description: Southern and eastern regions have flat farmland with waterways but less marshy terrain.

nl-low-hill-southern-limburg.title: Low Hills of Southern Limburg
nl-low-hill-southern-limburg.description: Southern Limburg features gentle rolling hills contrasting with the rest of the flat country.

nl-veluwe-forested-region.title: Veluwe Forested Region
nl-veluwe-forested-region.description: The Veluwe in central Gelderland is wooded with old-growth forest, heathland, and sandy ground.

nl-flevoland-reclaimed-polder.title: Flevoland's Reclaimed Polder
nl-flevoland-reclaimed-polder.description: Flevoland was reclaimed from the sea, with straight roads, vast fields, wind turbines, and no historic buildings.

nl-coastal-dune.title: Coastal Dunes
nl-coastal-dune.description: Sand dunes line most of the Dutch North Sea coastline.

nl-wadden-island.title: Wadden Islands
nl-wadden-island.description: The Wadden Islands have extensive sand dunes and tourism-related signage or infrastructure.

nl-large-farm-roof-north.title: Large Farm Roofs in the North
nl-large-farm-roof-north.description: Northern farmhouses have oversized, sweeping roofs.

nl-rolling-shutter-southern-house.title: Rolling Shutters on Southern Houses
nl-rolling-shutter-southern-house.description: Window rolling shutters are more common in the southern half of the country.

nl-country-flag.title: Country Flag
nl-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Netherlands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

nz-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
nz-licence-plate.description: New Zealand plates are white with black lettering, appearing almost entirely white when blurred.

nz-concrete-utility-poles-single-groove.title: Concrete Utility Poles with Single Groove
nz-concrete-utility-poles-single-groove.description: NZ's main poles are concrete with a single long vertical groove and small silver possum guards.

nz-white-sign-post.title: White Sign Posts
nz-white-sign-post.description: NZ directional and warning signs are typically mounted on white posts; warning signs are yellow diamonds.

nz-blue-street-sign.title: Blue Street Signs
nz-blue-street-sign.description: New Zealand street signs are predominantly blue with white text, especially in rural areas.

nz-road-line-marking.title: Road Line Markings
nz-road-line-marking.description: NZ outer road lines are generally white; centre lines are single white dashes or solid double yellow lines.

nz-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
nz-chevron-sign.description: NZ curve chevrons are black arrows on yellow with a thin black border.

nz-green-directional-sign.title: Green Directional Signs
nz-green-directional-sign.description: New Zealand highway direction signs are green with state highway numbers inside a red shield.

nz-bridge-marker-red-crest.title: Bridge Markers with Red Crest
nz-bridge-marker-red-crest.description: NZ bridge markers show highway numbers inside a red shield and a yellow marker with the river or bridge name.

nz-fern-forested-area.title: Ferns in Forested Areas
nz-fern-forested-area.description: Ferns are very common in New Zealand's wooded and forested areas.

nz-state-highway-numbering-system.title: State Highway Numbering System
nz-state-highway-numbering-system.description: New Zealand's two-digit state highway numbers run north to south sequentially.

nz-phone-number-area-code.title: Phone Number Area Codes
nz-phone-number-area-code.description: NZ phone numbers have seven digits preceded by a two-digit area code; numbers starting with 02 are mobile.

nz-fonterra-farm-sign-numbering.title: Fonterra Farm Sign Numbering
nz-fonterra-farm-sign-numbering.description: The leading digit on Fonterra dairy farm signs corresponds to a regional numbering pattern.

nz-waikato-northland-landscape.title: Waikato and Northland Landscape
nz-waikato-northland-landscape.description: These regions feature dry conditions and rolling hills; Northland is notably hilly.

nz-west-coast-temperate-rainforest.title: West Coast Temperate Rainforests
nz-west-coast-temperate-rainforest.description: The West Coast and parts of Tasman have lush temperate rainforests and rugged, densely green terrain.

nz-southland-otago-landscape.title: Southland and Otago Landscape
nz-southland-otago-landscape.description: Flatter parts of Southland and Otago have a cold climate with gently sloping alpine hills and sparse, stunted vegetation.

nz-southern-alps-mountain-range.title: Southern Alps Mountain Range
nz-southern-alps-mountain-range.description: A massive snow-covered mountain chain runs through most of the South Island with thinning vegetation further south.

nz-hawkes-bay-landscape.title: Hawke's Bay Landscape
nz-hawkes-bay-landscape.description: Dry, golden-grass-covered hills with sunny conditions and a white Street View car.

nz-bright-sandy-cliff.title: Bright Sandy Cliffs
nz-bright-sandy-cliff.description: Pale, sandy cliff faces common in central Manawatu-Whanganui and parts of Taranaki, Waikato, and Hawke's Bay.

nz-glacial-lake-queenstown.title: Glacial Lakes near Queenstown
nz-glacial-lake-queenstown.description: Numerous glacial lakes with striking teal, crystal-clear water around Queenstown in the Southern Alps region.

nz-gen-2-coverage-gravel-road-northland.title: Gravel Roads in Northland
nz-gen-2-coverage-gravel-road-northland.description: Unpaved gravel roads are frequent in the Northland region.

nz-tall-hedge-tree-row-canterbury.title: Tall Hedge and Tree Rows in Canterbury
nz-tall-hedge-tree-row-canterbury.description: Tall rows of hedges and trees are common across the flat Canterbury Plains with mountains visible to the west.

nz-very-tall-hedge-bay-plenty.title: Very Tall Hedges in Bay of Plenty
nz-very-tall-hedge-bay-plenty.description: Exceptionally tall hedges are characteristic around Tauranga in the Bay of Plenty.

nz-vineyard.title: Vineyards
nz-vineyard.description: Grape vineyards are prevalent in Marlborough and Hawke's Bay.

nz-corn-field.title: Corn Fields
nz-corn-field.description: Corn cultivation is found almost exclusively on the North Island.

nz-new-zealand-flax-neat-rows-southland.title: New Zealand Flax in Neat Rows
nz-new-zealand-flax-neat-rows-southland.description: NZ flax planted in orderly, straight rows indicates the Southland region.

nz-olive-brown-square-possum-guard-marlb.title: Olive-Brown Square Possum Guards
nz-olive-brown-square-possum-guard-marlb.description: Most utility poles in Marlborough have long, square-shaped olive-brown possum guards alongside shorter silver ones.

nz-long-cylindrical-silver-possum-guard-.title: Long Cylindrical Silver Possum Guards
nz-long-cylindrical-silver-possum-guard-.description: Many utility poles in Southland have tall, cylindrical silver possum guards.

nz-holey-pole.title: Holey Poles
nz-holey-pole.description: Concrete poles with a pattern of holes are common in Southland and Auckland.

nz-square-concrete-pole-no-groove.title: Square Concrete Poles without Groove
nz-square-concrete-pole-no-groove.description: Square-profile concrete poles lacking vertical grooves are most common in Southland.

nz-off-centre-crossbar-pole.title: Off-Centre Crossbars on Poles
nz-off-centre-crossbar-pole.description: Utility poles with uneven, asymmetrical crossbars appear in Otago, Marlborough, Wellington, and Taranaki.

nz-tall-metal-bar-insulator-extension.title: Tall Metal Bar Insulator Extension
nz-tall-metal-bar-insulator-extension.description: Poles with centre insulators atop tall vertical metal bars are frequent near the Auckland-Waikato border and elsewhere in Waikato.

nz-white-painted-crossbar.title: White-Painted Crossbars
nz-white-painted-crossbar.description: Some concrete poles in eastern Waikato and Whanganui have white paint on the middle section of wooden crossbars.

nz-yellow-cow-tag-pole-gisborne.title: Yellow Cow-Tag on Poles
nz-yellow-cow-tag-pole-gisborne.description: Most poles in Gisborne have a small yellow tag resembling a cattle ear tag.

nz-yellow-danger-triangle-warning-sticke.title: Yellow Danger Triangle Warning Sticker
nz-yellow-danger-triangle-warning-sticke.description: Pole stickers with a yellow hazard triangle flanked by white rectangles appear in Hawke's Bay, Taupo-Rotorua corridor, northern Waikato, and south of Auckland.

nz-medium-black-vertical-sticker-5-digit.title: Medium Black Vertical Sticker (5 Digits)
nz-medium-black-vertical-sticker-5-digit.description: Medium black vertical stickers with five digits appear on poles in West Coast, Tasman, southern Canterbury, and southern Northland.

nz-long-black-vertical-sticker-6-digits-.title: Long Black Vertical Sticker (6 Digits with Square)
nz-long-black-vertical-sticker-6-digits-.description: Tall black vertical stickers with six digits and a small black square appear across much of the North Island and in Southland and Otago.

nz-small-black-horizontal-pole-sticker.title: Small Black Horizontal Pole Sticker
nz-small-black-horizontal-pole-sticker.description: Compact black horizontal stickers with multiple numbers are common in Taranaki and Wellington.

nz-small-white-horizontal-pole-sticker.title: Small White Horizontal Pole Sticker
nz-small-white-horizontal-pole-sticker.description: Small white horizontal stickers with several numbers appear in various North Island locations.

nz-solid-white-edge-line-no-centre-line.title: Solid White Edge Lines without Centre Lines
nz-solid-white-edge-line-no-centre-line.description: Roads with solid white edge markings but no centre line are most common in Gisborne.

nz-green-stripe-bollard-southern-canterb.title: Green Stripe Bollards
nz-green-stripe-bollard-southern-canterb.description: NZ bollards with a green stripe instead of red are common in southern Canterbury and eastern Southland.

nz-black-stripe-bollard-wellington.title: Black Stripe Bollards
nz-black-stripe-bollard-wellington.description: Bollards with a black stripe replacing red are frequent in Wellington.

nz-tightly-spaced-wooden-fence-post.title: Tightly Spaced Wooden Fence Posts
nz-tightly-spaced-wooden-fence-post.description: Wooden fences with closely packed posts are prevalent on the North Island, northern South Island, and around Akaroa.

nz-widely-spaced-wooden-fence-post.title: Widely Spaced Wooden Fence Posts
nz-widely-spaced-wooden-fence-post.description: Wooden fences with large gaps between posts are common on the South Island and in Taranaki.

nz-thin-metal-fence-post.title: Thin Metal Fence Posts
nz-thin-metal-fence-post.description: Fences with slender metal posts are found almost exclusively on the South Island.

nz-short-wooden-fence-post-extension.title: Short Wooden Fence Post Extensions
nz-short-wooden-fence-post-extension.description: Small pieces of wood attached to the top of fence posts slightly extend their height, often seen in Hawke's Bay and occasionally in Manawatu-Whanganui and Gisborne.

nz-long-wooden-fence-post-extension.title: Long Wooden Fence Post Extensions
nz-long-wooden-fence-post-extension.description: Longer wooden extensions on fence posts, taller than the short variant, are primarily found in Southland and Hawke's Bay, with occasional sightings in Otago.

nz-fruit-farm-green-netting.title: Fruit Farms with Green Netting
nz-fruit-farm-green-netting.description: Orchards draped in green protective netting are especially common around Tauranga and occasionally near Gisborne.

nz-country-flag.title: Country Flag
nz-country-flag.description: The national flag of New Zealand is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-vehicles-01-01-call-the-police.title: Vehicles 01 01 Call The Police
xx-vehicles-01-01-call-the-police.description: A police vehicle, usually white or black, trails the Nigerian Street View car in nearly every coverage. The exact model may differ from images shown.

ng-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
ng-licence-plate.description: Nigerian plates are short and appear somewhat green through Google blur.

ng-concrete-utility-pole.title: Concrete Utility Poles
ng-concrete-utility-pole.description: Nigerian utility poles are concrete with vertical indents and a few horizontal supports.

ng-poor-road-condition.title: Poor Road Conditions
ng-poor-road-condition.description: Many Nigerian roads lack lines or have faded markings with potholes and cracked surfaces.

ng-architecture.title: Architecture
ng-architecture.description: Nigerian houses are mostly single-storey with steep metal-sheet roofs and cinder-block walls.

ng-city-state-name-signage.title: City and State Names on Signage
ng-city-state-name-signage.description: Storefronts and banners often display city or state names, aiding location identification.

ng-topography.title: Topography
ng-topography.description: Nigeria is generally flat with subtle elevation changes. Hills appear from Abuja northward and near Enugu. The tallest peaks are on the Cameroon border (Mandara Range).

ng-climate-zone.title: Climate Zones
ng-climate-zone.description: Nigeria's climate ranges from tropical rainforest in the south, drier savannah in the centre, to arid steppe in the north.

ng-13-lagos.title: Lagos Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-lagos.description: In Lagos, commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are bright yellow, often with black stripes or trim.

ng-13-kano.title: Kano Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-kano.description: Kano commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are typically green, sometimes with white or yellow accents.

ng-13-rivers.title: Rivers Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-rivers.description: In Rivers State, commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are usually blue, often with white or black roof sections.

ng-13-kaduna.title: Kaduna Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-kaduna.description: Kaduna commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are painted deep green, occasionally with yellow or black details.

ng-13-oyo.title: Oyo Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-oyo.description: Oyo commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are commonly wine red or maroon, often with white or yellow roofs.

ng-13-enugu.title: Enugu Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-enugu.description: In Enugu, commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are white with green stripes or accents.

ng-13-anambra.title: Anambra Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-anambra.description: Anambra commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are typically blue with white or yellow highlights.

ng-13-borno.title: Borno Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-borno.description: Borno commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are usually light or sky blue, sometimes with white or black accents.

ng-13-delta.title: Delta Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-delta.description: Delta commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are yellow and black, often in a two-tone pattern.

ng-13-edo.title: Edo Commercial Vehicle Colours
ng-13-edo.description: Edo commercial vehicles and tuk-tuks are painted red, sometimes with white or yellow roofs.

xx-misc-01-islamic-outfits.title: Misc 01 Islamic Outfits
xx-misc-01-islamic-outfits.description: You are more likely to see women wearing hijabs and men dressed in traditional Islamic outfits in the northern regions of Nigeria.

ng-haystack-kaduna-state.title: Haystacks, Kaduna State
ng-haystack-kaduna-state.description: Large haystacks are extremely common and almost exclusively found in Kaduna state.

ng-kano-state-arid-cornfield.title: Kano Arid Cornfields
ng-kano-state-arid-cornfield.description: An arid yet green agricultural landscape with abundant corn fields points to Kano state.

ng-benue-state-green-grass-red-soil.title: Benue Green Grass and Red Soil
ng-benue-state-green-grass-red-soil.description: Lush green grass with reddish soil, scattered tall trees, and thatched huts characterise Benue state.

ng-niger-state-crapcam-savannah.title: Niger Scattered Trees and Red Soil
ng-niger-state-crapcam-savannah.description: Scattered trees, reddish soil, and dry grass cover most of Niger state.

ng-northwest-state-open-arid-landscape.title: Northwest Open Arid Landscape
ng-northwest-state-open-arid-landscape.description: Kebbi, Sokoto, Zamfara, and Katsina have an open, arid landscape with very sparse or no tree cover.

ng-northeast-rocky-hill.title: Northeast Rocky Hills
ng-northeast-rocky-hill.description: Savannah terrain dotted with rocky hills appears across Plateau, Bauchi, Gombe, Adamawa, and northern Taraba.

ng-monolithic-mountain-abuja-area.title: Monolithic Mountains, Abuja Area
ng-monolithic-mountain-abuja-area.description: Large monolithic outcrops of exposed, weathered rock are common in and around Abuja.

ng-29-lagos.title: Lagos Follow Car
ng-29-lagos.description: In Lagos, the follow car is typically a white Toyota Hilux with blue police lights on the roof.

ng-29-kano.title: Kano Follow Car
ng-29-kano.description: Kano's follow car is usually a silver Toyota Hilux, sometimes with a black bull bar.

ng-29-rivers.title: Rivers Follow Car
ng-29-rivers.description: In Rivers State, the follow car is most often a dark blue Toyota Hilux with a red and blue police light bar.

ng-29-oyo.title: Oyo Follow Car
ng-29-oyo.description: Oyo's follow car is a white Toyota Hilux with no visible police lights or markings.

ng-29-kaduna.title: Kaduna Follow Car
ng-29-kaduna.description: Kaduna's follow car is a silver Toyota Hilux, often with a blue police light bar and sometimes a front bull bar.

ng-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ng-country-flag.description: The national flag of Nigeria is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

mp-tropical-landscape.title: Tropical Landscape
mp-tropical-landscape.description: The islands feature dense, low tropical vegetation throughout.

mp-abundant-road-reflectors.title: Abundant Road Reflectors
mp-abundant-road-reflectors.description: Roads have a very high density of reflectors, shared with Guam.

mp-east-asian-language-signage.title: East Asian Language Signage
mp-east-asian-language-signage.description: Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and Russian text appear frequently on commercial signs.

mp-commercial-area.title: Commercial Areas
mp-commercial-area.description: Denser commercial zones are along Saipan's southern west coast.

mp-country-flag.title: Country Flag
mp-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Northern Mariana Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

no-wooden-house.title: Wooden Houses
no-wooden-house.description: Norwegian homes are mostly wooden, often red-painted; black-painted houses are more common here than in neighbors.

xx-license-plates-01-green-license-plate.title: License Plates 01 Green License Plates
xx-license-plates-01-green-license-plate.description: In Norway, commercial license plates are green, and are often seen on vans.

no-road-line-long-dash.title: Road Line Markings with Long Dashes
no-road-line-long-dash.description: Smaller roads have white edge lines with long dashes; larger roads have solid edge lines and yellow center lines with an orange tint.

no-dotted-road-line.title: Dotted Paint Pattern on Road Lines
no-dotted-road-line.description: Norwegian road markings often use small dots of paint instead of solid lines.

no-norwegian-language-char.title: Norwegian Language Characters
no-norwegian-language-char.description: Norwegian uses special characters Æ, Ø, Å and writes "kk" where Swedish uses "ck".

no-bollard-black-parallelogram.title: Bollards with Black Parallelogram Reflector
no-bollard-black-parallelogram.description: Norwegian bollards are slender curved posts with a reflector inside a black parallelogram.

no-orange-snow-pole-mid-reflector.title: Orange Snow Poles with Mid-Height Reflector
no-orange-snow-pole-mid-reflector.description: Snow poles are orange with a narrow white reflector roughly at mid-height.

no-wooden-snow-pole-reflector.title: Wooden Snow Poles with Painted Reflectors
no-wooden-snow-pole-reflector.description: Thin wooden snow poles with painted reflectors are common.

no-guardrail-wooden-post.title: Guardrails with Wooden Posts
no-guardrail-wooden-post.description: Metal guardrails are often supported by wooden posts.

no-pedestrian-crossing-four-stripe.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signs with Four Stripes
no-pedestrian-crossing-four-stripe.description: Norwegian pedestrian signs show a figure with four stripes on the crossing.

no-blue-passing-place-sign.title: Blue Passing Place Signs
no-blue-passing-place-sign.description: Smaller roads frequently display blue signs bearing a large white letter M, indicating passing places.

no-bus-stop-sign.title: Bus Stop Signs
no-bus-stop-sign.description: Norwegian bus stops are marked by a small blue sign featuring a white bus icon.

no-sone-speed-zone-sign.title: "Sone" Speed Zone Signs
no-sone-speed-zone-sign.description: White signs displaying the word "Sone" along with a speed limit are common in Norwegian urban areas.

no-street-name-suffix.title: Street Name Suffixes (Vei and Gate)
no-street-name-suffix.description: The most typical Norwegian street name endings are "vei" and "gate." When attached to a name, they become "-veien" and "-gata" or "-gate."

no-centered-street-sign-post.title: Centered Street Signs on Posts
no-centered-street-sign-post.description: Street name signs in Norway are typically mounted centered on top of the sign post.

no-bright-yellow-construction-sign.title: Bright Yellow Construction Signs
no-bright-yellow-construction-sign.description: Road construction zones in Norway use warning signs with a vivid yellow background.

no-sign-mount-four-bolt.title: Sign Mounting with Four Bolts
no-sign-mount-four-bolt.description: Norwegian road signs are fastened with four visible bolts arranged in a tall rectangular pattern.

xx-general-01-64-black-and-yellow.title: General 01 64 Black And Yellow
xx-general-01-64-black-and-yellow.description: In Norway, you can see black and yellow chevrons.

no-distance-marker-sign.title: Distance Marker Signs
no-distance-marker-sign.description: Small white square signs show a road number at the top and the distance to the nearest town below on mid-sized roads.

no-wooden-utility-pole-black-cap.title: Wooden Utility Poles with Black Caps
no-wooden-utility-pole-black-cap.description: Utility poles in Norway are usually made of wood and often topped with a small black metal cap.

no-lamp-mount-single-bolt.title: Lamp Mounting with Single Thick Bolt
no-lamp-mount-single-bolt.description: Street lamps attached to wooden poles in Norway use a single thick bolt for mounting.

no-grass-covered-roof.title: Grass-Covered Roofs
no-grass-covered-roof.description: Traditional Norwegian buildings often feature living grass growing on their rooftops.

no-road-number-first-digit-pattern.title: Road Number First-Digit Regional Pattern
no-road-number-first-digit-pattern.description: The leading digit of Norwegian road numbers corresponds to geographic regions, with some exceptions.

no-bilingual-sami-sign-north.title: Bilingual Sámi Signs in Northern Areas
no-bilingual-sami-sign-north.description: Parts of northern Norway display signs in both Norwegian and a Sámi language, identified by letters Á, Đ, and multiple consecutive vowels.

no-bracken-fern-southern-norway.title: Bracken Ferns in Southern Norway
no-bracken-fern-southern-norway.description: Bracken ferns with tall stems and wide leaf fronds grow predominantly in southern Norway.

no-spruce-tree.title: Spruce Trees
no-spruce-tree.description: Spruce trees are concentrated in the southern half of Norway, especially in the southeast and Trondheim region.

no-pine-tree.title: Pine Trees
no-pine-tree.description: Pines are most prevalent along coastal areas and far inland zones within southern Norway.

no-oak-tree.title: Oak Trees
no-oak-tree.description: Oak trees in Norway are almost entirely restricted to the far southern part of the country.

no-maple-tree.title: Maple Trees
no-maple-tree.description: Maples grow primarily in southern Norway, especially around Oslo's agricultural areas.

no-bright-coloured-moss.title: Brightly Coloured Moss
no-bright-coloured-moss.description: Vivid, colourful moss is common from Lillehammer to Oppdal.

no-three-major-farmland-region.title: Three Major Farmland Regions
no-three-major-farmland-region.description: Norway's large agricultural zones are concentrated in the southeast, Trondheim surroundings, and south of Stavanger.

no-southeast-farmland-oslo.title: Southeast Farmlands near Oslo
no-southeast-farmland-oslo.description: The biggest farmland stretch lies in the southeast around Oslo, with flat, gently rolling terrain and smooth forested hills.

no-trondheim-area-farmland.title: Trondheim-Area Farmlands
no-trondheim-area-farmland.description: Agricultural land around Trondheim sits on steep, uneven hills more rugged than the southeast.

no-stavanger-area-farmland-jaeren.title: Stavanger-Area Farmlands
no-stavanger-area-farmland-jaeren.description: Farmland south of Stavanger is relatively flat with wide fields and common rock walls made of large rounded stones.

no-deep-fjord-tall-mountain.title: Deep Fjords with Tall Mountains
no-deep-fjord-tall-mountain.description: The deepest fjords flanked by towering mountains are concentrated between Bergen and Trondheim.

no-lofoten-jagged-rocky-mountain.title: Lofoten's Jagged Rocky Mountains
no-lofoten-jagged-rocky-mountain.description: The Lofoten Archipelago features sharp rocky peaks with very sparse tree cover.

no-northeast-norway-rolling-terrain.title: Northeast Norway Rolling Terrain
no-northeast-norway-rolling-terrain.description: Northeastern Norway has gently rolling terrain with small birch trees and patchy grass.

no-barren-highland-southwest.title: Barren Highlands in the Southwest
no-barren-highland-southwest.description: Treeless highland plateaus with rocky mountains along the road characterize southwestern Norway.

no-exposed-rock-south-coast.title: Exposed Rock on the South Coast
no-exposed-rock-south-coast.description: Bare rock outcrops with small coastal pines and low bushes are typical of Norway's southern coastline.

no-coastal-grassland-far-north.title: Coastal Grasslands
no-coastal-grassland-far-north.description: Roads along the far northern coast pass through open grasslands with minimal vegetation and low, distant mountains.

no-white-wooden-house-south-coast.title: White Wooden Houses
no-white-wooden-house-south-coast.description: Entire villages of all-white wooden houses are distinctive along Norway's southern coastline.

no-black-snow-pole-bergen-trondheim.title: Black Snow Poles
no-black-snow-pole-bergen-trondheim.description: Snow poles painted black are common between Bergen and Trondheim.

no-wide-black-pole-plate-southeast.title: Wide Black Pole Plates
no-wide-black-pole-plate-southeast.description: Small, wide black ID plates with alphanumeric characters appear on utility poles in southeastern Norway.

no-rusty-guardrail-west-coast.title: Rusty Guardrails
no-rusty-guardrail-west-coast.description: Rusty guardrails are prevalent along the southern half of Norway's west coast.

no-svalbard-archipelago.title: Svalbard Archipelago
no-svalbard-archipelago.description: Svalbard is a Norwegian Arctic archipelago with separate coverage and guide.

no-russian-border-road-appearance.title: Russian Border Road Look
no-russian-border-road-appearance.description: Roads near the Russian border have a humid, green look with overcast, foggy conditions and low birches and pines.

no-country-flag.title: Country Flag
no-country-flag.description: The national flag of Norway is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

om-arabic-language.title: Arabic
om-arabic-language.description: Arabic is Oman's sole official language; signage often appears in Arabic and English.

om-yellow-edge-line-white-centre-line.title: Yellow Edge Lines with White Centre Lines
om-yellow-edge-line-white-centre-line.description: Omani roads have yellow lines along edges and white lines down the centre.

om-black-yellow-curb.title: Black-and-Yellow Curbs
om-black-yellow-curb.description: Kerbs painted in alternating black and yellow segments are widespread on Omani roads.

om-light-stone-architecture-ornate-fence.title: Light Stone Architecture with Ornate Fences
om-light-stone-architecture-ornate-fence.description: Omani homes are pale stone with decorative details, enclosed by matching stone fences with elaborate gates.

om-blue-directional-sign.title: Blue Directional Signs
om-blue-directional-sign.description: Omani road signs are blue with white lettering, showing Arabic and English text.

om-striped-signpost.title: Striped Signposts
om-striped-signpost.description: Sign poles in Oman often have alternating black-and-white horizontal stripes.

om-wooden-utility-pole.title: Wooden Utility Poles
om-wooden-utility-pole.description: Wooden power poles in Oman have three distinct top designs, including a unique metal triangle above one variant.

om-red-white-high-voltage-pylon.title: Red-and-White High Voltage Pylons
om-red-white-high-voltage-pylon.description: Electricity transmission towers painted red and white stripes are common across Oman.

om-beah-garbage-bin.title: Be'ah Garbage Bins
om-beah-garbage-bin.description: Omani rubbish bins are black plastic or grey metal with a three-leaf logo and 'be'ah' text.

om-white-taxi-orange-panel.title: White Taxis with Orange Panels
om-white-taxi-orange-panel.description: Omani taxis are white with distinctive orange panels on both sides.

om-northern-dry-mountain.title: Northern Dry Mountains
om-northern-dry-mountain.description: Northern Oman has arid, rocky mountain terrain resembling eastern UAE.

om-southern-rolling-hill-salalah.title: Southern Rolling Hills near Salalah
om-southern-rolling-hill-salalah.description: The Salalah area features hilly terrain with rocky ground, scattered bushes, small trees, and green valleys.

om-green-vegetation-north-nizwa.title: Green Vegetation North of Nizwa
om-green-vegetation-north-nizwa.description: Mountains north of Nizwa have lush green bushes and jagged rocky peaks.

om-acacia-tree.title: Acacia Trees
om-acacia-tree.description: Short trees with flat, umbrella-shaped canopies, acacias are most prevalent in northern Oman and some coastal areas.

om-date-palm-plantation.title: Date Palm Plantations
om-date-palm-plantation.description: Groves of date palms are concentrated along Oman's northern coast.

om-red-sandy-dune.title: Red Sandy Dunes
om-red-sandy-dune.description: Dunes with a reddish hue appear near the Saudi border and in Oman's central interior.

om-country-flag.title: Country Flag
om-country-flag.description: The national flag of Oman is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

pk-urdu-english-signage.title: Urdu and English Signage
pk-urdu-english-signage.description: Urdu is the national language on signs, using a script related to Arabic with softer fonts; English is also common.

pk-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
pk-licence-plate.description: Pakistani plates are short with region-specific designs, mostly showing Punjab designs with a green strip.

pk-mughal-garden.title: Mughal Gardens
pk-mughal-garden.description: Coverage includes large, orderly gardens enclosed by stone walls featuring historic temples or fortresses.

pk-brightly-coloured-baggy-trouser.title: Brightly Coloured Baggy Trousers
pk-brightly-coloured-baggy-trouser.description: Vibrantly coloured, loose-fitting trousers are extremely common on pedestrians.

pk-jallo-hazy-suburb.title: Jallo, Hazy Suburbs
pk-jallo-hazy-suburb.description: An eastern suburb of Lahore with semi-urban, lower-income housing under a thick haze.

pk-katas-hazy-hill.title: Katas, Hazy Hills
pk-katas-hazy-hill.description: Coverage north of Sargodha with hilly terrain under a hazy sky.

pk-patriata-pine-covered-hill.title: Patriata, Pine-Covered Hills
pk-patriata-pine-covered-hill.description: Forested hills thick with tall pines northeast of Islamabad, partly captured from an aerial lift.

pk-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pk-country-flag.description: The national flag of Pakistan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

pa-tropical-hilly-landscape.title: Tropical Hilly Landscape
pa-tropical-hilly-landscape.description: Panama features tropical landscape with palms, rolling hills, and a mix of dry fields and dense vegetation.

pa-living-fence-post.title: Living Fence Posts
pa-living-fence-post.description: Panamanian roadside fences are often built from small living trees, with remaining posts also wooden.

pa-architecture.title: Spanish Colonial Architecture
pa-architecture.description: Panamanian buildings show Spanish colonial influence, with vivid painted concrete or brick walls and red metal-sheet or tile roofs.

pa-road-line.title: Road Lines
pa-road-line.description: Typical road markings are solid white edges with a yellow centre line; solid white edges with no centre line are nearly unique to Panama.

pa-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
pa-utility-pole.description: Panamanian utility poles are mostly round concrete with varying insulators; blue, white, or red numbers and metal plates are common.

pa-eye-warning-sign.title: Eye Warning Signs
pa-eye-warning-sign.description: Red octagonal signs with a realistic eye illustration are unique to Panama.

pa-phone-number-area-code.title: Phone Number Area Codes
pa-phone-number-area-code.description: In Panama, the first digit of a 7-digit phone number indicates the region; two-digit codes provide more precision.

pa-taxi-bus-plate-code.title: Taxi and Bus Plate Codes
pa-taxi-bus-plate-code.description: Leading digit on taxi and bus licence plates corresponds to a province in Panama.

pa-colon-panama-city-lush-tropic.title: Colón / Panama City Tropics
pa-colon-panama-city-lush-tropic.description: Dense green vegetation with palms and very tall grass characterizes areas around Colón and Panama City.

pa-aguadulce-flat-agriculture.title: Aguadulce Agriculture
pa-aguadulce-flat-agriculture.description: Flat terrain with agricultural fields and distinctly brown or orange soil surrounds Aguadulce.

pa-eastern-vertical-pole-plate.title: Eastern Vertical Pole Plates
pa-eastern-vertical-pole-plate.description: Tall, narrow yellow or white plates fastened to poles with black zip ties appear in eastern provinces.

pa-western-horizontal-pole-plate.title: Western Horizontal Pole Plates
pa-western-horizontal-pole-plate.description: Horizontal plates attached to poles are common in western provinces; eastern vertical plates override if both appear.

pa-yellow-border-plate-colon.title: Yellow Border Plates, Colón
pa-yellow-border-plate-colon.description: Thin yellow plates with a black border, vertical or horizontal, are most common in Colón Province.

pa-wind-turbine-penonome.title: Wind Turbines Near Penonomé
pa-wind-turbine-penonome.description: Wind turbines are visible both south and north of Penonomé.

pa-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pa-country-flag.description: The national flag of Panama is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

pe-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
pe-licence-plate.description: Peruvian plates are white or yellow; taxis have split-coloured plates, yellow on top and white on bottom.

pe-road-line-marking.title: Road Line Markings
pe-road-line-marking.description: Peruvian outer road lines are always white. Highways have single or double yellow centre lines. Rural mountain roads often lack a centre line.

pe-triangular-concrete-bollard.title: Triangular Concrete Bollards
pe-triangular-concrete-bollard.description: Peruvian bollards are usually red or yellow triangular concrete shapes; circular concrete variants also appear.

pe-black-yellow-guardrail.title: Black-and-Yellow Guardrails
pe-black-yellow-guardrail.description: Peruvian guardrails commonly have black-and-yellow diagonal stripes; other designs like sharp arrows also appear.

pe-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
pe-kilometre-marker.description: Concrete kilometre markers painted black and white are found along Peruvian roads.

pe-road-signs-01-01-concrete-foundations.title: Road Signs 01 01 Concrete Foundations
pe-road-signs-01-01-concrete-foundations.description: Metal signs in Peru are standing on visible concrete plinths.

xx-pole-01-02-peruvian-poles.title: Pole 01 02 Peruvian Poles
xx-pole-01-02-peruvian-poles.description: In Peru, you can often see concrete utility poles with three horizontal crossarms.

pe-painted-pole-base.title: Painted Pole Bases
pe-painted-pole-base.description: Some Peruvian utility poles have lower sections painted black or black-and-yellow stripes.

pe-orange-painted-bridge.title: Orange-Painted Bridges
pe-orange-painted-bridge.description: Peruvian bridges are often painted orange.

pe-semi-arid-mountain-landscape.title: Semi-Arid Mountain Landscape
pe-semi-arid-mountain-landscape.description: Much of Peru has dry mountain ranges and valleys with sparse vegetation.

pe-vehicles-01-tuk-tuks.title: Vehicles 01 Tuk Tuks
pe-vehicles-01-tuk-tuks.description: Tuk Tuks are a common sight in Peru. They are usually referred to as mototaxi.

pe-red-white-vehicle-sticker.title: Red-and-White Vehicle Stickers
pe-red-white-vehicle-sticker.description: Wide red-and-white reflective stickers are common on taxis and commercial vehicles in Peru.

pe-sol-currency.title: Sol Currency (S/.)
pe-sol-currency.description: The Peruvian sol, written as S/, appears on shop signs and ads.

pe-political-party-logo.title: Political Party Logos
pe-political-party-logo.description: Peruvian political party logos are often painted on walls and buildings.

pe-terrain-overview-east-west.title: Terrain Overview, East vs. West
pe-terrain-overview-east-west.description: Eastern Peru is generally flat; western Peru is mountainous.

pe-climate-zone.title: Climate Zones
pe-climate-zone.description: Western coast is arid desert; eastern lowlands are tropical rainforest; Andes create transitional climates.

pe-highway-numbering-system.title: Highway Numbering System
pe-highway-numbering-system.description: Western highways increase in number from north to south; Routes 1, 3, and 5 are longest.

pe-tumbes-off-road-landscape.title: Tumbes Off-Road Landscapes
pe-tumbes-off-road-landscape.description: Tumbes off-road areas have sandy soil with green or dry shrubs.

pe-southwestern-piura-dry-flat-terrain.title: Southwestern Piura, Dry Flat Terrain
pe-southwestern-piura-dry-flat-terrain.description: Southwest of Piura is dry, sparsely vegetated, mostly flat with gentle hills.

pe-northwestern-piura-hilly-terrain.title: Northwestern Piura, Hilly Terrain
pe-northwestern-piura-hilly-terrain.description: Northwest of Piura has similar vegetation but more hilly terrain.

pe-coconut-tall-palm-tree.title: Coconut and Tall Palm Trees
pe-coconut-tall-palm-tree.description: Coconut and tall palms grow in coastal farming areas north of Lima and near large coastal cities.

pe-sugar-cane-field.title: Sugar Cane Fields
pe-sugar-cane-field.description: Large sugar cane plantations are near northern coastal cities Chiclayo and Trujillo.

pe-banana-plantation.title: Banana Plantations
pe-banana-plantation.description: Bananas grow in northern coastal agricultural zones, similar to sugar cane.

pe-flat-highland-plateau.title: Flat Highland Plateaus
pe-flat-highland-plateau.description: Flat high-altitude terrain appears in central Puno and around Lake Chinchaycocha.

pe-scrubby-mountain-far-north.title: Scrubby Mountains in the Far North
pe-scrubby-mountain-far-north.description: Far northern Peruvian mountains have low shrubs and scrubby trees, often arid near coast and Ecuador.

pe-pine-plantation-high-elevation.title: Pine Plantations at High Elevation
pe-pine-plantation-high-elevation.description: Planted pine forests grow at higher elevations away from coastal deserts and Amazon basin.

pe-rocky-outcrop-central-highland.title: Rocky Outcrops in the Central Highlands
pe-rocky-outcrop-central-highland.description: Exposed rock faces are common on hillsides in central Peru from Lago Chinchaycocha south to Ayacucho.

pe-jagged-mountain-peak.title: Jagged Mountain Peaks
pe-jagged-mountain-peak.description: Tall, sharp rocky peaks are typical from Huaraz south to Cusco, away from the coast.

pe-light-green-lichen.title: Light Green Lichen
pe-light-green-lichen.description: Pale green lichen patches cover rocks and ground at high altitudes in central and southern Peru.

pe-dark-red-soil.title: Dark Red Soil
pe-dark-red-soil.description: Reddish-tinted earth appears notably around Cusco, Ayacucho, Cajamarca, and Tarapoto.

pe-southern-coastal-desert.title: Southern Coastal Desert
pe-southern-coastal-desert.description: From Ica down to Tacna, the landscape is a barren, flat desert with distant mountains to the east.

pe-coastal-agricultural-valley.title: Coastal Agricultural Valleys
pe-coastal-agricultural-valley.description: Green farming valleys run southwest-to-northeast between barren mountains in central and southern Peru.

pe-overhanging-roof-wooden-support.title: Overhanging Roofs with Wooden Supports
pe-overhanging-roof-wooden-support.description: Buildings with outward-extending roofs on wooden supports, often brightly painted, common in northern Peru.

pe-open-front-tuk-tuk.title: Open-Front Tuk-Tuks
pe-open-front-tuk-tuk.description: Tuk-tuks with exposed front compartments mainly in northern Peru, especially near northern Amazonian regions.

pe-moquegua-cylindrical-bollard.title: Moquegua Cylindrical Bollard
pe-moquegua-cylindrical-bollard.description: Cylindrical bollard topped a yellow stripe can be seen in the southern parts of Peru. A version with a black stripe is exclusive to southern Moquegua.

pe-ruta-5n-san-alejandro-esperanza.title: Ruta 5N, San Alejandro to Esperanza
pe-ruta-5n-san-alejandro-esperanza.description: Well-maintained, straight, flat north–south road through dense rainforest.

pe-ruta-28b-kimbiri-echarate.title: Ruta 28B, Kimbiri to Echarate
pe-ruta-28b-kimbiri-echarate.description: Narrow paved hillside road following a river valley with faded or absent lane markings.

pe-volcano-near-arequipa.title: Volcanoes Near Arequipa
pe-volcano-near-arequipa.description: Volcanic peaks frequently visible in and around Arequipa in southeastern Peru.

pe-lima-boulevard.title: Lima Boulevards
pe-lima-boulevard.description: Wide, long, straight streets split by concrete or grassy strips are most common in Lima.

pe-pucallpa-street-grid.title: Pucallpa Street Grid
pe-pucallpa-street-grid.description: Pucallpa has a uniform street grid oriented WSW–ENE.

pe-iquitos.title: Iquitos
pe-iquitos.description: Isolated northeastern city with overcast skies, three-wheeled tuk-tuks, and rolling Amazonian terrain.

pe-cusco.title: Cusco
pe-cusco.description: Southern highland city encircled by mountains with red-brick and colonial Spanish architecture.

pe-aguas-calientes-cusco-train-trekker.title: Aguas Calientes–Cusco Train Trekker
pe-aguas-calientes-cusco-train-trekker.description: Trekker follows railway line connecting Aguas Calientes with Cusco.

pe-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pe-country-flag.description: The national flag of Peru is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ph-licence-plate-green-tint.title: Licence Plates with Green Tint
ph-licence-plate-green-tint.description: Many Philippine vehicles carry privately issued plates with a distinctive greenish tint.

ph-octagonal-metal-pole.title: Octagonal Metal Poles
ph-octagonal-metal-pole.description: Utility poles with octagonal cross-section are common in the Philippines.

ph-side-mounted-pole-insulator.title: Side-Mounted Pole Insulators
ph-side-mounted-pole-insulator.description: Single insulator atop a short vertical bar attached to the side of utility poles is common.

ph-yellow-white-road-marking.title: Yellow and White Road Markings
ph-yellow-white-road-marking.description: Philippine centre lines may be yellow, white, or a side-by-side combination.

ph-yellow-kilometre-stone.title: Yellow Kilometre Stones
ph-yellow-kilometre-stone.description: Tall, square-shaped yellow road markers unique to the Philippines.

ph-red-white-chevron-sign.title: Red-on-White Chevron Signs
ph-red-white-chevron-sign.description: Philippine road curve chevrons use red arrows on white backgrounds.

ph-colourful-sign-post.title: Colourful Sign Posts
ph-colourful-sign-post.description: Posts supporting road signs are frequently painted red, orange, or yellow.

ph-tricycle-tuk-tuk.title: Tricycles / Tuk-Tuks
ph-tricycle-tuk-tuk.description: Motorised tricycles (tuk-tuks) are ubiquitous and often outnumber cars.

ph-grain-drying-road.title: Grain Drying on Roads
ph-grain-drying-road.description: Harvested grain is often spread out on roads for drying.

ph-regional-tricycle-design.title: Regional Tricycle Designs
ph-regional-tricycle-design.description: Different islands and regions use distinct tricycle and tuk-tuk designs.

ph-province-name-sign.title: Province Names on Signs
ph-province-name-sign.description: Philippine province names appear often on signs and help with location.

ph-phone-number-area-code.title: Phone Number Area Code
ph-phone-number-area-code.description: Landline numbers start with 0 plus regional code; mobile numbers start with 09.

ph-17-ilocos-norte.title: Ilocos Norte Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-ilocos-norte.description: Motorcycle plates have a colored strip along the top edge with the alphanumeric code below on a white background.

ph-17-la-union.title: 17 La Union
ph-17-la-union.description: Motorcycle plates have a colored strip at the top with the registration code beneath on white.

ph-17-pangasinan.title: Pangasinan Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-pangasinan.description: Motorcycle plates have a colored band at the top edge with the registration number below on white.

ph-17-cagayan.title: Cagayan Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-cagayan.description: Motorcycle plates show a colored band at the top with the registration code below on white.

ph-17-isabela.title: Isabela Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-isabela.description: Motorcycle plates feature a colored strip along the top edge with the registration number below on white.

ph-17-nueva-vizcaya.title: Nueva Vizcaya Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-nueva-vizcaya.description: Motorcycle plates have a colored band at the top with the registration code below on white.

ph-17-quirino.title: Quirino Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-quirino.description: Motorcycle plates display a colored band at the top with the registration number beneath on white.

ph-17-apayao.title: Apayao Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-apayao.description: Motorcycle plates feature a colored band at the top with the registration code below on white.

ph-17-abra.title: Abra Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-abra.description: Motorcycle plates have a colored strip at the top with the registration number below on white.

ph-17-kalinga.title: Kalinga Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-kalinga.description: Motorcycle plates display a colored band at the top with the registration code below on white.

ph-17-mountain.title: Mountain Province Motorcycle Plate
ph-17-mountain.description: Motorcycle plates have a colored band at the top with the registration number below on white.

ph-17-davao-del-sur.title: Davao del Sur Motorcycle Plate

ph-corn-field.title: Corn Fields
ph-corn-field.description: Corn cultivation is a common sight all over the Philippines.

ph-oil-palm-plantation.title: Oil Palm Plantations
ph-oil-palm-plantation.description: Nearly all oil palm plantations are on Mindanao.

ph-sugarcane-field.title: Sugarcane Fields
ph-sugarcane-field.description: Most sugarcane is grown on Negros and Panay.

ph-pineapple-plantation.title: Pineapple Plantations
ph-pineapple-plantation.description: Large-scale pineapple farming is concentrated on Mindanao.

ph-banana-plantation.title: Banana Plantations
ph-banana-plantation.description: Commercial banana plantations are almost exclusively in central and southern Mindanao.

ph-moluccan-albizia-tree.title: Moluccan Albizia Trees
ph-moluccan-albizia-tree.description: These trees have pale trunks and feathery pinnate leaves clustered near the crown, mainly on eastern and central Mindanao.

ph-amakan-wall-diamond-pattern.title: Amakan Walls with Diamond Pattern
ph-amakan-wall-diamond-pattern.description: Houses with woven bamboo walls in a diamond pattern are found almost exclusively in the southern half of the Philippines.

ph-amakan-sawali-wall-diagonal-weave.title: Amakan / Sawali Walls with Diagonal Weave
ph-amakan-sawali-wall-diagonal-weave.description: Woven bamboo walls with a diagonal pattern are most prevalent on Palawan and across the northern half of the country.

ph-yellow-black-concrete-guardrail.title: Yellow-and-Black Concrete Guardrails
ph-yellow-black-concrete-guardrail.description: Concrete guardrails painted with alternating yellow and black stripes are specific to the Cordillera Administrative Region.

ph-bicol-guardrail-three-black-stripes.title: Bicol Guardrails with Three Black Stripes
ph-bicol-guardrail-three-black-stripes.description: White guardrails with a repeating set of three black stripes are unique to the Bicol region in southern Luzon.

ph-chile-style-indented-concrete-pole.title: Chile-Style Indented Concrete Poles
ph-chile-style-indented-concrete-pole.description: Square concrete utility poles with a visible indent on each side are found mainly north of Manila and around Bacolod on Negros.

ph-square-metal-mesh-pole-zamboanga.title: Square Metal Mesh Poles on Zamboanga
ph-square-metal-mesh-pole-zamboanga.description: Utility poles built from square metal mesh are found primarily on the Zamboanga peninsula in Mindanao.

ph-muslim-majority-western-mindanao.title: Muslim Majority Area in Western Mindanao
ph-muslim-majority-western-mindanao.description: A region in western Mindanao has a Muslim majority population.

ph-mountain-dew-bottle-decoration.title: Mountain Dew Bottle Decorations
ph-mountain-dew-bottle-decoration.description: Neon-green Mountain Dew bottles repurposed as decorations are common in northern Luzon.

ph-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ph-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Philippines is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-54-jeepneys.title: General 01 54 Jeepneys
xx-general-01-54-jeepneys.description: In the Philippines it is common to find jeepneys in urban environments. They are often heavily decorated.

pn-dense-tropical-forest.title: Dense Tropical Forest
pn-dense-tropical-forest.description: Pitcairn Island is semi-tropical and thickly forested, with narrow dirt tracks winding through the trees.

pn-red-soil.title: Red Soil
pn-red-soil.description: Pitcairn's exposed soil is characteristically deep red.

pn-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pn-country-flag.description: The national flag of the Pitcairn Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

pl-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
pl-licence-plate.description: Polish plates are long and white with the standard EU blue strip on the left.

pl-double-white-centre-line.title: Double White Centre Lines
pl-double-white-centre-line.description: All road markings are white in Poland. Double centre lines are extremely common.

pl-b-type-guardrail-red-reflector.title: Guardrails with Red Reflectors
pl-b-type-guardrail-red-reflector.description: Polish guardrails are fitted with circular red reflectors.

pl-white-prohibitory-sign.title: White Prohibitory Signs
pl-white-prohibitory-sign.description: Polish round prohibitory signs use a white background with a thicker red border.

pl-town-entry-sign.title: Town Entry Signs
pl-town-entry-sign.description: Polish towns have two signs: a green one with the locality name and a white-and-black one with a stylised urban silhouette, both in a Polish typeface.

pl-chevron.title: Chevrons
pl-chevron.description: Polish chevrons are white boards with red arrows.

pl-polish-language.title: Polish Language
pl-polish-language.description: A West Slavic language with unique diacritics like Ł, Ą, Ę, Ż, and Ń, and W replacing V.

pl-flat-green-landscape.title: Flat Green Landscape
pl-flat-green-landscape.description: Poland features flat terrain with gentle hills, extensive agriculture, and moderate forest cover.

pl-tree-lined-road.title: Tree-Lined Roads
pl-tree-lined-road.description: Rows of mature trees flanking both sides of roads are common across Poland.

pl-tiled-sidewalk.title: Tiled Sidewalks
pl-tiled-sidewalk.description: Polish pavements commonly use neatly laid grey or light red paving tiles in various patterns.

pl-architecture.title: Architecture
pl-architecture.description: Central European style with plain stone walls, pastel stucco, and orange, red, black, or brown roof tiles; detached homes and communist-era blocks.

pl-roadside-christian-shrine.title: Roadside Christian Shrines
pl-roadside-christian-shrine.description: Small roadside shrines and blue-white or yellow-white Catholic flags are frequent.

pl-regional-road-numbering.title: Regional Road Numbering
pl-regional-road-numbering.description: Three-digit regional road numbers cluster geographically; the first digit indicates the region, often shown in yellow boxes.

pl-telephone-area-code.title: Telephone Area Codes
pl-telephone-area-code.description: Polish landline numbers have 9 digits; the first two form an area code mapping logically across the country.

pl-place-name-suffix.title: Place Name Suffixes
pl-place-name-suffix.description: Suffixes like -owo, -ów, -ino/-yno, and -ew help identify regions within Poland.

pl-22-pomeranian-voivodeship.title: Kashubian-Polish Bilingual Signs
pl-22-pomeranian-voivodeship.description: Signs show Polish above and Kashubian below, with Kashubian featuring distinctive diacritics and letters.

pl-22-opole-voivodeship.title: German-Polish Bilingual Signs
pl-22-opole-voivodeship.description: Place-name signs show Polish above and German below, with German including umlauts and ß.

pl-22-podlaskie-voivodeship.title: Belarusian-Polish Bilingual Signs (Eastern Podlaskie)
pl-22-podlaskie-voivodeship.description: Signs show Polish above and Belarusian in Cyrillic below near the Belarusian border.

pl-22-lublin-voivodeship.title: Belarusian-Polish Bilingual Signs (Lublin)
pl-22-lublin-voivodeship.description: Signs show Polish above and Belarusian in Cyrillic below in eastern Lublin villages.

pl-22-masovian-voivodeship.title: Belarusian-Polish Bilingual Signs (Masovian)
pl-22-masovian-voivodeship.description: Signs show Polish above and Belarusian in Cyrillic below in eastern Masovian villages.

pl-22-warmian-masurian-voivodeship.title: Lithuanian-Polish Bilingual Signs (Warmian-Masurian)
pl-22-warmian-masurian-voivodeship.description: Signs show Polish above and Lithuanian below, with Lithuanian-specific letters, near the Lithuanian border.

pl-22-lesser-poland-voivodeship.title: Lemko-Polish Bilingual Signs (Lesser Poland)
pl-22-lesser-poland-voivodeship.description: Signs show Polish above and Lemko in Cyrillic below in southeastern Lesser Poland.

pl-22-subcarpathian-voivodeship.title: Lemko-Polish Bilingual Signs (Subcarpathian)
pl-22-subcarpathian-voivodeship.description: Signs show Polish above and Lemko in Cyrillic below in southeastern Subcarpathian villages.

pl-southern-hill-mountain.title: Southern Hills and Mountains
pl-southern-hill-mountain.description: The southern border region has hilly terrain and some mountains.

pl-wooden-house-podlaskie.title: Wooden Houses, Podlaskie
pl-wooden-house-podlaskie.description: Traditional wooden houses are concentrated in eastern Podlaskie Voivodeship.

pl-tatra-mountain-zakopane.title: Tatra Mountains, Zakopane
pl-tatra-mountain-zakopane.description: Poland's highest peaks near Zakopane on the Slovak border.

pl-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pl-country-flag.description: The national flag of Poland is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

pt-portuguese-language.title: Portuguese Language
pt-portuguese-language.description: Portuguese uses distinctive letters like Ç, Ã, Õ, Â, and Ê; Ñ does not appear.

pt-ladder-poles-tall-steps.title: Ladder Poles with Tall Steps
pt-ladder-poles-tall-steps.description: Concrete ladder poles have unusually tall steps, often with small see-through holes.

pt-bollards.title: Bollards
pt-bollards.description: Bollards are wedge-shaped with thin white caps or flat with wide reflectors, usually white or sometimes orange.

pt-white-directional-signs.title: White Directional Signs
pt-white-directional-signs.description: Direction signs are white with black arrows floating clear of the edges.

pt-kilometre-markers.title: Kilometre Markers
pt-kilometre-markers.description: Kilometre markers are wide rectangular signs with a coloured left section and white right section; larger signs show road numbers.

pt-black-white-waystones.title: Black-and-White Waystones
pt-black-white-waystones.description: Small black-and-white stone markers are frequent along roads.

pt-stop-sign-font.title: Stop Sign Font
pt-stop-sign-font.description: Stop signs use a noticeably large font.

pt-black-yellow-chevrons.title: Black-and-Yellow Chevrons
pt-black-yellow-chevrons.description: Chevrons are black boards with yellow arrows.

pt-pedestrian-signs-five-stripes.title: Pedestrian Signs, Five Stripes
pt-pedestrian-signs-five-stripes.description: Pedestrian signs in Portugal show five stripes and a figure with a high belt.

pt-a-type-guardrails-red-reflectors.title: Guardrails with Red Reflectors
pt-a-type-guardrails-red-reflectors.description: In Portugal, guardrails have red reflectors.

pt-white-sign-borders.title: White Sign Borders
pt-white-sign-borders.description: Road signs typically have white borders.

pt-diagonal-cobblestone-roads.title: Diagonal Cobblestone Roads
pt-diagonal-cobblestone-roads.description: Cobblestone roads in Portugal have square stones laid diagonally to the road direction.

pt-bright-cobblestone-sidewalks.title: Bright Cobblestone Sidewalks
pt-bright-cobblestone-sidewalks.description: Portuguese pavements often use bright, pale cobblestones.

pt-white-houses-orange-roofs.title: White Houses with Orange Roofs
pt-white-houses-orange-roofs.description: White stone houses with orange clay-tile roofs are typical in Portugal.

pt-painted-window-door-borders.title: Painted Window and Door Borders
pt-painted-window-door-borders.description: Blue or yellow trim lines commonly outline windows, doors, and wall edges in Portugal.

pt-decorative-tile-facades.title: Decorative Tile Facades
pt-decorative-tile-facades.description: Portuguese buildings often have decorative mosaic tile (azulejos) facades.

pt-telephone-area-codes.title: Telephone Area Codes
pt-telephone-area-codes.description: Portuguese landline numbers start with 2 for geographic area codes; 29 indicates Azores or Madeira.

xx-architecture-01-portuguese-chimneys.title: Architecture 01 Portuguese Chimneys
xx-architecture-01-portuguese-chimneys.description: In southern Portugal, you will often see small chimneys that are either square or round in shape.

pt-concrete-block-houses-north.title: Concrete Block Houses, North
pt-concrete-block-houses-north.description: Northern Portuguese houses often use square concrete blocks with white mortar.

pt-holm-cork-oak-fields-southeast.title: Holm and Cork Oak Fields, Southeast
pt-holm-cork-oak-fields-southeast.description: Southeast fields have sparse holm and cork oaks, appearing dry in summer and lush in spring.

pt-olive-plantations-east.title: Olive Plantations, East
pt-olive-plantations-east.description: Olive groves concentrate in eastern Portugal, especially northeast and southeast.

pt-dense-eucalyptus-forests-northwest.title: Dense Eucalyptus Forests, Northwest
pt-dense-eucalyptus-forests-northwest.description: Thick eucalyptus forests are mainly in northwest Portugal.

pt-maritime-pine-forests-north.title: Maritime Pine Forests, North
pt-maritime-pine-forests-north.description: Northern Portugal has maritime pines with grey bark and reddish undertones, bare lower trunks.

pt-terraced-vineyards-douro-valley.title: Terraced Vineyards, Douro Valley
pt-terraced-vineyards-douro-valley.description: Steep terraced vineyards appear in the Douro wine region east of Porto.

pt-citrus-plantations-south-coast.title: Citrus Plantations, South Coast
pt-citrus-plantations-south-coast.description: Citrus groves concentrate along Portugal's southern coastline.

pt-serra-da-estrela-rocky-highland.title: Serra da Estrela, Rocky Highland
pt-serra-da-estrela-rocky-highland.description: Rocky mountainous highland with yellow-and-black striped snow poles.

pt-sandy-pine-coast-setubal-sines.title: Sandy Pine Coast, Setúbal to Sines
pt-sandy-pine-coast-setubal-sines.description: Pine forests grow on very white sandy soil along the coast between Setúbal and Sines.

pt-far-southwest-barren-flat-land.title: Far Southwest, Barren Flat Land
pt-far-southwest-barren-flat-land.description: Flat, uncultivated land with low bushes, grass, and very few trees, appearing dry.

pt-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pt-country-flag.description: The national flag of Portugal is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-38-stone-walls.title: General 01 38 Stone Walls
xx-general-01-38-stone-walls.description: Across the Azores, you will often see dry stone walls crafted from dark volcanic rock.

pr-area-code-787.title: Area Code 787
pr-area-code-787.description: Phone numbers use the 787 area code, shown as (787) XXX-XXXX.

pr-no-front-licence-plates.title: No Front Licence Plates
pr-no-front-licence-plates.description: Most vehicles lack front licence plates.

pr-divided-highways.title: Divided Highways
pr-divided-highways.description: Much of the rural area has wide divided highways.

pr-highway-shields.title: Highway Shields
pr-highway-shields.description: Puerto Rico uses unique highway shield designs not found elsewhere in the US.

pr-kilometre-markers.title: Kilometre Markers
pr-kilometre-markers.description: Kilometre markers are tall green signs with "km" at the top and a large vertical number below.

pr-concrete-flat-roof-architecture.title: Architecture, Concrete Flat Roofs
pr-concrete-flat-roof-architecture.description: Most houses are concrete with flat roofs and often metal security gates.

pr-drier-southern-coast.title: Drier Southern Coast
pr-drier-southern-coast.description: The southern coast is noticeably more arid.

pr-old-san-juan.title: Old San Juan
pr-old-san-juan.description: Narrow streets, vibrant buildings, brick roads, and Gothic, Renaissance, and Baroque architecture.

pr-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pr-country-flag.description: The national flag of Puerto Rico is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

qa-road-lines.title: Road Lines
qa-road-lines.description: Qatari roads have solid white edge lines with white or yellow centre markings; outer yellow lines appear sometimes.

qa-utility-poles.title: Utility Poles
qa-utility-poles.description: Qatari utility poles are round with three insulators, the middle raised, supported by a crossbar with diagonal braces.

qa-chevrons.title: Chevrons
qa-chevrons.description: Qatari chevrons are white-on-red and white-on-blue boards.

qa-zone-numbers-street-signs.title: Zone Numbers on Street Signs
qa-zone-numbers-street-signs.description: Qatar's numbered zones appear on street signs with a reference map.

qa-long-antenna-southwest.title: Long Antenna, Southwest
qa-long-antenna-southwest.description: The longest antenna variant is mostly in southwestern Qatar.

qa-country-flag.title: Country Flag
qa-country-flag.description: The national flag of Qatar is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

re-french-infrastructure.title: French Infrastructure
re-french-infrastructure.description: Standard French signs, bollards, and poles appear throughout Réunion.

re-mountainous-volcanic-island.title: Mountainous Volcanic Island
re-mountainous-volcanic-island.description: Réunion is a volcanic island with coastal roads, lush green mountains, palms, ferns, pine trees, and flowering plants.

re-bus-stop-designs.title: Bus Stop Designs
re-bus-stop-designs.description: Réunion has six bus stop styles: yellow, L-shaped (white or olive), pink, orange, green, and red, each in specific areas.

re-sugarcane-regions.title: Sugarcane Regions
re-sugarcane-regions.description: Sugarcane plantations appear in the northeast and southwest, with southwest fields in more built-up areas.

re-route-du-volcan-martian-landscape.title: Route du Volcan
re-route-du-volcan-martian-landscape.description: A barren volcanic landscape with brown-red soil, scattered shrubs, and white stones lining the road edges.

re-eastern-n2-sparse-population.title: Eastern N2, Sparse Population

re-country-flag.description: The national flag of Réunion is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ru-wide-intersections.title: Wide Intersections
ru-wide-intersections.description: Many Russian intersections are wider than usual, with dense bollards.

xx-general-01-41-black-socks.title: General 01 41 Black Socks
xx-general-01-41-black-socks.description: In Russia, signposts often have their lower sections painted black.

ru-black-white-striped-guardrails.title: Black-and-White Striped Guardrails
ru-black-white-striped-guardrails.description: Guardrails and barriers often have alternating black and white stripes.

ru-soviet-era-apartment-blocks.title: Soviet-Era Apartment Blocks
ru-soviet-era-apartment-blocks.description: Russian urban housing mostly consists of large rectangular concrete blocks with plain facades.

ru-rural-wooden-house.title: Rural Wooden Houses
ru-rural-wooden-house.description: Russian rural homes are simple wooden structures with metal roofs.

ru-ornate-window-frames.title: Ornate Window Frames
ru-ornate-window-frames.description: Traditional Russian houses, especially log cabins, feature richly carved decorative window frames often painted blue.

ru-black-white-pole-shields.title: Black-and-White Pole Shields
ru-black-white-pole-shields.description: Pole shields with alternating black and white stripes appear frequently along highways in European Russia.

ru-birch-tree-range.title: Birch Tree Range
ru-birch-tree-range.description: Birch trees with distinctive white peeling bark grow across much of Russia except the far south and far north of western regions.

ru-dense-birch-forest.title: Dense Birch Forests
ru-dense-birch-forest.description: Tightly packed pure birch forests suggest areas east of the Urals, typically between Chelyabinsk and Novosibirsk Oblasts.

ru-siberian-larch.title: Siberian Larches
ru-siberian-larch.description: Siberian larches with needle-like leaves dominate eastern Russia, becoming more prevalent further east and at higher elevations.

ru-giant-butterbur-sakhalin-cabbage.title: Giant Butterbur (Sakhalin Cabbage)
ru-giant-butterbur-sakhalin-cabbage.description: Giant butterbur, or Sakhalin cabbage, is common in southern Sakhalin Oblast.

ru-sosnowsky-hogweed.title: Sosnowsky's Hogweed
ru-sosnowsky-hogweed.description: Heracleum sosnowskyi, a white-flowered plant, appears frequently around Moscow, Komi Republic, and Perm Krai.

ru-fireweed.title: Fireweed
ru-fireweed.description: Abundant pink or red fireweed typically signals northern Russia, commonly found north of Moscow.

ru-sunflower-field.title: Sunflower Fields
ru-sunflower-field.description: Sunflower fields are prevalent near the Ukrainian border and in eastern oblasts like Ulyanovsk, Samara, and northern Orenburg.

ru-blue-pod-lupines.title: Blue-Pod Lupines
ru-blue-pod-lupines.description: Blue-pod lupines appear abundantly in northern Vladimir, eastern Ivanovo, and southwestern Kostroma Oblasts.

ru-black-poplar-tree.title: Black Poplar Trees
ru-black-poplar-tree.description: Black poplars are typically found in southern Russia near the Ukrainian and western Kazakhstan borders.

ru-russian-olive-tree.title: Russian Olive Trees
ru-russian-olive-tree.description: Russian olive trees are found along the Kazakhstan border.

ru-roadside-larches-open-fields.title: Roadside Larches with Open Fields
ru-roadside-larches-open-fields.description: Sparsely planted larches along roads with open rolling fields are typical of Tatarstan and neighboring regions.

ru-sandy-roadside.title: Sandy Roadsides
ru-sandy-roadside.description: Sandy roadsides are typical in Khanty-Mansi, Yamalo-Nenets, near Nizhny Novgorod, Karelia, Murmansk, and western Sakha.

ru-red-soil.title: Red Soil
ru-red-soil.description: Red soil appears around Izhevsk, Perm, Arkhangelsk, Leningrad, Pskov, Volgograd, and Astrakhan.

ru-kamchatka-grey-gravelly-soil.title: Kamchatka's Grey Gravelly Soil
ru-kamchatka-grey-gravelly-soil.description: Kamchatka Peninsula has distinctive grey gravelly soil and many volcanoes, some close to roads near Klyuchi.

ru-dark-gravelly-soil-east-yakutsk.title: Dark Gravelly Soil East of Yakutsk
ru-dark-gravelly-soil-east-yakutsk.description: Extremely gravelly, sometimes dark soil characterizes terrain east of Yakutsk, starting around Keskil.

ru-vladivostok-area-landscape.title: Vladivostok Area Landscape
ru-vladivostok-area-landscape.description: Lush, diverse forests cover hilly terrain in the warmer Vladivostok region, often overcast.

ru-hazy-coverage-near-mirny.title: Hazy Coverage Near Mirny
ru-hazy-coverage-near-mirny.description: Very hazy coverage appears east and south of Mirny, especially along the Vilyuy river, with orange or white haze.

ru-buryatia-landscape.title: Buryatia Landscape
ru-buryatia-landscape.description: Buryatia features open grassy landscapes with shrubs and mountains, becoming lusher near Lake Baikal.

ru-tuva-republic-dry-steppe.title: Tuva Republic Dry Steppe
ru-tuva-republic-dry-steppe.description: Dry steppe mountains with a long antenna typically indicate the Tuva Republic.

ru-arctic-tundra-landscape.title: Arctic Tundra Landscape
ru-arctic-tundra-landscape.description: The far north has flat terrain with very low vegetation, characteristic of tundra.

ru-omsk-oblast-landscape.title: Omsk Oblast Landscape
ru-omsk-oblast-landscape.description: Omsk Oblast shows green agricultural fields broken by isolated birch forest patches in summer.

ru-caspian-steppe.title: Caspian Steppe
ru-caspian-steppe.description: The area west of the Caspian Sea is extremely dry and flat, especially in Kalmykia, Astrakhan, and Dagestan.

ru-dagestan-grassy-field.title: Dagestan Grassy Fields
ru-dagestan-grassy-field.description: Grassy fields with bushy vegetation and small flowers in early spring are typical of Dagestan.

ru-caucasus-mountain-range.title: Caucasus Mountain Range
ru-caucasus-mountain-range.description: The Caucasus is a large mountain range with Mount Elbrus, Russia's tallest peak, on the Kabardino-Balkarian and Karachay-Cherkessia border.

ru-roadside-rocks-karelia-murmansk.title: Roadside Rocks in Karelia and Murmansk
ru-roadside-rocks-karelia-murmansk.description: Large rocks lining roads are common in Karelia and Murmansk, less so in Perm Krai and Buryatia.

ru-murmansk-oblast-landscape.title: Murmansk Oblast Landscape
ru-murmansk-oblast-landscape.description: Open, hilly terrain with low shrubbery and fireweed indicates Murmansk; shorter vegetation suggests further north.

ru-telephone-area-codes.title: Telephone Area Codes
ru-telephone-area-codes.description: Russian area codes: start with 8 in the west, 3 in central areas, and 4 in the east or around Moscow.

ru-licence-plate-regional-code.title: Licence Plate Regional Codes
ru-licence-plate-regional-code.description: Unblurred plates show a regional code on the right, ordered alphabetically by federal subject type.

ru-distinctive-regional-bus-stop.title: Distinctive Regional Bus Stops
ru-distinctive-regional-bus-stop.description: Certain federal subjects have unique bus stop designs, notably Krasnoyarsk Krai, Chuvashia, Tatarstan, and Mari El.

ru-thin-eastern-bollard.title: Thin Eastern Bollards
