ru-thin-eastern-bollard.description: Very thin bollards on sticks appear in eastern Russia starting around Omsk.

ru-black-traffic-sign-bottom-southern-ru.title: Black Traffic Sign Bottom
ru-black-traffic-sign-bottom-southern-ru.description: Traffic signs with black-painted bottoms are found mainly in Stavropol, Chechnya, and western Dagestan.

ru-signpost-edge-clip.title: Signpost Edge Clips
ru-signpost-edge-clip.description: Metal clips on signpost edges are typical of Leningrad Oblast and St. Petersburg.

ru-outer-dashed-road-line.title: Outer Dashed Road Lines
ru-outer-dashed-road-line.description: Dashed lines along road edges are mostly found in Kursk Oblast.

ru-concrete-block-road.title: Concrete Block Roads
ru-concrete-block-road.description: Roads made from individual concrete blocks appear in northern Russia, especially Komi, Nenets, and Yamalo-Nenets.

ru-bilingual-town-direction-sign.title: Bilingual Town and Direction Signs
ru-bilingual-town-direction-sign.description: Some republics show bilingual town and directional signs in Russian and a minority language.

ru-dual-cyrillic-latin-town-name.title: Dual Cyrillic-Latin Town Names
ru-dual-cyrillic-latin-town-name.description: Town names in both Cyrillic and Latin scripts appear near the Baltic border and around Moscow.

ru-brown-tourist-sign.title: Brown Tourist Signs
ru-brown-tourist-sign.description: Brown tourist directional signs are common in Moscow Oblast and nearby regions.

ru-white-limestone-brick-building.title: White Limestone Brick Buildings
ru-white-limestone-brick-building.description: White limestone brick buildings indicate Dagestan and nearby areas.

ru-red-brick-building.title: Red Brick Buildings
ru-red-brick-building.description: Red brick buildings are concentrated in southern Russia.

ru-mosque.title: Mosques
ru-mosque.description: Mosques are most common in Muslim-majority areas: the North Caucasus republics, Tatarstan, and Bashkortostan.

ru-mari-el-architecture.title: Mari El Architecture
ru-mari-el-architecture.description: Historic Mari El buildings have green roofs, red brick, and white stone details.

ru-large-red-brake-light.title: Large Red Brake Light
ru-large-red-brake-light.description: Large red brake light on camera car is common in Kaliningrad and some older western coverage.

ru-autumn-gen-3-coverage.title: Autumn Coverage
ru-autumn-gen-3-coverage.description: Autumn coverage appears in Kaliningrad, Bryansk, Tula, and Belgorod.

ru-winter-gen-4-coverage.title: Winter Coverage
ru-winter-gen-4-coverage.description: Winter coverage is common in southern Russia from Ryazan to Dagestan.

ru-spring-gen-4-coverage.title: Spring Coverage
ru-spring-gen-4-coverage.description: Spring coverage clusters around Kemerovo, Krasnoyarsk, Orenburg, Kamyshin, Lipetsk, and Moscow.

ru-summer-gen-4-coverage.title: Summer Coverage
ru-summer-gen-4-coverage.description: Summer coverage is the most common and widespread.

ru-autumn-gen-4-coverage.title: Autumn Coverage
ru-autumn-gen-4-coverage.description: Autumn coverage is rare, found near Kazan, Murmansk, and Ulan-Ude.

ru-rural-gen-4-desert-coverage-northern-.title: Rural Desert Coverage
ru-rural-gen-4-desert-coverage-northern-.description: Flat rural desert-like roads west of the Caspian Sea appear only in northern Dagestan and southwestern Astrakhan.

ru-tropical-plant-black-sea-coast.title: Tropical Plants
ru-tropical-plant-black-sea-coast.description: Tropical vegetation like palm trees appears only along Russia's Black Sea coast, mostly near Sochi.

ru-kamchatka-trekker-coverage.title: Kamchatka Trekker Coverage
ru-kamchatka-trekker-coverage.description: Most trekker coverage in Russia is from Kamchatka, identified by grey gravelly soil and volcanic terrain.

ru-tatar-bilingual-sign.title: Tatar Bilingual Signs
ru-tatar-bilingual-sign.description: Bilingual street signs in Tatarstan use "урамы" (ур. abbreviated) for street instead of Russian "улица".

ru-bashkir-bilingual-sign.title: Bashkir Bilingual Signs
ru-bashkir-bilingual-sign.description: Bilingual street signs in Bashkortostan use "урамы" for street, usually written in full.

ru-chuvash-bilingual-sign.title: Chuvash Bilingual Signs
ru-chuvash-bilingual-sign.description: Bilingual street signs in Chuvashia use the Chuvash word "урамӗ" for street.

ru-mari-bilingual-sign.title: Mari Bilingual Signs
ru-mari-bilingual-sign.description: Bilingual street signs in Mari El use the Mari word "урем" for street.

ru-komi-bilingual-sign.title: Komi Bilingual Signs
ru-komi-bilingual-sign.description: Bilingual street signs in the Komi Republic use the Komi word "улича" for street.

ru-yellow-pole-plate-tatarstan.title: Yellow Pole Plates in Tatarstan
ru-yellow-pole-plate-tatarstan.description: Yellow identification plates fastened to poles with metal bands are common in Tatarstan.

ru-double-yellow-band-signpost-murmansk.title: Double Yellow Bands on Signposts
ru-double-yellow-band-signpost-murmansk.description: In Murmansk and some Karelia roads, most signposts have two yellow bands wrapped around them.

ru-cobblestone-pavement.title: Cobblestone Pavement
ru-cobblestone-pavement.description: Cobblestone roads are common in Kaliningrad, Nizhny Tagil, and Kizel.

ru-extended-insulator-bar-pole.title: Extended Insulator Bars on Poles
ru-extended-insulator-bar-pole.description: Elongated insulator bars on utility poles appear in southern Chelyabinsk, eastern Orenburg, and southern Kemerovo Oblasts.

ru-decorative-pedestrian-sign-holder-psk.title: Decorative Pedestrian Sign Holders
ru-decorative-pedestrian-sign-holder-psk.description: Ornamental pedestrian sign mounting brackets are unique to Pskov Oblast.

ru-mid-line-rectangular-fence-chelyabins.title: Mid-Line Rectangular Fences
ru-mid-line-rectangular-fence-chelyabins.description: Rounded rectangular fences with a horizontal mid-line are unique to Chelyabinsk and eastern Orenburg Oblasts.

ru-thin-rectangular-top-fence-samara-reg.title: Thin Rectangular Top Fences
ru-thin-rectangular-top-fence-samara-reg.description: Fences with a thin rounded rectangular top are found in Syzran, Tolyatti, and Samara.

ru-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ru-country-flag.description: The national flag of Russia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

rw-hazy-sky-tint.title: Hazy Sky Tint
rw-hazy-sky-tint.description: Rwandan coverage has a noticeable haze, especially visible in the sky.

rw-architecture.title: Architecture
rw-architecture.description: Rwandan buildings are mainly brick and concrete houses with steep roofs and ventilation bricks.

rw-red-tinted-soil.title: Red-Tinted Soil
rw-red-tinted-soil.description: Most soil across Rwanda has a reddish tint.

rw-banana-plant.title: Banana Plants
rw-banana-plant.description: Banana plants grow abundantly throughout Rwanda.

rw-bollard.title: Bollards
rw-bollard.description: Rwandan bollards are red-and-white cylindrical shapes in several designs.

rw-waystone.title: Waystones
rw-waystone.description: White concrete waystones mark Rwandan roadsides.

rw-clean-street.title: Clean Streets
rw-clean-street.description: Rwandan streets are tidy and free of litter.

rw-black-white-kerb.title: Black-and-White Kerbs
rw-black-white-kerb.description: Rwandan kerbs are painted with alternating black and white stripes.

rw-security-fence-wall.title: Security Fences and Walls
rw-security-fence-wall.description: Rwandan villa neighbourhoods have many tall security fences and perimeter walls.

rw-district-code-street-sign.title: District Codes on Street Signs
rw-district-code-street-sign.description: Rwandan street names often include a two-letter district prefix.

rw-lamppost-style-national-road.title: Lamppost Styles by National Road
rw-lamppost-style-national-road.description: Lamp designs vary by national road: green roads have slightly curved arms; red roads have shorter arms with a sharp bend; blue roads have longer fully curved arms; grey roads rarely have lamps.

rw-road-number-lamppost.title: Road Numbers on Lampposts
rw-road-number-lamppost.description: National road numbers are painted in black on lampposts with sequential lamp numbers below.

rw-tea-plantation-western-rwanda.title: Tea Plantations
rw-tea-plantation-western-rwanda.description: Tea plantations are common in western Rwanda and a few other pockets.

rw-northeast-rolling-open-landscape.title: Northeast Rolling Landscape
rw-northeast-rolling-open-landscape.description: The northeast has rolling hills with open agricultural or grassland areas.

rw-northwest-volcano.title: Northwest Volcanoes
rw-northwest-volcano.description: Volcanoes and volcanic rocks are visible in the northwest corner.

rw-kigali-luxury-villas.title: Kigali Luxury Villas
rw-kigali-luxury-villas.description: Wealthier Kigali neighborhoods feature many luxury villas.

rw-butare-cobblestone-street.title: Butare Cobblestone Streets
rw-butare-cobblestone-street.description: Many roads in Butare are paved with cobblestones.

rw-country-flag.title: Country Flag
rw-country-flag.description: The national flag of Rwanda is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

pm-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
pm-licence-plate.description: Saint Pierre and Miquelon plates are white or yellow, short or long, with a blue EU strip on the left; front plates are optional.

pm-colourful-wooden-house.title: Colourful Wooden Houses
pm-colourful-wooden-house.description: Homes are boxy wooden panel buildings often painted in bold colours.

pm-grassy-coastal-landscape.title: Grassy Coastal Landscape
pm-grassy-coastal-landscape.description: Flat to gently rolling grassland terrain with visible coastline.

pm-saint-pierre-island-rural-trekker.title: Saint-Pierre Island Rural Trekker
pm-saint-pierre-island-rural-trekker.description: A rural trekker on Saint-Pierre island with rockier terrain and tree-lined paths.

pm-country-flag.title: Country Flag
pm-country-flag.description: The national flag of Saint Pierre and Miquelon is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

sm-rolling-agricultural-hills.title: Rolling Agricultural Hills
sm-rolling-agricultural-hills.description: Gently undulating farmland with lush Mediterranean vegetation and narrow winding roads.

sm-round-concrete-pole.title: Round Concrete Poles
sm-round-concrete-pole.description: Utility poles are mostly round concrete, identical to Italian types; wooden poles also appear.

sm-yellow-burgundy-chevron.title: Yellow-and-Burgundy Chevrons
sm-yellow-burgundy-chevron.description: Chevrons are yellow boards with burgundy-red arrows, unique to San Marino.

sm-lime-green-bin.title: Lime-Green Bins
sm-lime-green-bin.description: In San Marino, bright lime-green rubbish bins appear frequently along streets.

sm-country-flag.title: Country Flag
sm-country-flag.description: The national flag of San Marino is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

sn-general-01-blue-plates.title: Blue plates
sn-general-01-blue-plates.description: Senegal uses blue license plates, the only country in Africa to do so.

sn-road-01-driving-direction.title: Driving direction
sn-road-01-driving-direction.description: In Senegal they drive on the right side of the road.

sn-french-style-infrastructure.title: French-Style Infrastructure
sn-french-style-infrastructure.description: Senegal uses French-pattern bollards, poles, signs, and road markings.

sn-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
sn-kilometre-marker.description: Senegalese kilometre markers are white posts with red tops showing road numbers and distances.

sn-pink-bordered-town-sign.title: Pink-Bordered Town Signs
sn-pink-bordered-town-sign.description: Senegalese town entry signs are white with a thick pink outline and bold black lettering.

sn-solar-powered-black-lamp.title: Solar-Powered Black Lamps
sn-solar-powered-black-lamp.description: Black lampposts topped with solar panels appear frequently along Senegalese roads.

sn-yellow-orange-taxi.title: Yellow-Orange Taxis
sn-yellow-orange-taxi.description: Yellow-orange taxis with black-painted fenders are common in Senegal.

sn-northern-savannah-desert.title: Northern Savannah-Desert
sn-northern-savannah-desert.description: North of The Gambia, terrain is flat, arid with sparse, faded foliage trees.

sn-southern-green-region.title: Southern Green Region
sn-southern-green-region.description: South of The Gambia, vegetation is lush and green with palm trees near the coast.

sn-diourbel-rural-coverage.title: Diourbel Rural Coverage
sn-diourbel-rural-coverage.description: Extensive rural coverage with sandy unpaved roads and scattered trees around Diourbel.

sn-northwestern-coastal-dune.title: Northwestern Coastal Dunes
sn-northwestern-coastal-dune.description: Gently rolling vegetated sand dunes characterise the northwestern coastline.

sn-bakel-dry-hills.title: Bakel, Dry Hills
sn-bakel-dry-hills.description: Dry terrain with gentle hills appears around Bakel and south to Nayé.

sn-kedougou-greener-hills.title: Kedougou, Greener Hills
sn-kedougou-greener-hills.description: Kedougou and Mako have more verdant vegetation and larger hills.

sn-divided-highway.title: Divided Highways
sn-divided-highway.description: Senegal has two divided highways: Dakar–Touba and Dakar–Saly.

sn-saloum-delta-marshland.title: Saloum Delta Marshland
sn-saloum-delta-marshland.description: Flat, slightly marshy terrain with low vegetation appears in the Saloum River Delta.

sn-forest-thies.title: Forest of Thiès
sn-forest-thies.description: Slightly hilly area with dry brown vegetation, bright orange dirt roads, and noticeable haze.

sn-dakar.title: Dakar
sn-dakar.description: Senegal's capital has dense urban fabric and taller, modern buildings.

sn-country-flag.title: Country Flag
sn-country-flag.description: The national flag of Senegal is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

rs-chevrons.title: Chevrons
rs-chevrons.description: Serbian chevrons are black arrows on a white background.

rs-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
rs-licence-plate.description: Serbian plates are white with a blue strip on the left; agricultural vehicles have green plates.

rs-serbian-cyrillic-script.title: Serbian Cyrillic Script
rs-serbian-cyrillic-script.description: Serbian Cyrillic includes unique letters Ђ/ђ and Ћ/ћ.

rs-serbian-latin-script.title: Serbian Latin Script
rs-serbian-latin-script.description: Serbian Latin uses the special letters Č, Ć, Đ, Š, and Ž.

rs-topography.title: Topography
rs-topography.description: Vojvodina is flat; central-southern regions are hillier; mountains lie in southwest and southeast Serbia.

rs-telephone-area-codes.title: Telephone Area Codes
rs-telephone-area-codes.description: Serbian area codes are two digits starting with 1 to 3, varying by region.

rs-vojvodina-flat-agriculture.title: Vojvodina, Flat Agriculture
rs-vojvodina-flat-agriculture.description: Northern Serbia between Hungary and Belgrade is completely flat agricultural land.

rs-central-northern-rolling-hills.title: Central-Northern Rolling Hills
rs-central-northern-rolling-hills.description: Gentle rolling hills lie between Vojvodina and southern mountains.

rs-southern-morava-river-basin.title: Southern Morava River Basin
rs-southern-morava-river-basin.description: Rolling landscape with larger hills and distant mountains.

rs-lush-southern-mountains.title: Lush Southern Mountains
rs-lush-southern-mountains.description: Dense green mountains appear along the Bulgarian and Kosovo borders.

rs-autumn-coverage.title: Autumn Coverage
rs-autumn-coverage.description: Fall-colored coverage is found around Belgrade, south of Čačak and near Valjevo.

rs-language-01-bilingual.title: Language 01 Bilingual
rs-language-01-bilingual.description: Serbian can be written in both Cyrillic or Latin letters. You can often find both written on signs here.

rs-yellow-centre-lines-e-80.title: Yellow Centre Lines on E-80
rs-yellow-centre-lines-e-80.description: A short E-80 section north of Pirot has yellow centre lines.

rs-country-flag.title: Country Flag
rs-country-flag.description: The national flag of Serbia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

sl-hilly-forested-landscape.title: Hilly Forested Landscape
sl-hilly-forested-landscape.description: Slovenia's terrain is very hilly and heavily forested, with patches of agriculture.

sl-deep-forest-road.title: Deep Forest Roads
sl-deep-forest-road.description: Many Slovenian roads run deep through dense forest.

sl-architecture.title: Alpine Architecture
sl-architecture.description: Slovenian buildings are alpine-inspired with light walls, dark wood details, and semi-steep half-hipped roofs.

sl-slovene-language.title: Slovene Language
sl-slovene-language.description: A Slavic language using special letters Č, Š, and Ž.

sl-bollard.title: Bollards
sl-bollard.description: Slovenian bollards are white with black tops; front reflectors are red, back reflectors white.

sl-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
sl-directional-sign.description: Slovenian directional signs are yellow with a black border.

sl-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
sl-kilometre-marker.description: Slovenian kilometre markers show road number in a yellow rectangle, a second number, a black divider, and distance below.

sl-chevron.title: Chevrons
sl-chevron.description: Slovenian chevrons usually have red arrows on white; sometimes black arrows on white.

sl-pedestrian-sign.title: Pedestrian Signs
sl-pedestrian-sign.description: Slovenian pedestrian signs show five stripes and a simply drawn person with no belt.

sl-dashed-outer-road-line.title: Dashed Outer Road Lines
sl-dashed-outer-road-line.description: Slovenian roads often have long dashed edge lines.

sl-street-sign.title: Street Signs
sl-street-sign.description: Slovenian street signs are usually white with metal borders on posts; red variants attach to house walls.

sl-red-house-number.title: Red House Numbers
sl-red-house-number.description: Slovenian house number plates are typically red with white text.

sl-kozolec-drying-rack.title: Kozolec Drying Racks
sl-kozolec-drying-rack.description: Open-sided wooden sheds with visible gaps, typical of Slovenia.

sl-northwestern-alpine-region.title: Northwestern Alpine Region
sl-northwestern-alpine-region.description: Slovenia's tallest mountains are in the alpine northwest.

sl-eastern-plain.title: Eastern Plains
sl-eastern-plain.description: Flat or rolling agricultural fields with no mountains indicate eastern Slovenia.

sl-adriatic-coast.title: Adriatic Coast
sl-adriatic-coast.description: White cliffs, Mediterranean vegetation, vineyards, and Mediterranean-style architecture near Slovenia's Adriatic coast.

sl-southeast-valley.title: Southeast Valley
sl-southeast-valley.description: A wide east–west valley with mountains visible to north and south in southeastern Slovenia.

sl-bilingual-italian-sign.title: Bilingual Italian Signs
sl-bilingual-italian-sign.description: Bilingual Slovenian-Italian signs appear in Slovenia's western coastal region.

sl-country-flag.title: Country Flag
sl-country-flag.description: The national flag of Slovenia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

sg-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
sg-licence-plate.description: Singaporean plates are mostly black with white text, unlike Malaysian and Indonesian plates.

sg-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
sg-directional-sign.description: Singaporean directional signs are green with white English text and expressway codes like TPE.

sg-road-sign-white-backing.title: Road Signs on White Backing
sg-road-sign-white-backing.description: All road signs are mounted on square white background panels, unique to Singapore.

sg-rain-tree.title: Rain Trees
sg-rain-tree.description: Large rain trees line many main roads throughout Singapore.

sg-road-surface-warning.title: Road Surface Warnings
sg-road-surface-warning.description: Text warnings like "HUMP AHEAD" are painted directly on Singapore roads.

sg-bus-stop-bollard.title: Bus Stop Bollards
sg-bus-stop-bollard.description: Concrete bollards with black-and-yellow bands protect every bus stop in Singapore.

sg-bus-leaving-box.title: Bus-Leaving Box
sg-bus-leaving-box.description: A yellow box with an arrow is sometimes painted on the road at Singapore bus stops.

sg-traffic-light.title: Traffic Lights
sg-traffic-light.description: Singaporean traffic lights have a standard design with a curved metal sheet with holes.

sg-neighbourhood-name-street-sign.title: Neighbourhood Names on Street Signs
sg-neighbourhood-name-street-sign.description: Suburban streets in Singapore often include their neighbourhood name.

sg-country-flag.title: Country Flag
sg-country-flag.description: The national flag of Singapore is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

sk-wide-type-b-guardrail.title: Wide Guardrails
sk-wide-type-b-guardrail.description: Broad guardrails are unique to Slovakia and Czechia.

sk-paired-concrete-utility-pole.title: Paired Concrete Utility Poles
sk-paired-concrete-utility-pole.description: Broad cylindrical concrete poles often mounted side by side.

sk-short-metal-bar-pole-top.title: Short Metal Bar Pole Tops
sk-short-metal-bar-pole-top.description: Compact horizontal metal bars carrying line insulators.

sk-inverted-triangle-pole-support.title: Inverted Triangle Pole Supports
sk-inverted-triangle-pole-support.description: Two angled braces create upside-down triangle silhouette.

sk-trident-pole-top.title: Trident Pole Tops
sk-trident-pole-top.description: Three-pronged pole top with two outer arms angled upward.

sk-bolt-mounted-lamp-post-base.title: Bolt-Mounted Lamp Post Bases
sk-bolt-mounted-lamp-post-base.description: Chunky base plates secured by opposing pairs of bolts.

sk-red-white-striped-temporary-signpost.title: Red-and-White Striped Temporary Signposts
sk-red-white-striped-temporary-signpost.description: Square poles wrapped in alternating red and white bands.

sk-striped-gas-water-marker-pole.title: Striped Gas and Water Marker Poles
sk-striped-gas-water-marker-pole.description: Slender roadside poles painted in coloured stripes indicating underground lines.

sk-three-stripe-hiking-trail-marker.title: Three-Stripe Hiking Trail Markers
sk-three-stripe-hiking-trail-marker.description: Coloured band between two white bands; sometimes arrow-shaped.

sk-colourful-prefab-apartment.title: Colourful Prefabricated Apartment Blocks
sk-colourful-prefab-apartment.description: Soviet-era panel buildings often repainted in vibrant colours and patterns.

sk-diamond-roof-tiles.title: Diamond-Shaped Roof Tiles
sk-diamond-roof-tiles.description: Roofing composed of small diamond-shaped tiles is widespread.

sk-black-bridge-marker-sign.title: Black Bridge Marker Signs
sk-black-bridge-marker-sign.description: Dark plaques near bridge ends display the road number on the left side.

sk-slovak-czech-language-differences.title: Slovak vs Czech Language Differences
sk-slovak-czech-language-differences.description: Slovak uses unique accented letters like L with caron (Ľ) and O with circumflex (Ô); Czech uses others like R with caron (Ř) and U with ring (Ů).

sk-landscape-contrast-czechia.title: Landscape Contrast
sk-landscape-contrast-czechia.description: Slovakia alternates between dramatic mountains and flat lowlands.

sk-blue-directional-signs-small-arrows.title: Blue Directional Signs with Small Arrows
sk-blue-directional-signs-small-arrows.description: Road direction signs have a blue background with compact white arrows.

sk-sign-border-flush-edge.title: Sign Border Flush with Edge
sk-sign-border-flush-edge.description: Painted borders run right up to the physical edge of Slovak road signs.

sk-highway-signs-edge-flush-borders.title: Highway Signs with Edge-Flush Borders
sk-highway-signs-edge-flush-borders.description: Motorway signs in blue or green have a white border touching the panel edge.

sk-white-house-number-sign.title: White House Number Signs
sk-white-house-number-sign.description: Building numbers appear on white plaques with thin red or black borders.

sk-sign-post-cap-styles.title: Sign Post Cap Styles
sk-sign-post-cap-styles.description: Sign post tops are open, capped with grey metal discs, or thin black caps.

sk-pedestrian-crossing-sign.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signs
sk-pedestrian-crossing-sign.description: Signs feature five crossing stripes with either a simple figure or closely bunched stripes.

sk-bold-road-sign-font.title: Bold Road Sign Font
sk-bold-road-sign-font.description: Road signs use a notably heavy, bold typeface.

sk-two-section-kilometre-marker.title: Two-Section Kilometre Markers
sk-two-section-kilometre-marker.description: Distance markers have upper and lower sections separated by a black line; road number is on top.

sk-cycling-signs-marked-c.title: Cycling Signs Marked with "C"
sk-cycling-signs-marked-c.description: Cycle route signs display the letter C and resemble Czechoslovak hiking markers.

sk-window-shutter.title: Window Shutters
sk-window-shutter.description: Houses with window shutters appear frequently.

sk-hip-end-roofs-facing-road.title: Hip-End Roofs Facing the Road
sk-hip-end-roofs-facing-road.description: Residential buildings often have narrow gable ends facing the street with hipped roofs.

sk-grey-metal-roof.title: Grey Metal Roofs
sk-grey-metal-roof.description: Unpainted grey sheet-metal roofing is widespread, especially in the east.

sk-gen-3-spring-coverage.title: Spring Coverage
sk-gen-3-spring-coverage.description: Most imagery was captured in spring.

sk-railway-crossing-sign-white-backgroun.title: Railway Crossing Sign with White Background
sk-railway-crossing-sign-white-backgroun.description: Level crossing warning signs are mounted on white rectangular panels.

sk-double-sign-posts-small-signs.title: Double Sign Posts on Small Signs
sk-double-sign-posts-small-signs.description: Small road signs are often supported by two parallel posts.

sk-new-wedge-bollard-red-reflector.title: New Wedge-Shaped Bollard with Red Reflector
sk-new-wedge-bollard-red-reflector.description: A new wedge-shaped bollard with a red front reflector is introduced.

sk-wooden-poles-white-concrete-supports.title: Wooden Poles and White Concrete Supports
sk-wooden-poles-white-concrete-supports.description: Wooden utility poles with white concrete braces appear somewhat often.

sk-phone-number-area-codes.title: Phone Number Area Codes
sk-phone-number-area-codes.description: Telephone numbers are ten digits with the first two or three digits as area codes.

sk-road-numbering-system.title: Road Numbering System
sk-road-numbering-system.description: Roads have three- or four-digit numbers. Three-digit 500-560 and four-digit roads increase west to east.

sk-topography-overview.title: Topography Overview
sk-topography-overview.description: Highest mountains are central and north; flattest terrain is southwest and southeast.

sk-western-lowland.title: Western Lowlands
sk-western-lowland.description: Southwestern plains have perfectly flat agricultural fields stretching to the horizon.

sk-eastern-lowland.title: Eastern Lowlands
sk-eastern-lowland.description: Broad farmland with distant hills or ridges defines the eastern lowland region.

sk-hungarian-majority-areas-south.title: Hungarian-Majority Areas in the South
sk-hungarian-majority-areas-south.description: Southern areas have Hungarian-speaking populations with bilingual street names.

sk-yellow-circle-markings-poles.title: Yellow Circle Markings on Poles
sk-yellow-circle-markings-poles.description: Concrete poles with painted yellow circles are concentrated in Nitra and Trnava regions.

sk-yellow-lamp-posts-blue-bases.title: Yellow Lamp Posts with Blue Bases
sk-yellow-lamp-posts-blue-bases.description: Lamp posts have yellow bodies with blue bases, mainly in the east.

sk-northern-mountain-valley.title: Northern Mountain Valleys
sk-northern-mountain-valley.description: Two broad valleys flanked by tall, jagged peaks lie in the north. The nearest mountain range side helps tell them apart.

sk-pine-forest-far-west.title: Pine Forests
sk-pine-forest-far-west.description: Dense pine woodland is characteristic of western Slovakia.

sk-rusyn-bilingual-signs-northeast.title: Rusyn Bilingual Signs
sk-rusyn-bilingual-signs-northeast.description: Town entry signs in northeastern Presov may include Rusyn text in Cyrillic script.

sk-zilina-trolleybus.title: Zilina Trolleybuses
sk-zilina-trolleybus.description: Trolleybuses in Zilina have a green-yellow-white livery; overhead poles match in yellow and green.

sk-country-flag.title: Country Flag
sk-country-flag.description: The national flag of Slovakia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

si-hilly-forested-landscape.title: Hilly Forested Landscape
si-hilly-forested-landscape.description: Slovenia is very hilly and heavily forested with some agriculture.

si-deep-forest-road.title: Deep Forest Roads
si-deep-forest-road.description: Many roads run deep through dense forest in Slovenia.

si-slovene-language.title: Slovene Language
si-slovene-language.description: Slovene is a Slavic language using special letters Č, Š, and Ž.

si-kilometre-marker.title: Kilometre Markers
si-kilometre-marker.description: Road number in a yellow rectangle top left, second number right, black divider, distance below.

si-chevron.title: Chevrons
si-chevron.description: Red arrows on white background; sometimes black arrows on white.

si-pedestrian-sign.title: Pedestrian Signs
si-pedestrian-sign.description: Five stripes and a simply drawn person with no belt.

si-dashed-outer-road-line.title: Dashed Outer Road Lines
si-dashed-outer-road-line.description: Long dashed edge lines on roads.

si-kozolec-drying-rack.title: Kozolec Drying Racks
si-kozolec-drying-rack.description: Open-sided wooden sheds with thin beams and visible gaps.

si-northwestern-alpine-region.title: Northwestern Alpine Region
si-northwestern-alpine-region.description: Tallest mountains in the alpine northwest.

si-eastern-plain.title: Eastern Plains
si-eastern-plain.description: Flat or rolling agricultural fields with no mountains or tall hills.

si-adriatic-coast.title: Adriatic Coast
si-adriatic-coast.description: White cliffs, Mediterranean vegetation, vineyards, and Mediterranean-style architecture.

si-southeast-valley.title: Southeast Valley
si-southeast-valley.description: Wide east–west valley with mountains to north and south.

si-bilingual-italian-sign.title: Bilingual Italian Signs
si-bilingual-italian-sign.description: Slovenian-Italian bilingual signs in the westernmost coastal region.

si-country-flag.title: Country Flag
si-country-flag.description: The national flag of Slovenia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

za-yellow-edge-line.title: Yellow Edge Lines
za-yellow-edge-line.description: Most South African roads feature single yellow edge lines paired with white centre lines.

za-triple-centre-line.title: Triple Centre Lines
za-triple-centre-line.description: South Africa has a pattern of three white centre lines: two solid outer lines bracketing a dashed inner one.

za-bird-pole.title: Bird Poles
za-bird-pole.description: South African poles often have 1–5 horizontal bars with thin white insulators resembling rows of perching birds.

za-triangular-warning-sign.title: Triangular Warning Signs
za-triangular-warning-sign.description: South African warning signs are red-bordered triangles on a white background.

xx-general-01-18-south-african-chevrons.title: General 01 18 South African Chevrons
xx-general-01-18-south-african-chevrons.description: South Africa uses red and white chevron signs, and small, thin chevrons with a single arrow are common across Southern African countries.

za-provincial-licence-plate.title: Provincial Licence Plates
za-provincial-licence-plate.description: Each South African province has its own plate design; Free State plates have a greenish tint, KwaZulu-Natal plates lean bluish.

za-national-highway-map.title: National Highway Map
za-national-highway-map.description: South African N-roads appear with the letter N on signs and as blue pentagons with numbers on Google Maps.

za-r-road-number-region.title: R-Road Number Regions
za-r-road-number-region.description: Three-digit R-roads in South Africa are roughly grouped geographically.

za-telephone-area-code.title: Telephone Area Codes
za-telephone-area-code.description: South African landline numbers are 10 digits; the first three digits form the area code starting with 0.

za-a-shaped-pole-top-western-cape.title: A-Shaped Pole Tops
za-a-shaped-pole-top-western-cape.description: Poles with three bars forming an "A" shape appear almost exclusively in Western Cape.

za-wide-a-shaped-pole-top-eastern-cape.title: Wide A-Shaped Pole Tops
za-wide-a-shaped-pole-top-eastern-cape.description: A wider version of A-shaped poles with bottom insulators attached directly to the A-frame appears in Eastern Cape.

za-trident-pole-top-kwazulu-natal.title: Trident Pole Tops
za-trident-pole-top-kwazulu-natal.description: Three-pronged trident pole tops are nearly unique to KwaZulu-Natal.

za-alternating-horizontal-insulator-nort.title: Alternating Horizontal Insulators
za-alternating-horizontal-insulator-nort.description: Three alternating insulators projecting horizontally from the pole top are concentrated in Limpopo, Gauteng, North West, and Mpumalanga.

za-chevron-pole-top-northeast.title: Chevron Pole Tops
za-chevron-pole-top-northeast.description: Two diagonal bars forming a "<" shape are found mostly in Limpopo and North West.

za-metal-arm-pole-top-mpumalanga.title: Metal-Arm Pole Tops
za-metal-arm-pole-top-mpumalanga.description: One or two metal arms holding insulators are most common in Mpumalanga.

za-red-sign-back-sticker.title: Red Sign-Back Stickers
za-red-sign-back-sticker.description: Square red stickers on the rear of road signs appear frequently in Eastern Cape and nearby parts of Northern Cape and Free State.

za-white-chevron-back-sticker.title: White Chevron-Back Stickers
za-white-chevron-back-sticker.description: White stickers on the rear of chevron signs are common in the Cape provinces.

za-grainy-pink-pavement-limpopo.title: Grainy Pink Pavement
za-grainy-pink-pavement-limpopo.description: A coarse, slightly pinkish road surface reminiscent of Texas pavement.

za-bird-nest-pole-northern-cape.title: Bird Nests on Poles
za-bird-nest-pole-northern-cape.description: Large communal bird nests atop utility poles are frequent in northern Northern Cape.

za-dry-northeast-landscape.title: Dry Northeast Landscape
za-dry-northeast-landscape.description: Arid terrain with orange-red soil and shrub-covered hills or mountains characterises the northeast.

za-rocky-mountain-western-cape.title: Rocky Mountains
za-rocky-mountain-western-cape.description: Treeless rocky mountains with tall, steep sides and sharp peaks are distinctive to Western Cape.

za-vineyard-western-cape.title: Vineyards
za-vineyard-western-cape.description: Vineyards concentrate in coastal valleys of Western Cape, with clusters near Upington in Northern Cape.

za-red-soil-desert-northern-cape.title: Red Soil Desert
za-red-soil-desert-northern-cape.description: Dry expanses of red soil typify the Northern Cape interior.

za-sugarcane-kwazulu-natal.title: Sugarcane
za-sugarcane-kwazulu-natal.description: Sugarcane fields line much of the KwaZulu-Natal coast and patches along the Mpumalanga–Mozambique border.

za-cook-pine-tree-southeast-coast.title: Cook Pine Trees
za-cook-pine-tree-southeast-coast.description: Distinctively tall Cook pines grow mainly between East London and Durban along the southeastern coast.

za-pine-plantation-near-eswatini.title: Pine Plantations
za-pine-plantation-near-eswatini.description: Commercial pine plantations are concentrated west of Eswatini and in parts of southern KwaZulu-Natal.

za-grassy-rolling-hill-western-cape-coas.title: Grassy Rolling Hills
za-grassy-rolling-hill-western-cape-coas.description: Green rolling grassland stretches between Cape Town and George, usually with tall ridges visible to the north or east.

za-flat-subtropical-coast-mozambique-bor.title: Flat Subtropical Coast
za-flat-subtropical-coast-mozambique-bor.description: Noticeably flat terrain with lush green subtropical vegetation near the Mozambique border.

za-metropolitan-m-route.title: Metropolitan M-Routes
za-metropolitan-m-route.description: In South Africa, major urban roads are designated with the letter M.

za-informal-pole-advert-gauteng.title: Informal Pole Adverts
za-informal-pole-advert-gauteng.description: Poles and public infrastructure around Gauteng are often plastered with informal advertisements.

za-country-flag.title: Country Flag
za-country-flag.description: The national flag of South Africa is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

es-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
es-licence-plate.description: Standard elongated white EU plates with a single blue strip on the left edge.

es-bollard.title: Bollards
es-bollard.description: Hollow posts with a yellow-orange reflector on the front; rear has two small white dots or is blank.

es-ladder-wooden-pole.title: Ladder Poles and Wooden Poles
es-ladder-wooden-pole.description: Common poles include concrete 'ladder' poles with step-like indentations and plain wooden poles.

es-french-style-pole-top.title: French-Style Pole Tops
es-french-style-pole-top.description: Pole tops have an inverted-triangle with a gently upward-curving horizontal crossbar.

xx-general-01-60-road-markers.title: General 01 60 Road Markers
xx-general-01-60-road-markers.description: Distance markers along Spanish roads are recognisable by their colourful borders and the road number printed at the top.

es-guardrail.title: Guardrails
es-guardrail.description: Spain uses rounded guardrails with yellow reflectors.

es-stop-sign-font.title: Stop Sign Font
es-stop-sign-font.description: Spanish stop signs use a distinctively small typeface for 'STOP'.

es-sign-red-border.title: Sign Red Borders
es-sign-red-border.description: The red border on warning and prohibition signs runs right to the edge with no white outline.

es-flat-signpost.title: Flat Signposts
es-flat-signpost.description: Nearly all traffic signs, kilometre markers, and chevrons are mounted on flat-profile signposts.

xx-road-signs-01-01-spanish-chevrons.title: Road Signs 01 01 Spanish Chevrons
xx-road-signs-01-01-spanish-chevrons.description: In Spain, you can find both black and white chevrons and blue and white chevrons.

es-direction-sign.title: Direction Signs
es-direction-sign.description: Wayfinding signs have a white background with multi-coloured road number boxes; motorways use blue.

es-dashed-outer-road-line.title: Dashed Outer Road Lines
es-dashed-outer-road-line.description: Some rural roads feature dashed edge lines; many still use solid edge lines.

es-spanish-language.title: Spanish Language
es-spanish-language.description: Spanish is dominant; the letter Ñ is exclusive to Spanish.

es-street-name-calle.title: Street Name: Calle
es-street-name-calle.description: 'Calle' is the standard Spanish word for street on urban signs.

es-vado-permanente-sign.title: Vado Permanente Signs
es-vado-permanente-sign.description: 'Vado permanente' no-parking plaques are mounted on garage doors and gates.

es-landscape-diversity.title: Landscape Diversity
es-landscape-diversity.description: Spain's scenery ranges from lush forests and plateaus to semi-deserts and mountains.

es-mediterranean-climate.title: Mediterranean Climate
es-mediterranean-climate.description: Most of the country has a dry Mediterranean climate reflected in vegetation and agriculture.

es-regional-road-code.title: Regional Road Codes
es-regional-road-code.description: Road markers carry region-specific letter codes; national roads use codes like E, AP, A, R, and N.

es-telephone-area-code.title: Telephone Area Codes
es-telephone-area-code.description: Landline numbers start with 9 plus a two-digit regional code; mobiles start with 6.

es-catalan-language.title: Catalan Language
es-catalan-language.description: Catalan is used in Catalonia, Valencian Community, and Balearic Islands; identified by 'i' for 'and' and grave accents.

es-catalan-street-name-carrer.title: Catalan Street Name: Carrer
es-catalan-street-name-carrer.description: 'Carrer' is the Catalan word for street on signs in Catalonia and the Balearics.

es-gual-permanent-sign.title: Gual Permanent Signs
es-gual-permanent-sign.description: 'Gual permanente' signs are common in Catalonia and the Balearic Islands.

es-basque-language.title: Basque Language
es-basque-language.description: Basque is a language isolate spoken in the Basque Country and northern Navarre with distinctive Z and K usage.

es-basque-street-name-kalea.title: Basque Street Name: Kalea
es-basque-street-name-kalea.description: 'Kalea' is the Basque word for street; Spanish 'calle' is also common.

es-basque-bilingual-sub-sign.title: Basque Bilingual Sub-Signs
es-basque-bilingual-sub-sign.description: Road signs often have bilingual plates with a black border; Basque usually on top in Basque Country.

es-galician-language.title: Galician Language
es-galician-language.description: Galician is closely related to Portuguese, spoken in Galicia, distinguishable by Ñ and no Ç.

es-galician-street-name-rua.title: Galician Street Name: Rúa
es-galician-street-name-rua.description: 'Rúa' is the Galician word for street, often accented.

es-galician-town-name-article.title: Galician Town Name Articles
es-galician-town-name-article.description: Galician place names often start with articles A, O, As, or Os.

es-regional-flag-andalusia.title: Andalusia Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-andalusia.description: Green-white-green horizontal stripes with a central coat of arms.

es-regional-flag-aragon.title: Aragón Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-aragon.description: Four red stripes on yellow with coat of arms on the hoist side.

es-regional-flag-asturias.title: Asturias Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-asturias.description: Sky blue field with a yellow Cross of the Victory in the centre.

es-regional-flag-balearic-islands.title: Balearic Islands Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-balearic-islands.description: Four red stripes on yellow with a purple canton containing a white castle.

es-regional-flag-basque-country.title: Basque Country Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-basque-country.description: Red field with green diagonal cross behind a white upright cross.

es-regional-flag-canary-islands.title: Canary Islands Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-canary-islands.description: Three vertical stripes of white, blue, and yellow with a central coat of arms.

es-regional-flag-cantabria.title: Cantabria Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-cantabria.description: Two horizontal stripes of white over red with a coat of arms in the upper hoist.

es-regional-flag-castile-la-mancha.title: Castilla-La Mancha Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-castile-la-mancha.description: Two vertical halves: red with yellow castle on hoist, white on fly.

es-regional-flag-castile-and-leon.title: Castile and León Regional Flag
es-regional-flag-castile-and-leon.description: Chequered pattern of yellow castles on red and purple lions on white in 2x2 layout.

es-regional-flag-catalonia.title: Catalonia Flag
es-regional-flag-catalonia.description: Four horizontal red stripes on a yellow field (the Senyera), displayed throughout Catalonia.

es-regional-flag-extremadura.title: Extremadura Flag
es-regional-flag-extremadura.description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white, black with the coat of arms in the centre, displayed throughout Extremadura.

es-regional-flag-galicia.title: Galicia Flag
es-regional-flag-galicia.description: White field with a diagonal blue stripe and the coat of arms in the centre, displayed throughout Galicia.

es-regional-flag-la-rioja.title: La Rioja Flag
es-regional-flag-la-rioja.description: Four horizontal stripes of red, white, green, yellow with the coat of arms in the centre, displayed throughout La Rioja.

es-regional-flag-madrid.title: Madrid Flag
es-regional-flag-madrid.description: Red field with seven five-pointed white stars arranged in a 4-3 pattern, displayed throughout Madrid.

es-regional-flag-murcia.title: Murcia Flag
es-regional-flag-murcia.description: Red field with four yellow castles in the upper hoist and seven crowns in the lower fly, displayed throughout Murcia.

es-regional-flag-navarre.title: Navarre Flag
es-regional-flag-navarre.description: Red field with golden chains radiating from a central emerald coat of arms, displayed throughout Navarre.

es-regional-flag-valencia.title: Valencia Flag
es-regional-flag-valencia.description: Four horizontal red stripes on yellow with a blue vertical band on the hoist containing a crown and heraldic motifs, displayed throughout Valencia.

es-catalan-independence-flag.title: Catalan Independence Flag
es-catalan-independence-flag.description: An unofficial flag in Catalan-speaking areas, based on the red-and-yellow striped Senyera pattern.

es-topography.title: Topography
es-topography.description: Spain is mountainous with major ranges like the Pyrenees, Sierra Nevada, Cantabrian Mountains, Iberian System, and Sierra Morena. The Meseta Central is a high plateau. Four main rivers define drainage basins.

es-green-northern-coast.title: Green Northern Coast
es-green-northern-coast.description: The far north is lush with rolling hills, hedgerows, and verdant meadows.

es-pyrenees.title: Pyrenees
es-pyrenees.description: Mountain range along the French border with light-grey rock faces, pine forests, and stone-walled architecture.

es-pyrenean-pine-forest.title: Pyrenean Pine Forests
es-pyrenean-pine-forest.description: Dense tall pine forests cover much of the Pyrenees and smaller hills in the Basque Country or Navarre.

es-castilla-leon-flatland.title: Castilla y León Flatlands
es-castilla-leon-flatland.description: Broad, gently undulating agricultural plain dominated by cereal crops and occasional sunflower fields.

es-la-rioja-vineyard.title: La Rioja Vineyards
es-la-rioja-vineyard.description: Vineyards flanked by mountain ranges to the north and south indicate La Rioja.

es-aragon-ebro-semi-desert.title: Aragón Ebro Semi-Desert
es-aragon-ebro-semi-desert.description: Semi-arid terrain with sandy soil and low scrubby vegetation along the Ebro basin from Navarre through Aragón.

es-aragon-arid-plain.title: Aragón Arid Plains
es-aragon-arid-plain.description: Flat, parched terrain in central and southern Aragón with pale rocky or red earth soil.

es-castilla-la-mancha.title: Castilla la Mancha
es-castilla-la-mancha.description: Flat terrain with common vineyards and olive plantations, especially in western provinces.

es-holm-cork-oak-extremadura.title: Holm and Cork Oaks (Extremadura)
es-holm-cork-oak-extremadura.description: Open pastures with widely spaced holm and cork oaks, typical of Extremadura and surroundings.

es-murcia-arid-landscape.title: Murcia Arid Landscape
es-murcia-arid-landscape.description: Sandy soil, medium mountains, and roadside plantations of small fruit and olive trees around Murcia.

es-murcia-hazy-mountain.title: Murcia Hazy Mountains
es-murcia-hazy-mountain.description: Bare, rugged mountains often seen through hazy mist in Murcia and southern Alicante.

es-sierra-nevada.title: Sierra Nevada
es-sierra-nevada.description: Snow-capped peaks visible from November through May. Sierra Nevada is the only mountain range in southern Spain that carries snow for most of the year.

es-malaga-white-village.title: Málaga White Villages
es-malaga-white-village.description: Settlements composed entirely of white-painted houses cascading down mountain slopes are a quintessential sight along the southern coast near Málaga.

es-olive-tree.title: Olive Trees (General)
es-olive-tree.description: Olive cultivation is widespread across more than half of Spain.

es-massive-olive-plantation.title: Massive Olive Plantations (Córdoba/Jaén)
es-massive-olive-plantation.description: Vast olive groves over rolling hills concentrated around Córdoba and Jaén.

es-olive-plantation-south-madrid.title: Olive Plantations
es-olive-plantation-south-madrid.description: Olive groves on flat terrain is common south of Madrid.

es-olive-plantation-east-coast.title: Olive Plantations (East Coast)
es-olive-plantation-east-coast.description: East-coast olive groves enclosed by fences or stone walls with visible mountains nearby.

es-eucalyptus-plantation-north-coast.title: Eucalyptus Plantations (North Coast)
es-eucalyptus-plantation-north-coast.description: Eucalyptus plantations line the entire northern coast, especially abundant in Galicia.

es-eucalyptus-dry-environment.title: Eucalyptus in Dry Environments
es-eucalyptus-dry-environment.description: Eucalyptus in arid areas likely places you in Huelva province or nearby.

es-orange-plantation-east-coast.title: Orange Plantations (East Coast)
es-orange-plantation-east-coast.description: Orange groves on the Mediterranean coast from Valencia southward, in small valleys with mountains to the west.

es-orange-plantation-guadalquivir-basin.title: Orange Plantations (Guadalquivir Basin)
es-orange-plantation-guadalquivir-basin.description: Orange orchards on open, flat terrain in the Guadalquivir river basin.

es-corn-field.title: Corn Fields
es-corn-field.description: Corn cultivated in major river basins, northern coast, and northwest Castilla y León.

es-stone-pine.title: Stone Pines
es-stone-pine.description: Pinus pinea has a compact, bulbous crown wider than tall. Flat forests dominated by stone pines are common near Valladolid and Huelva.

es-aleppo-pine.title: Aleppo Pines
es-aleppo-pine.description: Pinus halepensis has a looser, irregular crown. It is the most prevalent pine along the east coast and Balearic Islands.

es-baltic-pine-scots-pine.title: Baltic Pines
es-baltic-pine-scots-pine.description: Pinus sylvestris grows tall and slender with dark bark that sheds near the top to reveal orange-red wood. The lower trunk is usually branchless. Found mainly in the Pyrenees, Sierra de Guadarrama, and the Iberian System.

es-maritime-pine-atlantic-variant.title: Maritime Pines (Atlantic)
es-maritime-pine-atlantic-variant.description: Near the Atlantic coast, Pinus pinaster shows grey bark with red undertones and fluffy upward-pointing branches. Mature trees lose their lower branches.

es-maritime-pine-mediterranean-variant.title: Maritime Pines (Mediterranean)
es-maritime-pine-mediterranean-variant.description: Away from the Atlantic, Pinus pinaster has grey, deeply fissured bark with red tones. Found in mountain ranges across central and southern Spain.

es-regional-road-line-style.title: Regional Road Line Styles
es-regional-road-line-style.description: Small road markings vary by region with solid or dashed edge lines and varied centre lines.

es-kilometre-marker-shape.title: Kilometre Marker Shapes
es-kilometre-marker-shape.description: Marker posts are rectangular or square, roughly splitting the country. Andalusia's are extra tall, Madrid's show the regional flag, Biscay's have semi-circular tops.

es-kilometre-marker-border-colour.title: Kilometre Marker Border Colours
es-kilometre-marker-border-colour.description: Border colours correspond to road size: orange for large, green for medium, yellow for small roads.

es-galician-concello-sign.title: Galician Concello Signs
es-galician-concello-sign.description: Town entry signs in Galicia feature a green or blue strip at the top displaying the municipality name. The word 'Concello' (municipality) is exclusive to this region.

es-asturias-bus-stop.title: Asturias Bus Stops
es-asturias-bus-stop.description: Red bus stop posts bearing the CTA logo at the top are specific to Asturias.

es-asturias-cogersa-bin.title: Asturias COGERSA Bins
es-asturias-cogersa-bin.description: Rubbish and recycling containers marked with the COGERSA logo are recognisable even from a distance and indicate Asturias.

es-asturias-yellow-snow-pole.title: Asturias Yellow Snow Poles
es-asturias-yellow-snow-pole.description: Yellow roadside poles with one or two reflectors are unique to Asturias, typically found in the mountainous south of the region.

es-aragon-bollard.title: Aragón Bollard
es-aragon-bollard.description: Short, flat rectangular white stick with grey reflectors on both sides common on Aragón regional roads.

es-corrugated-round-signpost.title: Corrugated Round Signposts
es-corrugated-round-signpost.description: Round corrugated-metal signposts are common in Catalonia, the Basque Country, and the Balearic Islands.

es-catalan-hunting-sign.title: Catalan Hunting Signs
es-catalan-hunting-sign.description: Signs reading 'Àrea privada de Caça' mark private hunting grounds in Catalonia and sometimes the Balearics.

es-lleida-tarragona-bollard.title: Lleida/Tarragona Bollard
es-lleida-tarragona-bollard.description: A bollard with a square orange reflector on the front and a white reflector on the back is almost exclusive to the provinces of Lleida and Tarragona on the mainland.

es-catalan-single-arrow-chevron.title: Catalan Single-Arrow Chevrons
es-catalan-single-arrow-chevron.description: Large square chevron boards with a single directional arrow are common in Catalonia.

es-murcia-red-arrow-chevron.title: Murcia Red-Arrow Chevrons
es-murcia-red-arrow-chevron.description: Small square chevrons with a red arrow on a white background are exclusive to the region of Murcia.

es-madrid-bus-stop.title: Madrid Bus Stops
es-madrid-bus-stop.description: Round-topped red bus stop posts and green inter-urban buses indicate the Community of Madrid. Blue urban buses operate within the city centre.

es-extremadura-green-top-bollard.title: Extremadura Green-Top Bollards
es-extremadura-green-top-bollard.description: Standard Spanish bollards capped with a green top are exclusive to Extremadura.

es-castilla-la-mancha-stone-marker.title: Castilla la Mancha Stone Markers
es-castilla-la-mancha-stone-marker.description: Low stone markers with the regional coat of arms, blue left side and unpainted right side, line field boundaries.

es-rectangular-mesh-pole.title: Rectangular Mesh Poles
es-rectangular-mesh-pole.description: Steel lattice poles with rectangular cross-sections are concentrated in southern Spain, especially Murcia and southern Alicante.

es-andalusia-green-stripe-sign.title: Andalusia Green-Stripe Signs
es-andalusia-green-stripe-sign.description: Regional government signs have a green stripe along the left edge; smaller green-posted versions appear near nature reserves.

es-andalusia-snow-pole.title: Andalusia Snow Poles
es-andalusia-snow-pole.description: Blue-and-yellow snow marker poles unique to Andalusia.

es-slate-roof-northwest.title: Slate Roofs (Northwest)
es-slate-roof-northwest.description: Nearly black slate roofing dominates northwestern Spain, western Galicia, the Pyrenees near Andorra, and mountains northeast of Madrid.

es-galician-concrete-block-house.title: Galician Concrete Block Houses
es-galician-concrete-block-house.description: Large concrete blocks, sometimes textured like stone, are common building material in Galicia.

es-galician-granary-horrero.title: Galician Granaries
es-galician-granary-horrero.description: Elongated raised granaries called 'hórreos gallegos' or 'cabazos' are characteristic of Galician farms.

es-asturian-granary-horrero.title: Asturian Granaries
es-asturian-granary-horrero.description: Asturian hórreos are larger, squarer, elevated on four pillars; 'panera' variant sits on six or eight supports. Slate roofs indicate western Asturias.

es-basque-white-house.title: Basque White Houses
es-basque-white-house.description: Large white-rendered houses with exposed timber frames are typical of the Basque Country, Basque Navarre, and Cantabria.

es-catalan-masia.title: Catalan Masías
es-catalan-masia.description: Traditional stone farmhouses, usually isolated or in small clusters, common in Catalonia, eastern Aragón, and parts of the Valencian Community.

es-white-house-town-south.title: White House Towns
es-white-house-town-south.description: Entire towns of whitewashed houses are common in Andalusia and Extremadura.

es-asturias-black-car.title: Asturias Black Car
es-asturias-black-car.description: A black vehicle with no antenna and a visible brake light is associated with Asturias.

es-balearic-island-landscape.title: Balearic Islands Landscape
es-balearic-island-landscape.description: Coastal Mediterranean feel with dry Aleppo pine forests on hillsides and small agricultural patches of fruit and olive trees.

es-balearic-rock-wall.title: Balearic Rock Walls
es-balearic-rock-wall.description: Low dry-stone walls are extremely prevalent throughout the Balearic Islands.

es-balearic-architecture.title: Balearic Architecture
es-balearic-architecture.description: White-painted houses with gently inclined tile roofs are the norm; some have flat roofs.

es-formentera.title: Formentera
es-formentera.description: A small, low-lying island characterised by coastal scrubland. The mountains of neighbouring Ibiza are often visible from the north shore.

es-mallorca-mountain.title: Mallorca Mountains
es-mallorca-mountain.description: A tall mountain range runs along northwestern Mallorca and is visible from much of the island. No other Balearic island has peaks of comparable size.

es-canary-island-location.title: Canary Islands Location
es-canary-island-location.description: A Spanish archipelago off Africa's west coast, far from mainland Spain.

es-canary-island-landscape.title: Canary Islands Landscapes
es-canary-island-landscape.description: Diverse landscapes: volcanic mountains, pine forests, lava fields, arid zones, and Mediterranean-like countryside.

es-lanzarote-volcanic-soil.title: Lanzarote Volcanic Soil
es-lanzarote-volcanic-soil.description: Very dark exposed volcanic terrain, almost lunar in places, is more abundant on Lanzarote than on any other Canary Island.

es-fuerteventura.title: Fuerteventura
es-fuerteventura.description: An arid island with sparse vegetation. Orange-tinted soil is essentially unique to Fuerteventura within the Canary chain.

es-las-palmas-bollard.title: Las Palmas Bollard
es-las-palmas-bollard.description: Bollards with square orange front and white rear reflectors common in Las Palmas province and parts of mainland Spain.

es-lanzarote-wine-plantation.title: Lanzarote Wine Plantations
es-lanzarote-wine-plantation.description: Unique vineyards where each vine is sheltered inside a semicircular stone wall built on dark volcanic soil.

es-la-graciosa.title: La Graciosa
es-la-graciosa.description: A small, barren island north of Lanzarote with consistently overcast skies. Its two south-coast settlements consist of white, flat-roofed houses.

es-ceuta-melilla-location.title: Ceuta and Melilla
es-ceuta-melilla-location.description: Two Spanish autonomous cities on the North African coast, partially surrounded by Morocco.

es-ceuta-architecture.title: Ceuta Architecture
es-ceuta-architecture.description: North African style, flat-roofed buildings in warm tones from pale yellow to red.

es-ceuta-landscape.title: Ceuta Landscape
es-ceuta-landscape.description: Hilly Mediterranean terrain with eucalyptus and pine trees outside the urban core.

es-ceuta-black-white-guardrail.title: Ceuta Black-and-White Guardrails
es-ceuta-black-white-guardrail.description: Guardrails painted in alternating black and white are unique to Ceuta within Spain.

es-melilla.title: Melilla
es-melilla.description: North African architecture similar to Ceuta, with hazy, desaturated, and overcast imagery.

es-camino-santiago.title: Camino de Santiago
es-camino-santiago.description: Pilgrim routes marked by a yellow scallop shell on a blue background on signs and road surfaces.

es-castilla-la-mancha-spring-coverage.title: Castilla la Mancha Spring
es-castilla-la-mancha-spring-coverage.description: Early spring imagery showing dirt farm tracks between bright green fields and bare vineyards on red soil.

es-ap-15-navarra-bollard.title: AP-15 Navarra Bollards
es-ap-15-navarra-bollard.description: Flat bollards with square red reflectors, accompanied by guardrails also fitted with red reflectors. Unlike the yellow reflectors seen elsewhere in Spain.

es-barcelona-taxi.title: Barcelona Taxis
es-barcelona-taxi.description: Black cars with yellow doors, the yellow extends to the boot lid as well.

es-ebro-delta.title: Ebro Delta
es-ebro-delta.description: An exceptionally flat landscape of rice paddies and water channels. Significant mountains are visible to the south, west, and north.

es-almeria-greenhouse.title: Almería Greenhouses
es-almeria-greenhouse.description: Dense clusters of white-roofed greenhouses fill the lowland between Almería and Motril, particularly around the town of El Ejido.

es-bilbao-street-sign.title: Bilbao Street Signs
es-bilbao-street-sign.description: Street name plaques in Bilbao are set inside an ornate decorative frame not found elsewhere in Spain.

es-donana-national-park-car-meta.title: Doñana National Park Car Meta
es-donana-national-park-car-meta.description: A unique vehicle type appears on coverage southwest of Seville within the Doñana National Park.

es-country-flag.title: Country Flag
es-country-flag.description: The national flag of Spain is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

lk-language-01-sinhala-writing.title: Language 01 Sinhala Writing
lk-language-01-sinhala-writing.description: The written Sri Lankan language Sinhala have letters that are very round. Some letter makes it look like there are small doodle characters among us.

xx-general-01-43-sri-lanka-poles.title: General 01 43 Sri Lanka Poles
xx-general-01-43-sri-lanka-poles.description: Sri Lanka commonly uses concrete utility poles with large see through holes in the lower half, often called holey poles

lk-waystone.title: Waystones
lk-waystone.description: Tall white concrete posts have an indented base section with a yellow road number.

lk-road-line-edge.title: Road Lines (Edge Only)
lk-road-line-edge.description: Rural roads often have white edge lines but no centre line.

lk-tropical-landscape.title: Tropical Landscape
lk-tropical-landscape.description: Lush green tropical vegetation dominates, with a patchwork of cultivated fields.

lk-tiled-roof.title: Tiled Roofs
lk-tiled-roof.description: Houses frequently have orange or red tile roofs that weather to brownish tones.

lk-buddhism.title: Buddhism
lk-buddhism.description: Temples, stupas, Buddha statues, and Buddhist flags are common.

lk-other-religion.title: Other Religions
lk-other-religion.description: Hinduism, Islam, and Christianity have distinct regional strongholds.

lk-tuk-tuk.title: Tuk-Tuks
lk-tuk-tuk.description: Sri Lankan tuk-tuks are bulky with a black roof, typically painted green, yellow, or red.

lk-area-code.title: Area Codes
lk-area-code.description: Sri Lankan landline numbers are 10 digits, starting with a 0 area code. Mobile numbers begin with 07.

lk-religious-distribution-map.title: Religious Distribution
lk-religious-distribution-map.description: Buddhism dominates most of Sri Lanka except the north and east coast. Hinduism is strongest in the north, east, and around Nuwara Eliya. Islam is along the east coast. Christianity clusters in the northwest around Mannar.

lk-tamil-script-distribution.title: Tamil Script Distribution
lk-tamil-script-distribution.description: Tamil script appears in Hindu-majority areas: north, east, and central Nuwara Eliya. Tamil-only signs indicate Tamil-majority areas.

lk-topography.title: Topography
lk-topography.description: Hills and mountains are concentrated in central-southern Sri Lanka; the rest is relatively flat.

lk-wet-southwest-climate.title: Wet Southwest Climate
lk-wet-southwest-climate.description: The southwest receives more rainfall, producing dense, deep-green vegetation.

lk-drier-climate-elsewhere.title: Drier Climate Elsewhere
lk-drier-climate-elsewhere.description: Outside the wet southwest, the landscape is more open and scrubby with mixed brown and green tones.

lk-tea-plantation.title: Tea Plantations
lk-tea-plantation.description: Bright-green shrubs planted in neat rows on hillsides, concentrated in central and southwestern highlands, especially west of Nuwara Eliya.

lk-country-flag.title: Country Flag
lk-country-flag.description: The national flag of Sri Lanka is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

sj-barren-arctic-landscape.title: Barren Arctic Landscape
sj-barren-arctic-landscape.description: Treeless mountains with moss and grasses; often overcast sky.

sj-russian-language-sign.title: Russian Language on Signs
sj-russian-language-sign.description: Russian text appears on some signs.

sj-longyearbyen.title: Longyearbyen
sj-longyearbyen.description: Svalbard's largest settlement, characterised by boxy, minimalistic buildings.

sj-pyramiden.title: Pyramiden
sj-pyramiden.description: An abandoned-feeling settlement with Soviet-style apartment blocks and little human activity. Pyramidal mountains are visible in the distance.

sj-barentsburg.title: Barentsburg
sj-barentsburg.description: The most desolate of Svalbard's three settlements. Multi-coloured apartment blocks sit near the hilltop, and coverage is notably more overcast and gloomy.

sj-nw-spitsbergen-national-park-ship.title: NW Spitsbergen National Park Ship
sj-nw-spitsbergen-national-park-ship.description: A large ship circles the Northwest Spitsbergen National Park. Coverage darkens toward the east as the sun sets.

sj-wooden-deck-boat.title: Wooden-Deck Boat
sj-wooden-deck-boat.description: A boat with a wooden deck can be found at specific locations around the archipelago.

sj-country-flag.title: Country Flag
sj-country-flag.description: The national flag of Svalbard and Jan Mayen is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-59-tall-grass.title: General 01 59 Tall Grass
xx-general-01-59-tall-grass.description: Eswatini features stretches of tall grass.

sz-dark-brown-wooden-poles.title: Dark Brown Wooden Poles
sz-dark-brown-wooden-poles.description: Eswatini's utility poles are dark brown wood with side-mounted insulators.

sz-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
sz-licence-plate.description: Eswatini plates are long with a green bottom section.

sz-western-highland-grassland.title: Western Highland Grasslands
sz-western-highland-grassland.description: Montane grasslands with golden grass and mountainous backdrop characterise the western highlands.

sz-pine-tree-plantations.title: Pine Tree Plantations
sz-pine-tree-plantations.description: Commercial pine plantations occur in select western areas.

sz-central-south-dark-green-region.title: Central-South Dark Green Region
sz-central-south-dark-green-region.description: Area with dark green vegetation and tall wooded mountains.

sz-eastern-flatlands.title: Eastern Flatlands
sz-eastern-flatlands.description: Eswatini's eastern lowlands have flat terrain with distant mountains.

sz-sugarcane-eastern-border.title: Sugarcane Along the Eastern Border
sz-sugarcane-eastern-border.description: Sugarcane is cultivated near the eastern boundary with Mozambique.

sz-country-flag.title: Country Flag
sz-country-flag.description: The national flag of Eswatini is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

se-licence-plate.title: Licence Plates
se-licence-plate.description: Swedish plates are long and white with a blue EU strip; taxi plates have a yellow background.

se-swedish-language.title: Swedish Language
se-swedish-language.description: Swedish is a North Germanic language with the letters Å, Ä, and Ö.

se-white-road-line.title: White Road Lines
se-white-road-line.description: All road markings in Sweden are white.

se-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
se-utility-pole.description: Swedish wooden utility poles often have a small black metal cap on top.

se-lamp-mounting-wooden-pole.title: Lamp Mounting on Wooden Poles
se-lamp-mounting-wooden-pole.description: Lamps on Swedish wooden poles are mounted slightly below the top with a double-bolt arrangement.

se-electricity-marker.title: Electricity Markers
se-electricity-marker.description: Wooden electricity markers with a blue and white stripe at the top are unique to Sweden.

se-directional-sign.title: Directional Signs
se-directional-sign.description: Most Swedish directional signs are blue with white text and an arrow, while yellow signs with black text are typically used for smaller local destinations.

se-warning-road-sign.title: Warning Road Signs
se-warning-road-sign.description: Swedish warning and regulatory signs have a red border with a yellow background.

se-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
se-chevron-sign.description: Swedish chevrons feature yellow arrows on a blue background.

se-meeting-place-sign.title: Meeting Place Signs
se-meeting-place-sign.description: Blue signs with a large white M indicate designated meeting places on smaller roads.

se-striped-signpost-marking.title: Striped Signpost Markings
se-striped-signpost-marking.description: Swedish signposts often have coloured striped markings, commonly blue-and-white or red-and-yellow.

se-red-yellow-road-infrastructure.title: Red-and-Yellow Road Infrastructure
se-red-yellow-road-infrastructure.description: Road infrastructure and work signs in Sweden are often painted red and yellow.

se-street-name-suffix.title: Street Name Suffixes
se-street-name-suffix.description: Swedish street names often end in "vägen" or "gatan," abbreviated as "v" and "g" on signs.

se-landscape-overview.title: Landscape Overview
se-landscape-overview.description: Sweden has boreal forests, farmlands, lakes, mountainous north and west, and flatter south and east.

se-traditional-wooden-fence.title: Traditional Wooden Fences
se-traditional-wooden-fence.description: Traditional fences use thin vertical tree trunks with diagonal trunks stacked on top.

se-volvo-car.title: Volvo Cars
se-volvo-car.description: Volvo is the most popular car brand, nearly 30% of passenger vehicles.

se-swedish-church-flag.title: Swedish Church Flag
se-swedish-church-flag.description: The church flag has a red cross on yellow with a crown in the centre.

se-broad-leafed-tree.title: Broad-Leafed Trees
se-broad-leafed-tree.description: Broad-leafed trees grow naturally only in southern Sweden and increase further south.

se-fern.title: Ferns
se-fern.description: Ferns are mostly in southern and central Sweden, occasionally further north along the east coast.

se-treeless-mountain-top.title: Treeless Mountain Tops
se-treeless-mountain-top.description: Mountains with bare, treeless summits are found exclusively in northwestern Sweden.

se-far-north-boreal-vegetation.title: Far-North Boreal Vegetation
se-far-north-boreal-vegetation.description: Thin, sparse boreal trees growing on sandy soil are characteristic of Sweden's far north.

se-beech-forest.title: Beech Forests
se-beech-forest.description: Beech forests have barren floors carpeted with brown leaves and are restricted to southern Sweden.

se-rock-wall.title: Rock Walls
se-rock-wall.description: Stone walls are mainly found in southern Sweden, especially along coasts, Öland, and Gotland.

se-exposed-rock-west-coast.title: Exposed Rocks on the West Coast
se-exposed-rock-west-coast.description: Rounded, exposed rocky outcrops with low vegetation are common along the Swedish west coast.

se-skane-open-agricultural-landscape.title: Skåne's Open Agricultural Landscape
se-skane-open-agricultural-landscape.description: Skåne features open farmland with scattered trees and diverse crops.

se-lake-malaren-landscape.title: Lake Mälaren Landscape
se-lake-malaren-landscape.description: Around Lake Mälaren, flat terrain has medium fields, forests in the background, and small tree clusters in fields.

se-vastergotland-ostergotland-farmland.title: Västergötland and Östergötland Farmlands
se-vastergotland-ostergotland-farmland.description: Flat, open farmland with abundant wind turbines and distant forest lines.

se-halland-west-coast-landscape.title: Halland West Coast Landscape
se-halland-west-coast-landscape.description: Flat fields with small, round forested hills and lush vegetation characterize Halland's west coast.

se-northern-coastal-farmland.title: Northern Coastal Farmland (Umeå–Luleå)
se-northern-coastal-farmland.description: Flat, small-to-medium agricultural fields near the coast between Umeå and Luleå.

se-jamtland-hillside-farmland.title: Jämtland Hillside Farmlands
se-jamtland-hillside-farmland.description: Large farmlands on wide, steep hillsides around Lake Storsjön, usually covered in grass.

se-high-coast-landscape.title: High Coast Landscape (Västernorrland)
se-high-coast-landscape.description: Forested, rocky mountains surround winding agricultural valleys in the High Coast area.

se-sodermanland-valley-field.title: Södermanland Valley Fields
se-sodermanland-valley-field.description: Medium to small agricultural fields run through small valleys lined with forests.

se-white-sand-gotland.title: White Sand on Gotland
se-white-sand-gotland.description: White sand is often visible alongside roads on Gotland, especially northern parts and Fårö.

se-red-dirt-road.title: Red Dirt Roads
se-red-dirt-road.description: Unpaved roads with red soil appear mainly in Dalarna and parts of Kalmar, Norrbotten, and Västerbotten.

se-grey-dirt-road-northern-jamtland.title: Grey Dirt Roads in Northern Jämtland
se-grey-dirt-road-northern-jamtland.description: Deep grey dirt roads bordered by low green grass are common in northern Jämtland.

se-oland-island-landscape.title: Öland Island Landscape
se-oland-island-landscape.description: Öland is flat; the south is barren with small bushes, the north lusher with larger bushes and trees.

se-birch-row-north-coast.title: Birch Rows Along the North Coast
se-birch-row-north-coast.description: Long rows of thin birch trees line urban streets in northern coastal towns.

se-grey-metal-roof.title: Grey Metal Roofs
se-grey-metal-roof.description: Grey metal roofing on houses becomes more common further north in Sweden.

se-skane-wooden-gable-triangle.title: Skåne Houses with Wooden Gable Triangles
se-skane-wooden-gable-triangle.description: Houses in Skåne often have white stone or red brick walls with coloured wooden triangles on gables.

se-half-timbered-house.title: Half-Timbered Houses
se-half-timbered-house.description: Half-timbered architecture is mainly found in southern Skåne and parts of Halland.

se-red-brick-house-skane.title: Red Brick Houses in Skåne
se-red-brick-house-skane.description: Many older single-family homes in Skåne are built from red brick.

se-corrugated-metal-roof-moss.title: Corrugated Metal Roof Panels with Moss
se-corrugated-metal-roof-moss.description: Square corrugated metal roofs with moss are typical in southern Sweden, especially Skåne and Blekinge.

se-diamond-tiled-roof.title: Diamond-Tiled Roofs
se-diamond-tiled-roof.description: Grey diamond-shaped roof tiles are mainly found in Skåne, Blekinge, Öland, and sometimes Gotland.

se-light-coloured-house-west-coast.title: Light-Coloured Houses on the West Coast
se-light-coloured-house-west-coast.description: The west coast has many white and light yellow houses, especially between Gothenburg and Norway.

se-red-fishing-shed-west-coast.title: Red Fishing Sheds on the West Coast
se-red-fishing-shed-west-coast.description: Dense rows of small red sheds are typical in coastal towns along the northern west coast.

se-dalarna-wooden-craftsmanship-architec.title: Dalarna Wooden Craftsmanship Architecture
se-dalarna-wooden-craftsmanship-architec.description: Central Dalarna features red timbered houses, log portals, and distinctive "härbren" storage buildings.

se-halsingland-farmhouse.title: Hälsingland Farmhouses
se-halsingland-farmhouse.description: Hälsingland has large red farmhouses with many windows and long grand facades.

se-octagonal-leaning-wall-shed.title: Octagonal and Leaning-Wall Sheds
se-octagonal-leaning-wall-shed.description: Northern coastal agricultural sheds are octagonal or rectangular with outward-leaning red-painted log walls.

se-gotland-limestone-architecture.title: Gotland Limestone Architecture
se-gotland-limestone-architecture.description: Gotland houses are often limestone with dirty white facades; churches have grey or white walls with grey corners and small windows.

se-oland-uneven-stone-brick.title: Öland Uneven Stone Brick
se-oland-uneven-stone-brick.description: Uneven, irregular stone bricks characterize houses and rock walls on Öland.

se-58-blekinge.title: Blekinge Bus Stop Sign

se-red-tinted-paved-road-dalarna.title: Red-Tinted Roads in Dalarna
se-red-tinted-paved-road-dalarna.description: Paved roads in western Dalarna often have a pronounced reddish colour.

se-green-snow-pole-umea.title: Green Snow Poles Near Umeå
se-green-snow-pole-umea.description: Green snow poles occasionally appear around Umeå.
