se-wedge-shaped-bollard-southern-sweden.description: Wedge-shaped bollards like those in Germany are common in southern Sweden.

se-cylindrical-bollard.title: Cylindrical Bollards
se-cylindrical-bollard.description: Cylindrical bollards with a horizontal black section near the top appear near the west coast, Värmland, and southern Dalarna.

se-flat-bollard-northern-sweden.title: Flat Bollards in Northern Sweden
se-flat-bollard-northern-sweden.description: Flat bollards or cylindrical bollards with a black reflector rectangle appear on major roads in northern Sweden.

se-skane-blue-red-striped-bollard.title: Skåne Blue/Red-Striped Bollards
se-skane-blue-red-striped-bollard.description: Small white bollards with blue or red strips near the top are found in rural Skåne.

se-railway-crossing-sign-id.title: Railway Crossing Sign ID Numbers
se-railway-crossing-sign-id.description: The back of railway crossing signs has a yellow sticker with a 5-digit ID; the first digit indicates region.

se-place-name-ending.title: Place Name Endings
se-place-name-ending.description: Certain place name suffixes are region-specific, useful for pinpointing locations.

se-sami-bilingual-sign.title: Sámi Bilingual Signs
se-sami-bilingual-sign.description: Bilingual Sámi and Swedish signs appear in northern Sweden's inland areas.

se-meankieli-language-sign.title: Meänkieli Language Signs
se-meankieli-language-sign.description: Meänkieli appears on signs near the Finnish border, often on river names ending in "väylä."

se-area-code-phone-number.title: Area Codes on Phone Numbers
se-area-code-phone-number.description: Swedish landlines start with 3–4 digit area codes; the first two digits follow a regional pattern.

se-mistletoe-lake-malaren.title: Mistletoe Near Lake Mälaren
se-mistletoe-lake-malaren.description: Mistletoe grows mainly near Lake Mälaren, especially in Västerås.

se-orchard-kivik.title: Orchards Near Kivik
se-orchard-kivik.description: Most of Sweden's large orchards are around Kivik on Skåne's east coast.

se-slag-stone-building-bergslagen.title: Slag Stone Buildings
se-slag-stone-building-bergslagen.description: Buildings partly or fully made from blue or green slag stone appear in Bergslagen.

se-wooden-windmill-oland.title: Wooden Windmills on Öland
se-wooden-windmill-oland.description: Numerous small grey or red wooden windmills dot Öland, which has the most windmills in Sweden.

se-local-city-bus-stop-sign.title: Local City Bus Stop Signs
se-local-city-bus-stop-sign.description: Many cities and towns have unique local bus stop sign designs.

se-neon-yellow-school-bus-stop-sign.title: Neon-Yellow School Bus Stop Signs
se-neon-yellow-school-bus-stop-sign.description: Bright neon-yellow school bus stop signs are common in Linköping, Norrköping, and Jönköping.

se-kungsbacka-bus-stop-blue-stripe.title: Kungsbacka Bus Stops with Blue Stripes
se-kungsbacka-bus-stop-blue-stripe.description: Bus stops with three blue stripes indicate Kungsbacka municipality.

se-tram.title: Trams

se-black-bus-shelter-vasteras-umea.title: Black Bus Shelters in Västerås and Umeå

se-stockholm-street-sign.title: Stockholm Street Signs

se-gothenburg-blue-street-sign.description: Gothenburg uses distinctive blue street signs across the entire city. They almost always feature two lines of text.

se-malmo-street-sign.title: Malmö Street Signs
se-malmo-street-sign.description: Malmö uses somewhat old-looking white street signs with black corners found throughout the city.

se-ystad-street-sign.title: Ystad Street Signs
se-ystad-street-sign.description: Street signs in Ystad resemble those in Malmö but have a yellow background instead of white.

se-vellinge-blue-street-sign.title: Vellinge Blue Street Signs
se-vellinge-blue-street-sign.description: Vellinge uses blue street signs similar to Gothenburg's but usually with one line of text.

se-falkoping-yellow-street-sign.title: Falköping Yellow Street Signs
se-falkoping-yellow-street-sign.description: Plain yellow street signs are distinctive to Falköping.

se-dalarna-dialect-street-name.title: Dalarna Dialect Street Names

ch-yellow-zebra-crossing.title: Yellow Zebra Crossings

ch-high-alpine-south.title: High Alpine South
ch-high-alpine-south.description: Southern cantons have tall, rugged Alpine peaks with deep valleys.

ch-modest-northern-hills.title: Modest Northern Hills
ch-modest-northern-hills.description: Northern cantons feature gentler terrain with modest hills and lower mountains.

ch-jura-mountains.title: Jura Mountains

ch-jura-limestone-outcrop.title: Jura Limestone Outcrops
ch-jura-limestone-outcrop.description: Bare limestone rock faces jutting from wooded hillsides are typical of the Jura mountains.

ch-rock-wall.title: Rock Walls

ch-italian-style-architecture-ticino.title: Italian-Style Architecture
ch-italian-style-architecture-ticino.description: Orange-yellow walls, terracotta roofs, and Italian shutters indicate Ticino.

ch-bernese-arch-house.title: Bernese Arch Houses
ch-bernese-arch-house.description: Bern farmhouses have massive roofs with undersides curving into a pronounced arch.

ch-northeastern-timber-framing.title: Northeastern Timber Framing
ch-northeastern-timber-framing.description: Ornate, often red timber-framed buildings are typical of northeastern Switzerland.

ch-appenzell-house-style.title: Appenzell House Style
ch-appenzell-house-style.description: Appenzell houses join living quarters to barns at a 90° roof angle with facades subdivided into window-framing squares.

ch-graubunden-stone-house.title: Graubünden Stone Houses
ch-graubunden-stone-house.description: Graubünden houses are stone-built with white painted motifs around windows and edges.

ch-vaud-oversized-town-sign.title: Vaud Oversized Town Signs

ch-basel-landschaft-olive-green-infrastr.title: Basel-Landschaft Olive Green Infrastructure

ch-valais-wooden-bollard.title: Valais Wooden Bollards

ch-glarus-fence-reflector.title: Glarus Fence Reflectors

ch-geneva-bike-path-symbol.title: Geneva Bike Path Symbol

ch-road-divider-type.title: Road Divider Types

ch-other-fruit-tree-area.title: Other Fruit Tree Areas

ch-country-flag.title: Country Flag

tw-white-edge-lines-no-centre.title: White Edge Lines Without Centre Lines
tw-white-edge-lines-no-centre.description: Roads with only white edge lines and no centre marking are common in Taiwan.

tw-black-yellow-chevrons.title: Black-on-Yellow Chevrons

tw-orange-hooded-mirrors.title: Orange-Hooded Mirrors
tw-orange-hooded-mirrors.description: Convex road mirrors with bright orange hoods are common at Taiwanese intersections and bends.

tw-concrete-drainage-ditches.title: Concrete Drainage Ditches
tw-concrete-drainage-ditches.description: Open concrete drainage channels run alongside many Taiwanese roads.

tw-distribution-transformers.title: Distribution Transformers
tw-distribution-transformers.description: Box-shaped distribution transformers, usually dark green or grey, appear frequently in Taiwanese urban areas.

tw-architecture.title: Architecture
tw-architecture.description: Taiwanese residential buildings range from cramped multi-storey to flat single-storey homes, often boxy with white tile walls and light-green tin sheds.

tw-county-map-offshore-islands.title: County Map and Offshore Islands
tw-county-map-offshore-islands.description: Taiwan includes distant island groups: Kinmen, Lienchiang, Penghu, Green Island, and Orchid Island.

tw-telephone-area-codes.title: Telephone Area Codes
tw-telephone-area-codes.description: Taiwanese phone numbers have two-digit area codes (02–08) increasing from north to south. Mobile numbers start with 09.

tw-national-freeway-system.title: National Freeway System
tw-national-freeway-system.description: Taiwan's odd-numbered freeways run north–south, even-numbered run east–west, with numbers increasing west to east and north to south.

tw-township-road-signs-county.title: Township Road Signs by County
tw-township-road-signs-county.description: Taiwanese township road signs show a Chinese character indicating the county before or above the road number.

tw-blue-pole-plaques-grid-coordinates.title: Blue Pole Plaques, Grid Coordinates
tw-blue-pole-plaques-grid-coordinates.description: Blue plaques on poles encode precise coordinates with a letter for a grid rectangle and four digits for position within it.

tw-central-western-plains.title: Central Western Plains
tw-central-western-plains.description: Flat to gently rolling agricultural land dominates Taiwan's central western lowlands.

tw-central-eastern-mountains.title: Central-Eastern Mountains
tw-central-eastern-mountains.description: Forested mountains cover two-thirds of Taiwan with temperate or coniferous trees at higher elevations.

tw-hualien-taitung-valley.title: Hualien–Taitung Valley
tw-hualien-taitung-valley.description: A long, narrow north–south valley on the east coast between Hualien and Taitung, with flat plains between forested mountains.

tw-yilan-plain.title: Yilan Plain
tw-yilan-plain.description: A plain enclosed by mountains on three sides, featuring rice paddies and houses beside fields.

tw-kinmen-fuzzy-leaved-trees.title: Kinmen, Fuzzy-Leaved Trees
tw-kinmen-fuzzy-leaved-trees.description: Roads lined with trees bearing fuzzy foliage and red-tinged soil identify Kinmen Island.

tw-miaoli-hsinchu-low-rolling-hills.title: Miaoli and Hsinchu, Low Rolling Hills
tw-miaoli-hsinchu-low-rolling-hills.description: Gently rolling terrain with winding roads and sparse farmland.

tw-areca-palm-central-southern-taiwan.title: Areca Palms, Central and Southern Taiwan
tw-areca-palm-central-southern-taiwan.description: Areca (betel nut) palms grow extensively in mountainous areas of central and southern Taiwan.

tw-coconut-palm-southern-coast.title: Coconut Palms, Southern Coast
tw-coconut-palm-southern-coast.description: Coconut palms concentrate near the southern coast.

tw-leafless-tree-penghu.title: Leafless Trees, Penghu
tw-leafless-tree-penghu.description: Bare, leafless trees are common on Penghu.

tw-coastal-fish-farm-western-counties.title: Coastal Fish Farms, Western Counties
tw-coastal-fish-farm-western-counties.description: Cultivated fish ponds line the western coast from Yunlin to Pingtung.

tw-tea-plantation.title: Tea Plantations
tw-tea-plantation.description: Tea plantations appear in mountainous areas, especially Chiayi, Nantou, Hsinchu, and Miaoli.

tw-areca-palm-plantation-pingtung.title: Areca Palm Plantations, Pingtung
tw-areca-palm-plantation-pingtung.description: Neat rows of areca palms on flat plains characterize Pingtung County.

tw-dense-urban-housing-northern-taiwan.title: Dense Urban Housing, Northern Taiwan
tw-dense-urban-housing-northern-taiwan.description: Older, disorganized housing and tall, dingy apartment blocks are common in northern urban areas.

tw-red-brick-building-taoyuan.title: Red Brick Buildings, Taoyuan
tw-red-brick-building-taoyuan.description: Red brick and red tile apartment buildings are frequent in Taoyuan.

tw-luxury-villa-yilan.title: Luxury Villas, Yilan
tw-luxury-villa-yilan.description: Multi-storey, often gated villas characterize parts of Yilan.

tw-cream-coloured-house-penghu.title: Cream-Coloured Houses, Penghu
tw-cream-coloured-house-penghu.description: White-tinged cream-colored residential buildings are common on Penghu.

tw-traditional-house-kinmen.title: Traditional Houses, Kinmen
tw-traditional-house-kinmen.description: Small traditional-style houses with characteristic rooflines appear on Kinmen.

tw-lamppost-location-sticker.title: Lamppost Location Stickers
tw-lamppost-location-sticker.description: Stickers on lampposts encode location data, similar to blue pole plaques on utility poles.

tw-white-speckled-pavement-east-coast.title: White-Speckled Pavement, East Coast
tw-white-speckled-pavement-east-coast.description: Road surfaces with visible white speckles are common along the eastern coast.

tw-red-white-striped-lamppost-kinmen.title: Red-and-White Striped Lampposts, Kinmen
tw-red-white-striped-lamppost-kinmen.description: Lampposts with diagonal red-and-white stripes appear frequently on Kinmen.

tw-trapezoidal-base-lamppost-kaohsiung.title: Trapezoidal-Base Lampposts, Kaohsiung
tw-trapezoidal-base-lamppost-kaohsiung.description: Lampposts with red-and-white stripes on a trapezoidal base are prevalent in Kaohsiung.

tw-thick-pole-top-support-yunlin.title: Thick Pole-Top Supports, Yunlin
tw-thick-pole-top-support-yunlin.description: Utility poles with thicker-than-usual supports below the pole top are found in Yunlin.

tw-green-square-sticker-chiayi-city.title: Green Square Stickers, Chiayi City
tw-green-square-sticker-chiayi-city.description: Green square stickers appear on nearly every pole in Chiayi City.

tw-bent-chevron-holder-southern-counties.title: Bent Chevron Holders, Southern Counties
tw-bent-chevron-holder-southern-counties.description: Curved sign and chevron holders with black-and-yellow-striped stickers appear in Pingtung, Kaohsiung, and Taitung.

tw-country-flag.title: Country Flag
tw-country-flag.description: The national flag of Taiwan is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

tz-extremely-limited-coverage.title: Extremely Limited Coverage
tz-extremely-limited-coverage.description: Tanzania has very sparse coverage: trekkers in Gombe National Park, some on Mount Kilimanjaro, and spill coverage from the Kenyan border.

tz-country-flag.title: Country Flag
tz-country-flag.description: The national flag of Tanzania is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

th-road-01-driving-direction.title: Driving direction
th-road-01-driving-direction.description: In Thailand they drive on the left side of the road.

th-bollard.title: Bollards
th-bollard.description: Thai bollards are square with a pointed top and painted in alternating black-and-white stripes.

th-concrete-road.title: Concrete Roads
th-concrete-road.description: Paved concrete surfaces in Thailand typically display a large square-tile pattern.

th-utility-pole.title: Utility Poles
th-utility-pole.description: Thai utility poles are square-profiled concrete with a vertical row of small pinholes up the shaft.

th-language-01-small-circles.title: Language 01 Small Circles
th-language-01-small-circles.description: In the written Thai language there is a lot of small circles on the letters.

th-yellow-centre-line.title: Yellow Centre Lines
th-yellow-centre-line.description: Thai road centre markings are yellow, either solid or dashed lines.

th-street-light-pole-marking.title: Street Light Pole Markings
th-street-light-pole-marking.description: The base of street light poles is painted with red-and-black or black-and-white stripes.

th-overhanging-lamp-post.title: Overhanging Lamp Posts
th-overhanging-lamp-post.description: Thai lamp posts are long and slender, arcing outward over the roadway.

th-directional-road-sign.title: Directional Road Signs
th-directional-road-sign.description: Minor-road directional signs are white with two stacked panels; highways have green signs often with romanised names.

th-road-signs-01-stop-signs.title: Road Signs 01 Stop Signs
th-road-signs-01-stop-signs.description: In Thailand the stop signs are written in Thai.

th-garuda-road-marker.title: Garuda Road Markers
th-garuda-road-marker.description: Thai route-number markers feature a white or black Garuda symbol; national routes are white-and-black shields, provincial routes blue-and-yellow.

th-green-village-sign.title: Green Village Signs
th-green-village-sign.description: Distinctive small green signs are widespread, especially in rural villages.

th-black-utility-box-province-code.title: Black Utility Boxes with Province Codes
th-black-utility-box-province-code.description: Small black boxes on utility infrastructure display a three-letter province code in two formats.

th-muslim-community-deep-south.title: Muslim Communities
th-muslim-community-deep-south.description: Islamic culture is concentrated in Thailand's southernmost provinces with mosques and Jawi script.

th-flat-dry-landscape.title: Flat and Dry Landscapes
th-flat-dry-landscape.description: Two regions north and east of Bangkok are noticeably flat and arid.

th-tall-mountain-northwest.title: Tall Mountains in the Northwest
th-tall-mountain-northwest.description: High mountain terrain is concentrated in northwestern Thailand.

th-low-forested-mountain-centre-north.title: Low Forested Mountains
th-low-forested-mountain-centre-north.description: Gently rounded, densely forested hills appear in the centre-north of the country.

th-exposed-rock-mountain.title: Exposed Rock Mountains
th-exposed-rock-mountain.description: Steep, rocky mountain faces with exposed rock are mostly in western Thailand and the southern peninsula.

th-red-soil.title: Red Soil
th-red-soil.description: Reddish earth is most prevalent in the northeast (Isan).

th-rubber-plantation.title: Rubber Plantations
th-rubber-plantation.description: Rubber tree plantations are concentrated in the south, identifiable by black tapping cups near trunks.

th-rice-cultivation-zone.title: Rice Cultivation Zone
th-rice-cultivation-zone.description: Most of Thailand's rice farming takes place within the highlighted region.

th-dry-season-rice-central-plains.title: Dry-Season Rice
th-dry-season-rice-central-plains.description: Dry-season rice is common on the central plains, often with hazy skies from wildfire smoke.

th-wet-season-rice-eastern-plains.title: Wet-Season Rice
th-wet-season-rice-eastern-plains.description: Wet-season rice paddies are concentrated in the eastern lowlands.

th-palm-oil-plantation.title: Palm Oil Plantations
th-palm-oil-plantation.description: Palm oil plantations are heavily concentrated on the southern peninsula.

th-short-coconut-palm-plantation.title: Short Coconut Palm Plantations
th-short-coconut-palm-plantation.description: Dense groves of short to medium coconut palms are common west of Bangkok.

th-palmyra-palm.title: Palmyra Palms
th-palmyra-palm.description: Large clusters of palmyra palms are typical of the eastern peninsula coast and far south.

th-sugar-cane-field.title: Sugar Cane Fields
th-sugar-cane-field.description: Sugar cane cultivation is mainly in central and eastern Thailand.

th-cassava-field.title: Cassava Fields
th-cassava-field.description: Cassava, a shrubby plant with hand-shaped leaves, is common on central and northeastern plains.

th-corn-field.title: Corn Fields
th-corn-field.description: Maize cultivation is concentrated in northern and central regions.

th-durian-plantation.title: Durian Plantations
th-durian-plantation.description: Durian orchards near Chanthaburi and the peninsula have cone-shaped young trees and mature trees with dark bark and pointed leaves.

th-pineapple-plantation.title: Pineapple Plantations
th-pineapple-plantation.description: Pineapple farms are concentrated southeast and southwest of Bangkok.

th-teak-tree.title: Teak Trees
th-teak-tree.description: Teak grows mainly in the north, recognizable by large leaves and yellow flowers.

th-pine-tree-tenasserim-pine.title: Pine Trees (Tenasserim Pine)
th-pine-tree-tenasserim-pine.description: Pinus latteri is found almost exclusively in the north and northwest.

th-garden-croton.title: Garden Croton
th-garden-croton.description: Garden croton is an ornamental shrub with vivid yellow, orange, and red foliage, thriving around Ranong and coastal provinces.

th-gray-corrugated-metal-roof.title: Gray Corrugated Metal Roofs
th-gray-corrugated-metal-roof.description: Gray corrugated metal roofing is most frequent in northern and southern regions.

th-indented-utility-pole-bangkok.title: Indented Utility Poles
th-indented-utility-pole-bangkok.description: Poles with a Chilean-style vertical indent are typical near Bangkok.

th-wind-turbine.title: Wind Turbines
th-wind-turbine.description: Wind farms are on western flanks of Chaiyaphum and Nakhon Ratchasima, and eastern coast in Songkhla and Nakhon Si Thammarat.

th-insulator-7-plus-ridges.title: Insulators with 7+ Ridges
th-insulator-7-plus-ridges.description: Power-line insulators with seven or more ridges appear in the southern peninsula and highways in Chiang Rai and Phayao.

th-single-insulator-crossbar.title: Single Insulator on Crossbar
th-single-insulator-crossbar.description: Poles with one insulator on the crossbar are found from Ranong and Chumphon southward.

th-two-insulator-crossbar.title: Two Insulators on Crossbar
th-two-insulator-crossbar.description: Poles with two insulators on the crossbar are common outside the southern peninsula.

th-country-flag.title: Country Flag
th-country-flag.description: The national flag of Thailand is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

tn-olive-tree-plantation.title: Olive Tree Plantations
tn-olive-tree-plantation.description: Neatly arranged rows of olive trees on raked, weed-free soil frequently line Tunisian roads.

tn-white-road-line.title: White Road Lines
tn-white-road-line.description: Tunisian roads typically have white road lines.

tn-white-directional-sign.title: White Directional Signs
tn-white-directional-sign.description: Tunisian directional signs have a white background with town names in Arabic and Latin script.

tn-traditional-blue-paint-building.title: Traditional Blue Paint on Buildings
tn-traditional-blue-paint-building.description: Doors, windows, gates, and other architectural elements are sometimes painted in a distinctive traditional blue.

tn-red-white-striped-kerb.title: Red-and-White Striped Kerbs
tn-red-white-striped-kerb.description: Red-and-white striped kerbs are common on Tunisian roads.

tn-concrete-road-marker-coloured-top.title: Concrete Road Markers with Coloured Tops
tn-concrete-road-marker-coloured-top.description: White concrete markers with rounded red, yellow, or green tops are found throughout Tunisia.

tn-bilingual-stop-sign.title: Bilingual Stop Signs
tn-bilingual-stop-sign.description: Tunisian stop signs feature both Arabic and Latin text.

tn-light-green-toyota-follow-car-north.title: Light Green Toyota Follow Car
tn-light-green-toyota-follow-car-north.description: A light green Toyota follow car appears throughout northern Tunisia, never seen south of Hammamet.

tn-dark-green-mazda-follow-car-hammamet-.title: Dark Green Mazda Follow Car
tn-dark-green-mazda-follow-car-hammamet-.description: The dark green Mazda is Tunisia's most common follow car, found from Hammamet south to Djerba, with a military licence plate featuring a red strip on the left.

tn-multiple-follow-car-tunis.title: Multiple Follow Cars in Tunis
tn-multiple-follow-car-tunis.description: Follow cars in the capital Tunis vary, but most of them are carrying a red beacon on the roof.

tn-country-flag.title: Country Flag
tn-country-flag.description: The national flag of Tunisia is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

tr-european-licence-plates-blue-strip.title: European-Style Licence Plates
tr-european-licence-plates-blue-strip.description: Turkish licence plates are white, elongated European format with a blue vertical strip on the left.

tr-mixed-white-yellow-road-lines.title: Mixed White and Yellow Road Lines
tr-mixed-white-yellow-road-lines.description: In Turkey, road markings vary between white and yellow, sometimes mixed on the same stretch.

tr-divided-highways-prevalence.title: Prevalence of Divided Highways
tr-divided-highways-prevalence.description: Turkey has a high rate of dual-carriageway roads.

tr-red-white-chevron-signs.title: Red-on-White Chevron Signs
tr-red-white-chevron-signs.description: Turkish chevron signs are red arrows on a white background, often with a neon yellow border.

tr-black-yellow-upward-chevron.title: Black-and-Yellow Upward-Arrow Chevrons
tr-black-yellow-upward-chevron.description: Intersections often have black-and-yellow chevron panels with upward-pointing arrows.

tr-narrow-red-white-chevrons.title: Narrow Red-and-White Chevrons
tr-narrow-red-white-chevrons.description: A slim Turkish chevron variant uses red-and-white colors.

tr-wide-spaced-font-direction-signs.title: Wide-Spaced Font on Direction Signs
tr-wide-spaced-font-direction-signs.description: Turkish directional signs use a typeface with large gaps between letters.

xx-general-01-39-stop-signs.title: General 01 39 Stop Signs
xx-general-01-39-stop-signs.description: In Turkey, stop signs say "DUR", which is unique to the country.

tr-ladder-mesh-metal-poles.title: Ladder and Mesh Metal Poles
tr-ladder-mesh-metal-poles.description: Metal utility poles with ladder or mesh-grid patterns are widespread in Turkey.

tr-varied-landscape-regions.title: Varied Landscape Across Regions
tr-varied-landscape-regions.description: Turkey's terrain ranges from arid southeast plains to Mediterranean coasts and greener northern forests.

tr-boxy-apartment-blocks.title: Boxy Apartment Blocks
tr-boxy-apartment-blocks.description: Tall, cube-shaped apartment buildings are common in Turkish cities and towns.

tr-interlocking-brick-pavements.title: Interlocking Brick Pavements
tr-interlocking-brick-pavements.description: Sidewalks and pedestrian areas often use interlocking bricks in a repeating shape.

tr-telephone-area-codes-region.title: Telephone Area Codes by Region
tr-telephone-area-codes-region.description: Turkish area codes rise from 2 in the west to 4 in the east, indicating general location.

tr-numbered-road-system.title: Numbered Road System (O-Roads and D-Roads)
tr-numbered-road-system.description: Major highways have 'O-' prefixes on kilometre markers; D-roads show three-digit numbers with section and kilometre counts.

tr-provincial-road-km-markers.title: Provincial Road Kilometre Markers
tr-provincial-road-km-markers.description: Provincial road markers start with two digits representing the province code.

tr-lush-green-landscape-north.title: Lush Green Landscape in the North
tr-lush-green-landscape-north.description: Northern coastal Turkey is greener and more densely forested than other regions.

tr-northeastern-treeless-grassland.title: Northeastern Treeless Grassland Valleys
tr-northeastern-treeless-grassland.description: The northeast has open valleys of grass between rounded, treeless hills.

tr-turkish-pines-mediterranean-coast.title: Turkish Pines Along the Mediterranean Coast
tr-turkish-pines-mediterranean-coast.description: Turkish pines grow mainly along the Mediterranean coast.

tr-tea-plantations-rize.title: Tea Plantations in Rize Province
tr-tea-plantations-rize.description: Terraced tea fields are a hallmark of Rize Province along the northeastern Black Sea coast.

tr-olive-trees-mediterranean-coast.title: Olive Trees on the Mediterranean Coast
tr-olive-trees-mediterranean-coast.description: Olive groves are concentrated along Turkey's Mediterranean shoreline.

tr-sunflower-fields-northwest.title: Sunflower Fields in the Northwest
tr-sunflower-fields-northwest.description: Large sunflower plantations are typical in northwestern Turkey.

tr-vineyards-east-izmir.title: Vineyards East of Izmir
tr-vineyards-east-izmir.description: Most Turkish vineyards lie inland east of Izmir.

tr-cotton-fields-sanliurfa.title: Cotton Fields Near Sanliurfa
tr-cotton-fields-sanliurfa.description: Cotton cultivation is concentrated around the city of Sanliurfa in the southeast.

tr-lake-van-semi-arid-surroundings.title: Lake Van and Its Semi-Arid Surroundings
tr-lake-van-semi-arid-surroundings.description: Turkey's largest lake sits within a semi-arid basin of dry grassy hills, with scattered trees and pockets of farmland closer to the shoreline.

tr-dark-volcanic-rock-sanliurfa-diyarbak.title: Dark Volcanic Rock Between Sanliurfa and Diyarbakir
tr-dark-volcanic-rock-sanliurfa-diyarbak.description: Dark basaltic rock formations are widespread in the area stretching between Sanliurfa and Diyarbakir.

tr-steep-rocky-river-valleys.title: Steep Rocky River Valleys
tr-steep-rocky-river-valleys.description: Deep river gorges with rocky cliffs occur in northeast and far southeast Turkey.

tr-flat-roofs-southeast.title: Flat Roofs in the Southeast
tr-flat-roofs-southeast.description: Flat-roofed buildings dominate southeastern Turkey and parts of the southern coast.

tr-metal-roofs-east.title: Metal Roofs in the East
tr-metal-roofs-east.description: Sheet metal roofing is common in eastern Turkey.

tr-yellow-black-chevrons-balikesir-kars.title: Yellow-on-Black Chevrons (Balikesir and Kars)
tr-yellow-black-chevrons-balikesir-kars.description: Yellow arrows on black chevrons appear mainly around Balikesir and Kars provinces.

tr-black-yellow-chevrons-north-izmir.title: Black-on-Yellow Chevrons North of Izmir
tr-black-yellow-chevrons-north-izmir.description: Black arrows on yellow chevrons are common north of Izmir.

tr-divided-highways-no-physical-divider.title: Divided Highways Without Physical Dividers
tr-divided-highways-no-physical-divider.description: Four-lane highways separated only by painted double lines occur mostly in eastern Turkey.

tr-vertical-water-tanks.title: Vertical Water Tanks
tr-vertical-water-tanks.description: Upright cylindrical water tanks are common throughout most of Turkey.

tr-stacked-horizontal-vertical-water-tan.title: Stacked Horizontal-on-Vertical Water Tanks
tr-stacked-horizontal-vertical-water-tan.description: A horizontal tank atop a vertical tank is typical along the south coast extending inland toward Elazig.

tr-square-water-tanks-angled-corners.title: Square Water Tanks with Angled Corners
tr-square-water-tanks-angled-corners.description: Boxy water tanks with bevelled corners appear in the southern zone between Iskenderun and Sanliurfa.

tr-white-spherical-water-tanks-batman.title: White Spherical Water Tanks Near Batman
tr-white-spherical-water-tanks-batman.description: White ball-shaped water tanks cluster in the southeast, south of Batman.

tr-six-digit-pole-codes-european-turkey.title: Six-Digit Pole Codes
tr-six-digit-pole-codes-european-turkey.description: In European Turkey, utility poles carry a six-digit code below the yellow electrical warning sign.

tr-ankara-street-signs-blue-round-top.title: Ankara Province Street Signs
tr-ankara-street-signs-blue-round-top.description: Street name plates in Ankara Province are blue with a small semicircular cap at the top.

tr-izmir-street-signs-curved-dark-blue.title: Izmir Province Street Signs
tr-izmir-street-signs-curved-dark-blue.description: Izmir street signs are dark blue, convex, and usually feature the white Izmir emblem at the top.

tr-greenhouses-west-adana.title: Greenhouses West of Adana
tr-greenhouses-west-adana.description: Dense clusters of greenhouses mark the southern coast west of Adana.

tr-whitewashed-buildings-bodrum.title: Whitewashed Buildings Around Bodrum
tr-whitewashed-buildings-bodrum.description: Bodrum features whitewashed flat-roofed buildings often accented with blue trim or natural stonework.

tr-cappadocia-rock-formations-goreme.title: Cappadocia Rock Formations in Goreme
tr-cappadocia-rock-formations-goreme.description: The town of Goreme, located west of Kayseri, is unmistakable thanks to towering sandstone pillars with ancient cave dwellings carved into their faces.

tr-mount-ararat-agri-dagi.title: Mount Ararat (Agri Dagi)
tr-mount-ararat-agri-dagi.description: Turkey's highest peak is a dormant volcano in the far east, often visible with a smaller cone (Kucuk Agri).

tr-banana-plants-alanya.title: Banana Plants Near Alanya
tr-banana-plants-alanya.description: Banana plantations are localised around the coastal city of Alanya.

tr-light-blue-tourist-signs-bozcaada.title: Light-Blue Tourist Signs on Bozcaada Island
tr-light-blue-tourist-signs-bozcaada.description: Bozcaada island uses distinctive light-blue and grey tourist information signs, shaped either as arrows or as rectangles with a rounded top.

tr-istanbul-street-sign-arrow.title: Istanbul Street Sign Arrow Indicator
tr-istanbul-street-sign-arrow.description: Red street name plates with a coloured bottom strip are used in multiple Turkish cities. A white arrow in the lower-right corner pointing in both directions with a single arrowhead is a strong indicator of Istanbul specifically.

tr-red-oval-street-signs-trabzon-yalvac.title: Red Oval Street Signs in Trabzon and Yalvac
tr-red-oval-street-signs-trabzon-yalvac.description: Trabzon and Yalvac share a distinctive red, oval-shaped street sign design. House number plates follow the same styling.

tr-green-street-signs-bursa.title: Green Street Signs in Bursa
tr-green-street-signs-bursa.description: Bursa's street name plates are green with slightly raised lettering, giving the surface a textured, three-dimensional feel.

tr-green-borderless-street-signs-bolu.title: Green Borderless Street Signs in Bolu
tr-green-borderless-street-signs-bolu.description: Street signs in Bolu are also green, but they are completely flat and have no border or frame around the edges.

tr-country-flag.title: Country Flag
tr-country-flag.description: The national flag of Turkey is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

ug-palm-tree-north.title: Palm Trees in the North
ug-palm-tree-north.description: Palm trees in Ugandan coverage indicate the northern section of Murchison Falls.

ug-water-filled-crater.title: Water-Filled Craters
ug-water-filled-crater.description: Large water-filled craters appear in the northern coverage of the park.

ug-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ug-country-flag.description: The national flag of Uganda is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-50-red-car.title: General 01 50 Red Car
xx-general-01-50-red-car.description: In Ukraine, you will most often see the back of a red Google car.

ua-poor-road-quality.title: Poor Road Quality
ua-poor-road-quality.description: Ukraine has some of the worst roads in Europe, with rural roads full of potholes and cracks.

ua-ukrainian-cyrillic-script.title: Ukrainian Cyrillic Script
ua-ukrainian-cyrillic-script.description: Ukrainian uses Cyrillic with unique letters: Є є, Ґ ґ, І і, and Ї ї.

ua-word-street-vul.title: Word for Street, вулиця (vul.)
ua-word-street-vul.description: The Ukrainian word for street is вулиця, abbreviated вул.

ua-word-city-m.title: Word for City, місто (m.)
ua-word-city-m.description: The Ukrainian word for city is місто, abbreviated м.

ua-white-town-entry-sign.title: White Town Entry Signs
ua-white-town-entry-sign.description: Ukrainian town entry signs are white.

ua-square-concrete-utility-pole.title: Square Concrete Utility Poles
ua-square-concrete-utility-pole.description: Ukraine uses square concrete utility poles with various tops, sometimes white-painted bases.

ua-diagonal-pole-support-beam.title: Diagonal Pole Support Beams
ua-diagonal-pole-support-beam.description: Utility poles often have diagonal support beams.

ua-wooden-pole-concrete-base.title: Wooden Poles with Concrete Bases
ua-wooden-pole-concrete-base.description: Wooden utility poles with concrete bases appear in Ukraine.

ua-red-chevron-white-arrow.title: Red Chevrons with White Arrows
ua-red-chevron-white-arrow.description: Ukrainian chevrons are red with white arrows.

ua-three-stripe-pedestrian-sign.title: Three-Stripe Pedestrian Signs
ua-three-stripe-pedestrian-sign.description: Pedestrian crossing signs show three stripes.

ua-black-white-guardrail.title: Black-and-White Guardrails
ua-black-white-guardrail.description: Guardrails and barriers are often painted black and white.

ua-soviet-era-apartment-block.title: Soviet-Era Apartment Blocks
ua-soviet-era-apartment-block.description: Cities feature large Soviet-era apartment blocks of light grey brick or concrete prefab.

ua-rundown-suburban-home.title: Rundown Suburban Homes
ua-rundown-suburban-home.description: Suburbs have vegetated areas with single-family brick houses, corrugated roofs, fenced yards, and mostly unpaved roads.

ua-typical-rural-scenery.title: Typical Rural Scenery
ua-typical-rural-scenery.description: Rural Ukraine has poor roads, flat to hilly terrain, roadside trees, open farmland, little infrastructure, and low traffic.

ua-summer-coverage.title: Summer Coverage
ua-summer-coverage.description: Most Ukrainian coverage was shot in summer.

ua-tall-poplar-tree.title: Tall Poplar Trees
ua-tall-poplar-tree.description: Tall, columnar poplar trees are common across Ukraine.

ua-ultra-rural-track-near-city.title: Ultra-Rural Tracks Near Cities
ua-ultra-rural-track-near-city.description: Ultra-rural dirt tracks near cities appear commonly in Ukraine.

ua-oblast-internet-domain.title: Oblast Internet Domains
ua-oblast-internet-domain.description: Oblast-specific second-level domains (e.g. .te.ua) appear on signs and are mostly intuitive.

ua-carpathian-mountain.title: Carpathian Mountains
ua-carpathian-mountain.description: Western Ukraine's Carpathians are hillier and forested with pine trees and curving roads.

ua-baltic-pine-forest-north.title: Baltic Pine Forests in the North
ua-baltic-pine-forest-north.description: Northern Ukraine near Belarus has forests of tall Baltic pines with orange-red bark.

ua-drier-landscape-south.title: Drier Landscape in the South
ua-drier-landscape-south.description: Southern Ukraine is warmer and drier with shrubs and open fields.

ua-blooming-sunflower-field-south-east.title: Blooming Sunflower Fields in the South and East
ua-blooming-sunflower-field-south-east.description: Blooming sunflower fields appear mainly in southern and eastern Ukraine by late July.

ua-russian-language-east-south.title: Russian Language in the East and South
ua-russian-language-east-south.description: Russian text appears in eastern and southern Ukraine with letters Ы ы and Э э.

ua-polish-style-bollard-zakarpattia.title: Polish-Style Bollards in Zakarpattia
ua-polish-style-bollard-zakarpattia.description: Bollards with red reflectors wrapping around appear in Zakarpattia Oblast.

ua-hungarian-language-border.title: Hungarian Language Near the Border
ua-hungarian-language-border.description: Near the Hungarian border, signs are bilingual or monolingual Hungarian.

ua-country-flag.title: Country Flag
ua-country-flag.description: The national flag of Ukraine is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

xx-general-01-06-emirati-road-lines.title: General 01 06 Emirati Road Lines
xx-general-01-06-emirati-road-lines.description: In the UAE, outer road lines are yellow, while the center lines can be white or yellow.

ae-arabic-english.title: Arabic and English
ae-arabic-english.description: Signage in the UAE is bilingual, with Arabic script alongside English.

ae-striped-signpost.title: Striped signposts
ae-striped-signpost.description: In the UAE, signposts often have alternating black-and-white stripes.

ae-striped-kerb.title: Striped kerbs
ae-striped-kerb.description: In the UAE, kerbs are often painted with black-and-white or black-and-yellow stripes.

ae-divided-road-roundabout.title: Divided roads
ae-divided-road-roundabout.description: Divided roads and roundabouts are very common in the UAE.

ae-electricity-pole.title: Wooden poles
ae-electricity-pole.description: Emirati utility poles are dark brown wood topped with three insulators on a horizontal metal bar.

ae-coverage-area.title: Coverage area
ae-coverage-area.description: UAE Street View coverage is concentrated in the northeast.

ae-eastern-mountain.title: Eastern mountains
ae-eastern-mountain.description: Mountains in the UAE appear only in the far east.

ae-dubai-blue-street-sign.title: Dubai street signs
ae-dubai-blue-street-sign.description: Street name signs in Dubai are blue with a thin metal border, not seen elsewhere in the UAE.

ae-country-flag.title: UAE flag
ae-country-flag.description: Horizontal stripes of green, white, and black with a vertical red band on the left.

gb-double-yellow-road-line.title: Double Yellow Road Lines
gb-double-yellow-road-line.description: Paired yellow lines along the kerbside mark no-stopping zones in towns and cities.

gb-standard-bollard.title: Standard Bollard
gb-standard-bollard.description: Squat, barrel-shaped posts with black base and cap separated by a white band; red reflector faces traffic, white faces away.

gb-wooden-pole-with-step.title: Wooden Poles with Steps
gb-wooden-pole-with-step.description: Timber utility poles have thin horizontal metal rungs bolted up one side.

gb-chevron-sign.title: Chevron Signs
gb-chevron-sign.description: Curve warning boards use white arrows on a black background.

gb-triangular-warning-sign.title: Triangular Warning Signs
gb-triangular-warning-sign.description: Warning signs are red-bordered triangles on a white background.

gb-direction-sign.title: Direction Signs
gb-direction-sign.description: Directional signs are blue (motorways), green (primary routes), and white (local roads), with 'A', 'M', or 'B' prefixes.

gb-white-street-sign.title: White Street Signs
gb-white-street-sign.description: Low-mounted white plaques with black lettering, often on two short posts; suburban versions may show cul-de-sac pictograms.

gb-give-way-sign.title: Give Way Signs
gb-give-way-sign.description: Inverted-triangle yield signs read 'GIVE WAY' in large text.

gb-pole-warning-sticker.title: Pole Warning Stickers
gb-pole-warning-sticker.description: Yellow hazard stickers on utility poles depict a human figure struck by lightning.

gb-yellow-traffic-bollard.title: Yellow Traffic Bollard
gb-yellow-traffic-bollard.description: Yellow reflective panels on traffic-island bollards indicate which side traffic should pass.

gb-square-cornered-metal-gate.title: Square-Cornered Metal Gates
gb-square-cornered-metal-gate.description: Farm gates made from tubular metal with square-angled corners.

gb-green-countryside-hedgerow.title: Green Countryside with Hedgerows
gb-green-countryside-hedgerow.description: Rural areas have green pastures, dense hedgerows lining narrow lanes, and rolling hills.

gb-red-brick-building.title: Red Brick Buildings
gb-red-brick-building.description: Red brick construction is common in residential and commercial buildings.

gb-suburban-layout.title: Suburban Layout
gb-suburban-layout.description: Residential estates have rows of near-identical semi-detached homes with manicured gardens and cul-de-sacs.

gb-chimney-pot.title: Chimney Pots
gb-chimney-pot.description: Brick chimney stacks topped with multiple cylindrical terracotta pots.

gb-black-white-timber-framing.title: Black-and-White Timber Framing
gb-black-white-timber-framing.description: Buildings feature black timber frames against white-rendered walls.

gb-country-flag.title: Country Flags
gb-country-flag.description: Flags of England, Scotland, Wales, or Northern Ireland appear on buildings or flagpoles.

gb-23-cornwall-england.title: Cornwall A-Road Numbering
gb-23-cornwall-england.description: Major A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A30, A39) on green signs with white numbers.

gb-23-devon-england.title: Devon A-Road Numbering
gb-23-devon-england.description: Main A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A38, A377) on green signs with white numbers.

gb-23-dorset-england.title: Dorset A-Road Numbering
gb-23-dorset-england.description: Primary A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A35, A354) on green signs with white numbers.

gb-23-somerset-england.title: Somerset A-Road Numbering
gb-23-somerset-england.description: Major A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A37, A361) on green signs with white numbers.

gb-23-wiltshire-england.title: Wiltshire A-Road Numbering
gb-23-wiltshire-england.description: Main A-roads start with '3' (e.g. A303, A346) on green signs with white numbers.

gb-23-gloucestershire-england.title: Gloucestershire A-Road Numbering
gb-23-gloucestershire-england.description: Major A-roads start with '4' (e.g. A40, A417) on green signs with white numbers.

gb-23-bristol-england.title: Bristol A-Road Numbering
gb-23-bristol-england.description: Primary A-roads start with '4' (e.g. A4, A432) on green signs with white numbers.

gb-23-cumbria-england.title: Cumbria A-Road Numbering
gb-23-cumbria-england.description: In Cumbria, major A-roads typically start with '6', such as A66 or A685. Signs are green with bold white digits, sometimes outlined in white.

gb-23-cheshire-england.title: Cheshire A-Road Numbering
gb-23-cheshire-england.description: Cheshire's main A-roads often begin with '5' or '6', such as A56 or A534. Signs are green with large white numbers, sometimes outlined in white.

gb-23-lancashire-england.title: Lancashire A-Road Numbering
gb-23-lancashire-england.description: Lancashire's major A-roads usually start with '5' or '6', such as A59 or A683. Signs are green with bold white numbers, sometimes outlined in white.

gb-23-greater-manchester-england.title: Greater Manchester A-Road Numbering
gb-23-greater-manchester-england.description: Greater Manchester's primary A-roads typically start with '5' or '6', such as A56 or A635. Signs are green with prominent white numbers, sometimes bordered in white.

gb-23-merseyside-england.title: Merseyside A-Road Numbering
gb-23-merseyside-england.description: Merseyside's main A-roads are generally in the '5' series, such as A580 or A5036. Signs are green with large white numbers, sometimes outlined in white.

gb-23-northern-ireland.title: Northern Ireland A-Road Numbering
gb-23-northern-ireland.description: In Northern Ireland, A-roads can start with any digit from 1 to 8, such as A1 or A6. Signs are green with white numbers, sometimes with a white border.

gb-phone-area-code.title: Phone Area Codes
gb-phone-area-code.description: Landline numbers start with 0 followed by nine or ten digits; the first two to four digits form the area code.

gb-city-name-bin.title: City Name on Bins
gb-city-name-bin.description: Public rubbish bins in urban areas often display the local council or city name.

gb-scottish-highland-landscape.title: Scottish Highlands Landscape
gb-scottish-highland-landscape.description: Open, semi-barren terrain with imposing mountains characterises the Highlands, often brown and yellow in early spring.

gb-scottish-red-white-bollard.title: Scottish Red-and-White Bollards
gb-scottish-red-white-bollard.description: Chunky, round-topped bollards with a red-and-grey reflective band encircling the post appear mainly in Scotland.

gb-scottish-passing-place-sign.title: Scottish Passing Place Signs
gb-scottish-passing-place-sign.description: Diamond-shaped white signs reading 'Passing Place' are exclusive to Scotland's single-track roads.

gb-welsh-language.title: Welsh Language
gb-welsh-language.description: Welsh appears alongside English on road signs throughout Wales, identifiable by D, W, Y, and the double-L digraph (Ll).

gb-araf-road-marking.title: 'Araf' Road Markings
gb-araf-road-marking.description: The word 'Araf' (Welsh for 'Slow') painted on roads alongside English is found only in Wales.

gb-scottish-gaelic-language.title: Scottish Gaelic Language
gb-scottish-gaelic-language.description: A Celtic language with accent marks and clusters like bh, dh, fh, mh, ai, ea, eo, and ui. Bilingual signs appear mainly north of Glasgow.

gb-cornish-palm.title: Cornish Palms
gb-cornish-palm.description: Cabbage trees (Cordyline australis), called Cornish palms, are most common along southwest England's coast and Jersey.

gb-northern-ireland-lamppost-sticker.title: Northern Ireland Lamppost Stickers
gb-northern-ireland-lamppost-sticker.description: Small black stickers with yellow text sometimes appear on street lights in Northern Ireland.

gb-london-street-sign.title: London Street Signs
gb-london-street-sign.description: London's distinctive street plaques show the road name in black lettering, with the postcode and borough name printed in red beneath.

um-albatross-everywhere.title: Albatrosses Everywhere
um-albatross-everywhere.description: Albatrosses are present in nearly every location on Midway Atoll.

um-runway-coverage.title: Runway Coverage
um-runway-coverage.description: Much of Midway Atoll coverage is on two runways, where albatrosses may be scarce.

um-other-islands-trekker-coverage.title: Other Islands, Trekker Coverage
um-other-islands-trekker-coverage.description: Islands beyond Midway have trekker coverage, low bushy vegetation, and many birds.

um-well-paved-east-west-runway.title: Well-Paved East-West Runway
um-well-paved-east-west-runway.description: A nicely paved east-west runway runs on the southern side of Midway Atoll.

um-deteriorating-north-south-runway.title: Deteriorating North-South Runway
um-deteriorating-north-south-runway.description: A north-south runway on Midway has poor pavement worsening toward the north.

um-small-village-eastern-midway.title: Small Village on Eastern Midway
um-small-village-eastern-midway.description: A small settlement is on the eastern side of Midway Atoll.

um-southeast-island.title: Southeast Island
um-southeast-island.description: The least distinctive island, with a small central lake and many birds in the sky.

um-lisianski-island-large-bush.title: Lisianski Island, Large Bushes
um-lisianski-island-large-bush.description: Lisianski Island coverage is along the shoreline, encircled by large bushes.

um-laysan-island-clear-skies.title: Laysan Island, Clear Skies
um-laysan-island-clear-skies.description: Laysan Island coverage has almost no cloud cover.

um-french-frigate-shoals-most-birds.title: French Frigate Shoals, Most Birds
um-french-frigate-shoals-most-birds.description: A long, thin island with a shabby runway and the highest bird density in the chain.

um-western-runway-corner-most-common-spa.title: Western Runway Corner, Most Common Spawn
um-western-runway-corner-most-common-spa.description: The western corner of Midway Atoll runway is a common GeoGuessr spawn location.

um-country-flag.title: Country Flag
um-country-flag.description: The national flag of the US Minor Outlying Islands is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

uy-typical-landscape-weather.title: Typical Landscape and Weather
uy-typical-landscape-weather.description: Overcast skies over open grasslands with gentle hills and occasional tree plantations.

uy-plain-white-licence-plate.title: Plain White Licence Plates
uy-plain-white-licence-plate.description: Uruguayan licence plates are plain white with black text.

uy-smudgy-camera-quality.title: Smudgy Camera Quality
uy-smudgy-camera-quality.description: Much of Uruguay's coverage has a somewhat smudgy camera quality.

xx-general-01-27-triple-road-lines.title: General 01 27 Triple Road Lines
xx-general-01-27-triple-road-lines.description: In Uruguay, you can find triple road markings, double yellow lines with a white dashed line running between them.

uy-other-road-line-pattern.title: Other Road Line Patterns
uy-other-road-line-pattern.description: Yellow-white lines and plain white lines also appear in Uruguay.

uy-other-pole-design.title: Other Pole Designs
uy-other-pole-design.description: Uruguay also features round poles with flat metal-sheet tops, square concrete poles, simple wooden poles with a single insulator, and occasionally Argentine-style poles.

uy-guardrail-support.title: Guardrail Supports
uy-guardrail-support.description: Uruguayan guardrails have small rectangular yellow or red reflectors and uniquely shaped supports.

uy-green-stone-kilometre-marker.title: Green Stone Kilometre Markers
uy-green-stone-kilometre-marker.description: Green-painted stone kilometre markers are unique to Uruguay.

uy-yellow-black-chevron.title: Yellow-and-Black Chevrons
uy-yellow-black-chevron.description: Uruguayan chevrons are yellow with black arrows.

uy-gently-hilly-terrain.title: Gently Hilly Terrain
uy-gently-hilly-terrain.description: Most of Uruguay has subtle, gentle hills despite low overall elevation. Roads almost always have at least a slight incline.

uy-reddish-soil.title: Reddish Soil
uy-reddish-soil.description: Reddish soil, from light pink to deep red, appears in many parts of Uruguay.

uy-concrete-cube-shaped-house.title: Concrete Cube-Shaped Houses
uy-concrete-cube-shaped-house.description: Many Uruguayan houses are concrete and cube-shaped, with drab, weathered walls and flat roofs.

uy-short-stocky-palm-tree.title: Short Stocky Palm Trees
uy-short-stocky-palm-tree.description: Short, stocky palm trees occasionally appear in Uruguay's countryside.

uy-widespread-cattle.title: Widespread Cattle
uy-widespread-cattle.description: Cattle outnumber people four to one, making livestock very common in rural Uruguay.

uy-elevation-difference.title: Elevation Differences
uy-elevation-difference.description: Uruguay's highest hills are near Minas east of Montevideo and north of Tacuarembo.

uy-rocky-hill-near-minas.title: Rocky Hills Near Minas
uy-rocky-hill-near-minas.description: The Minas area has some of Uruguay's tallest hills with exposed rock and heavy bushland.

uy-dark-soiled-northern-hill.title: Dark-Soiled Northern Hills
uy-dark-soiled-northern-hill.description: Northern hills have darker soil than Minas and typically lack exposed rock, with common vegetation and tree plantations.

uy-tree-plantation-north.title: Tree Plantations in the North
uy-tree-plantation-north.description: Commercial tree plantations are common, especially in northern and northwestern Uruguay.

uy-country-flag.title: Country Flag
uy-country-flag.description: The national flag of Uruguay is visible on flagpoles, official buildings, and occasionally on shop fronts or houses.

vu-location.title: Location
vu-location.description: Vanuatu is a Pacific island nation northeast of Brisbane, between the Solomon Islands, New Caledonia, and Fiji.

vu-dark-volcanic-soil.title: Dark Volcanic Soil
vu-dark-volcanic-soil.description: Vanuatu's volcanic island has dark volcanic soil frequently appearing along paths.

vu-dense-tropical-forest.title: Dense Tropical Forest
vu-dense-tropical-forest.description: Much of Vanuatu's coverage passes through dense tropical forest.

vu-black-sand-beach.title: Black Sand Beach
vu-black-sand-beach.description: A beach with black volcanic sand appears on the east side of Ambrym Island.

xx-general-01-31-vietnamese-language.title: General 01 31 Vietnamese Language
xx-general-01-31-vietnamese-language.description: The Vietnamese language is written in a modified Latin script that features an extensive system of diacritical marks.

vn-red-white-striped-signpost.title: Red-and-White Striped Signposts
vn-red-white-striped-signpost.description: Vietnamese road sign posts are usually painted with red-and-white stripes.

vn-yellow-orange-road-sign.title: Yellow-Orange Road Signs
vn-yellow-orange-road-sign.description: Vietnamese road signs have a yellow-orange background.

vn-waystone-coloured-top.title: Waystones with Coloured Tops
vn-waystone-coloured-top.description: Vietnamese waystones are white with red or blue tops, showing road numbers and distances.

vn-single-arrow-chevron.title: Single-Arrow Chevrons
vn-single-arrow-chevron.description: Vietnamese chevrons are black-on-yellow or white-on-red, typically with a single arrow.

vn-blue-directional-sign.title: Blue Directional Signs
vn-blue-directional-sign.description: Vietnamese directional signs are blue with thin or no white borders and white arrows.

vn-short-yellow-centre-dash.title: Short Yellow Centre Dashes
vn-short-yellow-centre-dash.description: Short yellow dashes as centre road lines are common and distinctive in Vietnam.

vn-concrete-block-road.title: Concrete Block Roads
vn-concrete-block-road.description: Minor Vietnamese roads are often made of concrete blocks.

vn-red-white-concrete-safety-barrier.title: Red-and-White Concrete Safety Barriers
vn-red-white-concrete-safety-barrier.description: Red-and-white striped concrete barriers are common on Vietnamese mountain roads.

vn-holey-concrete-pole.title: Holey Concrete Poles
vn-holey-concrete-pole.description: Concrete poles with rows of holes, on the lower half or nearly to the top, are common in Vietnam.

vn-round-pole-pin-hole.title: Round Poles with Pin Holes
vn-round-pole-pin-hole.description: Vietnam often has round concrete poles with indents and small pin holes near the top.

vn-inverted-trapezoid-pole-top.title: Inverted-Trapezoid Pole Tops
vn-inverted-trapezoid-pole-top.description: Pole tops shaped like upside-down trapezoids are common in Vietnam.

vn-double-pole.title: Double Poles
vn-double-pole.description: Double utility poles of various designs are fairly common in Vietnam.

vn-grain-drying-road.title: Grain Drying on Roads
vn-grain-drying-road.description: In Vietnam, grains are often spread out on road surfaces to dry.

vn-address-storefront.title: Addresses on Storefronts
vn-address-storefront.description: Vietnamese addresses appear on signs and follow a hierarchy from specific to general with key terms like phường, xã, quận, huyện, thị xã, thành phố, tỉnh.

vn-province-name-abbreviation.title: Province Names and Abbreviations
vn-province-name-abbreviation.description: Province names and abbreviations (e.g. TG for Tien Giang) are useful parts of Vietnamese addresses.

vn-area-code.title: Area Codes
vn-area-code.description: Vietnamese area codes start with 2 followed by one or two digits, generally ordered north to south.

vn-licence-plate-regional-code.title: Licence Plate Regional Codes
vn-licence-plate-regional-code.description: Vietnamese licence plate codes, often painted on trucks, help determine the region.

vn-regional-place-name-prefix.title: Regional Place Name Prefixes
vn-regional-place-name-prefix.description: Some city name prefixes are regionally specific within Vietnam.

vn-flat-agricultural-delta.title: Flat Agricultural Deltas
vn-flat-agricultural-delta.description: Wide open, flat agricultural fields are most common in the Red River Delta and less so in the Mekong Delta.

vn-mekong-delta-canal-palm-tree.title: Mekong Delta, Canals and Palm Trees
vn-mekong-delta-canal-palm-tree.description: The Mekong Delta is flat and water-rich, criss-crossed by straight canals flanked by linear villages, with abundant palms.

vn-central-highland-landscape.title: Central Highlands Landscape
vn-central-highland-landscape.description: The Central Highlands are hilly with distant mountains, red soil, and dry rolling farmland.

vn-rubber-tree-plantation.title: Rubber Tree Plantations
vn-rubber-tree-plantation.description: Rubber plantations north of Ho Chi Minh City and in the Central Highlands have thin-trunked trees often wrapped in plastic and planted in dense grids.

vn-tea-plantation.title: Tea Plantations
vn-tea-plantation.description: Vietnamese tea plantations are mainly in the north and Lam Dong province, with compact, trimmed plants in winding hillside rows.

vn-khasi-pine-northeast.title: Khasi Pines in the Northeast
vn-khasi-pine-northeast.description: Clusters of Khasi pines on hills are typical of far northeastern Vietnam, especially Lang Son and Quang Ninh provinces.

vn-dragonfruit-farm.title: Dragonfruit Farms
vn-dragonfruit-farm.description: Dragonfruit farms, resembling upturned wet mops, are found around Phan Thiet and the Long An / Tien Giang border.

vn-dry-sandy-coast-northeast-phan-thiet.title: Dry Sandy Coast Northeast of Phan Thiet
vn-dry-sandy-coast-northeast-phan-thiet.description: The coast northeast of Phan Thiet is dry and sandy with some rocky sections.

vn-black-pepper-plantation.title: Black Pepper Plantations
vn-black-pepper-plantation.description: Black pepper vines in the Central Highlands shroud tree trunks with dense downward-pointing leaves.

vn-wind-turbine-cluster.title: Wind Turbine Clusters
vn-wind-turbine-cluster.description: Wind turbines appear in several clusters mostly in southern Vietnam near Dalat, Buon Ma Thuot, Pleiku, Dong Hoi, Quy Nhon, Ho Chi Minh City, and Quang Tri.

vn-roof-spire-north.title: Roof Spires in the North
vn-roof-spire-north.description: Thin spires on house roofs are almost exclusively found in northern Vietnam.

vn-red-river-delta-tall-boxy-house.title: Red River Delta, Tall Boxy Houses
vn-red-river-delta-tall-boxy-house.description: Houses around Hanoi and the Red River Delta are tall, multi-storey with gaudy Greco-Roman details.

vn-mekong-delta-low-single-storey-house.title: Mekong Delta, Low Single-Storey Houses
vn-mekong-delta-low-single-storey-house.description: Mekong Delta houses are boxy concrete and almost always single ground-level storey.

vn-northwestern-stilt-house.title: Northwestern Stilt Houses
vn-northwestern-stilt-house.description: Traditional wooden houses in northwestern Vietnam often have stilts, corrugated metal roofs, and triangular roof gable openings.

vn-grave-agricultural-field.title: Graves in Agricultural Fields
vn-grave-agricultural-field.description: Single graves in the middle of agricultural fields are found in the Red River Delta.

vn-stick-bamboo-fence-north.title: Stick and Bamboo Fences in the North
vn-stick-bamboo-fence-north.description: Wooden fences of sticks or bamboo in a grid-like pattern appear in northern Vietnam.

vn-black-pole-sticker-northern.title: Black Pole Stickers
vn-black-pole-sticker-northern.description: Poles in northern Vietnam often have black stickers with simple designs.

vn-sand-dune-northern-khanh-hoa.title: Sand Dunes in Northern Khanh Hoa
vn-sand-dune-northern-khanh-hoa.description: A peninsula in far northern Khanh Hoa province has sand dunes hugging a mostly divided highway.

vn-hoi-an-yellow-historic-buildings.title: Hoi An Yellow Buildings
vn-hoi-an-yellow-historic-buildings.description: Hoi An is identifiable by old yellow buildings with dark brown doors and details.

vn-sa-pa-touristy-mountain-town.title: Sa Pa, Touristy Mountain Town
vn-sa-pa-touristy-mountain-town.description: Sa Pa is a resort town deep in the northern mountains, overflowing with tourist shops, restaurants with excessive signage, and grand hotel buildings mixing European and Southeast Asian styles.

vn-russian-cyrillic-signs-phan-thiet.title: Russian Cyrillic Signs Near Phan Thiet
vn-russian-cyrillic-signs-phan-thiet.description: Near the beach resorts east of Phan Thiet, most signs include Cyrillic text alongside Vietnamese, catering to Russian tourists.

vn-country-flag.title: Country Flag

xx-general-01-35-stone-buildings.title: General 01 35 Stone Buildings
